title: The structured pseudospectrum of Schwarzschild black hole
summary: The non-Hermitian nature of black hole quasinormal modes (QNMs) can give rise to remarkable spectrum instability. Such instability is naturally characterized by the pseudospectrum for the operator. However, conventional pseudospectrum analyses permit arbitrary operator perturbations that may not correspond to physically admissible modifications. In this work, we introduce the structured pseudospectrum into black hole perturbation theory. We construct two physically motivated perturbation spaces based on effective field theory and the Rezzolla--Zhidenko parametrization, and get their structured pseudospectra using two distinct norms. Our numerical results show that imposing physical constraints substantially reduces the accessible spectrum instability, especially for higher overtones. More importantly, at sufficiently small perturbation scales $\varepsilon$, the structured pseudospectrum around isolated QNMs exhibits approximately elliptical contours with preferred directions that depend on both the mode and the perturbation space, revealing an anisotropic structure beyond the familiar circular behavior of the conventional pseudospectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文将结构化伪谱（structured pseudospectrum）引入黑洞扰动理论，基于有效场论（effective field theory）与 Rezzolla–Zhidenko 参数化构造两类物理允许的扰动空间，并采用两种范数计算结构化伪谱，发现物理约束显著降低谱不稳定性，且在小扰动尺度下呈现各向异性椭圆轮廓。
AI.motivation: 黑洞准正规模（quasinormal modes, QNMs）的非厄米性（non-Hermitian nature）会导致显著的谱不稳定性，通常用伪谱（pseudospectrum）刻画；但传统伪谱分析允许任意算符扰动，这些扰动未必对应物理上允许的修改，因此需要引入受物理约束的伪谱框架。
AI.method: 引入结构化伪谱（structured pseudospectrum）到黑洞扰动理论中，基于有效场论（effective field theory）与 Rezzolla–Zhidenko 参数化构造两个有物理动机的扰动空间，并在两种不同范数（norm）下数值计算其结构化伪谱。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，施加物理约束会大幅降低可及的谱不稳定性，尤其对高阶泛音（higher overtones）更为明显；在足够小的扰动尺度 ε 下，孤立 QNM 周围的结构化伪谱呈近似椭圆轮廓（elliptical contours），其优势方向（preferred directions）依赖于模式与扰动空间，显示出超越传统伪谱圆形行为的各向异性（anisotropic）结构。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束下的结构化伪谱为黑洞准正规模的谱不稳定性提供了更贴近物理的分析框架，并揭示出传统伪谱无法捕捉的各向异性特征。

title: Reinforcement Learning in High-Energy Physics: A Survey from Accelerator Control to Theory Exploration
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a machine learning paradigm in which an agent learns a decision-making policy by interacting with an environment, guided by a scalar reward rather than explicit supervision. Supervised and unsupervised learning have become indispensable tools in high-energy physics (HEP), but they learn from fixed datasets, whereas many HEP tasks are closed-loop decisions: the data an algorithm observes depend on its choices, the feedback is sparse or delayed, and the objective is often measured on a real machine or in a stochastic simulation, not by a differentiable model. This survey reviews the application of RL to such tasks: accelerator control and feedback, data quality monitoring, jet grooming, clustering, and representation, charged particle tracking, beyond-the-Standard-Model (BSM) and string model building, detector design, trigger control, analysis, and formal quantum field theory computation. It provides a self-contained introduction to the underlying RL methods, from model-free and model-based to multi-agent, offline, inverse, and bandit approaches, reviews each domain against its traditional methods, and summarizes the head-to-head comparisons. The applications range from policies deployed on real accelerators and evaluated on recorded collision data to exploratory studies in formal theory. RL is most advantageous for repeated tasks with a fast simulator, decisions inside fast control loops, operation under faults and corrupted measurements, physics-based rewards in place of labels, and sequential discrete constructions with a reusable policy, while Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, and differentiable methods remain competitive elsewhere. We conclude with the open challenges that recur across domains, including reward design, sim-to-real transfer, safety, the lack of shared benchmarks, and the statistical validity of policy-driven decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述（survey），系统梳理了强化学习（reinforcement learning, RL）在高能物理（high-energy physics, HEP）闭环决策任务中的应用，涵盖加速器控制、触发、追踪、数据分析与形式场论计算等十余个领域。
AI.motivation: 监督与无监督学习依赖固定数据集，而许多HEP任务是闭环决策：观测数据依赖算法自身选择、反馈稀疏或延迟、目标由真实机器或随机模拟测得而非可微模型给出。RL因此成为更贴切的建模范式，但相关应用分散，缺乏系统梳理。
AI.method: 综述采用三个步骤：先提供自足的RL方法导论（从无模型、基于模型到多智能体、离线、逆向与赌博机（bandit）方法）；再按领域逐一对照传统方法评述各项应用；最后汇总正面头对头比较（head-to-head comparisons）的结果。
AI.result: 应用范围从部署于真实加速器并在实际碰撞数据上评估的策略，到形式理论中的探索性研究。RL在以下情形最具优势：有快速模拟器的重复性任务、快速控制回路内的决策、故障与测量污染下的运行、以物理量替代标签的奖励、以及可复用策略的序贯离散构造；而贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization）、遗传算法与可微方法在其他场景仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 跨领域反复出现的开放挑战包括奖励设计（reward design）、仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real transfer）、安全性、共享基准（benchmark）的缺失，以及策略驱动决策的统计有效性（statistical validity）。

title: 5d SCFTs and Intersection Theory of Generalized Toric Threefolds
summary: Five-dimensional superconformal field theories are intrinsically strongly coupled fixed points that can be realized as M-theory on local Calabi-Yau threefolds with canonical singularities. The low-energy effective theory on their extended Coulomb branch is governed by a cubic prepotential, determined by the triple intersection numbers of divisors in the resolved geometry. For toric threefolds, dual to 5-brane webs, these numbers are computed combinatorially from the toric polygon. However, no such description has been available for generalized toric polygons (GTPs), dual to 5-brane webs with 7-branes, since the corresponding generalized toric Calabi-Yau threefolds are generally non-toric. We show that the 7-brane data are encoded by additional lines in the GTP, which correspond to non-toric, non-compact divisors that we call exuberant divisors. Building on a local analysis of these divisors and on the associativity of the intersection product, we develop an algorithm that computes the triple intersection numbers, and hence the prepotential, directly from the combinatorial data of the GTP. We illustrate it in examples and provide a Mathematica code implementation of the intersection algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文针对与含7-膜（7-brane）的五膜网（5-brane web）对偶的广义环面多边形（GTP），提出由额外线段对应的“繁茂除子（exuberant divisor）”编码7-膜数据，并给出直接从GTP组合数据计算三重相交数（triple intersection numbers）与预势（prepotential）的算法。
AI.motivation: 五维超共形场论（superconformal field theory）的低能有效理论由三次预势（cubic prepotential）决定，其系数来自三重相交数；环面（toric）情形可组合计算，但对应含7-膜五膜网的GTP因几何非环面（non-toric）而缺乏此类描述。
AI.method: 指出7-膜数据由GTP中的额外线段编码，对应非环面、非紧的“繁茂除子”；基于对这些除子的局部分析与相交积（intersection product）的结合性（associativity），构造从GTP组合数据直接计算三重相交数的算法。
AI.result: 算法可在示例中成功计算三重相交数，从而得到预势；并提供了相交算法的Mathematica代码实现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将预势的组合计算从环面三折体推广到广义环面情形，为含7-膜五膜网对应的五维超共形场论提供了可操作的几何-组合计算工具。

title: Ab initio exploration of hydrogen-intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides: From identifying stable structures to emergent superconductivity
comment: 32 pages (11 pages main text with 6 figures and 2 tables, plus 21 pages of supplemental material). Submitted to Physical Review Materials
summary: We present a first-principles study of hydrogen-intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), examining the structural, thermodynamic, electronic and superconducting properties of distinct intercalation configurations. In most configurations, the two intercalated hydrogen atoms contribute two electrons per unit cell, creating a band gap and thus rendering the system semiconducting. Among the dynamically stable configurations there is one exception to this rule, with inherently metallic behavior. The pristine phases of these materials are known to exhibit a charge density wave instability, which is fully suppressed by specific hydrogen configurations. Moreover, the semiconducting structures can be metallized by hole doping, albeit that the superconducting critical temperatures ($T_c$) are vanishingly low. On the other hand, electron doping drives the $T_c$ up to 25 K, by populating dense states above the gap. This finding can motivate further experimental exploration of superconductivity in hydrogen-intercalated TMDs through ionic-liquid gating or alkali co-intercalation.

AI.tldr: 本文以第一性原理（first-principles）方法系统研究氢插层过渡金属硫族化合物（hydrogen-intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides, TMDs）的多种插层构型，发现多数构型呈半导体性、电荷密度波（charge density wave, CDW）被抑制，且电子掺杂可将超导临界温度（superconducting critical temperature, $T_c$）提升至25 K。
AI.motivation: 原始TMD相存在电荷密度波不稳定性，需探索插层调控对其结构、电子与超导性质的影响，并寻找可实验实现的超导增强途径。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，考察不同氢插层构型的结构、热力学、电子与超导性质，并结合空穴/电子掺杂分析能带填充与$T_c$变化。
AI.result: 多数构型中两个插层氢原子每单胞贡献两个电子，打开带隙而呈半导体性；动态稳定构型中有一例外呈金属性。特定氢构型可完全抑制CDW不稳定性；空穴掺杂可实现金属化但$T_c$极低，而电子掺杂因填充带隙上方高态密度使$T_c$升至25 K。
AI.conclusion: 氢插层可调控TMD的带隙与CDW，电子掺杂是提升超导性的有效途径；结果可推动通过离子液体栅控（ionic-liquid gating）或碱金属共插层（alkali co-intercalation）开展实验探索。

title: Explicit Boundary-Entropy Deficits in the XX Spin Chain with arbitrary boundary fields
summary: The exact thermodynamics of the XX spin-1/2 chain with arbitrary Hermitian boundary fields is constructed via fusion techniques. The rigorous result shows that (1) each end with a nonzero transverse field contributes $+\frac12T\ln2$ to the low-temperature free energy, whereas strictly diagonal and free ends contribute no such linear term; (2) each nondiagonal end has a characteristic temperature $T_B$, which scales as $T_B\propto h_\perp^2/J$ in the weak-field regime. For $T\ll\min\{J,T_B\}$, the boundary entropy approaches a deficit of $\frac12\ln2$ relative to a diagonal end. As the transverse field tends to zero, the boundary crossover scale vanishes and the low-temperature expansion becomes nonuniform. The present result provides a clear benchmark not only for the boundary thermodynamics of open boundary quantum integrable systems, but also for dot defects in quantum critical systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过融合（fusion）技术严格构造了带任意厄米边界场（Hermitian boundary fields）的 XX 自旋-1/2 链的精确热力学，给出边界自由能线性项与边界熵亏损的定量判据。
AI.motivation: 开放边界量子可积系统的边界热力学缺乏严格基准，尤其当边界场既非纯对角又非自由时，低温自由能的边界贡献尚需精确刻画。
AI.method: 采用融合技术（fusion techniques），对带任意厄米边界场的 XX 自旋-1/2 链构造精确热力学解。
AI.result: 每个带非零横向场（transverse field）的端点对低温自由能贡献 $+\frac12 T\ln 2$，而严格对角端与自由端无此线性项；每个非对角端具特征温度 $T_B$，弱场区满足 $T_B\propto h_\perp^2/J$；当 $T\ll\min\{J,T_B\}$ 时，边界熵（boundary entropy）相对对角端出现 $\frac12\ln 2$ 的亏损。
AI.conclusion: 横向场趋于零时边界交叉尺度（boundary crossover scale）消失，低温展开变得非一致。该结果为开放边界量子可积系统的边界热力学以及量子临界系统（quantum critical systems）中的点缺陷（dot defects）提供了清晰基准。

title: Excess inner-horizon entropy and the thermodynamics of Kerr formation
summary: \noindent We develop a charge-matched thermodynamic framework for the regular rotating black-hole family underlying an exact model of Kerr formation. Since the Kerr endpoint already possesses a Cauchy horizon, hidden entropy is identified with the excess inner-horizon area relative to Kerr at fixed mass $M$ and angular momentum $J=Ma$: $\Sexc=π[h_c^2-(r_-^{\Kerr})^2]$, where $h_c$ is the regular inner-horizon radius and $r_-^{\Kerr}=M-\sqrt{M^2-a^2}$. Under regularity and interior-profile assumptions, we prove $r_-^{\Kerr}<h_c<h$ and establish the sharp bound $0<\Sexc<4πM\sqrt{M^2-a^2}$. The Schwarzschild limit yields $\Sexc=πh_c^2$, while $\Sexc=0$ at the Kerr endpoint. The Kerr reference entropy satisfies $S_+^{\Kerr}+S_-^{\Kerr}=4πM^2$, so rotation redistributes its two-horizon contributions at fixed mass. For the time-dependent model, we derive exact evolution equations for the inner root and $\Sexc$, interpreted as root-bookkeeping identities unless the roots are established as dynamical horizons. In the minimal $N=1$ trajectory, the apparent pole at $n=2$ is removable in the mass profile, giving a logarithmic continuation of the root equation, although the stationary curvature is singular there. The stationary Ricci-scalar density is locally absolutely integrable for $-1<n\leq2$, with the Kerr endpoint $n=-1$ treated separately. Minkowski breaking occurs at $n=0$, independently of inner-horizon disappearance. Quasi-extremal regular configurations approach, but cannot attain, the entropy bound without losing a regular Killing horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文为精确 Kerr 形成模型所对应的正则转动黑洞族建立电荷匹配（charge-matched）热力学框架，将"隐藏熵"（hidden entropy）定义为固定质量与角动量下相对 Kerr 内视界面积的超出量，并证明其严格上下界。该框架进一步给出含时模型内根与隐藏熵的精确演化方程，并讨论极值极限与曲率奇异性的关系。
AI.motivation: Kerr 端点本身已具有 Cauchy 视界（Cauchy horizon），但正则转动黑洞中隐藏熵的定量刻画及其与 Kerr 的对照尚缺乏严格框架。作者旨在以固定质量 M 与角动量 J=Ma 为基准，构建可比较的内视界熵记账体系。
AI.method: 以电荷匹配热力学框架处理该正则转动黑洞族，将隐藏熵定义为 S_exc=π[h_c²−(r_−^Kerr)²]。在正则性与内部剖面假设下证明不等式 r_−^Kerr<h_c<h 及尖锐界 0<S_exc<4πM√(M²−a²)；并对含时模型推导内根与 S_exc 的精确演化方程（视为根记账恒等式）。
AI.result: 得到尖锐界 0<S_exc<4πM√(M²−a²)；Schwarzschild 极限给出 S_exc=πh_c²，Kerr 端点处 S_exc=0。Kerr 参考熵满足 S_+^Kerr+S_-^Kerr=4πM²，表明转动在固定质量下重新分配两视界贡献。极值正则构型可逼近但无法达到该熵界而不失去正则 Killing 视界；静态 Ricci 标量密度在 −1<n≤2 上局部绝对可积，n=0 处出现 Minkowski 破缺。
AI.conclusion: 该框架表明隐藏熵被内视界面积严格约束，转动仅重分配两视界熵贡献而不改变总量 4πM²。含时演化方程仅为根记账结果，除非根被确立为动力学视界（dynamical horizons）；n=2 处极点可移除但静态曲率仍奇异，Minkowski 破缺与内视界消失彼此独立。

title: Search for supersymmetric particle pair production in final states with two oppositely charged leptons and large missing transverse momentum in proton-proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}$ = 13 TeV
comment: Submitted to the Journal of High Energy Physics. All figures and tables can be found at http://cms-results.web.cern.ch/cms-results/public-results/publications/SUS-23-002 (CMS Public Pages)
summary: A search is presented for direct production of pairs of supersymmetric particles in final states with a pair of oppositely charged leptons (electrons or muons) and missing transverse momentum. The analysis uses proton-proton collision data at $\sqrt{s}$ = 13 TeV, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 fb$^{-1}$, recorded with the CMS detector at the CERN LHC. The observed data do not exhibit any excess over the standard model predictions. Constraints are derived on chargino, top squark, and slepton pair production in the context of simplified models with $R$-parity conservation. In these models, the neutralino is taken to be the lightest supersymmetric particle. For chargino production, an exclusion region in the chargino-neutralino mass plane is determined, which extends to chargino masses of 1120 GeV and neutralino masses of 490 GeV. For mass splittings between the lighter top squark and the neutralino ranging from the W boson mass to the top quark mass, top squark masses up to 500$-$540 GeV are excluded. Slepton masses are excluded up to 700 GeV for a massless neutralino.

AI.tldr: CMS 利用 13 TeV、138 fb⁻¹ 的质子-质子碰撞数据，在对向双轻子加缺失横向动量的末态中搜寻超对称粒子对的直接产生；未观测到超出标准模型的显著 excess，并在 R 宇称守恒的简化模型框架下给出对 chargino、top squark 与 slepton 的质量排除限。
AI.motivation: 超对称（supersymmetry）粒子对的直接产生在对向带电轻子加缺失横向动量末态中具有较低的多重数本底，是探测弱产生超对称粒子的重要通道；在 LHC 高亮度数据下可提升对 chargino、top squark 与 slepton 的质量排除范围。
AI.method: 使用 CMS 探测器在 CERN LHC 采集的 √s = 13 TeV 质子-质子碰撞数据（积分亮度 138 fb⁻¹），选取对向双轻子（电子或 μ 子）与缺失横向动量的末态，将数据与标准模型（standard model）预言比较；约束在 R 宇称守恒（R-parity conservation）的简化模型（simplified models）中推导，其中 neutralino 被设为最轻超对称粒子（lightest supersymmetric particle）。
AI.result: 观测数据相对标准模型预言无 excess。chargino 产生：给出 chargino–neutralino 质量平面上的排除区域，延伸至 chargino 质量 1120 GeV、neutralino 质量 490 GeV。top squark 产生：当较轻 top squark 与 neutralino 的质量差（mass splitting）从 W 玻色子质量至顶夸克质量范围内，排除 top squark 质量上限 500–540 GeV。slepton 产生：在 neutralino 无质量情形下排除 slepton 质量至 700 GeV。
AI.conclusion: 该分析在双轻子加缺失横向动量末态中未发现超对称信号，所给排除限在简化模型假设下显著约束了 chargino、top squark 与 slepton 的产生相空间；结果依赖于 neutralino 为最轻超对称粒子的模型设定。

title: Wilsonian exact renormalization group flow in the gauged Nambu--Jona-Lasinio model
summary: We study the Wilsonian exact renormalization group flow of the gauged Nambu--Jona-Lasinio (NJL) model, a four-dimensional $U(1)$ gauge theory with chirally invariant four-Fermi interactions, by using the gradient flow exact renormalization group~(GFERG). Our gauge-invariant ansatz (truncation) for the 1PI Wilson action keeps a general photon kinetic function~$\mathcal{K}_τ(k^2)$, the fermion mass, and the scalar and vector four-Fermi couplings. For a fixed gauge coupling~$e^2$, the Gaussian and NJL (quasi-)fixed points on the critical surface merge at~$e_c^2\simeq17$, as anticipated by the ladder Schwinger--Dyson equation and the conventional Wilsonian renormalization group. We then let $e^2$ itself flow. Owing to the manifest gauge invariance of the GFERG, the flow of~$e^2$ is governed solely by the photon anomalous dimension~$γ_A$, which remains positive along both branches up to the merging point. Hence, no fixed point with~$e^2\neq0$ exists. Flows from a sufficiently large~$e^2$ in the ultraviolet (UV) reach the chirally broken phase even for vanishing four-Fermi couplings, so the gauge interaction does trigger chiral symmetry breaking. The merging point, however, is not a fixed point, and the gauge coupling vanishes in any continuum limit within our truncation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用梯度流精确重整化群（gradient flow exact renormalization group, GFERG）研究四维 U(1) 规范 Nambu–Jona-Lasinio（NJL）模型的 Wilson 精确重整化群流，发现高斯与 NJL（准）不动点在临界面上于 e_c^2≈17 处合并，且由于光子反常维度为正，不存在 e^2≠0 的不动点。
AI.motivation: 旨在借助 GFERG 显式规范不变性的优势，考察带手征不变四费米相互作用（four-Fermi interactions）的规范 NJL 模型中规范耦合与四费米耦合的联合流向，并检验规范相互作用能否触发手征对称性破缺（chiral symmetry breaking）。
AI.method: 对 1PI Wilson 作用量采用规范不变截断（ansatz），保留一般光子动能函数 K_τ(k^2)、费米子质量以及标量与矢量四费米耦合；先固定规范耦合 e^2 考察临界面上不动点的合并，随后令 e^2 自身演化，其流仅由光子反常维度（photon anomalous dimension）γ_A 决定。
AI.result: 固定 e^2 时，高斯与 NJL（准）不动点在 e_c^2≃17 处合并，与阶梯 Schwinger–Dyson 方程及传统 Wilson 重整化群的预期一致；γ_A 在两支上直至合并点均为正，故不存在 e^2≠0 的不动点。紫外区足够大的 e^2 即使在四费米耦合为零时也流入手征破缺相。
AI.conclusion: 规范相互作用确实能触发手征对称性破缺；但合并点并非不动点，且在该截断范围内任何连续极限（continuum limit）下规范耦合均趋于零。

title: Impact of Surface Preparation on the Propulsion of Catalytic Janus Colloids and Implications for Reproducibility
comment: 31 pages: main text (19 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables) and Supporting Information (12 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables)
summary: Platinum-coated polystyrene (PS) Janus particles (JPs) propelled by the catalytic decomposition of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) are a widely used model system for active matter, yet reported speeds for similar particles and fuel concentrations differ by more than an order of magnitude. Broad adoption of these materials requires increasing consistency in the preparation and achieving improved repeatability in their behavior. Herein, we focused on two routine, but rarely reported, preparation steps that we found to alter the particle speed. First, we found that pre-exposing the platinum cap to H2O2 before cell assembly increased the mean speed by a factor of 2.4. The size of this effect depended on batch history, where an aged batch responded strongly, while a freshly prepared batch sped up by only 16%. Second, we found that plasma cleaning of the glass substrate decreased the speed 2.7 times. In a 120 $μ$m cell the suppression was the same at both walls even when only one wall was treated. The suppression grew with the treated glass area per unit fluid volume, which pointed to species released into the bulk solution rather than to a change at the wall. Plasma-cleaned glass released more ions into water than untreated glass, and XPS detected an ionic metal fluoride on the plasma-cleaned surface. A model in which the released ions lower the speed through the solution conductivity reproduced the measured speeds in all four cell geometries. Of the 17 published studies compared here, pre-activation is reported in only four studies and substrate cleaning in only six studies. We propose a minimum reporting standard for the preparation and associated speed measurements of catalytic Janus particles.

AI.tldr: 该研究识别出两个常被忽略的制备步骤——铂帽预暴露于过氧化氢（H2O2）与玻璃基底等离子清洗——会显著改变铂包覆聚苯乙烯（polystyrene, PS）Janus 粒子（Janus particles, JPs）的自驱动速度，并提出最低报告标准以提升可重复性。
AI.motivation: 铂包覆 PS Janus 粒子是活性物质（active matter）研究的常用模型体系，但相似粒子与燃料浓度下报道速度相差超过一个数量级；材料推广需要更一致的制备与更可重复的行为，因而需查明导致差异的制备因素。
AI.method: 聚焦两个常规但鲜有报道的制备步骤：组装测量池前将铂帽预暴露于 H2O2，以及对玻璃基底进行等离子清洗（plasma cleaning）；结合速度测量、不同池几何（含120 μm 池）、离子释放测量与 XPS 表面成分分析，并建立基于溶液电导率（conductivity）的模型解释速度变化。
AI.result: 预暴露使平均速度提高2.4倍，效应大小依赖批次历史（老化批次响应强，新鲜批次仅提高16%）；等离子清洗使速度降低2.7倍，且抑制随单位流体体积对应的处理玻璃面积增大而增强，指向释放到本体溶液中的物种；清洗后玻璃向水中释放更多离子，XPS 检出离子型金属氟化物，基于电导率的模型可复现四种池几何下的实测速度。在比较的17项已发表研究中，仅4项报告预激活、6项报告基底清洗。
AI.conclusion: 制备细节可大幅改变催化 Janus 粒子的速度，且当前文献报告不足；因此提出针对催化 Janus 粒子制备及相关速度测量的最低报告标准（minimum reporting standard），以提升该模型体系的可重复性与可比性。

title: Equivalence of superintegrable Poisson projection chains: magnetic cotangent bundles and spin Calogero-Moser models
summary: We study superintegrable Hamiltonian systems in terms of Poisson projection chains and their (spectral) equivalence. We compare two reduction constructions: (i) the cotangent bundle $T^*(G/A)$, $A=Z_G(γ)$, with the magnetic symplectic form defined by the orbit $G\cdot γ\cong G/A$, and (ii) the left-right Hamiltonian reduction of $T^*G$ that gives spin Calogero-Moser type systems. We prove that the two resulting chains are equivalent on an open set of regular points of principal orbit type: the phase spaces, the intermediate Poisson manifolds and the base spaces are identified compatibly with the projections. In particular, both constructions give the same commuting Hamiltonians.

AI.tldr: 本文通过泊松投影链（Poisson projection chains）及其谱等价（spectral equivalence）研究超可积哈密顿系统（superintegrable Hamiltonian systems），比较两种约化构造并证明其在正则点开集上等价。
AI.motivation: 目的在于厘清两类约化构造——余切丛 $T^*(G/A)$ 上的磁辛形式（magnetic symplectic form）构造与 $T^*G$ 的左右哈密顿约化（left-right Hamiltonian reduction）——之间的关系，判断它们是否给出同一类超可积结构。
AI.method: 采用泊松投影链与谱等价的框架，对比两种约化：一是以 $A=Z_G(\gamma)$ 的余切丛 $T^*(G/A)$ 配以由轨道 $G\cdot\gamma\cong G/A$ 定义的磁辛形式；二是对 $T^*G$ 作左右哈密顿约化，得到自旋 Calogero-Moser 型（spin Calogero-Moser type）系统。
AI.result: 证明两条约化链在主轨道型（principal orbit type）正则点的开集上等价：相空间、中间泊松流形（intermediate Poisson manifolds）与底空间（base spaces）均与投影相容地被等同，且两种构造给出相同的对易哈密顿量（commuting Hamiltonians）。
AI.conclusion: 磁辛约化与左右哈密顿约化在正则点开集上产生等价的泊松投影链，从而统一了两类超可积系统的构造，并说明其可积结构来源一致。

title: Probing Hidden Dimensions with Multimessenger Gravitational Waves
summary: The dimensionality of spacetime is a fundamental property of nature, yet whether our observed four-dimensional spacetime is embedded in a higher-dimensional geometry remains experimentally unresolved. Gravitational waves (GWs) offer a direct probe of compact extra dimensions through the strong-field dynamics of binary coalescences. In this work, we investigate extra-dimensional modifications to GW generation within a compactified Kaluza--Klein framework. We derive the Newtonian conservative binary dynamics and the leading-order extra-dimensional correction to the GW energy flux and formulate the corresponding waveform modifications within the parameterized post-Einsteinian (ppE) framework. Combining these results with the previously derived 1PN amplitude correction arising from perturbations of the internal volume, we construct modified GW waveform templates for ground- and space-based detectors. To alleviate parameter degeneracies in GW parameter estimation, we combine the observed strain data of GW170817 with independent electromagnetic observations in a multimessenger Bayesian analysis, yielding a 95\% credible upper bound of $n<0.11$ on the phenomenological dimensional parameter. We further investigate injected multimessenger massive black hole binary observations with Taiji, finding that the upper bound could be improved by nearly two orders of magnitude to $n<0.00178$. These results highlight the potential of multimessenger GW observations to probe extra-dimensional effects and test fundamental gravity in the strong-field and dynamical regime.

AI.tldr: 本文在紧致化Kaluza–Klein框架下推导额外维对引力波产生的修正，并结合多信使贝叶斯分析给出维度参数n的上限：GW170817数据得到n<0.11，模拟Taiji大质量双黑洞观测可将上限提升近两个数量级至n<0.00178。
AI.motivation: 时空维度是自然的基本属性，但观测到的四维时空是否嵌入更高维几何仍无实验定论。引力波（gravitational waves, GWs）通过双星并合的强场动力学为探测紧致额外维提供了直接手段，本文据此研究额外维效应。
AI.method: 在紧致化Kaluza–Klein框架下推导牛顿级守恒双星动力学及引力波能量通量的领头阶额外维修正，并在参数化后爱因斯坦（parameterized post-Einsteinian, ppE）框架下构造波形修正；结合此前导出的内部体积扰动所致1PN振幅修正，构建地面与空间探测器的修正波形模板，并采用多信使贝叶斯分析（multimessenger Bayesian analysis）联合应变数据与电磁观测以缓解参数简并。
AI.result: 基于GW170817应变数据与独立电磁观测的联合分析，得到现象学维度参数的95%置信上限n<0.11；对Taiji模拟的大质量双黑洞多信使观测，该上限可改善近两个数量级至n<0.00178。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明多信使引力波观测具备探测额外维效应、在强场与动力学区域检验基础引力的潜力。

title: Experimental Searches for Muon to Electron Conversion in Nuclei
comment: Contribution to the Encyclopedia of Nuclear Physics
summary: Charged lepton flavor violation (CLFV) provides a highly sensitive probe of physics beyond the Standard Model. This experimental review discusses $μ^{-} \to e^{-}$ conversion in nuclei, which is a muon CLFV process characterized by a clean monoenergetic-electron signature and the ability to exploit large samples of stopped muons. It describes the physics motivation, basic experimental principles, key background sources, and search strategies, as well as the status and prospects of past and next-generation experiments such as COMET and Mu2e. Future experimental concepts may extend the sensitivity even further. If a signal is observed, comparisons among results obtained with different target nuclei and with those from complementary searches for other muon CLFV decay modes will be essential for identifying the underlying interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了核内μ⁻→e⁻转换（muon-to-electron conversion in nuclei）这一带电轻子味破坏（charged lepton flavor violation, CLFV）过程，梳理其物理动机、实验原理、本底来源与搜寻策略，并总结COMET、Mu2e等实验的现状与前景。
AI.motivation: 带电轻子味破坏是探测超出标准模型（beyond the Standard Model）新物理的高灵敏度探针；核内μ⁻→e⁻转换具有单能电子（monoenergetic-electron）的干净信号特征，且可利用大量停止μ子（stopped muons）样本，因而成为重点研究对象。
AI.method: 采用实验综述（experimental review）的方式，系统阐述该过程的物理动机、基本实验原理、关键本底来源（key background sources）与搜寻策略，并对已有及下一代实验（如COMET与Mu2e）的状态与前景进行归纳。
AI.result: 综述整合了核内μ⁻→e⁻转换实验的原理与策略框架，总结了COMET、Mu2e等过去与下一代实验的现状及未来展望，并指出未来实验概念（future experimental concepts）有望进一步提升灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 若观测到信号，需通过比较不同靶核（target nuclei）所得结果以及与其他μ子CLFV衰变模式互补搜寻（complementary searches）的结果，方可识别其背后的相互作用机制。

title: Doubly-periodic instanton via the ADHM method and the self-dual monopole-center vortex chain
summary: Calorons, i.e., instantons on $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$, with nontrivial asymptotic holonomy decompose into $N$ fundamental monopole constituents. This suggests that a doubly-periodic Yang--Mills instanton on $\mathbb{R}^2\times T^2$ may admit a description in terms of a periodic array of monopole constituents. Starting from the Atiyah--Drinfeld--Hitchin--Manin (ADHM) construction, we derive the $2$d Abelian Hitchin system with impurities as a dual description of the doubly-periodic instanton. We then give a prescription for reconstructing the instanton from the Green's function of this system, assuming a scaling ansatz for the ultraviolet divergences induced by the delta-function impurities. In the far-field limit with strongly anisotropic torus periods, we extend the analysis of Bruckmann and van Baal for multi-calorons and identify an alternating chain of BPS and Kaluza--Klein (KK) monopole constituents: The monopole-center vortex chain arises from the non-Abelian self-dual field especially when an 't Hooft twist cuts the torus into the $1/N$ fragment.

AI.tldr: 本文从ADHM构造出发，将双周期杨–米尔斯瞬子（doubly-periodic instanton）对偶描述为含杂质的二维阿贝尔Hitchin系统，并给出由该系统的格林函数重建瞬子的方案，进而在强各向异性环面周期下识别出BPS单极子与Kaluza–Klein（KK）单极子交替链结构。
AI.motivation: 热核子（caloron，即 $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$ 上的瞬子）在具有非平凡渐近完整（holonomy）时分解为 $N$ 个基本单极子组分，这一事实提示 $\mathbb{R}^2\times T^2$ 上的双周期瞬子或可用单极子组分的周期阵列来描述。
AI.method: 以Atiyah–Drinfeld–Hitchin–Manin（ADHM）构造为起点，导出以含杂质（impurities）的二维阿贝尔Hitchin系统作为双周期瞬子的对偶描述；并在对delta函数杂质所致紫外发散采用标度假设（scaling ansatz）的前提下，给出由该���统格林函数（Green's function）重建瞬子的方案。
AI.result: 在强各向异性环面周期的远场极限（far-field limit）下，推广Bruckmann与van Baal对多热核子的分析，识别出由BPS单极子与Kaluza–Klein（KK）单极子组分构成的交替链；当't Hooft扭转（'t Hooft twist）将环面切成 $1/N$ 片段时，非阿贝尔自对偶场尤其导致单极子中心涡旋链（monopole-center vortex chain）的出现。
AI.conclusion: 双周期瞬子可通过含杂质的二维阿贝尔Hitchin系统实现有效的对偶刻画，其远场结构表现为BPS–KK单极子交替链，且涡旋链的形成与非阿贝尔自对偶场及't Hooft扭转所决定的环面片段化密切相关。

title: The Agentic AI Kerr Lab: LLM Agents for Kerr Microscopy Experiments with Magnetic Skyrmions
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Contribution to the proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on AI for Science (AI4Sci 2026), Mainz, Germany, 5-9 October 2026. Supplementary video: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23736472
summary: Magnetic skyrmions are topological spin textures that can be observed directly by magnetic microscopy and driven by fields and currents, which makes them a model system for fundamental physics and candidates for spintronic devices. Magneto-optical Kerr microscopy is a method to image them in real time; however, most experiments use an inefficient cycle of consecutive imaging, analysis and excitation in which every step requires the judgement of the experimentalist operating the setup. Here we present the Agentic AI Kerr Lab (AgentKerr), in which an agent based on a large language model operates this cycle automatically and efficiently on a Kerr microscope. Rather than relying on pattern detection by a language model, a convolutional neural network trained on Kerr images turns live images into skyrmion observables such as position, size and shape, on which the agent bases its decisions. The architecture lets agents operate the instruments safely, as every hardware action is checked deterministically against an action policy, independently of the agent that issues it. With no procedure given, the agent determines by itself how to create, tune and move skyrmions, and writes its own analyses. The approach can be transferred to other spin textures and points towards magnetic imaging experiments in which the researcher poses the question and the agent finds the way to realize the experiments that yield the answer.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic AI Kerr Lab（AgentKerr）系统，由大语言模型智能体在克尔显微镜上自动完成磁斯格明子的成像—分析—激励闭环，结合卷积神经网络将图像转为可观测量，并通过确定性动作策略保障硬件操作安全。
AI.motivation: 磁斯格明子（magnetic skyrmions）是拓扑自旋纹理（topological spin texture），是基础物理的模型系统与自旋电子学器件候选，但常规磁光克尔显微镜（magneto-optical Kerr microscopy）实验依赖“成像—分析—激励”的人工串行循环，效率低下且每步均需实验者判断。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型（large language model, LLM）的智能体自动驱动克尔显微镜循环；不依赖语言模型直接做图像模式识别，而由在克尔图像上训练的卷积神经网络（convolutional neural network, CNN）把实时图像转换为位置、尺寸、形状等斯格明子可观测量作为决策依据；所有硬件动作由动作策略（action policy）确定性校验以保证安全。
AI.result: 在未给定操作流程的情况下，智能体自行确定如何产生、调控与移动斯格明子，并自行编写其分析程序，实现对实验循环的自动且高效运行。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可迁移至其他自旋纹理，指向一种新的磁成像实验范式：研究者提出问题，智能体自行寻找实现路径以完成可回答该问题的实验。

title: Canonical quantum curve I
summary:
We formulate a canonical quantum curve conjecture $\widehat HΨ_*=0$ for spectral curves of positive genus. Here $Ψ_*$ is the non-perturbative wave function associated with Eynard--Orantin topological recursion, specialized at the \emph{canonical vanishing point}, a distinguished zero of the closed non-perturbative partition function. The operator $\widehat H$ is obtained by Weyl quantization of $H(x,y)$, with $\widehat x=x\cdot$ and $\widehat y=\hbar\partial_x$, together with quantum corrections to its coefficients. These corrections depend only on closed moduli and $\hbar$ and vanish classically. Whenever a geometric definition is available, we conjecture that the corrected coefficients are suitably normalized Wilson-loop expectation values. When a corresponding refined theory exists, we conjecture a relation between the canonical vanishing point and the closed Nekrasov--Shatashvili free energy.
  We prove the quantum curve conjecture for Weierstrass curves and the mirror curves of canonical bundles of smooth projective toric weak del Pezzo surfaces, including local $\mathbb P^2$. For the local surfaces considered here, we relate the canonical vanishing point to a derivative of the closed NS free energy. For local $\mathbb P^2$, we also identify the corrected coefficient with a suitably normalized, geometrically defined NS Wilson-loop expectation value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正亏格谱曲线的正则量子曲线猜想（canonical quantum curve conjecture）$\widehat H\Psi_*=0$，并证明其在 Weierstrass 曲线（Weierstrass curves）及光滑射影环面弱 del Pezzo 曲面（smooth projective toric weak del Pezzo surfaces）典范丛的镜像曲线（mirror curves）上成立，包括局部 $\mathbb P^2$。
AI.motivation: 已有量子曲线构造多针对低亏格情形，缺乏对正亏格谱曲线（positive genus）与非微扰层面（non-perturbative）的系统表述；本文旨在给出正亏格谱曲线的统一量子化框架，并与拓扑递归（topological recursion）、Wilson 环（Wilson-loop）及精化理论（refined theory）建立联系。
AI.method: 以 Eynard--Orantin 拓扑递归（Eynard--Orantin topological recursion）对应的非微扰波函数（non-perturbative wave function）$\Psi_*$ 在正则消没点（canonical vanishing point）处的取值为对象，对 $H(x,y)$ 作 Weyl 量子化（Weyl quantization，$\widehat x=x\cdot$，$\widehat y=\hbar\partial_x$）并对系数加入仅依赖闭模（closed moduli）与 $\hbar$ 的量子修正；猜想修正系数在可几何定义时为适当归一化的 Wilson 环期望值。
AI.result: 对 Weierstrass 曲线与光滑射影环面弱 del Pezzo 曲面典范丛的镜像曲线（含局部 $\mathbb P^2$）证明了该量子曲线猜想；在所考虑的局部曲面情形，将正则消没点与闭 Nekrasov--Shatashvili 自由能（closed NS free energy）的导数相联系；对局部 $\mathbb P^2$，进一步将修正系数等同于适当归一化、几何定义的 NS Wilson 环期望值。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持正则量子曲线猜想及"修正系数即 Wilson 环期望值"的几何诠释，并给出正则消没点与闭 NS 自由能之间的对应关系；在存在相应精化理论时，猜想该消没点与闭 NS 自由能相关，为后续精化与更一般几何情形提供检验方向。

title: Daemon sub Ponte: The Cost of a Second Black Hole (A Scholium on an ER=EPR Thought Experiment)
comment: This concerns a question that has haunted the author since 2014, repeatedly set aside in favor of more pressing projects. As the project queue has shown no sign of shortening, the author has finally decided to address it
summary: A thought experiment in the ER=EPR and related literature involves collecting the Hawking radiation of an old black hole, then collapsing it into a second, entangled black hole. In this short note, we examine the resources required by this idealized conversion. More specifically, we are interested in answering the question: how much external energy is needed to form the second black hole? Assuming a semiclassical bound on the information capacity of the newly formed black hole, we derive a conditional lower bound on external energy and a complementary constraint on correlations retained by the exterior degrees of freedom. We also distinguish entropy-level feasibility from the requirements for exact and approximate purification. We illustrate these requirements via a Page curve analysis.

AI.tldr: 该短文分析ER=EPR思想实验中"将老黑洞霍金辐射收集并坍缩为第二个纠缠黑洞"所需的外部能量资源，在半经典信息容量上限假设下给出外部能量的条件性下界及对外部自由度所保留关联的互补约束，并借助Page曲线说明精确与近似纯化要求的差异。
AI.motivation: ER=EPR及相关文献中的理想化思想实验通常默认可将霍金辐射（Hawking radiation）坍缩成第二个纠缠黑洞，但该转换所需的资源（尤其是外部能量）未被明确考察，本文旨在量化这一被忽略的成本。
AI.method: 以半经典（semiclassical）的新形成黑洞信息容量上界为假设前提，推导形成第二个黑洞所需外部能量（external energy）的条件性下界（conditional lower bound），并导出对外部自由度（exterior degrees of freedom）所保留关联（correlations）的互补约束；同时区分熵层面（entropy-level）可行性与精确（exact）、近似（approximate）纯化（purification）的要求，并以Page曲线（Page curve）分析加以图示。
AI.result: 在所述假设下得到外部能量的条件性下界，以及外部自由度所保留关联的互补性约束；结果表明熵层面的可行性并不等同于精确或近似纯化所需的资源条件，Page曲线分析直观呈现了这些要求。
AI.conclusion: 理想化的黑洞—辐射—黑洞转换并非"免费"，其能量与关联成本受半经典信息容量约束；区分熵层面可行性与纯化要求有助于更审慎地评估ER=EPR类思想实验的物理可实现性。

title: Search for dark photon dark matter near $\mathbf{1\,meV}$ using a superconducting mixer
summary: We demonstrate the use of a superconducting mixer for direct searches for dark photon dark matter (DPDM) in the meV mass range. DPDM couples to the ordinary electromagnetic field through kinetic mixing with a coupling constant $χ$ and can convert into ordinary photons at the surface of a metal plate. For DPDM masses of 1 meV, the conversion photons have frequencies of around 240 GHz. At such frequencies, superconducting mixers enable low-noise spectroscopic measurements. We performed a direct search for DPDM in the mass range 1.0047578-1.0047598 meV, corresponding to the frequency range 242.94935-242.94983 GHz, using approximately one hour of data obtained with a cryogenic millimeter-wave receiver based on a superconducting mixer. No significant excess was found, and we set upper limits of $χ< (1.6\text{-}1.9)\times10^{-9}$ at the 95% confidence level. These limits are comparable to existing constraints from solar dark photons. By applying this method, we plan to extend the search to the wider mass range of 0.7-1.1 meV, corresponding to 170-260 GHz, with improved sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用超导混频器（superconducting mixer）在 meV 质量区间直接搜寻暗光子暗物质（dark photon dark matter, DPDM）。在 1.0047578–1.0047598 meV 范围内未发现显著信号，给出 95% 置信水平下耦合常数上限 χ < (1.6–1.9)×10⁻⁹。
AI.motivation: 暗光子暗物质可通过动力学混合（kinetic mixing）与普通电磁场耦合，并在金属板表面转化为普通光子，为直接探测提供可行途径；而 meV 质量对应的约 240 GHz 频段恰适合采用低噪声超导混频技术进行谱学测量。
AI.method: 采用基于超导混频器的低温毫米波接收机（cryogenic millimeter-wave receiver）进行直接搜寻，使用约一小时数据，覆盖 1.0047578–1.0047598 meV 质量范围（对应 242.94935–242.94983 GHz 频率范围）。
AI.result: 未观测到显著超出，在 95% 置信水平（confidence level）下设定耦合常数上限 χ < (1.6–1.9)×10⁻⁹，该限制与太阳暗光子（solar dark photon）的既有约束相当。
AI.conclusion: 超导混频器方法可用于 DPDM 直接搜寻；作者计划将搜寻扩展至 0.7–1.1 meV（170–260 GHz）的更宽质量范围并提升灵敏度。

title: A note on the quantization of M2-branes on local Calabi-Yau manifolds
summary: In this note we present a detailed computation of the BPS states from M2-branes wrapping 2-cycles in local Calabi-Yau manifolds, at the level of brane quantization. For the cases of local Calabi-Yau threefolds, the supersymmetric quantum mechanics is the 1d $\mathcal{N}=4$ non-linear sigma model. We achieve systematic, physical interpretations of refined Gopakumar-Vafa (GV) invariants, first for the curve classes with fixed geometric genus, and then for curves whose geometric genus jumps. The BPS states of 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories are interpreted from the local geometries, which are presented in a number of case studies. In particular, we compute the refined GV invariants for generalized conifolds, local CY3 giving 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ gauge theories and a singularity whose crepant resolution contains a singular divisor. For the cases of local Calabi-Yau fourfolds, we point out the supersymmetric quantum mechanics is of type $\mathcal{N}=2B$. We set up the framework for studying M2-branes wrapping 2-cycles, and discuss a few cases of M2-brane wrapping genus-0 curves with this new approach.

AI.tldr: 该文在膜量子化（brane quantization）层面，系统计算局部 Calabi-Yau 流形中 M2 膜包裹 2-cycles 所产生的 BPS 态（BPS states），并据此对精化 Gopakumar-Vafa（GV）不变量与 5d N=1 超共形场论给出物理诠释。
AI.motivation: 目标是建立精化 GV 不变量（refined Gopakumar-Vafa invariants）与 BPS 态计数之间的系统性、物理化对应，特别是处理固定几何亏格（geometric genus）的曲线类以及几何亏格发生跳变（genus jumps）的曲线，并将局部几何与 5d N=1 超共形场论（superconformal field theories）的 BPS 谱联系起来。
AI.method: 在局部 Calabi-Yau 三维体情形下，采用 1d N=4 非线性 sigma 模型（non-linear sigma model）作为相应的超对称量子力学；在局部 Calabi-Yau 四维体情形下，指出其超对称量子力学为 N=2B 型，并搭建研究 M2 膜包裹 2-cycles 的框架。
AI.result: 对固定几何亏格的曲线类及几何亏格跳变的曲线给出精化 GV 不变量的物理诠释；以若干案例研究计算广义 conifold、给出 5d N=1 规范理论的局部 CY3，以及 crepant resolution 含奇异除子（singular divisor）的奇点等情形的精化 GV 不变量；在四维体情形下讨论了若干 M2 膜包裹 genus-0 曲线的案例。
AI.conclusion: 局部 Calabi-Yau 几何可为 5d N=1 超共形场论的 BPS 态提供物理诠释，且膜量子化方法可推广至局部 Calabi-Yau 四维体，为后续系统研究奠定框架。

title: Quantum dynamics of ultrasmall magnetic skyrmions in atomic-defect landscapes
summary: Magnetic skyrmions are prime candidates for future information technology, and their fate in devices is settled by the defects they encounter. In ultrathin films, skyrmions can be as small as a couple of nanometers, carrying only a few tens of magnetic moments, while atomic defects reshape their energy landscape on the atomic scale. Here, we demonstrate that such ultrasmall skyrmions can behave quantum mechanically and that their quantum dynamics is unusual. Since the gyrotropic force dominates, the two coordinates of a ferromagnetic skyrmion are canonically conjugate and the skyrmion behaves as a particle in the lowest Landau level of an effective magnetic field, with a magnetic length of 0.6~Å. Utilizing skyrmion-defect interaction profiles of Cr and Fe adatoms and dimers in PdFe/Ir(111), obtained from atomistic spin simulations parametrized from first principles, we unveil quantized gyrotropic orbits with level spacings of 20--85~$μ$eV, bound not only by pinning defects but also, counter-intuitively, by repulsive ones. Saddle points of the energy landscape act as quantum beam splitters for skyrmions, and quantum depinning reaches rates of 1--100~Hz below the critical current. Embedded impurities, in contrast, bind the skyrmion so strongly that it ceases to behave as a rigid particle, defining a strong-coupling regime. For the Gilbert damping typical of ultrathin films, the quantized levels remain well resolved. The thermal-to-quantum crossover lies between 40 and 160~mK, which is within reach of millikelvin scanning tunneling microscopy, where tip-induced escape statistics and electron spin resonance STM can reveal the quantized gyrotropic motion of skyrmions pinned at defects crafted atom by atom.

AI.tldr: 超小磁斯格明子（magnetic skyrmion）在原子缺陷势场中可表现出量子行为：其两个坐标互为共轭，等效于最低朗道能级（lowest Landau level）中的粒子，并存在20–85 μeV的量子化回旋轨道。
AI.motivation: 磁斯格明子是未来信息技术的候选载体，其在器件中的命运由所遇缺陷决定；超薄薄膜中斯格明子可小至几纳米、仅含数十个磁矩，而原子缺陷在原子尺度上重塑其能量景观，因而需要考察此类超小斯格明子是否具有量子行为。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理参数化的原子尺度自旋模拟（atomistic spin simulation），获得PdFe/Ir(111)中Cr、Fe吸附原子（adatom）与二聚体（dimer）同斯格明子的相互作用势剖面，并据此分析回旋规范动力学与量子化能级。
AI.result: 由于回旋力（gyrotropic force）主导，铁磁斯格明子表现为有效磁场最低朗道能级中的粒子，磁长度（magnetic length）约0.6 Å；出现能级间距20–85 μeV的量子化回旋轨道，且不仅被钉扎缺陷束缚，也被排斥性缺陷束缚；能量景观鞍点充当量子分束器（beam splitter），低于临界电流时量子脱钉（quantum depinning）速率达1–100 Hz；嵌入型杂质导致强耦合区，斯格明子不再表现为刚体粒子。
AI.conclusion: 在超薄薄膜典型吉尔伯特阻尼（Gilbert damping）下量子化能级仍可良好分辨，热–量子交叉（thermal-to-quantum crossover）位于40–160 mK，处于毫开尔文扫描隧道显微镜（STM）可及范围，可借针尖诱导逃逸统计与电子自旋共振STM探测逐个原子构造的缺陷处被钉扎斯格明子的量子化回旋运动。

title: Semiclassical Wave Packet Dynamics For Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations with Harmonic Potentials
summary: We propose an approximate Hamiltonian dynamics for the Gross--Pitaevskii equation $i\hbarψ_t = -\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}Δψ+ V(x)ψ+ \hbar^2 λ|ψ|^2ψ$ with harmonic potential $V(x)$ and $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$. We do this by extending the Gaussian ansatz of Perez-Garcia et al.~(Phys.~Rev.~A 56, 1424 (1997)) to the semiclassical wave packets of Hagedorn. We derive the evolution equations for the wave packets from the Hamiltonian/symplectic perspective, rather than the Lagrangian/variational one taken by Perez-Garcia et al. We first show that these two perspectives yield identical evolution equations in the Gaussian case. We then derive the evolution equations for an arbitrary element of the semiclassical wave packets. Finally, we demonstrate the efficacy of the approximate dynamics with numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 该文为含谐振势的 Gross–Pitaevskii 方程提出一种近似哈密顿动力学，将 Perez-Garcia 等人的高斯拟设推广至 Hagedorn 半经典波包，并从哈密顿/辛（symplectic）视角推导波包演化方程，最后以数值实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯拟设（Gaussian ansatz）方法采用拉格朗日/变分（Lagrangian/variational）视角，适用范围限于高斯型波包；作者希望将其推广到更一般的半经典波包（semiclassical wave packets），并改用哈密顿/辛视角处理。
AI.method: 将 Perez-Garcia 等的高斯拟设推广为 Hagedorn 半经典波包，从哈密顿/辛（Hamiltonian/symplectic）而非拉格朗日/变分视角推导演化方程；先证明两种视角在高斯情形下给出相同的演化方程，再推导半经典波包任意元素的演化方程。
AI.result: 证明在高斯情形下哈密顿/辛视角与拉格朗日/变分视角所得演化方程一致；给出了半经典波包任意元素的演化方程；数值实验表明该近似动力学具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: 半经典波包框架下的哈密顿近似动力学可作为高斯拟设的推广，用于近似描述含谐振势 Gross–Pitaevskii 方程的解演化。

title: Strong gravity physics of dynamical horizons in black hole mergers and its imprint in their gravitational radiation
comment: Final accepted Ph.D. thesis, Jawaharlal Nehru University (Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics, Pune). Defended on 29 March 2023. 199 pages; with minor copy edits. Alternate: hdl:10603/560622
summary: In a binary black hole merger, the inspiral portion of the gravitational waveform corresponds to two distinct horizons orbiting each other, and the merger and ringdown signals correspond to the final horizon being formed and settling down to equilibrium. However, we still lack a detailed understanding of the relation between the horizon geometry in these three regimes and the observed waveform. In this thesis, we show that the well-known inspiral chirp waveform has a clear counterpart on black hole horizons, namely the shear of the outgoing null rays at the horizon. The shear behaves very much like a compact binary coalescence waveform with increasing frequency and amplitude, and the parameters of the system estimated from the horizon agree with those estimated from the waveform. We then track the source multipole moments of the dynamical horizons in simulations of several binary black hole mergers and calculate the corresponding Love numbers for axisymmetric modes. Unlike the (field) tidal Love numbers of non-spinning black holes, these do not vanish. We present evidence that, at least for modest mass ratios, their behaviour is universal. We extend this to the non-axisymmetric moments and show that the dynamical horizons encode detailed information about the dynamics of the binary, and that their source multipole moments are strongly correlated with the gravitational field at null infinity. Finally, we study the outer common dynamical horizon formed during the merger and its relationship with the outgoing gravitational waves, and show how the deformed common horizon approaches the final Kerr state by absorbing gravitational radiation with signatures of quasi-normal ringing. Its gravitational field shares a similar multipolar structure as that at future null infinity, and we point out some limitations, inconsistencies, and anomalies that need to be addressed.

AI.tldr: 该博士论文研究双黑洞并合中视界几何与引力波波形之间的关系，发现出射零测地线在视界上的剪切（shear）可作为inspiral chirp波形的对应量，并系统刻画动态视界（dynamical horizon）的多极矩、Love数及其与零无穷远引力场的关联。
AI.motivation: 双黑洞并合波形的inspiral、merger与ringdown分别对应两个视界绕转、最终视界形成与趋于平衡，但视界几何与观测波形之间的具体联系仍缺乏细致理解。论文旨在建立这一联系。
AI.method: 在数值模拟中追踪动态视界上出射零测地线的剪切，并将其与紧凑双星并合（compact binary coalescence）波形对比、比较参数估计；进而计算若干并合模拟中动态视界的源多极矩（source multipole moments）及轴对称模式的Love数，并扩展至非轴对称情形，最后研究并合期形成的公共动态视界及其与出射引力波的关系。
AI.result: 视界剪切表现出频率与振幅递增的类波形特征，由其估计的系统参数与波形估计一致；轴对称模式的Love数不 vanish（区别于非自旋黑洞的场潮汐Love数），且在适度质量比下表现出普适性；非轴对称源多极矩与零无穷远引力场强相关；形变的公共视界通过吸收带准正规模（quasi-normal ringing）特征的引力辐射趋近最终Kerr态，其引力场具有与未来零无穷远相似的多极结构。
AI.conclusion: 动态视界编码了双星动力学的详细信息，其多极矩与零无穷远引力场密切关联，为通过视界几何理解并合波形提供新视角；同时指出若干需解决的局限性、不一致与异常现象。

title: Study of the up-down asymmetry in $B^+\to K^+π^+π^-γ$ using $K_1(1270)$ amplitudes constrained by semileptonic $D$ Decays
summary: Using $K_1(1270)\to Kππ$ amplitude models constrained by the charmed-meson semileptonic decays $D^{+(0)}\to K^-π^+π^{0(-)} e^+ν_e$, we present a model-dependent estimate of the up-down asymmetry observed in $B^+\to K^+π^+π^-γ$ in the mass region $M_{K^+π^+π^-}\in[1.1,1.3]$~GeV/$c^2$. Estimates based on an isolated $K_1(1270)$ show significant model dependence, but systematically lie below the measured asymmetry $\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{\mathrm{ud}}=(0.092\pm0.023)$ when assuming $λ_γ=1$. We also explore interference with the $K_1(1400)$ tail and find that it can appreciably reduce the tension.

AI.tldr: 基于受粲介子半轻衰变约束的 $K_1(1270)\to K\pi\pi$ 振幅模型，对 $B^+\to K^+\pi^+\pi^-\gamma$ 中的 up-down 不对称性（up-down asymmetry）作模型依赖估计；孤立 $K_1(1270)$ 预言系统性低于测量值，但与 $K_1(1400)$ 尾部干涉可显著缓解张力。
AI.motivation: 实验测得的 $B^+\to K^+\pi^+\pi^-\gamma$ 在 $M_{K^+\pi^+\pi^-}\in[1.1,1.3]$ GeV/$c^2$ 区域的 up-down 不对称性 $\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{\mathrm{ud}}=(0.092\pm0.023)$ 与理论预期之间的关系尚需定量澄清，尤其需评估强子振幅模型不确定性对该预言的影响。
AI.method: 采用由粲介子半轻衰变 $D^{+(0)}\to K^-\pi^+\pi^{0(-)}e^+\nu_e$ 约束的 $K_1(1270)\to K\pi\pi$ 振幅模型（amplitude model），在假设 $\lambda_\gamma=1$ 下计算 up-down 不对称性；并进一步考察与 $K_1(1400)$ 尾部（tail）的干涉效应。
AI.result: 基于孤立 $K_1(1270)$ 的估计表现出显著的模型依赖性（model dependence），但系统性地低于测量值 $\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{\mathrm{ud}}=(0.092\pm0.023)$；引入 $K_1(1400)$ 尾部干涉后，该张力（tension）可得到明显减小。
AI.conclusion: 孤立 $K_1(1270)$ 图像难以单独解释所测 up-down 不对称性，共振态间干涉（interference）、特别是 $K_1(1400)$ 的贡献，是理解该可观测量（observable）的关键因素。

title: Quantum Black Holes in Non-Linear Electrodynamics
summary: Techniques of AdS/CFT correspondence and braneworld holography have proven to be a useful tool for solving the problem of semi-classical gravity where quantum matter provides the back-reaction to classical spacetime geometry. In this paper, we apply this approach to Einstein gravity coupled to RegMax nonlinear electrodynamics and construct novel type of charged quantum black holes. We then discuss their thermodynamics and horizon structure.

AI.tldr: 该文利用AdS/CFT对应与膜世界全息（braneworld holography）方法，研究爱因斯坦引力（Einstein gravity）耦合RegMax非线性电动力学（nonlinear electrodynamics）的情形，构建了新型带电量子黑洞（charged quantum black holes），并讨论其热力学（thermodynamics）与视界结构（horizon structure）。
AI.motivation: 半经典引力（semi-classical gravity）问题中量子物质对经典时空几何产生反作用（back-reaction），需要有效求解手段；AdS/CFT对应与膜世界全息已被证明是处理该问题的有用工具。
AI.method: 将AdS/CFT对应与膜世界全息技术应用于爱因斯坦引力耦合RegMax非线性电动力学，据此构造一类新型带电量子黑洞解。
AI.result: 成功构建了新型带电量子黑洞，并对其热力学性质与视界结构进行了讨论（摘要未给出具体结论细节）。
AI.conclusion: 表明全息方法可推广至含非线性电动力学的带电场景，为半经典引力中的反作用问题提供新的黑洞解范例。

title: Evidence for topological flat band magnetism in Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$
summary: Correlations and topology are central pillars in the study of emergent electronic phases. Topological flat bands near the Fermi level unite these concepts, providing a route towards correlated topological phenomena and unconventional magnetism. Despite theoretical predictions, momentum-resolved observation of a topological flat band at the Fermi level has remained elusive. Using angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we observe a flat band at the Fermi level within the topologically non-trivial electronic structure of the magnetic kagome Weyl semimetal Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$. We further uncover a strong temperature dependence in which the flat band shifts across the Fermi level, accompanied by a reconstruction of the Fermi surface. Strikingly, this evolution occurs on the same temperature scale as previously reported anomalies in the magnetic response. Together, these results provide evidence for topological flat band magnetism in Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$, establishing a microscopic setting in which topology, electronic correlations, and magnetism become intertwined.

AI.tldr: 利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）在磁性kagome外尔半金属（Weyl semimetal）Co₃Sn₂S₂中观测到费米能级处的平带（flat band），并发现其随温度跨越费米能级移动及费米面重构，与磁性响应异常出现在同一温标。
AI.motivation: 关联（correlations）与拓扑（topology）是研究涌现电子相（emergent electronic phases）的核心概念，费米能级附近的拓扑平带（topological flat band）有望沟通二者并通向关联拓扑现象与非常规磁性；然而尽管已有理论预测，对费米能级处拓扑平带的动量分辨（momentum-resolved）观测始终缺失。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱（angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy, ARPES）对磁性kagome外尔半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂的拓扑非平庸电子结构进行动量分辨测量，追踪平带位置与费米面随温度的变化。
AI.result: 在Co₃Sn₂S₂拓扑非平庸电子结构中观测到位于费米能级处的平带；该平带随温度发生显著移动并跨越费米能级，同时伴随费米面（Fermi surface）重构，且这一演化与先前报道的磁响应（magnetic response）异常处于同一温度尺度。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了Co₃Sn₂S₂中拓扑平带磁性（topological flat band magnetism）的证据，确立了一个拓扑、电子关联与磁性相互交织的微观图像。

title: Density functionals for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian
summary: We develop a density-functional theory for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian of nonrelativistic quantum electrodynamics in the spirit of the convex-analytic formulation of Lieb. We consider finitely many electrons, subject to external scalar and vector potentials, coupled to the full continuum of massless transverse photons with an ultraviolet cutoff. The natural basic variables are the standard electron density and a combined current density, the sum of the paramagnetic current density and a field-induced current density generated by the quantized vector potential. We prove representability results for these density-current pairs and show that the mixed-state constrained-search functional attains its infimum and coincides with the Lieb functional obtained by convex conjugation. Since arbitrarily soft photons purify mixed states at a negligible energy cost without changing their density and combined current density, the pure-state Levy-Lieb functional equals the Lieb functional and is therefore convex, even though its infimum need not be attained. In addition, we establish the zero-coupling limit, which recovers the mixed-state Vignale-Rasolt functional of current-density-functional theory. Finally, we consider the long-wavelength (dipole) limit and show that the limiting functional can be written as a constrained search for the well-known length-gauge dipole Hamiltonian.

AI.tldr: 本文在Lieb凸分析框架下为非相对论量子电动力学的Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量建立密度泛函理论，以电子密度与"顺磁电流密度加场致电流密度"的合成电流密度为基本变量，证明了密度-电流对的可表示性、约束搜索泛函下确界的存在性及其与Lieb泛函的一致性，并给出零耦合极限与长波（偶极）极限。
AI.motivation: 现有电流密度泛函理论（current-density-functional theory）多基于半经典或固定外场处理，缺乏对光子场与电子耦合的严格密度泛函表述；本文旨在将Lieb的凸分析（convex-analytic）形式推广至含全连续无质量横光子场的量子电动力学体系。
AI.method: 考虑有限个电子受外部标量与矢量势作用，耦合至带紫外截断（ultraviolet cutoff）的无质量横光子连续谱；选取标准电子密度与合成电流密度（顺磁电流密度加量子化矢量势诱导的场致电流密度）为基本变量，证明其可表示性（representability），并比较混合态约束搜索泛函、凸共轭所得Lieb泛函与纯态Levy-Lieb泛函。
AI.result: 混合态约束搜索泛函达到其下确界且等于凸共轭得到的Lieb泛函；由于任意软光子可在可忽略能量代价下纯化混合态而不改变密度与合成电流密度，纯态Levy-Lieb泛函等于Lieb泛函因而为凸，尽管其下确界未必达到；零耦合极限恢复电流密度泛函理论的混合态Vignale-Rasolt泛函；长波（偶极）极限下极限泛函可写为熟知的长度规范偶极哈密顿量的约束搜索。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为量子电动力学体系提供了严格的密度-电流泛函理论框架，明确了光子场在纯化混合态与保证泛函凸性中的作用，并通过零耦合与偶极极限与既有电流密度泛函理论建立联系。

title: Gravitational dynamics and backward ray-traced shadows of bumblebee AdS black holes
summary: We investigate the total observed frequency shift of photons emitted by massive geodesic particles in circular orbits near the event horizon of bumblebee AdS black holes. The cosmological effects of the bumblebee field are investigated through dynamical equations governing the evolution and characteristic features of the Universe. In addition, the bumblebee field generates cosmological anisotropies by acting as a source of anisotropy and selecting a preferred spatial direction. We formulate the characteristic equations for the innermost stable circular orbit using the effective potential approach. Further analysis is devoted to establishing a functional relationship between the BH mass and the observed redshift and blueshift of photons emitted from the accretion disk. Finally, we study the shadow cast by the bumblebee AdS BH using the backward ray tracing process implemented in the Arcmancer code, where photon geodesics are initialized at the observers location and integrated backward in time to generate BH images, typically illuminated by electromagnetic radiation from nearby accretion flows.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 bumblebee AdS 黑洞视界附近圆轨道大质量测地线粒子所发射光子的总观测频移，并分析黑洞质量与红移/蓝移的泛函关系，最后用 Arcmancer 反向光线追踪代码模拟黑洞阴影。
AI.motivation: bumblebee 场会引入宇宙学各向异性并选择优先空间方向，需考察其对黑洞附近光子频移、最内稳定圆轨道及阴影观测特征的影响。
AI.method: 通过动力学方程考察 bumblebee 场的宇宙学效应；用有效势方法建立最内稳定圆轨道（innermost stable circular orbit, ISCO）的特征方程；并以 Arcmancer 代码实现反向光线追踪（backward ray tracing）生成黑洞图像。
AI.result: 建立了黑洞质量与吸积盘发射光子观测红移及蓝移之间的泛函关系，并通过反向积分光子测地线得到 bumblebee AdS 黑洞的阴影图像。
AI.conclusion: bumblebee 场导致的各向异性会影响黑洞附近的轨道与光子频移特征，反向光线追踪可用于刻画该黑洞的阴影形态。

title: Two-peak gravitational wave spectra from supercooled two-field phase transitions
summary: We study the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum generated by supercooled first-order phase transitions in two-field conformal models. We construct three representative toy models that capture the essential features of these models, derive analytical criteria for the existence of two-step transitions, and show how the two-field dynamics generate a genuine two-peak GW spectrum. We identify regions of parameter space in which two-peak GW spectra are observable at LISA and the Einstein Telescope. By way of illustration, we apply our analysis to a realistic conformal dark SU(3) model.

AI.tldr: 该文研究双场共形模型（two-field conformal models）中超冷一级相变（supercooled first-order phase transitions）产生的引力波（gravitational wave, GW）谱，通过三个代表性玩具模型（toy models）推导两步相变存在的解析判据，并展示双场动力学可产生真正的双峰（two-peak）GW谱，指出其在LISA与爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope）的可观测参数空间。
AI.motivation: 双场共形模型中超冷一级相变的引力波信号特征尚缺乏系统性刻画，尤其是两步相变与多峰谱之间的对应关系及其可观测性未被明确建立。
AI.method: 构造三个代表性玩具模型以捕捉此类模型的关键特征，推导两步相变（two-step transitions）存在的解析判据，并结合双场动力学分析GW谱的形成；进一步将分析应用于一个现实的共形暗SU(3)模型（conformal dark SU(3) model）。
AI.result: 双场动力学可产生真正的双峰GW谱；研究识别出使双峰谱在LISA与爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope）可观测的参数空间区域，并在现实的共形暗SU(3)模型中予以示例性验证。
AI.conclusion: 双场共形模型的超冷一级相变可产生具有双峰结构的引力波谱，且部分参数区域可被未来空间与地面探测器观测，为相关模型检验提供潜在信号通道。

title: Chiral magnetic wave and axial charge relaxation in flavor branes
summary: We investigate the chiral magnetic wave and axial charge relaxation in the chiral symmetry broken phase of the holographic D3/D7 model with massless quarks, where the axial charge in the flavor sector can relax through transfer to the adjoint sector in the probe limit. We find that the dispersion relations of the quasi-normal modes are well described by the phenomenological expression for the chiral magnetic wave when the relaxation rate is small. We then determine how this rate depends on vector charge density and the chiral condensate. At higher temperatures, it increases with charge density and decreases with increasing condensate, while these dependences become non-monotonic at lower temperatures. These results show that the phenomenological description of the chiral magnetic wave also applies in the chiral symmetry broken phase in the quasi-hydrodynamic regime.

AI.tldr: 在带无质量夸克的全息 D3/D7 模型手征对称破缺相中研究手征磁波与轴荷弛豫，发现小弛豫率下准正态模式色散关系可由唯象手征磁波表达式良好描述，且弛豫率对矢荷密度与手征凝聚的依赖随温度变化。
AI.motivation: 探究手征磁波（chiral magnetic wave）与轴荷弛豫（axial charge relaxation）在手征对称破缺相中的行为，检验唯象描述在该相与准流体力学（quasi-hydrodynamic）区域是否仍适用。
AI.method: 采用全息 D3/D7 模型（holographic D3/D7 model），在探针极限（probe limit）下考虑无质量夸克（massless quarks），使味道部分（flavor sector）的轴荷可通过转移到伴随部分（adjoint sector）而弛豫；计算准正态模式（quasi-normal modes）的色散关系（dispersion relations）并与唯象表达式对比。
AI.result: 当弛豫率较小时，准正态模式色散关系可由手征磁波的唯象表达式良好描述；较高温度下弛豫率随电荷密度（charge density）增大而增大、随凝聚（condensate）增大而减小，而较低温度下这些依赖关系变为非单调。
AI.conclusion: 手征磁波的唯象描述同样适用于手征对称破缺相中的准流体力学区域。

title: Multistable elastic pixels: nematic elasticity for non-volatile positioning of colloidal optical scatterers
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, Supplementary Information with 6 figures
summary: Non-volatile reconfiguration of optical devices, in which a configuration persists without continuous energy input, remains a challenge. We introduce multistable elastic pixels (MEPs), lithographically defined pores filled with a nematic liquid crystal, whose curved ends capture a scattering inclusion in one of two mechanically stable sites. Simulations and experiments show that pore geometry and homeotropic surface anchoring define the energy minima and the height of the barrier between them. This barrier far exceeds thermal energies, stabilizing a scatterer location absent an external field. Colloidal inclusions switch reversibly between sites under transient electric fields. Using arrays of static scatterers, we show that the two positional states produce distinct responses at visible wavelengths, demonstrating the potential of MEPs for reconfigurable devices and metasurfaces. Unlike phase-change and liquid-crystal-tuned approaches, which switch a material surrounding fixed scatterers, MEPs use the nematoelastic energy landscape to move the optical element itself.

AI.tldr: 提出多稳态弹性像素（multistable elastic pixels, MEPs）：将向列相液晶（nematic liquid crystal）填充于光刻定义的孔中，孔两端曲率捕获散射性颗粒（inclusion），使其在两个力学稳定位点间切换，实现无需持续供能的非易失性光学重构。
AI.motivation: 光学器件的非易失性重构（即配置在无持续能量输入下保持）仍是难题。现有相变与液晶调控方案通过改变固定散射体周围材料实现开关，而非移动光学元件本身。
AI.method: 设计多稳态弹性像素（MEPs）——以光刻定义的孔填充向列相液晶，孔两端曲率可捕获散射性夹杂物于两个力学稳定位点；结合模拟与实验分析孔几何与垂直表面锚定（homeotropic surface anchoring）对能量极小值与势垒高度的作用，并用瞬态电场驱动胶体夹杂物可逆切换。
AI.result: 势垒高度远超热能（thermal energies），在无外场条件下稳定散射体位置；胶体夹杂物在瞬态电场下于两位点间可逆切换；静态散射体阵列在可见波段呈现两种位置状态对应的不同响应。
AI.conclusion: MEPs 利用液晶弹性（nematoelastic）能量景观移动光学元件本身，而非改变固定散射体周围材料，展示了其在可重构器件与超表面（metasurfaces）中的应用潜力。

title: Exponential suppression of bit-flip errors in dissipative cat qubits
summary: We study the infinite-dimensional Lindblad generator $L_ε=D[a^2-α^2]+εD[a]$, describing a dissipative cat qubit subject to single-photon loss. For sufficiently large $α$ and sufficiently small $ε>0$, we identify a two-dimensional spectral subspace near zero and establish an upper bound on the slow decay rate that decreases exponentially with $α^2$, uniformly in $ε$. This proves exponential suppression of bit-flip errors.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究受单光子损耗影响的耗散猫量子比特（dissipative cat qubit），其无穷维 Lindblad 生成元为 $L_\varepsilon=D[a^2-\alpha^2]+\varepsilon D[a]$。在 $\alpha$ 足够大且 $\varepsilon>0$ 足够小时，作者在零附近识别出一个二维谱子空间（spectral subspace），并对缓慢衰减率（slow decay rate）给出随 $\alpha^2$ 指数下降的上界，且该界关于 $\varepsilon$ 一致成立，从而证明比特翻转错误（bit-flip error）的指数抑制。
AI.motivation: 动机在于刻画耗散猫量子比特中比特翻转错误的抑制机制：双光子耗散项 $D[a^2-\alpha^2]$ 与单光子损耗项 $\varepsilon D[a]$ 共存时，需要从谱理论上定量说明低频误差通道被指数压制。摘要未进一步说明与其他方法的具体比较或应用背景。
AI.method: 方法为无穷维 Lindblad 生成元（Lindblad generator）的谱分析：定位零附近的二维谱子空间，并估计其上的缓慢衰减率上界，重点处理上界对 $\varepsilon$ 的一致性与对 $\alpha^2$ 的指数依赖。
AI.result: 结果表明，对足够大的 $\alpha$ 与足够小的 $\varepsilon>0$，存在零附近的二维谱子空间，其缓慢衰减率被一个随 $\alpha^2$ 指数衰减的上界控制，且该上界关于 $\varepsilon$ 一致成立。
AI.conclusion: 结论是比特翻转错误实现指数抑制（exponential suppression of bit-flip errors），为耗散猫量子比特的误差保护提供了谱理论层面的定量依据。

title: Effects of radiation on the Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA)
summary: The Moon provides a promising environment for gravitational-wave (GW) observations in the midband. The Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA) combines a lunar deformation channel (LDC) and a geodesic deformation channel (GDC) to cover the midband. The LDC uses the Moon's resonant response to GW for the lower portion of the midband while the GDC measures displacement of suspended test masses to measure the latter. Radiation on the lunar surface can produce spurious signals through test-mass charging, momentum transfer, and thermoelastic deformation. We estimate these contributions for a notional 100 kg fused-silica optic using Geant4 transport, a finite-element electrostatic force map, and a spatial thermoelastic response kernel. Solar-minimum galactic cosmic rays and lunar albedo neutrons define a background case; a worst-day solar energetic particle spectrum (1989 solar flare conditions) defines an extreme, but rare, case. Aluminum-equivalent shielding from 50 to 1000 mils (1.27 to 25.4 mm) and two electrostatic actuator voltage configurations are compared. In the uniform-charge approximation, balanced drive with electrode configuration (B) substantially reduces linear charge-to-force coupling. Ideal continuous compensation of the mean charging current suppresses coherent charge accumulation while introducing negligible discharge shot noise. With compensation, charge-related noise dominates the low-frequency response, whereas thermoelastic deformation dominates at higher frequencies. Accumulated-dose and photodetector transient estimates identify additional component-qualification considerations. Estimates indicate that even under solar flare conditions, radiation noise is not a significant contributor to LILA's overall noise budget as long as charge-aware designs are followed.

AI.tldr: 针对月球中频引力波探测的LILA方案，评估月表辐射（太阳极小宇宙线、月壤反照中子、太阳耀斑粒子）通过检验质量充电、动量传递和热弹形变产生的伪信号噪声，并比较铝等效屏蔽与静电驱动构型。
AI.motivation: 月球为中频段（midband）引力波（gravitational-wave, GW）观测提供有前景的环境，但月表辐射可能通过多条途径产生伪信号，需量化其对噪声预算的贡献。
AI.method: 以假想的100 kg熔融石英光学件为对象，采用Geant4输运、有限元静电力图谱和空间热弹响应核（thermoelastic response kernel）进行估算；设定太阳极小宇宙线与月壤反照中子为背景情形，1989年太阳耀斑条件为极端情形；比较50–1000 mils铝等效屏蔽及两种静电致动器电压构型。
AI.result: 在均匀充电近似下，平衡驱动（B构型）显著降低线性电荷–力耦合；理想连续补偿可抑制相干电荷积累且引入的放电散粒噪声可忽略。补偿后，电荷相关噪声主导低频响应，热弹形变在高频主导；累积剂量与光电探测器瞬变另提出器件鉴定要求。
AI.conclusion: 即使处于太阳耀斑条件下，只要采用电荷感知设计，辐射噪声对LILA整体噪声预算并非显著贡献。

authors: M. G. D. van der Grinten
title: The Skin Detector System of the LZ Dark Matter Experiment
comment: 26 pages, 14 figures, 3 tables, submitted to JINST
summary: This paper presents the design, calibration, and performance of the Skin Detector component of the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) dark matter experiment. The Skin Detector consists of approximately 2 tonnes of liquid xenon instrumented with 131 photomultiplier tubes, surrounding the central time-projection chamber and functions as an active veto system for background rejection. Energy calibration with monoenergetic gamma sources established a position-dependent energy scale and determined prompt and delayed veto thresholds. Radon decays in the Skin can be identified with less than 15~mm spatial resolution, revealing stable convective flow patterns with measured velocities ranging from 2-4 mm/s that persisted throughout extended data-taking periods. The achieved Skin veto threshold meets or exceeds the design goal of 100~keV throughout the Skin volume. The prompt veto efficiency for gamma rays emitted following electron capture in $^{127}$Xe is found to be ($88 \pm 2$)\%, consistent with the simulated value of ($90.4 \pm 0.6$)\%. M-shell EC decays are used to validate the LZ detector sensitivity for low-mass dark matter during the first science run.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）暗物质实验的Skin Detector（皮肤探测器）的设计、标定与性能。该探测器由约2吨液氙和131个光电倍增管组成，作为主动反符合（active veto）系统抑制本底，其位置相关能量刻度、氡衰变成像、veto阈值与效率均得到实验验证。
AI.motivation: 暗物质直接探测实验需要高效的本底抑制手段。Skin Detector围绕中心时间投影室（time-projection chamber）构建主动veto系统，用于甄别和排除外部放射性本底，从而提升对暗物质信号的灵敏度。
AI.method: 采用约2吨液氙配131个光电倍增管（photomultiplier tubes）构建Skin Detector；利用单能γ源进行能量刻度（energy calibration），建立位置相关能量标度并确定即时与延迟veto阈值（prompt and delayed veto thresholds）；通过氡衰变（radon decays）成像研究对流流场，并测量$^{127}$Xe电子俘获（electron capture）后γ射线的即时veto效率。
AI.result: 氡衰变定位空间分辨率优于15 mm，揭示出速度2–4 mm/s且长期稳定的对流流型（convective flow）。Skin veto阈值在整个体积内达到或超过100 keV的设计目标。对$^{127}$Xe电子俘获后γ射线的即时veto效率为(88±2)%，与模拟值(90.4±0.6)%一致。
AI.conclusion: Skin Detector各项性能满足或超过设计预期，验证了其作为主动veto系统的可靠性。M壳层电子俘获（M-shell EC）衰变被用于验证LZ在首次科学运行（first science run）中对低质量暗物质（low-mass dark matter）的探测灵敏度。

title: Quasinormal Modes Criticality across Black Hole Extremality
summary: We investigate the extremal solution branch to nonextremal branch transition in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg anti-de Sitter black holes, where the nonlinear electromagnetic parameter $λ$ governs the existence of the extremal branch solution. At fixed pressure and charge, extremal black hole only exist for $λ\leqλ_c$. For $λ>λ_c$, the lowest Hawking temperature keeps nonzero. Near this threshold, the lowest temperature follows a linear critical scaling, $T_{\min}\propto(λ-λ_c)^{α_T}$. We investigate the corresponding dynamical behavior by computing the quasinormal modes of a massless scalar perturbation along the lowest-temperature black hole branch. As the critical threshold is approached, two complex-frequency quasinormal modes branches collide on the imaginary axis and reorganize into distinct purely imaginary branches. Then the imaginary parts of these modes, together with higher overtones, reach zero at the critical threshold, described by $Γ_n\propto(λ-λ_c)^{α_n}$, with $α_n\simeqα_T$. The resulting zero-damped modes become increasingly localized near the event horizon, and their relative damping rates closely follow the overtone spacing predicted by the near-horizon AdS$_2$ spectrum. Our results show that the thermodynamic and dynamical critical behavior remain closely connected even when extremal black hole solutions cease to exist, providing further evidence for the relevance of near-extremal spectral behavior in this distinct critical regime.

AI.tldr: 该文研究 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 反德西特黑洞中极值解支向非极值解支的转变，发现临界非线性电磁参数 λ_c 处最低霍金温度和准正规模（quasinormal modes）阻尼率均以相同临界指数标度趋于零。
AI.motivation: 非线性电磁参数 λ 决定极值解支是否存在，需厘清极值解消失后热力学与动力学临界行为是否仍相互关联。
AI.method: 在固定压强与电荷下考察 λ ≤ λ_c 的极值解存在条件，并沿最低温度黑洞支计算无质量标量扰动（massless scalar perturbation）的准正规模。
AI.result: λ > λ_c 时最低霍金温度非零，且 T_min ∝ (λ−λ_c)^{α_T}；趋近阈值时两支复频模在虚轴上碰撞并重组为纯虚模，其虚部与高阶泛音满足 Γ_n ∝ (λ−λ_c)^{α_n}，α_n ≃ α_T，零阻尼模（zero-damped modes）愈发局域于事件视界附近。
AI.conclusion: 即使极值黑洞解不再存在，热力学与动力学临界行为仍紧密关联，为近极值谱行为（near-extremal spectral behavior）在该临界区的相关性提供进一步证据。

title: Quantum Dipolar Magnon Drag in Conducting Magnetic Bilayers
summary: We predict electrical drag between two electrically isolated metallic ferromagnets mediated by quantum dipolar magnon coupling. A charge current in one layer generates a nonequilibrium magnon current whose momentum is transferred across an insulating spacer through interlayer dipolar interactions. The resulting magnon current in the passive layer produces a measurable voltage through electron-magnon scattering. We show the combination of resonant quantum momentum transfer and magnetic tunability through the control of magnetization configurations distinguish quantum dipolar drag from conventional drag mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该工作预测两个电绝缘隔离的金属铁磁体之间可通过量子偶极磁振子耦合（quantum dipolar magnon coupling）产生电拖曳（electrical drag）效应。
AI.motivation: 现有拖曳机制之外，需探索由量子磁振子动量转移驱动的新型拖曳，并寻找可与常规拖曳机制区分的判据。
AI.method: 理论预测：一层中的电荷电流产生非平衡磁振子流（nonequilibrium magnon current），其动量经层间偶极相互作用（interlayer dipolar interactions）穿过绝缘间隔层转移；被动层中的磁振子流通过电子-磁振子散射（electron-magnon scattering）产生可测电压。
AI.result: 预测被动层可产生可测量的电压信号；共振量子动量转移与通过磁化构型调控的磁可调性相结合，可将其与常规拖曳机制区分。
AI.conclusion: 量子偶极拖曳是一种可由磁化构型调控的独立拖曳机制，其特征为共振量子动量转移，区别于传统拖曳。

title: Eynard-Orantin Topological Recursions for Higher Weil-Petersson Volumes on Moduli Spaces of Super Riemann Surfaces
summary: We derive an Eynard-Orantin topological recursion for intersection numbers involving Norbury's $Θ$-class together with $ψ$-classes and higher $κ$-classes. These intersection numbers encode higher Weil-Petersson volumes of moduli spaces of super Riemann surfaces. The resulting recursion is a higher-$κ$ deformation of the topological recursion associated with the Bessel curve, which encodes the Brézin-Gross-Witten model.

AI.tldr: 该文推导了含 Norbury Θ-类（Θ-class）、ψ-类（ψ-classes）与高阶 κ-类（higher κ-classes）的相交数的 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归（topological recursion），并指出其结果是对 Bessel 曲线对应递归的高阶 κ 变形。
AI.motivation: 此类相交数编码超黎曼曲面模空间（moduli spaces of super Riemann surfaces）的高阶 Weil-Petersson 体积，故需要为其建立可计算的递归结构。
AI.method: 采用 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归（Eynard-Orantin topological recursion）框架，针对涉及 Θ-类、ψ-类与高阶 κ-类的相交数推导递归关系。
AI.result: 得到相应的拓扑递归，其形式为与 Bessel 曲线（Bessel curve）相关的拓扑递归的高阶 κ 变形；该 Bessel 曲线递归编码 Brézin-Gross-Witten 模型。
AI.conclusion: 所导出的递归将超黎曼曲面模空间高阶 Weil-Petersson 体积的相交数与 Brézin-Gross-Witten 型递归统一起来，表现为后者在高阶 κ-类方向上的变形。

title: Choosing a generator for streaming Gaussian noise in gravitational-wave mock data: accuracy, cost and reproducibility
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to Classical and Quantum Gravity. Data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23243286; reproduction code: https://github.com/isaac-cf-wong/noise-stitching-statistics-data
summary: Mock data challenges need long stretches of colored Gaussian noise with a prescribed spectrum. The candidates are the crossfade of independently drawn windows that the standard gravitational-wave libraries implement, overlap-save finite-impulse-response filtering, autoregressive and autoregressive moving-average (ARMA) models, and the reproducible filter of PyCBC. One measure ranks them all: the covariance error against the target over the analysis band, evaluated from each generator's algebra; generated noise only checks the implementations. We also measure throughput, retained state and the cost of bit-exact regeneration. With the target continued smoothly below the band, the crossfade with windows of 256 s or more reaches an error below $10^{-3}$ on all eleven detector curves as tabulated, at about 4.7 million samples per second from a state of a few hundred bytes. An overlap-save filter is faster but needs tens of thousands of taps for an error of a few percent, and no tested autoregressive or ARMA configuration lies on the accuracy--throughput fronts. An error of $10^{-3}$ needs a window of 8 to 235 s, longest on the design curves with narrow lines, where it also depends on the tabulation. With the target cut at the band edge, as current generators do by default, every method has an error above one half on the projected Advanced LIGO (aLIGO) O4 curve, and the crossfade on five other curves. The crossfade is cyclostationary. With the continued target, its cyclic part is the larger part of the error only at 8 s, on the aLIGO O4 and the Virgo and KAGRA design curves, and stays within a factor of two of the stationary part on the aLIGO O3 and the Virgo and KAGRA design curves. We recommend the crossfade with a window from the table of detector curves, and a smooth continuation of the target below the band.

AI.tldr: 本文对引力波（gravitational-wave）模拟数据所需的色高斯噪声（colored Gaussian noise）生成方法进行系统比较：以协方差误差（covariance error）为核心指标，提出在分析频带下方平滑延拓目标谱的准则。结果表明，256 s 及以上的交叉淡入（crossfade）窗在全部十一条探测器曲线上误差低于 10^-3，吞吐约 470 万样本/秒、状态仅数百字节，被推荐为首选方案。
AI.motivation: Mock data challenge 需要长段满足指定谱的色高斯噪声，而现有生成方式（标准引力波库的交叉淡入窗、overlap-save 有限冲激响应（finite-impulse-response）滤波、自回归（autoregressive）与 ARMA 模型、PyCBC 可复现滤波器）缺乏统一、可比的评价标准，尤其在精度、吞吐与可复现性之间的取舍不清。
AI.method: 以目标谱在分析频带内的协方差误差作为统一排名指标，该误差由各生成器的代数形式直接计算，生成噪声仅用于检验实现；同时测量吞吐、保留状态（retained state）与位精确再生（bit-exact regeneration）成本。并对比两种目标处理方式：频带下方平滑延拓与在带边直接截断。
AI.result: 目标谱平滑延拓时，窗长≥256 s 的交叉淡入在全部十一条探测器曲线上误差低于 10^-3，吞吐约 4.7×10^6 样本/秒，状态仅数百字节；overlap-save 滤波更快但需数万抽头（taps）才能达到百分之几的误差，所测自回归与 ARMA 配置均不落在精度—吞吐前沿上。达到 10^-3 误差需 8–235 s 窗长，含窄线的设计曲线需求最长且依赖制表。若在带边截断目标，各方法在投影的 Advanced LIGO（aLIGO）O4 曲线上误差均超过 0.5，交叉淡入在另外五条曲线上亦如此。交叉淡入为循环平稳（cyclostationary）过程：延拓目标下，其循环部分仅在 8 s 窗、aLIGO O4 及 Virgo、KAGRA 设计曲线上占误差主体，并在 aLIGO O3 及 Virgo、KAGRA 设计曲线上保持在平稳部分的两倍以内。
AI.conclusion: 推荐采用窗长取自探测器曲线表格的交叉淡入方法，并对目标谱在频带下方作平滑延拓；带边截断会显著恶化误差，不宜作为默认做法。

title: SCRAMJet: An Ultra Low Latency JetClass-Scale Transformer for the HL-LHC Level-1 Trigger
summary: Level-1 Triggers at the LHC classify collisions within a few microseconds on FPGAs, where a network is a fully unrolled circuit whose cost is area rather than time. We present SCRAMJet, a transformer encoder that replaces multi-head attention with a low-rank projection, trains under per-parameter learned fixed-point quantization, and compiles to Verilog with distributed arithmetic optimization. On the ten-class JetClass dataset it reaches $71.4 \pm 0.6\%$ accuracy with 0.157M multiply-accumulates, 6.1 accuracy points above the strongest published resource-constrained model at an eighth of the operations, and meets timing on a Virtex UltraScale+ VU13P at 147 ns using 25.7% of the logic. We also show that resource-aware training silently removes attention channels: one whose learned bit-width reaches zero still carries signal during training but is absent from the compiled circuit, so the loss never sees it go. We call these virtual channels, and a floor on the attention datalane that prevents them is worth 3.1 accuracy points at matched budget. Code and trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Aaddy-1/hgq-jetformer.

AI.tldr: SCRAMJet 是一个面向 LHC Level-1 触发器（trigger）的 transformer 编码器（transformer encoder），用低秩投影（low-rank projection）替代多头注意力（multi-head attention），并在逐参数学习到的定点量化（fixed-point quantization）下训练，最终编译为带分布式算术（distributed arithmetic）优化的 Verilog 电路。在 JetClass 数据集上以 0.157M 乘加（multiply-accumulate）取得 71.4±0.6% 准确率，并在 VU13P FPGA 上于 147 ns 内满足时序。
AI.motivation: LHC 的 Level-1 触发器需在数微秒内于 FPGA 上完成碰撞事件分类，此时网络作为完全展开的电路（fully unrolled circuit），其代价体现为面积（area）而非时间。因此需要面向硬件资源约束设计并训练模型，而非仅优化推理延迟。
AI.method: 将多头注意力替换为低秩投影以降低计算量；训练时采用逐参数可学习的定点量化（per-parameter learned fixed-point quantization）；再经分布式算术优化编译为 Verilog。同时在训练中引入资源感知（resource-aware training）机制，并以注意力数据通路（attention datalane）下限约束加以修正。
AI.result: 在十类 JetClass 数据集上达到 71.4±0.6% 准确率，仅用 0.157M 乘加；相较已发表的最强资源受限模型提升 6.1 个百分点，运算量仅为其八分之一。在 Virtex UltraScale+ VU13P 上以 147 ns 满足时序，占用 25.7% 逻辑资源。
AI.conclusion: 资源感知训练会隐性移除注意力通道：某通道学习位宽降为零后，训练中仍携带信号但已不存在于编译电路中，导致损失函数无法感知其消失，作者称之为“虚拟通道（virtual channels）”。在同等预算下，为注意力数据通路设置下限以避免该现象可带来 3.1 个百分点准确率收益。

title: An Amplitudes Approach to Spinning Black Hole Scattering
summary: The detection of gravitational waves has opened a new era of precision studies of gravity, demanding advances in our understanding of compact binary dynamics. Scattering amplitudes provide a powerful framework for studying these systems using methods from high-energy physics. In this thesis, we study classical black hole scattering, systematically including spin---an important feature of real astrophysical systems---to describe Kerr black hole dynamics. We model Kerr black holes as massive point particles in finite-spin representations and compute their scattering dynamics perturbatively. We resolve an ambiguity mixing classical and quantum contributions using our spin interpolation method, obtaining a classical amplitude for Kerr black hole scattering through quartic order in spin at third post-Minkowskian order. From this amplitude, we extract the gauge-invariant radial action, enabling the computation of classical non-aligned-spin observables---such as the linear and angular impulses---using covariant Dirac brackets. The amplitude exhibits spin-shift symmetry, remaining invariant under a shift of the black hole spin by the momentum transfer. Motivated by this property, we study the conserved quantities governing the scattering process and show that the dynamics of a probe black hole remains integrable at asymptotic infinity through quartic order in probe spin. Finally, we show that the quartic-in-spin radial action for a probe black hole in a Kerr background, at any order in perturbation theory, is completely fixed by the aligned-spin dynamics, provided that it satisfies asymptotic integrability and spin-shift symmetry.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用散射振幅（scattering amplitudes）方法系统纳入自旋（spin），在第三 post-Minkowskian 阶、自旋四阶精度下计算 Kerr 黑洞（Kerr black hole）经典散射振幅，并提取规范不变的径向作用量（radial action）以求解非对齐自旋可观测量。
AI.motivation: 引力波（gravitational waves）探测开启了精密引力研究新时代，需要对致密双星（compact binary）动力学有更深入理解；散射振幅为借助高能物理方法研究此类系统提供强有力框架，而真实天体系统的重要特征——自旋——需被系统纳入以描述 Kerr 黑洞动力学。
AI.method: 将 Kerr 黑洞建模为有限自旋表示（finite-spin representations）中的大质量点粒子，微扰计算其散射动力学；采用自旋插值方法（spin interpolation method）消解经典与量子贡献混合的歧义，得到第三 post-Minkowskian 阶、自旋四阶的经典振幅，并由协变 Dirac 括号（covariant Dirac brackets）提取可观测量。
AI.result: 获得 Kerr 黑洞散射的经典振幅及规范不变径向作用量，可计算线性与角向冲量（linear and angular impulses）等非对齐自旋可观测量；振幅表现出自旋平移对称性（spin-shift symmetry），即黑洞自旋在平移动量转移下保持不变；探针黑洞动力学在渐近无穷处至探针自旋四阶保持可积（integrable）。
AI.conclusion: Kerr 背景下探针黑洞的自旋四阶径向作用量在任意微扰阶数下完全由对齐自旋（aligned-spin）动力学确定，前提是满足渐近可积性与自旋平移对称性。

title: A Julia implementation of Floquet-Bloch theory for high-harmonic generation in periodic systems
summary: We present a flexible Julia codebase implementing Floquet-Bloch theory for high-harmonic generation (HHG) in periodic tight-binding systems. Using the frequency-domain Fourier-Sambe formalism, the package maps the time-dependent Schroedinger equation onto a static eigenvalue problem. This allows direct computation of Floquet states, quasienergy bands, and harmonic currents for 1D, 2D, or 3D lattices under arbitrary light polarizations. The implementation supports both analytical Fourier-Bessel expansions (via Peierls substitution) and numerical Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT). We validate the code against a canonical 1D two-band model and showcase its capabilities on 2D honeycomb systems: gapped graphene mapping HHG cutoff scaling with hopping parameters and the Kane-Mele model, exploring field-induced quasienergy gaps and topological transitions under linear and circular driving fields. In addition to the theoretical presentation, we provide a flexible and efficient open-source Julia implementation of the Floquet formalism: https://github.com/Ashwin-A-Pillai/Floquet-Fourier-Numericals/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个基于Julia的开源代码库，用频域Fourier-Sambe形式将Floquet-Bloch理论用于周期性紧束缚系统的高次谐波产生（HHG）计算，并在一维与二维模型上完成验证与演示。
AI.motivation: 高次谐波产生（high-harmonic generation, HHG）的Floquet-Bloch理论计算往往实现分散、缺乏灵活高效的开源工具，本文旨在提供一个通用代码库以直接求解Floquet态、准能带与谐波电流。
AI.method: 采用频域Fourier-Sambe形式（frequency-domain Fourier-Sambe formalism），将含时薛定谔方程（time-dependent Schroedinger equation）映射为静态本征值问题；支持Peierls替换下的解析Fourier-Bessel展开与数值快速傅里叶变换（Fast Fourier Transform, FFT）两种途径，适用于1D/2D/3D晶格与任意光偏振。
AI.result: 代码通过典型一维两带模型（1D two-band model）验证；在二维蜂窝系统（2D honeycomb systems）上演示：带隙石墨烯（gapped graphene）中HHG截止频率（cutoff）随跃迁参数（hopping parameters）的标度关系，以及Kane-Mele模型中线性与圆偏振驱动场下场致准能隙（quasienergy gaps）与拓扑相变（topological transitions）的探究。
AI.conclusion: 除理论阐述外，作者提供了灵活高效的Floquet形式开源Julia实现（含代码仓库链接），为周期性紧束缚体系HHG研究提供可复用工具。

title: On Emergent Geometry of the Generalized BGW Theory
summary: We present a systematic study of the mathematical theory of the generalized Brézin-Gross-Witten (BGW) theory using methods from statistical physics. We prove the multidifferentials of the generalized BGW theory are given by the Eynard-Orantin topological recursion in a generic background with general coupling constants. Furthermore, we characterize the transition between the Witten-Kontsevich model and the generalized BGW theory. This approach yields a new proof of the Okuyama-Sakai conjecture, further elucidating the deep structural connections between these two fundamental models.

AI.tldr: 本文运用统计物理（statistical physics）方法系统研究广义 Brézin-Gross-Witten（BGW）理论的数学结构，证明其多重微分由一般背景下的 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归（topological recursion）给出，并刻画了 Witten-Kontsevich 模型与广义 BGW 理论之间的转变。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对广义 BGW 理论的数学刻画尚不系统，且其与 Witten-Kontsevich 模型之间的结构联系及 Okuyama-Sakai 猜想缺乏统一解释，本文旨在以统计物理方法建立系统性的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用统计物理（statistical physics）中的方法，在含一般耦合常数（general coupling constants）的一般背景（generic background）下研究广义 BGW 理论的多重微分（multidifferentials），并借助 Eynard-Orantin 拓扑递归（topological recursion）进行刻画，同时分析两类模型间的转变。
