AI.method: 提出 SeriesXRD，将衍射序列而非独立图样作为分析对象：抑制方位角局域的金刚石散射、扣背景、跨帧拟合与追踪反射，利用压力相关晶格参数（pressure-dependent lattice parameters）匹配已知物相，扣除已确信归属的贡献，并将持续存在的未解释反射分组为候选样品相关或未知物相特征。
AI.result: 在约 30 nm 厚层状 UOTe 薄片、3.5–50.7 GPa、共 1288 帧的数据上验证；该数据背景极强，仅约 4% 帧可检测到 UOTe 衍射。全序列拟合 17,143 个峰，14,395 个通过质量筛选，其中 90% 归属为已知背景或参考物相；并复现了原人工分析识别出的样品相关反射，将相归属与残差分析流程从两个多月人工时间缩短为一夜自动运行。
AI.conclusion: SeriesXRD 可将大规模、背景主导的衍射序列转化为可处理的物相归属结果与相干未解释反射集合，同时保留每个判定决策的可追溯记录，为弱信号与非晶/未知相的自动化发现提供可行途径。

title: Koopman-von Neumann formalism meets contact Hamiltonian systems
summary: The present work develops a Koopman--von Neumann (KvN) formulation of contact Hamiltonian dynamics on the Hilbert space defined by the contact volume. The resulting generator includes the divergence correction required for unitary evolution. We establish symmetry and, for complete contact Hamiltonian vector fields, essential self-adjointness and a strongly continuous unitary evolution; we also describe covariance under contactomorphisms. For completely integrable contact systems with complete flows, it is possible to recover an invariant direct-integral decomposition and strongly commuting KvN generators. We further relate contact KvN dynamics to the KvN formulation of its symplectization.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Koopman–von Neumann（KvN）表述推广到接触哈密顿动力学（contact Hamiltonian dynamics），在由接触体积（contact volume）定义的希尔伯特空间上构造含散度修正（divergence correction）的生成元，并建立对称性、本质自伴性与强连续酉演化等性质。
AI.motivation: KvN 表述此前主要针对辛哈密顿系统，本文旨在为接触哈密顿动力学建立相应的希尔伯特空间算子框架，使酉演化（unitary evolution）与对称性分析可在接触几何（contact geometry）下进行。
AI.method: 在接触体积定义的希尔伯特空间上构造 KvN 生成元，引入保证酉演化所需的散度修正；证明对称性与完全接触哈密顿向量场（complete contact Hamiltonian vector fields）下的本质自伴性（essential self-adjointness）及强连续酉演化，并刻画接触同构（contactomorphisms）下的协变性。
AI.result: 对具有完全流的完全可积接触系统（completely integrable contact systems），可恢复不变直积分分解（invariant direct-integral decomposition）与强交换的 KvN 生成元；并建立接触 KvN 动力学与其辛化（symplectization）KvN 表述之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 接触哈密顿动力学可获得结构完整的 KvN 量子化式表述，其算子性质与可积结构及辛化图像相容，为接触系统的谱与演化分析提供框架。

title: Charge-Activated Birefringence and Shadow Mimicry around Reissner-Nordström Black Holes
summary: We discover that electric charge can activates birefringence for a neutral vector field coupled to the Einstein tensor around a Reissner-Nordström black hole. Changing the electric charge of an uncoupled black hole can mimic one parity's shadow radius of a coupled black hole. The coupling makes the two parity looks differently. It separates their shadow edges of two parities and produces a backward-scattered signal with reversed helicity. However changing the charge alone cannot reproduce both effects. They require both nonzero charge and coupling. At weak coupling, the leading correction is the same for both potential. Positive coupling raises the potential, reduces low-frequency absorption and decrease the average shadow radius. Negative coupling reverses these trends. The backward signal is nonzero, this is due to the difference between the complex scattering amplitudes of the two parities. It is entirely helicity reversed. For the uncoupled field, the shadows is the same for both parities and the backward intensity vanishes exactly at every charge. We can use the split edge and backward signal to distinguish the coupling from a change of charge alone. A comparison with observations still requires a mechanism that produces and detects this field.

AI.tldr: 该摘要指出，在Reissner-Nordström黑洞背景下，电中性矢量场与爱因斯坦张量耦合后，电荷可"激活"双折射效应，导致两种宇称的阴影边缘分离并产生螺旋度反转的后向散射信号；这些效应需要电荷与耦合同时非零，可作为区分"耦合"与"单纯改变电荷"的观测判据。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探究中性矢量场与引力（爱因斯坦张量）的非最小耦合是否会带来可观测的偏振相关效应，以及这类效应能否与黑洞电荷变化所导致的效应相区分。
AI.method: 采用围绕Reissner-Nordström黑洞的矢量场微扰分析，比较耦合与非耦合情形下两种宇称（parity）的势函数、低频吸收、阴影半径及后向散射信号，并在弱耦合（weak coupling）下考察领头阶修正。
AI.result: 耦合使两种宇称的阴影边缘分离并产生螺旋度（helicity）反转的后向散射信号；弱耦合下两种势的领头修正相同，正耦合抬高势、降低低频吸收并减小平均阴影半径，负耦合则相反。非耦合场两种宇称阴影相同，后向强度在任意电荷下严格为零。改变电荷本身无法同时复现上述两种效应。
AI.conclusion: 阴影边缘分裂与后向信号可用于将爱因斯坦张量耦合与单纯电荷改变区分开；但与实际观测对比仍需一套能够产生并探测该矢量场的机制。

title: Light nucleus and hypernucleus production at RHIC and LHC energies: a comparative study of phenomenological models
comment: Report of the EMMI Rapid Reaction Task Force on "Understanding Light (Anti)Nuclei Production at RHIC and LHC", held at GSI on April 8-12, 2024
summary: This document summarizes the work of the EMMI Rapid Reaction Task Force on ``Understanding light (anti)nuclei production at RHIC and LHC'', which took place at GSI on 8--12 April 2024. The meeting brought together experimentalists and theorists to discuss the current understanding of light-nuclei and hypernuclei production in high-energy hadronic collisions, with particular emphasis on statistical hadronization, coalescence, kinetic, and transport approaches. The discussions addressed the experimental status and the ability of different theoretical descriptions to reproduce the available measurements, as well as the connections between nuclear production, femtoscopic correlations, source sizes, nuclear wave functions, and the formation dynamics of loosely bound states. This document reviews the main experimental and theoretical developments presented during the RRTF, summarizes the key questions that emerged from the discussions, and identifies observables and future measurements that may help discriminate among different production mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文件总结了2024年4月在GSI举行的EMMI快速反应任务组会议，围绕高能强子碰撞中轻（反）核与超核产生机制展开综述，涵盖实验现状与多种理论描述的比较，并提出可区分不同产生机制的观测量与未来测量方向。
AI.motivation: 高能强子碰撞中轻核（light nuclei）与超核（hypernuclei）的产生机制尚存争议，需汇聚实验与理论视角厘清现有理解，并评估不同理论框架对测量数据的再现能力。
AI.method: 以任务组（Rapid Reaction Task Force）形式组织实验学家与理论学家共同研讨，重点比较统计强子化（statistical hadronization）、聚结（coalescence）、动力学（kinetic）与输运（transport）等理论途径，并探讨核产生与飞米oscopic关联（femtoscopic correlations）、源尺寸（source sizes）、核波函数（nuclear wave functions）及松散束缚态形成动力学之间的联系。
AI.result: 综述了RHIC与LHC相关实验与理论进展，梳理了讨论中浮现的关键问题，并识别出若干有助于判别不同产生机制的观测量与未来测量。
AI.conclusion: 不同理论描述对现有测量的再现能力各有差异，需借助新的观测量与未来实验数据来区分统计强子化、聚结、动力学与输运等产生机制。

title: I want to Break Free: The Positive Side of Symmetry Breaking
summary: We study the role of internal field-space symmetries in Effective Field Theories constrained by positivity bounds. For theories with $N$ real scalar fields, we classify derivative operators according to the internal symmetries they preserve, organising them into hierarchies based on the maximal symmetry $O(N)$ and its subgroups. We find that the Wilson coefficients of operators that depart from an enhanced symmetry are bounded in terms of those that respect it. This means that departures from an enhanced internal symmetry cannot be made arbitrarily large while maintaining a standard UV completion, even when the enhanced internal symmetry was not imposed in constructing the low-energy theory. Moreover, along a cascade of progressively smaller preserved subgroups, the coefficients of operators preserving lower levels of symmetry are bounded by those preserving larger subgroups in the cascade, and are consequently subject to progressively stronger constraints. We demonstrate these results through a variety of examples involving $2-2$ and $3-3$ scattering of indefinite states formed from superpositions of multiple scalar species.

AI.tldr: 本文研究受正性边界（positivity bounds）约束的有效场论（Effective Field Theory）中内部场空间对称性（internal field-space symmetries）的作用，证明偏离增强对称性的算符系数被保持该对称性的系数所限制。
AI.motivation: 正性边界对有效场论施加约束，但内部场空间对称性（尤其是未被显式施加的增强对称性）在这些约束中的角色尚不清楚，本文旨在厘清偏离增强对称性的程度是否可任意大。
AI.method: 针对含 $N$ 个实标量场（real scalar fields）的理论，按所保持的内部对称性对导数算符（derivative operators）分类，并以最大对称群 $O(N)$ 及其子群构建层级结构；通过由多个标量种类叠加形成的非定态（indefinite states）的 $2-2$ 与 $3-3$ 散射过程举例论证。
AI.result: 偏离增强对称性的算符的威尔逊系数（Wilson coefficients）被保持该对称性的算符系数所界定；在逐级缩小的保持子群级联（cascade）中，保持较低对称性层级的算符系数被保持较大子群的系数所限制，因而受到逐级更强的约束。
AI.conclusion: 即使在构建低能理论时未施加增强的内部对称性，只要要求存在标准的紫外完备（standard UV completion），偏离增强内部对称性也不能任意大，这对模型构建具有非平凡的约束意义。

title: Kinetics of Self-Organization in One Component Active Matter Systems
summary: We study an inherently nonequilibrium system consisting of self-propelled particles using molecular dynamics simulation in $d=2$. The system self-organizes through quorum-sensing interactions characterized by an interaction range $λ$ and a parameter $c_{\mathrm{th}}$. When the local concentration sensed by a particle, represented by an auxiliary variable $c_i(t)$ exceeds $c_{\mathrm{th}}$, its self-propulsion velocity abruptly drops to zero, leading to the emergence of particle rich domains. For small $λ$, we observe a droplet-like morphology of clusters, which crosses over to a bicontinuous structure as $λ$ increases. We confirm this transition by computing the eccentricity of the domains. Next, we characterize the evolving domain morphologies using equal-time correlation function $C(r,t)$ and structure factor $S(k,t)$ of the density field. For a fixed $λ$, the scaled $C(r,t)$'s at different times are indistinguishable from each other, indicating dynamical scaling. However, at a fixed time $t$, the scaling functions differ for different values of $λ$, confirming a $λ$-dependent morphological transition. In the large-wavevector limit ($k\rightarrow\infty$), the tail of $S(k,t)$ consistently follows the Porod's law: $S(k,t)\sim k^{-3}$. Furthermore, the average domain size $L(t)$ exhibits a power-law growth, $L(t)\sim t^{1/3}$, independent of $λ$.

AI.tldr: 采用二维分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟研究由群体感应（quorum-sensing）相互作用驱动的自驱动粒子（self-propelled particles）非平衡体系，发现随相互作用范围 λ 增大，团簇形貌由液滴状转变为双连续结构，并呈现动力学标度与 $L(t)\sim t^{1/3}$ 的普适生长律。
AI.motivation: 研究目标是刻画内在非平衡（inherently nonequilibrium）的自驱动粒子体系如何通过群体感应相互作用实现自组织，并考察相互作用范围 λ 与阈值参数 $c_{\mathrm{th}}$ 对团簇形貌及演化动力学的影响。
AI.method: 在 $d=2$ 中进行分子动力学模拟；粒子通过辅助变量 $c_i(t)$ 感知局部浓度，当浓度超过 $c_{\mathrm{th}}$ 时自驱动速度骤降为零，从而形成粒子富集区域。分析手段包括偏心度（eccentricity）、等时关联函数（equal-time correlation function）$C(r,t)$、结构因子（structure factor）$S(k,t)$ 及平均畴尺寸 $L(t)$。
AI.result: 小 λ 时团簇呈液滴状形貌，随 λ 增大过渡为双连续（bicontinuous）结构，该转变经偏心度计算得到确认。固定 λ 时不同时刻的标度化 $C(r,t)$ 重合，显示动力学标度（dynamical scaling）；但同一时刻不同 λ 的标度函数不同，证实形貌转变依赖于 λ。大波矢极限下 $S(k,t)$ 尾部服从 Porod 定律 $S(k,t)\sim k^{-3}$，且 $L(t)$ 呈与 λ 无关的幂律生长 $L(t)\sim t^{1/3}$。
AI.conclusion: 群体感应相互作用范围 λ 控制团簇的稳态形貌（液滴状至双连续的转变），而畴生长的动力学标度指数与 Porod 尾部行为对 λ 不敏感，表明形貌差异与生长普适性在该体系中可相互独立。

title: Rapid mixing for Gibbs samplers for quantum spin systems with all-to-all interactions
summary: Understanding when quantum many-body systems rapidly converge to thermal equilibrium is a central problem in quantum statistical mechanics. While spatial locality provides powerful tools for systems with an underlying geometry, fully connected models require estimates that accommodate interactions between every pair of spins. We study Gibbs-state preparation for two-local quantum Hamiltonians on arbitrary interaction graphs, including fully connected systems, via Lindblad dynamics that satisfies Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) detailed balance. Our approach is based on a quantum analogue of the classical Dobrushin condition, which controls the influence of local perturbations on the rest of the system. Using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order $1$, we quantify how these perturbations propagate under the dynamics and derive contraction estimates in a high-temperature regime controlled by the maximum total interaction strength per site. These estimates require no assumptions on spatial geometry or graph growth and yield mixing times logarithmic in the system size and the inverse error tolerance, uniformly over all initial states.

AI.tldr: 本文利用满足KMS细致平衡的Lindblad动力学，基于经典Dobrushin条件的量子类比，在无需空间几何假设的任意相互作用图（含全连接系统）上证明了Gibbs态制备的混合时间（mixing time）随系统尺寸与误差倒数均呈对数增长。
AI.motivation: 量子多体系统何时快速趋于热平衡是量子统计力学（quantum statistical mechanics）的核心问题。空间局域性（spatial locality）为具几何结构的系统提供了有力工具，但全连接模型（fully connected models）需处理任意自旋对之间的相互作用，缺乏相应的估计手段。
AI.method: 针对任意相互作用图上的两体局域哈密顿量（two-local Hamiltonians），采用满足Kubo–Martin–Schwinger（KMS）细致平衡的Lindblad动力学；以经典Dobrushin条件的量子类比控制局部扰动对系统其余部分的影响，并用一阶量子Wasserstein距离（quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1）量化扰动的传播。
AI.result: 在由每格点最大总相互作用强度控制的高温区间（high-temperature regime）导出了动力学收缩估计（contraction estimates），且不需要空间几何或图增长方面的任何假设；所得混合时间与系统尺寸及逆误差容忍度（inverse error tolerance）均呈对数关系，且对所有初始态一致成立。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，即使在全连接等无空间局域性的系统中，Gibbs态制备仍可在对数混合时间内完成；基于量子Dobrushin条件与量子Wasserstein距离的分析框架为无几何假设的混合时间估计提供了通用途径。

title: Spectral instability of charged scalar quasinormal modes and superradiance: Stabilizing the unstable
summary: The spectral instability of black holes has become a central topic of the black-hole spectroscopy program. Small changes to the black-hole scattering potential are known to produce disproportionately large migrations of its quasinormal modes in the complex plane, but it is unclear whether this sensitivity carries over to energy extraction through superradiance. We study this relation for massless charged scalar fields on Reissner--Nordström and Reissner--Nordström--de Sitter backgrounds. A localized positive potential bump, small in mass-scaled height, is displaced outward from the light ring while the original radiative boundary conditions are preserved. In the asymptotically flat case, a quasinormal branch enters the superradiant frequency regime while remaining damped. By searching for competing modes, we show that the least-damped positive-frequency mode also enters this regime, after a series of mode overtakings driven by quasinormal-mode migration. The real-frequency amplification, nevertheless, is only weakly affected and develops no pronounced narrow resonance. In de Sitter black holes, the bump can move an initially growing monopole mode into the damped half of the complex plane, stabilizing selected configurations that are initially modally unstable. After stabilization, the peak superradiant amplification can remain above both its unperturbed value and a gain of $100\%$; it falls below $100\%$ only for more distant bump locations. A prescribed positive perturbation can thus suppress modal growth without changing the superradiant frequency bounds or immediately suppressing the scattering peak.

AI.tldr: 本文研究黑洞谱不稳定性（spectral instability）是否会传导至超辐射（superradiance）能量提取过程。通过在 Reissner–Nordström 与 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 背景上引入局部正势垒微扰，发现准正规模（quasinormal modes）虽显著迁移并进入超辐射频域，但实频放大率仅受轻微影响；在 de Sitter 情形下，该微扰可将初始增长的单极模推入阻尼半平面从而实现稳定化，而超辐射峰值仍可保持在 100% 以上。
AI.motivation: 黑洞谱程序（black-hole spectroscopy program）中已知散射势的微小改变会引起准正规模在复平面上的不成比例大迁移，但这种敏感性是否同样影响超辐射（superradiance）能量提取尚不明确，本文旨在厘清二者关系。
AI.method: 在 Reissner–Nordström 与 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 背景上研究无质量带电标量场（massless charged scalar fields），引入高度在质量标度下很小的局域正势垒（localized positive potential bump），将其自光球（light ring）向外移动并保持原有辐射边界条件；通过搜索竞争模式追踪准正规模迁移与模式交叉，并计算实频放大的峰值。
AI.result: 渐近平坦情形下，经一系列由准正规模迁移驱动的模式交叉后，阻尼最小的正频模式进入超辐射频域而仍保持阻尼，但实频放大（real-frequency amplification）仅被轻微改变，未出现显著窄共振。de Sitter 情形下，势垒可使初始增长的单极模移至复平面阻尼半侧，稳定原本模不稳定的构型；稳定后峰值超辐射放大仍可高于未微扰值及 100% 增益，仅当势垒位置更远时才降至 100% 以下。
AI.conclusion: 预设的正微扰能够抑制模增长，却不改变超辐射频率边界，也不立即压制散射峰值，表明谱敏感性与超辐射能量提取之间存在弱耦合关系。

title: BESIII $X(3790)$ enhancement as a reflection of higher charmed mesons
summary: In this work, we show that the $X(3790)$ reported by the BESIII Collaboration is unlikely to be a genuine resonance, a conclusion that follows from the incompleteness of the BESIII experimental analysis. Although BESIII included the established charmed mesons that couple to $Dπ$, as listed by the Particle Data Group, and incorporated their reflections in the $D^0D^-$ invariant mass spectrum, this fit to the experimental data does not exhaust the charmed mesons that can contribute to the $D^0D^-$ invariant mass spectrum through reflections, as can be explicitly seen from a theoretical charmed-meson spectroscopy. We find that a predicted charmed meson, either $D(3\,{}^3S_1)$ or $D(2\,{}^3D_1)$, can play a crucial role in mimicking the $X(3790)$ structure through the corresponding reflection. This warrants caution in interpreting the $X(3790)$ as a genuine resonance. Moreover, such an interpretation is not supported by most theoretical studies of $D\bar{D}$ hadronic molecules and compact $c\bar{c}d\bar{u}$ tetraquarks currently available.

AI.tldr: 该工作指出BESIII报道的X(3790)很可能并非真实共振态，其原因在于BESIII分析中未穷尽可通过反射（reflection）贡献到D⁰D⁻不变质量谱的粲介子（charmed meson），理论上预言的D(3³S₁)或D(2³D₁)即可通过相应反射模拟出X(3790)结构。
AI.motivation: BESIII将X(3790)解释为共振态，但其数据分析仅纳入了粒子数据组（Particle Data Group）所列与Dπ耦合的已知粲介子及其反射，作者质疑该拟合的完备性与X(3790)共振态解释的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于理论粲介子谱（charmed-meson spectroscopy），考察BESIII拟合未纳入的粲介子及其反射对D⁰D⁻不变质量谱的贡献，并与现有的D̄D强子分子（hadronic molecule）与紧凑c̄c d̄u四夸克（tetraquark）理论研究进行对照。
AI.result: 理论预言的粲介子D(3³S₁)或D(2³D₁)能够通过相应反射关键性地模拟X(3790)结构，表明BESIII对实验数据的拟合并未穷尽可贡献于D⁰D⁻谱的粲介子；此外，多数现有D̄D强子分子与紧凑四夸克理论研究并不支持X(3790)的共振态解释。
AI.conclusion: X(3790)不应被轻易解读为真实共振态，BESIII实验分析在粲介子反射贡献上存在不完备性；对X(3790)的性质判定需更加谨慎，并需补全理论谱中可能的反射来源。

title: The Virasoro Bootstrap: from the $c\sim1$ desert to coupled Potts
summary: We develop a numerical conformal bootstrap for two-dimensional CFTs with $c>1$ based on Virasoro conformal blocks, computed with Zamolodchikov's recursion and optimal polynomial interpolation. As a first test we isolate an island around three decoupled Ising models. We then consider three 3-state Potts models coupled through their energy operators, a candidate irrational CFT. Mixed correlators isolate the decoupled theory in an island, and different gap assumptions, motivated by perturbation theory, yield a peninsula that contains the coupled fixed point but not the decoupled one. Finally, we explore the standard single-correlator bound on the lowest-dimension scalar primary in the OPE of two identical scalars. We find that for central charges just above $c=1$ the bound collapses over a wide range of external dimensions. This excludes any theory whose lightest scalar is absent from its own OPE and lies in this range, and supports the conjecture that no compact CFT exists in this region. We explain several features of these bounds analytically.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了适用于 c>1 的二维共形场论的数值共形 bootstrap 方法，并据此分离出三个解耦 Ising 模型构成的岛，进而对耦合 3-state Potts 模型候选不动点与 c 略大于 1 区域的紧致 CFT 存在问题给出约束。
AI.motivation: 现有数值共形 bootstrap 多集中于 c≤1 的有理 CFT，缺乏对 c>1 非有理 CFT 的有效数值处理手段；同时 c 略大于 1 区域是否存在紧致 CFT 尚属未决猜想，需要独立数值检验。
AI.method: 基于 Virasoro 共形块（Virasoro conformal blocks）构建二维 CFT 的数值共形 bootstrap，共形块由 Zamolodchikov 递推（Zamolodchikov's recursion）计算并结合最优多项式插值（optimal polynomial interpolation）；使用混合关联函数（mixed correlators）与由微扰论启发的能隙假设（gap assumptions），并考察两个相同标量算符 OPE 中最低维标量原初场的单关联函数界（single-correlator bound）。
AI.result: 混合关联函数在三个解耦 Ising 模型周围给出一个岛（island）；不同能隙假设给出一个半岛（peninsula），其中包含耦合不动点而不包含解耦理论。单关联函数界显示，当中心荷（central charge）略大于 c=1 时，该界在大范围外维度上发生塌缩，从而排除最轻标量不出现在自身 OPE 中且处于该范围内的理论。
AI.conclusion: 结果为 c>1 非有理 CFT 的数值 bootstrap 提供了可行框架，并支持“该区域不存在紧致 CFT（compact CFT）”的猜想；作者还对若干界的特征给出了解析解释。

title: X-ray magnetic circular dichroism in altermagnets: insights from symmetry
summary: Altermagnets are a unique subset of antiferromagnets possessing ferromagnet-like responses that are odd in the Néel vector, making X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) a natural probe of ground state altermagnetic order. Because the relativistic ingredient of XMCD at the $L$-edge is supplied predominantly by core-level spin--orbit coupling (SOC), the dichroic signal can reflect the non-relativistic order of the valence electrons. Here we develop a complete symmetry framework for XMCD in altermagnets (AMs) preserving the crystalline unit cell. We tabulate the symmetry-allowed optical Hall vector, anisotropic magnetic dipole (AMD), and underlying octupolar components for all magnetic point groups, thereby identifying the experimental geometries that maximize the XMCD signal. We show that only twelve magnetic point groups, none with a rotation axis of order three or higher, are compatible with both altermagnetism and finite XMCD. By extending the Landau theory of collinear AMs, we connect these relativistic constraints to the spin--orbit-free order. We show that the AMD is forced to vanish at zero valence SOC in conventional antiferromagnets, and that every AM sublattice structure allows the Hall vector and AMD at linear or cubic order in the Néel vector; whether the resulting XMCD is nonzero depends on the Néel vector orientation at finite SOC. The Landau theory thus fixes the Néel-vector dependence of the XMCD for all AM candidates, and separates $d$-wave AMs, whose signal is inherited from a non-relativistic AMD, from $g$- and $i$-wave AMs, whose signal requires valence SOC or core--valence multiplet effects. We illustrate these predictions with first-principles Bethe--Salpeter calculations of $L$-edge XMCD for five representative altermagnetic materials and one conventional antiferromagnet.

AI.tldr: 该论文为交错磁体（altermagnet）中的X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）建立了完整的对称性框架，将与自旋轨道耦合（SOC）相关的相对论性二色信号与非相对论价电子序联系起来。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体具有对奈尔矢量（Néel vector）呈奇宇称的铁磁类响应，使XMCD成为探测其基态交错磁序的天然手段；但XMCD在L边的相对论成分主要来自芯能级自旋轨道耦合，因此需要阐明该二色信号如何反映价电子的非相对论序。
AI.method: 构建保持晶胞不变的交错磁体XMCD完整对称性框架，对全部磁点群列表给出对称性允许的光学霍尔矢量（optical Hall vector）、各向异性磁偶极（anisotropic magnetic dipole, AMD）及底层八极（octupolar）分量；并扩展共线交错磁体的朗道理论（Landau theory），结合第一性原理Bethe–Salpeter计算对五种代表性交错磁体与一种常规反铁磁体的L边XMCD进行验证。
AI.result: 仅十二个磁点群（且均不含三阶及以上转轴）同时兼容交错磁性与有限XMCD；AMD在零价电子SOC下于常规反铁磁体中被迫为零，而每种交错磁子晶格结构均允许霍尔矢量与AMD在奈尔矢量的线性或三次阶出现，XMCD是否非零取决于有限SOC下奈尔矢量的取向。
AI.conclusion: 该朗道理论确定了所有交错磁候选材料的XMCD对奈尔矢量的依赖关系，并区分了信号源自非相对论AMD的d波交错磁体与需要价电子SOC或芯–价多重态效应的g波和i波交错磁体。

title: On the lower bound of the refined Bessis--Moussa--Villani conjecture: proof of the cases S_{6,3} and S_{7,3} for 3x3 matrices
comment: Proof by Claude (Anthropic) checked by Gemini Opus (Google). The author guided Claude in finding the proof
summary: For Hermitian matrices $α,β$ let $\A_{n,m}(e^α,e^β)$ be the average of the traces of all words with $n$ letters $e^α$ and $m$ letters $e^β$. The refined Bessis--Moussa--Villani conjecture contains the lower bound $\A_{n,m}(e^α,e^β)\ge\Tr e^{nα+mβ}$ (Tr denotes the trace), which for $n=m=1$ is the Golden--Thompson inequality. We prove this lower bound for all $n+m\le7$ when the matrices have size at most three, and for $\min(n,m)\le2$ in every dimension. In all these cases we prove the stronger inequality $\A_{n,m}(A,B)\ge\Tr(A^{n/m}B)^m$ for positive semidefinite $A,B$, or its mirror image with the roles of $A$ and $B$ exchanged; the lower bound of the refined conjecture follows from the Araki--Lieb--Thirring inequality. The cases with three letters $B$ in dimension three, $(n,m)=(3,3)$ and $(4,3)$, are reduced by an exact identity and the inequality of arithmetic and geometric means to a polynomial inequality in two variables, which is certified in exact rational arithmetic by Bernstein expansion on three boxes. The certificate is a short program in the ancillary files.

AI.tldr: 论文证明细化 Bessis–Moussa–Villani 猜想（Bessis–Moussa–Villani conjecture）中的迹不等式下界 A_{n,m}(e^α,e^β) ≥ Tr e^{nα+mβ} 在若干低阶情形成立，包括维数≤3 且 n+m≤7，以及任意维数下 min(n,m)≤2 的情形。
AI.motivation: 该下界是 Golden–Thompson 不等式（Golden–Thompson inequality）在 n=m=1 时的推广，对理解矩阵指数迹的单调性及相关量子不等式具有意义；作者旨在验证细化猜想在小参数范围内的正确性。
AI.method: 借助更强的半正定矩阵（positive semidefinite）情形不等式 A_{n,m}(A,B) ≥ Tr(A^{n/m}B)^m（或其镜像形式），并结合 Araki–Lieb–Thirring 不等式（Araki–Lieb–Thirring inequality）导出目标下界；对维数三、含三个字母 B 的 (3,3) 与 (4,3) 情形，用精确恒等式与算术–几何平均不等式化归为二元多项式不等式，再以 Bernstein 展开（Bernstein expansion）在三个盒上做有理算术精确验证。
AI.result: 在维数不超过三且 n+m≤7 的情形，以及任意维数下 min(n,m)≤2 的情形，所证更强不等式成立，从而细化猜想中的下界成立；稠密情形由精确有理算术证书完成验证，证书为附加文件中的简短程序。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持细化 Bessis–Moussa–Villani 猜想在低阶与低维范围内的有效性，并提供可复现的计算机辅助精确证明；全参数范围的猜想仍未解决。

title: Integrable mass of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black hole
summary: The nontrivial asymptotic structure of rotating black holes in the Bertotti-Robinson universe complicates a direct determination of their conserved mass, leading previous studies to rely on a priori thermodynamic input. We address this long-standing problem using integrability methods, establish local analytic existence and uniqueness via the Cauchy-Kovalevskaja theorem, and obtain a closed expression via a rescaled recurrence whose termination is proved at all orders. The resulting Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson mass coincides with the expression previously derived using the canonical first law identity and reproduces the masses of both Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson subcases. With the mass thus fixed without invoking thermodynamic relations for the first time, we rigorously establish the first law of black-hole thermodynamics and the Smarr formula for a whole family of Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson black holes suitable for future applications.

AI.tldr: 本文利用可积性方法（integrability methods）严格确定旋转Bertotti-Robinson黑洞的守恒质量（conserved mass），从而首次在不依赖热力学关系的前提下建立黑洞热力学第一定律（first law）与Smarr公式。
AI.motivation: 旋转黑洞在Bertotti-Robinson宇宙中的渐近结构（asymptotic structure）非平凡，使得守恒质量难以直接确定，此前研究只能依赖先验的热力学输入（thermodynamic input）。
AI.method: 采用可积性方法，借助Cauchy-Kovalevskaja定理（Cauchy-Kovalevskaja theorem）确立局部解析存在性与唯一性，并通过尺度重标递推（rescaled recurrence）给出闭合表达式，其终止性在所有阶上得到证明。
AI.result: 所得Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson质量与此前由正则第一定律恒等式（canonical first law identity）导出的表达式一致，并再现两类Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson子情形的质量。
AI.conclusion: 在无需热力学关系即可确定质量的基础上，严格建立了适用于一族Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson黑洞的热力学第一定律与Smarr公式（Smarr formula），可供后续应用。

title: The search for the Higgs Boson and the EBH mechanism
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, Contribution to the 4th International Symposium on the History of Particle Physics covering the period between 1980 and 2000, held at CERN in November 2025
summary: The searches for the Higgs boson at LEP and the Tevatron between 1980 and 2000 are set in the context of the underlying theory of spontaneous symmetry breaking and early phenomenological studies. The evolution of direct searches at LEP and the Tevatron are reviewed, as well as indirect constraints from precision electroweak data. Finally, the state of play in 2000 is summarised, together with the perspectives it offered for later searches.

AI.tldr: 该文梳理1980至2000年间LEP与Tevatron对希格斯玻色子（Higgs boson）的搜寻历程，并将其置于自发对称性破缺（spontaneous symmetry breaking）理论及早期唯象研究的背景中，综述直接搜寻、精确电弱数据（precision electroweak data）给出的间接限制以及2000年的研究状况。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机，仅指出将搜寻工作置于自发对称性破缺理论及早期唯象研究（phenomenological studies）的语境中加以考察。
AI.method: 采用历史综述（review）方式：回顾LEP与Tevatron上直接搜寻（direct searches）的演进，并整理精确电弱数据带来的间接约束（indirect constraints）。
AI.result: 摘要仅说明综述了直接搜寻的演进与间接约束，未给出具体实验结果或质量界限等数值。
AI.conclusion: 总结2000年的研究状况（state of play），并讨论其对此后搜寻工作的展望（perspectives）。

title: Nonlinear gauge maps and the structure of Goldstone loops in canonical inflation
summary: We clarify the nonlinear relation between the spatially flat scalar and Goldstone descriptions of canonical single-field inflation. An exact clock map shows how potential interactions are reorganized into derivative Goldstone interactions. A change of slicing further connects their dilation symmetry to its comoving realization. We then study the Goldstone two-point function at one loop in the decoupling limit. Using identities derived from the general mode equation, we reveal how seemingly independent loop contributions combine and their non-boundary parts cancel once the associated counterterms are included. This reduction requires no explicit mode-function solution. The leading adiabatic long-mode response reduces to a total derivative in loop momentum, which requires an additional regularization prescription.

AI.tldr: 该文厘清标准单场暴胀（canonical single-field inflation）中空间平坦的标量描述（scalar description）与戈德斯通描述（Goldstone description）之间的非线性关系，并通过精确的时钟映射（clock map）与切片变换（change of slicing）重构相互作用与膨胀对称性，进而在退耦极限（decoupling limit）下完成戈德斯通两点函数（Goldstone two-point function）的单圈（one-loop）分析。
AI.motivation: 标量描述与戈德斯通描述在非线性阶上的对应关系尚不清晰，环图贡献（loop contributions）之间的组合与抵消结构缺乏不依赖显式模函数解（mode-function solution）的一般性理解。
AI.method: 构建精确的时钟映射，说明势能相互作用如何重组为导数型戈德斯通相互作用（derivative Goldstone interactions）；通过切片变换把膨胀对称性（dilation symmetry）与其共动实现（comoving realization）相联系；再利用由一般模方程（general mode equation）导出的恒等式分析退耦极限下的单圈两点函数。
AI.result: 看似独立的单圈贡献可相互组合，在引入相应抵消项（counterterms）后其非边界部分（non-boundary parts）相互抵消；该约化无需显式模函数解。领先的绝热长模响应（adiabatic long-mode response）化为圈动量（loop momentum）中的全导数（total derivative），因而需要额外的正规化方案（regularization prescription）。
AI.conclusion: 标量与戈德斯通描述之间的非线性映射可系统组织环图结构，单圈非边界贡献在含抵消项时抵消，但绝热长模极限下出现的全导数项须借助附加正规化处理，提示该极限下结果对正规化方案的依赖性。

title: Zeeman Spin Photocurrents without Spin Textures
summary: Inversion symmetry forbids bulk second-order spin photocurrents driven solely by electric-dipole coupling. We show that interference between the electric-dipole and spin Zeeman couplings of light enables Zeeman spin-shift and spin-injection currents in centrosymmetric magnets. Our microscopic theory and systematic symmetry analysis establish the allowed responses and polarization selection rules for both spin-degenerate and spin-split antiferromagnets, with and without spin--orbit coupling (SOC). In collinear magnets without SOC, spin injection vanishes, whereas a pure spin-shift current survives independently of the carrier scattering time. This response arises from transverse electronic spin coherences generated by the optical magnetic field, while the ordered moments remain collinear and fixed. Model analyses validate the mechanism, and first-principles calculations for $\mathrm{MnF_2}$ predict experimentally accessible spin photocurrents. These findings establish a general framework for optical spin-current generation in centrosymmetric magnets, including a SOC-free pure-spin mechanism particularly relevant to altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，电偶极耦合与光自旋塞曼耦合的干涉可在中心对称磁体中产生自旋光电流，突破反演对称性的限制，并预言MnF₂中可实验观测。
AI.motivation: 反演对称性（inversion symmetry）禁止仅由电偶极耦合驱动的体二阶自旋光电流（bulk second-order spin photocurrents），因此需要在中心对称磁体中寻找新的产生机制。
AI.method: 结合微观理论（microscopic theory）与系统对称性分析（symmetry analysis），对自旋简并及自旋劈裂反铁磁体在有/无自旋轨道耦合（spin–orbit coupling, SOC）情形下的允许响应与偏振选择定则进行推导，并对MnF₂开展第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。
AI.result: 电偶极与自旋塞曼耦合的干涉可产生塞曼自旋位移电流（Zeeman spin-shift current）与自旋注入电流（spin-injection current）；在无SOC的共线磁体中自旋注入消失，而纯自旋位移电流不依赖载流子散射时间（scattering time），源于光磁场诱导的横向电子自旋相干。MnF₂计算预言了实验可达的自旋光电流。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了中心对称磁体中光学自旋电流产生的通用框架，并提出一种无需SOC的纯自旋机制，对交错磁体（altermagnets）尤为相关。

title: Exhaustive Construction of Generalized Parent Hamiltonians for Matrix Product States
summary: Characterizing local Hamiltonians that host interesting many-body states as eigenstates has been an important problem in quantum many-body physics. For matrix product states (MPS), there is a well-known construction of parent Hamiltonians that have the MPS as the frustration-free ground state. However, recent results on quantum many-body scars have shown that such a construction does not exhaust all possible Hamiltonians that have the MPS as an eigenstate. In this work, we develop an exhaustive construction of generalized parent Hamiltonians that have a given translation-invariant MPS as an eigenstate. These go beyond the conventional projector-based construction of frustration-free parent Hamiltonians, where each local Hermitian term has the MPS as an eigenstate, by allowing non-Hermitian telescoping terms that cancel out with periodic boundary conditions (PBC). We derive a local tensor equation that establishes a correspondence between inequivalent classes of generalized parent Hamiltonians, i.e., those that cannot be related using linear combinations with frustration-free Hamiltonians, and the MPS transfer matrix spectrum. We illustrate the connection to intrinsic physical properties, including non-Abelian symmetries and zero correlation length, and further extend this construction to block-injective MPS. Our framework hence provides a systematic bridge between generalized parent Hamiltonians and the local structure of quantum states.

AI.tldr: 本文对以给定平移不变矩阵乘积态（matrix product states, MPS）为本征态的一般化父哈密顿量（generalized parent Hamiltonians）给出了穷尽构造，超越传统基于投影算符的无阻挫（frustration-free）构造，并通过局域张量方程将其不等价类与 MPS 转移矩阵谱（transfer matrix spectrum）对应。
AI.motivation: 刻画以有趣多体态为本征态的局域哈密顿量是量子多体物理的重要问题；已有针对 MPS 的父哈密顿量构造，但量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）等近期结果表明该构造并未穷尽所有以 MPS 为本征态的哈密顿量。
AI.method: 在传统“每个局域厄米项均以 MPS 为本征态”的投影算符构造之外，允许引入在周期边界条件（periodic boundary conditions, PBC）下相互抵消的非厄米“望远镜式”项（non-Hermitian telescoping terms），并推导一个局域张量方程。
AI.result: 该局域张量方程建立了广义父哈密顿量的不等价类（即无法通过与非阻挫哈密顿量的线性组合相联系者）与 MPS 转移矩阵谱之间的对应关系；并说明了其与非阿贝尔对称性（non-Abelian symmetries）及零关联长度（zero correlation length）等内禀物理性质的联系，构造进一步推广至块单射 MPS（block-injective MPS）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在广义父哈密顿量与量子态的局域结构之间建立了系统性的桥梁，为以 MPS 为本征态的哈密顿量的完整分类提供了工具。

title: A new toric ALF gravitational instanton
summary: We construct a new explicit toric ALF gravitational instanton. The instanton has Euler characteristic $χ= 4$ and Hirzebruch signature $τ= 1$. The topology at infinity is a lens space $L(3,1)$. The solution depends on one parameter and is constructed from the Belinski--Zakharov four-soliton solution. We prove that the instanton is smooth and positive definite on and away from the axis. This is the first example of a non-Hermitian ALF (not AF) gravitational instanton.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个新的显式环面型（toric）ALF 引力瞬子，其欧拉示性数为 4、Hirzebruch 符号差为 1、无穷远拓扑为透镜空间（lens space）L(3,1)，是首个非厄米（non-Hermitian）的 ALF（非 AF）引力瞬子实例。
AI.motivation: 已有 ALF 引力瞬子实例多为厄米（Hermitian）情形，非厄米 ALF（非 AF）瞬子此前缺乏具体构造，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于 Belinski–Zakharov 四孤子解（four-soliton solution）构造该瞬子，解依赖一个参数，并证明其在轴（axis）上及轴外均为光滑且正定（positive definite）。
AI.result: 所得瞬子具有欧拉示性数 χ=4、Hirzebruch 符号差 τ=1，无穷远拓扑为透镜空间 L(3,1)，且被证明光滑且正定。
AI.conclusion: 该构造给出首个非厄米 ALF（非 AF）引力瞬子，为 ALF 瞬子的分类与非厄米情形研究提供新的显式范例。

title: Axion polarimetry with parametric readout: photon-number conversion and sensitivity limits
summary: We propose a bias-assisted active photon-number conversion scheme for axion-induced polarization rotation in a four-port optical ring cavity with parametric readout. A calibrated real polarization rotation applied \emph{before} the final optical parametric oscillator (OPO) converts the otherwise quadratic response of the summed output photon number into a linear signal. We derive the resulting photon moments and the extracted-field covariance, retaining the four-port optical transfer, finite axion coherence and linewidth. Our principal phenomenological result is a prospective low-mass sensitivity window at $m_a=10^{-18}$--$10^{-16}\,\mathrm{eV}$, extending below the published exclusion bounds included in our comparison, notably the NuSTAR M82 limits. This is a conditional noise-equivalent projection, using the adopted $A/σ_A=1$ stochastic-power criterion and a parameterized technical-noise budget, not a confidence-level exclusion forecast. As a separate readout result, OPO-based total counting reduces the noise-equivalent coupling by approximately $5\%$ relative to matched selective attenuation in a favorable higher-frequency band; $5\%$ internal loss together with a $0.10$-rad pump-phase offset leaves a $3.5\%$ advantage in the stated example. A coherent input with only the final OPO retains this high-frequency benefit, whereas optimized coherent polarimetry remains more sensitive in the baseline. Our results identify both the operating principle of active number conversion and the stability requirements for a future implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种偏置辅助的主动光子数转换方案，用于四端口光学环形腔中轴子诱导偏振旋转的参量读出，将原本的二次响应线性化，并给出质量约 10^-18–10^-16 eV 的低质量敏感窗口预测。
AI.motivation: 轴子（axion）诱导的偏振旋转信号微弱且读出呈二次响应，需要提升低质量区间的探测灵敏度并厘清主动数转换的工作原理与技术噪声要求。
AI.method: 在四端口光学环形腔中，于末级光学参量振荡器（optical parametric oscillator, OPO）之前施加标定好的真实偏振旋转作为偏置，使输出总光子数的二次响应转化为线性信号；推导光子矩与提取场协方差，并保留四端口光学传递、有限轴子相干性与线宽。
AI.result: 在 m_a=10^-18–10^-16 eV 给出低于对比中已发表排除界限（尤指 NuSTAR M82 限制）的预期敏感窗口；作为独立读出结果，OPO 总计数在有利高频段较匹配选择性衰减将噪声等效耦合降低约 5%，在 5% 内损耗与 0.10 rad 泵浦相位偏移下仍保留 3.5% 优势。
AI.conclusion: 该结果属条件性噪声等效投影（采用 A/σ_A=1 随机功率判据与参数化技术噪声预算），并非置信水平排除预测；相干输入仅配末级 OPO 可保留高频优势，而优化相干偏振测量在基线情形下仍更灵敏。

title: Mutual information to all orders from modular flow: a replica-free approach
summary: We derive an all-orders long-distance expansion of vacuum mutual information between two disjoint balls in generic $d$-dimensional CFTs. The derivation uses a novel radial sewing expansion of the joint vacuum density matrix, together with a modular response formula for relative entropy and the geometric modular flow of a single ball, without analytic continuation in replica number. The expansion coefficients are modular integrals of modular-flowed vacuum correlators. Our formula provides a systematic treatment of arbitrary multi-point sectors, and recovers known results on two-point sector derived from replica methods. The full two-point sector resums into a modular integral of the thermal partition function on $S^{d-1}$, with an effective temperature depending on ball configuration and modular time. We compute the expansion explicitly in CFTs. In two-dimensional Ising CFT, using analytic reductions and multidimensional numerical integration, we obtain the first ten radial orders in the long-distance expansion, which involve sphere correlators with up to twenty spin insertions. The truncated expansion agrees well with lattice data at finite separation, and approximately satisfies crossing symmetry. Analytic calculations also reproduce known expansion coefficients for 2d free compact boson at self-dual radius and its current sector, as well as for free scalars in higher dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该文给出一般 $d$ 维共形场论（conformal field theory, CFT）中两个不相交球体真空互信息（mutual information）的全阶长距展开，方法基于径向缝合展开（radial sewing expansion）与模流（modular flow）响应公式，无需复本数解析延拓，并在二维 Ising CFT 中数值验证到前十阶。
AI.motivation: 真空互信息的长距行为此前多依赖复本技巧（replica trick）与解析延拓，对多点扇区缺乏系统处理，本文旨在建立不依赖复本数解析延拓的全阶展开框架。
AI.method: 采用联合真空密度矩阵（joint vacuum density matrix）的新型径向缝合展开，结合相对熵（relative entropy）的模响应公式与单球几何模流；展开系数为模流演化后真空关联函数的模积分，可系统处理任意多点扇区；二维 Ising CFT 中用解析约化与多维数值积分计算。
AI.result: 完整两点扇区重求和为 $S^{d-1}$ 上热配分函数（thermal partition function）的模积分，有效温度依赖球体构型与模时间；二维 Ising CFT 得到长距展开前十个径向阶，涉及最多二十个自旋插入的球面关联函数，截断展开与有限间距格点数据吻合良好并近似满足交叉对称性（crossing symmetry）；还复现了自对偶半径二维自由紧致玻色子及其流扇区、高维自由标量的已知展开系数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了 CFT 中真空互信息长距展开的系统非微扰框架，统一并推广了既有复本结果，且在具体模型中经受格点数据与对称性检验。

title: Confinement Geometry Regulates Fluctuations, Densities, and Collective Escape in Interacting Active Matter
summary: Active matter exhibits non-equilibrium signatures such as the violation of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, giant number fluctuations, and non-Gaussian velocity distributions. We investigate how confinement geometry and particle number influence the steady-state behavior of sterically interacting Active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Particles (AOUPs) in a double-well potential. Unlike bulk active systems, increasing particle number suppresses non-equilibrium fluctuations through crowding, making the steady-state density profiles increasingly resemble those of passive systems. Nevertheless, instantaneous active density profiles exhibit both unimodal and bimodal distributions, even at large particle numbers, whereas passive profiles remain bimodal. The local velocity and position distributions are unimodal in the concave regions of the potential but become bimodal in non-concave regions. Confinement suppresses long-range correlations while producing spatially localized fluctuations governed by potential geometry. Velocity fluctuations are suppressed in the densely populated wells but enhanced near the barrier, where non-equilibrium effects are strongest. At large persistence times, correlated barrier crossings and strong velocity-alignment correlations emerge, which are absent in passive systems. These results demonstrate how confinement geometry, crowding, and persistence jointly control density fluctuations, velocity correlations, and collective escape in interacting active matter.

AI.tldr: 该文研究双势阱（double-well potential）中具有硬球相互作用（sterically interacting）的活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子（Active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Particles, AOUPs）在受限几何下的稳态行为，揭示粒子数、受限几何与持续性（persistence）如何共同调控密度涨落、速度关联与集体逃逸。
AI.motivation: 活性物质（active matter）具有涨落-耗散定理（fluctuation-dissipation theorem）破缺、巨数涨落（giant number fluctuations）与非高斯速度分布等非平衡特征，但受限几何与粒子数如何影响相互作用活性粒子的稳态行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用双势阱中硬球相互作用的活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子模型，考察受限几何与粒子数对稳态密度分布、局部速度与位置分布、空间关联及势垒穿越行为的影响。
AI.result: 与体相活性系统不同，粒子数增加通过拥挤（crowding）抑制非平衡涨落，使稳态密度分布趋近被动系统；但瞬态活性密度分布在大粒子数下仍呈单峰（unimodal）与双峰（bimodal）并存，而被动分布始终为双峰。速度与位置分布在势的凹（concave）区域为单峰、非凹区域为双峰；受限削弱长程关联并产生由势几何主导的局域涨落；速度涨落在高密度阱内被抑制、在势垒附近增强；大持续性时间下出现关联势垒穿越与强速度取向关联。
AI.conclusion: 受限几何、拥挤与持续性共同控制相互作用活性物质的密度涨落、速度关联与集体逃逸，突显了活性系统与被动系统在受限条件下的本质差异。

title: Exact Regular Planar Black Holes solutions in Bumblebee gravity
summary: We discuss possibilities of finding exact regular planar black hole solutions in bumblebee gravity with temporal and radial components of the bumblebee field. We consider quadratic and linear potentials, with vanishing and nonzero cosmological constants, respectively. The field equations determine the nonminimal coupling and the relations between the model parameters. Found solution produce regular planar black hole with planar deformation function. Analytical expressions for this functions has been found. This solutions free of singularities at the $r=0$.

AI.tldr: 该文探讨在bumblebee引力（bumblebee gravity）中，当bumblebee场同时具有时间分量与径向分量时，寻求精确规则平面黑洞（regular planar black hole）解的可能性。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是检验bumblebee引力框架下能否构造出在r=0处无奇点的规则平面黑洞精确解，并厘清势函数形式、宇宙学常数与非最小耦合之间的关系。
AI.method: 分别考虑二次势（quadratic potential）与线性势（linear potential），对应宇宙学常数取零与非零情形；通过场方程（field equations）确定非最小耦合（nonminimal coupling）以及各模型参数之间的关系，并求出解析形式的平面形变函数（planar deformation function）。
AI.result: 所得解给出带有平面形变函数的规则平面黑洞，并给出了该形变函数的解析表达式；该解在r=0处不存在奇点（singularity）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在bumblebee引力中引入时间与径向分量的bumblebee场后，可借助特定势函数与参数关系得到精确的规则平面黑洞解，其核心特征为r=0处正则。

title: Curvature-Driven Density and Fluctuations in Interacting AOUPs under Confinement
summary: We investigate interacting active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles (AOUPs) confined in harmonic and double-well potentials, combining mean-field theory, analytical approximations, and numerical simulations. We derive the stationary density, position and velocity correlations, correlation length, dynamical structure factor, and leading-order entropy production. Unlike established harmonic normal-mode descriptions, our framework incorporates steric interactions, persistent forcing, and spatially varying confinement curvature through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the many-body Hessian. Within a locally homogeneous approximation, the correlation length is controlled by persistence and local curvature, increasing as the effective restoring stiffness decreases and formally diverging at the instability of the linearized description. Entropy production, at leading nontrivial order in persistence, is governed by gradients of the effective curvature. Harmonic confinement provides a constant-curvature reference, whereas double-well confinement creates equilibrium-like regions near the minima and strongly nonequilibrium regions near the barrier. The barrier exhibits enhanced velocity and density fluctuations, soft collective modes, long-lived correlations, and increased entropy production. Persistence amplifies these effects, while steric crowding suppresses collective fluctuations. The dynamical structure factor reveals enhanced low-frequency contributions from soft modes. Our results establish how confinement geometry, active persistence, and interactions jointly regulate collective fluctuations and irreversibility in active matter.

AI.tldr: 该文研究谐振与双势阱约束下的相互作用活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子（active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles, AOUPs），结合平均场理论、解析近似与数值模拟，揭示约束几何、活性持续性与相互作用如何共同调控集体涨落与不可逆性。
AI.motivation: 既有基于简正模式（normal-mode）的谐振约束描述忽略了空间变化的约束曲率、硬核排斥（steric interactions）与持续驱动力，难以刻画复杂势阱中活性物质的集体行为。
AI.method: 构建以多体 Hessian 矩阵（many-body Hessian）的特征值与特征向量为核心的框架，纳入硬核相互作用、持续驱动力与空间变化的约束曲率，并结合局域均匀近似（locally homogeneous approximation）推导解析结果。
AI.result: 导出稳态密度、位置与速度关联、关联长度（correlation length）、动力学结构因子（dynamical structure factor）及主导阶熵产生；关联长度随有效回复刚度降低而增大，并在线性化描述失稳处形式发散；熵产生由有效曲率梯度控制；双势阱中势垒处出现增强的速度与密度涨落、软集体模式（soft collective modes）、长寿命关联与更高熵产生。
AI.conclusion: 持续性放大了双势阱中的上述效应，而硬核拥挤抑制集体涨落；动力学结构因子显示软模式增强的低频贡献，表明约束几何、活性持续性与相互作用共同调控活性物质的集体涨落与不可逆性。

title: Distance to integrability and complexity
summary: We consider nearest-neighbour interactions on spin-1/2 chains. We find the full set of integrable models of this form and apply a numerical algorithm to determine the "closest" integrable model for a given Hamiltonian. This allows us to define a model-independent distance to integrability. We show that standard measures of chaos interpolate between integrable and chaotic values with increasing values of this distance. However, there is a large variation across models and the distance to integrability provides additional information not directly provided by these diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 该文给出自旋-1/2链上最近邻相互作用形式的全部可积模型，并借助数值算法定义给定哈密顿量与可积模型之间的“距离”，据此提出与模型无关的可积性距离（distance to integrability），并考察混沌诊断量随该距离的变化。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是建立一个不依赖具体模型的可积性度量，以刻画给定哈密顿量偏离可积性的程度，并检验常用混沌诊断量能否反映这一偏离。
AI.method: 方法包括：确定自旋-1/2链上最近邻相互作用形式的全部可积模型集合，并应用数值算法找出给定哈密顿量的“最近”可积模型，从而定义可积性距离。
AI.result: 标准混沌度量随可积性距离增大而在可积值与混沌值之间过渡；但不同模型间差异较大，可积性距离提供了这些诊断量不能直接给出的额外信息。
AI.conclusion: 可积性距离可作为模型无关的补充指标：混沌诊断量虽随距离呈现插值行为，但不足以单独刻画模型与可积性的偏离程度。

title: Exact static two-body gravitational potential at first self-force order
comment: 29 pages, submission includes zip file with ancillary material
summary: The static interaction potential of two non-spinning point masses in general relativity was previously computed through seventh post-Newtonian order using methods of effective field theory. Its probe limit, or zeroth-self-force contribution, is determined exactly by the Schwarzschild geometry. We derive a closed-form expression for the static first-self-force correction, quadratic in the light mass, and establish its weak-field expansion to all orders. Working in harmonic gauge, we construct the required Green function for the coupled linearised gravitational equations about the Schwarzschild background. We fix its homogeneous contributions and regularised coincident limit by matching to the dimensionally continued point-source theory. The result reproduces known perturbative coefficients and determines all higher static post-Newtonian coefficients in this mass sector.

AI.tldr: 该文在广义相对论（general relativity）框架下，推导了两个无自旋点质量静态相互作用势中正比于轻质量平方的“一阶自力修正（first-self-force correction）”，并给出其闭式表达式与全阶弱场展开（weak-field expansion）。
AI.motivation: 此前两无自旋点质量静态相互作用势已通过有效场论（effective field theory）方法计算至七阶后牛顿（post-Newtonian）阶，其中探针极限（probe limit，即零自力贡献）由施瓦西几何（Schwarzschild geometry）精确确定；本文旨在补足缺失的自力修正部分（self-force contribution）信息。
AI.method: 采用谐和规范（harmonic gauge），围绕施瓦西背景（Schwarzschild background）构造耦合线性化引力方程（coupled linearised gravitational equations）所需的格林函数（Green function）；通过将齐次解贡献与重合极限（coincident limit）的正则化匹配到维度延拓的点源理论（dimensionally continued point-source theory）予以确定。
AI.result: 得到了静态一阶自力修正的闭式表达式及全阶弱场展开，结果复现了已知的微扰系数，并确定了该质量扇区（mass sector）内所有更高阶的静态后牛顿系数。
AI.conclusion: 静态自力修正可由闭式表达式完整刻画，从而系统给出该类质量项的全部高阶静态后牛顿系数，为有效场论框架下的后牛顿势计算提供补充与验证。

title: Quantized valley source in bilayer graphene via adiabatic quantum pumping
summary: We propose a quantized valley source based on adiabatic quantum pumping in bilayer graphene in the presence of both quantum spin Hall and quantum valley Hall effects. By periodically modulating the gate voltages of two quantum dots coupled to a bilayer graphene nanoribbon, the helical edge states enable the generation of a pure valley current. Depending on the geometry of quantum dots, the number of emitted valley pairs either forms quantized plateaus or varies continuously with the pumping amplitude. The quantized plateau structure can be tuned by the static gate voltage and by the coupling between the quantum dots and the ribbon. Quantized valley pairs are robust against Anderson disorder applied in the quantum dots and persist for both zigzag and armchair quantum-dot boundaries. These results demonstrate that adiabatic quantum pumping provides a route toward electrically controllable quantized valley sources.

AI.tldr: 基于双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene）中量子自旋霍尔效应与量子谷霍尔效应共存的条件，利用绝热量子泵浦（adiabatic quantum pumping）与螺旋边缘态（helical edge states）产生纯谷电流，实现可电控的量子化谷源（quantized valley source）。
AI.motivation: 探索一种可电学调控的量子化谷源，作为谷电子学（valleytronics）中信息载体的可控输运方案。
AI.method: 在同时存在量子自旋霍尔效应（quantum spin Hall effect）与量子谷霍尔效应（quantum valley Hall effect）的双层石墨烯纳米带（nanoribbon）上耦合两个量子点（quantum dots），周期性调制两量子点的栅压以驱动绝热泵浦，并由螺旋边缘态输送谷电流。
AI.result: 谷对（valley pairs）发射数目随量子点几何构型或呈量子化平台、或随泵浦幅度连续变化；平台结构可由静态栅压及量子点—纳米带耦合强度调节；量子化谷对在量子点内施加安德森无序（Anderson disorder）下仍保持稳健，并适用于锯齿型（zigzag）与扶手椅型（armchair）量子点边界。
AI.conclusion: 绝热泵浦为实现电学可控的量子化谷源提供了可行途径。

title: A Koszul-Type Splitting Theorem for Complex Supermanifolds
summary:
We study the splitting problem for complex supermanifolds using formal exponential maps and Ehresmann connections. We show that every formal exponential map induces a splitting of the underlying supermanifold. Furthermore, we establish that every Ehresmann connection determines a linearization of the infinite jet space, extending the corresponding construction for ordinary manifolds to supermanifolds.
  For Ehresmann connections preserving the zero section, we construct a formal exponential map in two ways: via the linearization of the infinite jet space and directly from the connection operator. We prove that both constructions yield the same map and induce the same splitting, thereby generalizing Koszul's splitting theorem from linear connections to zero-section-preserving Ehresmann connections. Finally, we provide examples showing that, without this assumption, the two constructions may yield different splittings, or one or both of them may fail to induce a splitting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究复超流形（complex supermanifolds）的分裂问题，证明每个形式指数映射（formal exponential map）可诱导底层超流形的分裂，并证明每个 Ehresmann 联络可决定无穷射流空间（infinite jet space）的线性化；对保持零截面的 Ehresmann 联络，两种构造给出同一形式指数映射与同一分裂，推广了 Koszul 分裂定理。
AI.motivation: 将常流形上关于分裂与线性化的经典结果（尤其是 Koszul 分裂定理）推广到超流形（supermanifolds）框架，厘清形式指数映射与 Ehresmann 联络在超几何中的分裂作用。
AI.method: 借助形式指数映射与 Ehresmann 联络研究复超流形的分裂问题；对保持零截面（zero section）的 Ehresmann 联络，分别通过无穷射流空间的线性化和由联络算子直接构造形式指数映射，并比较二者。
AI.result: 证明每个形式指数映射诱导底层超流形的一个分裂，每个 Ehresmann 联络决定无穷射流空间的线性化；对保持零截面的联络，两种构造给出相同的形式指数映射并诱导相同的分裂，从而把 Koszul 分裂定理从线性联络推广到保持零截面的 Ehresmann 联络。
AI.conclusion: 零截面保持条件是两种构造一致性的关键；文中给出反例表明，去掉该假设后两种构造可能产生不同分裂，或其中之一乃至两者均无法诱导分裂。

title: Surrogate model of gravitational waveforms for quasi-circular, spin-aligned, asymmetric-mass black hole binaries based on the hybridization of WaSABI-C inspirals with numerical relativity waveforms
summary: With the incorporation of aligned-spin dynamics into self-force waveform models, such as the WaSABI-C inspiral model, and with the release of the SXS collaboration's third public catalog of NR simulations, the gravitational waveform modeling community has made significant advances in the modeling of spinning, asymmetric-mass black hole binaries. In light of these developments, we present WaSABINRHybSur2dq15, the first surrogate model to incorporate information from self-force theory, post-Newtonian theory, and numerical relativity. The model is trained on 65 hybrid waveforms for quasi-circular, spin-aligned, asymmetric-mass black hole binaries with mass ratios spanning 1:1.25 to 1:20 and aligned-spins for the primary black hole ranging -0.5 to 0.5. The hybrid waveforms are generated from a set of WaSABI-C inspirals and NR waveforms from the third SXS public catalog. The model covers the parameter domain $1.25 \leq q \leq 15$ and $|χ_{1z}| \leq 0.5$, and includes the $(2,2),\, (2,1),\, (3,3),\, (4,4),$ and $(5,5)$ spin-weighted spherical harmonic modes. The model also spans the entire LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) frequency band (with $f_{\text{low}}=20$ Hz) for total masses $M \gtrsim 111.5\,M_{\odot}$. We find that the WaSABINRHybSur2dq15 model faithfully reproduces the hybrid waveforms with mismatches less than $10^{-3}$ for total masses in the range $80\,M_{\odot} \leq M \leq 300\,M_{\odot}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个融合自力理论（self-force theory）、后牛顿理论（post-Newtonian theory）与数值相对论（numerical relativity）的代理模型（surrogate model）WaSABINRHybSur2dq15，用于准圆形、自旋对齐、非对称质量双黑洞的引力波波形建模，在80–300倍太阳质量范围内失配率（mismatch）低于10^{-3}。
AI.motivation: 随着自旋动力学被纳入自力波形模型（如WaSABI-C）以及SXS合作组第三版数值相对论模拟公开目录的发布，自旋、非对称质量双黑洞的波形建模取得显著进展，亟需一个整合多理论来源的统一波形模型。
AI.method: 模型基于65个混合波形（hybrid waveforms）训练，这些波形由WaSABI-C旋进模型与SXS第三版目录的数值相对论波形拼接而成，参数覆盖质量比（mass ratio）1.25至15、主黑洞自旋-0.5至0.5，并包含(2,2)、(2,1)、(3,3)、(4,4)、(5,5)五个自旋加权球谐模式。
AI.result: 模型覆盖LVK频段（f_low=20 Hz，总质量约111.5倍太阳质量以上），并在总质量80至300倍太阳质量区间内以低于10^{-3}的失配率忠实重现混合波形。
AI.conclusion: WaSABINRHybSur2dq15实现了自力、后牛顿与数值相对论信息的首次联合建模，为自旋、非对称质量双黑洞提供高精度波形代理，适用于LVK探测频段内的相关分析。

title: Topological Multi-Natural Inflation
summary: We investigate topological inflation in minimal multi-natural inflation, in which the axion potential consists of two cosine terms. Focusing on the high-scale regime, we perform a systematic parameter scan for representative ratios of the two periods and identify regions consistent with current constraints on the scalar spectral index and tensor-to-scalar ratio, including those from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope. The interplay of the two harmonics allows departures from the quartic hilltop limit and accommodates the higher spectral index favored by recent cosmological data combinations. We characterize the hilltop and near-inflection-point branches and analyze the associated vacuum structure and domain-wall properties. We also discuss a symmetry-breaking origin of the required domain walls when the inflaton is the angular component of a complex scalar field. We identify regions in which the observational constraints and the adopted criteria for topological inflation are simultaneously satisfied, including regions with a sub-Planckian axion decay constant. Our results show that the observational tension encountered in the minimal quartic double-well model need not extend to topological inflation in a minimal multi-natural axion potential.

AI.tldr: 本文在最小多自然暴胀（minimal multi-natural inflation）框架内研究拓扑暴胀（topological inflation），其中轴子势（axion potential）由两个余弦项构成；通过系统参数扫描，识别出同时满足标量谱指数（scalar spectral index）与张标比（tensor-to-scalar ratio）观测约束的参数区域。
AI.motivation: 最小四次双势阱模型（minimal quartic double-well model）在拓扑暴胀下存在观测张力，本文检验该张力是否可借助多自然轴子势中两个谐波（harmonics）的相互配合而得到缓解。
AI.method: 针对两个周期比的代表性取值，在高能标区域（high-scale regime）开展系统参数扫描，刻画山顶支（hilltop branch）与近拐点支（near-inflection-point branch），并分析相应的真空结构（vacuum structure）与畴壁性质（domain-wall properties），同时讨论暴胀子（inflaton）为复标量场角分量时畴壁的对称性破缺起源。
AI.result: 两个谐波的相互作用使模型可以偏离四次山顶极限（quartic hilltop limit），并容纳近期宇宙学数据组合所偏好的较高谱指数；所识别区域中包含轴子衰变常数（axion decay constant）低于普朗克标度（sub-Planckian）的情形，且观测约束与所采用的拓扑暴胀判据可同时满足。
AI.conclusion: 最小四次双阱模型中所遇到的观测张力，未必会延伸到最小多自然轴子势下的拓扑暴胀；多自然轴子势为同时满足观测约束与拓扑暴胀条件提供了可行参数空间。

title: Beyond Synthesis Conditions: Linking In-situ Growth Dynamics to Carbon Nanotube Forest Properties through Multimodal Machine Learning
summary: Machine learning for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) has largely mapped static synthesis conditions to final properties, implicitly treating these conditions as a complete description of growth. Here, we test this assumption by integrating gas-flow conditions with in-situ time-resolve growth profiles (growth curves) of vertically aligned CNT forests. We introduce an observation-window analysis, in which prediction is evaluated as a function of observation time by providing models with the growth curve only up to progressively later times, to determine not only whether a property can be predicted, but when the necessary information becomes available during synthesis. Clustering of normalized growth curves revealed distinct growth patterns independent of final forest height. The gas conditions alone could predict the initial growth rate but not the growth lifetime and failed to capture the variation in yield (R^2<0). Adding the growth curve improved yield prediction (R^2~0.4-0.5), with the relevant information emerging during the intermediate and later stages of growth rather than at its onset. In contrast, density and G/D ratio, which forest height does not record, showed no consistent improvement. The maximum height and lifetime could be estimated with moderate accuracy midway through the 10-min growth. Permutation feature importance identified water vapor and H_2, both linked to catalyst activity, as the most informative gas variables. These results indicate that variation unexplained by synthesis conditions is not merely noise but reflects an evolving catalyst state, and they establish mid-growth decision points for autonomous synthesis, enabling early termination of unpromising batches and, ultimately, in-batch adjustment of growth conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了"静态合成条件足以描述碳纳米管生长"这一隐含假设，通过在气体流动条件之外引入原位时间分辨生长曲线，并提出观测窗口分析（observation-window analysis），揭示合成条件无法解释的变异反映的是催化剂状态的动态演化。
AI.motivation: 以往面向碳纳米管（carbon nanotubes, CNTs）化学气相沉积（chemical vapor deposition, CVD）的机器学习工作多将静态合成条件映射到最终性质，隐含地把条件视为对生长的完整描述；本文旨在检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 将气体流动条件与原位时间分辨生长曲线（growth curves）结合，针对垂直排列CNT森林（vertically aligned CNT forests）建模；提出观测窗口分析，即只提供截至逐步延后时刻的生长曲线来评估预测随观测时间的变化；并对归一化生长曲线做聚类。
AI.result: 聚类显示生长模式与最终森林高度无关。仅用气体条件可预测初始生长速率，但无法预测生长寿命，且对产量变异的解释失败（R^2<0）；加入生长曲线后产量预测提升（R^2~0.4-0.5），相关信息出现在生长中后期而非起始阶段。密度与G/D比（森林高度未记录）无一致改善；最大高度与寿命可在10分钟生长中段以中等精度估计。置换特征重要性（permutation feature importance）指认水蒸气与H_2为信息量最大的气体变量，二者均与催化剂活性相关。
AI.conclusion: 合成条件无法解释的变异并非噪声，而是催化剂状态演化的反映；结果确立了生长中段的决策点（mid-growth decision points），可用于自主合成，实现无前景批次的提前终止乃至批内生长条件调整。

title: Oscillatory instability of subcritical stationary solutions in the parametrically driven, damped nonlinear Dirac equation
summary:
The dynamics of the nonlinear Dirac equation (NLDE) under the influence of dissipation and parametric forcing exhibit complex phenomenologies, including soliton destruction and chaotic transitions, which have been extensively observed in numerical simulations. However, a rigorous analytical understanding of the underlying instability mechanisms in the subcritical regime has remained open.
  In this work, we provide a theoretical answer to these numerical findings by establishing the spectral instability of the fundamental soliton solution. Our methodology relies on a three-step approach linking local asymptotic analyses with global topological arguments. First, we characterize the generalized null space at the critical parameter ($λ_c$), revealing the onset of instability through the splitting of the zero eigenvalue within a parity-dependent subspace. Second, in the non-relativistic limit ($λ\to 0$), we use a Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction to reduce the linearized Dirac's operators into a Pöschl--Teller Schrödinger operator, thereby identifying the instability source as a unique real pair of discrete eigenvalues in the restricted problem. Third, we extend these local results to the entire subcritical domain using a topological continuation argument, which tracks the invariance of the spectral parity in a subset of the complex plane. These analytical results rigorously confirm the instability of the soliton, providing the mathematical mechanism for the wave collapse observed in the driven-damped system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究耗散与参量驱动下非线性狄拉克方程（nonlinear Dirac equation, NLDE）孤子解的动力不稳定性，通过渐近分析与拓扑延拓相结合的三步方法，严格证明了基态孤子解在亚临界区（subcritical regime）的谱不稳定性（spectral instability）。
AI.motivation: 数值模拟已广泛观测到NLDE在耗散与参量驱动下的孤子破坏与混沌转变等现象，但亚临界区不稳定性机制的严格解析理解仍属空白，本文旨在为这些数值发现提供理论解释。
AI.method: 采用连接局部分析与全局拓扑论证的三步法：先在临界参数（λ_c）处刻画广义零空间（generalized null space），揭示宇称相关子空间中零特征值的分裂；再在非相对论极限（λ→0）下用Lyapunov–Schmidt约化将线性化狄拉克算子化为Pöschl–Teller型薛定谔算子，识别出受限问题中的唯一实离散特征值对；最后用拓扑延拓论证将局部结果推广至整个亚临界域。
AI.result: 分析表明临界参数处零特征值在宇称相关子空间中分裂，标志不稳定性出现；受限薛定谔问题存在唯一实离散特征值对作为不稳定源；借助谱宇称在复平面子集中的不变性，将不稳定结论延拓至整个亚临界域。
AI.conclusion: 这些解析结果严格证实了孤子的不稳定性，为驱动–耗散系统中观测到的波塌缩（wave collapse）提供了数学机制。

title: Tracing source imprints on the gravitational direct wave
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, plus Supplemental Material. To be submitted to Physical Review D Letters
summary: The direct wave component of black hole (BH) ringdown, revealed through quasinormal-mode filters, carries a non-quasinormal-mode imprint of the plunging perturber's dynamics. However, the connection between the source trajectory and the observed direct wave remains incompletely understood. We first show that the full waveform filtered by the frequency-dependent black hole response gives a substantially more localized kernel than the standard rational filter approach. We then show that analytically continuing the Teukolsky source variables to complex coordinates allows for a semianalytic direct wave which closely reproduces numerical integration throughout the entire plunge. Our generalized steepest-descent method clarifies how coherent emission shapes the imprint of source dynamics on the observed direct wave beyond the light-cone picture.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，经频率依赖黑洞响应滤波后的完整波形给出比标准有理滤波器更局域的核，并通过对Teukolsky源变量作复坐标解析延拓，构造出贯穿整个下落阶段、与数值积分高度吻合的半解析直接波（direct wave）。广义最速下降法（steepest-descent method）阐明了相干发射如何塑造源动力学在观测直接波上的印记，超越光锥图像。
AI.motivation: 黑洞铃宕（ringdown）直接波分量携带下落微扰体动力学的非准正规模（non-quasinormal-mode）印记，但源轨迹与观测直接波之间的联系尚不完全清楚，本文旨在厘清这一映射关系。
AI.method: 首先比较频率依赖黑洞响应滤波与标准有理滤波器（rational filter）所得核的局域性；随后将Teukolsky源变量解析延拓至复坐标，构建半解析直接波，并采用广义最速下降法（generalized steepest-descent method）分析其形成机制。
AI.result: 频率依赖响应滤波给出显著更局域的核；半解析直接波在整个下落（plunge）阶段与数值积分结果吻合良好；广义最速下降法揭示了相干发射（coherent emission）对直接波印记的塑造作用。
AI.conclusion: 源动力学的观测印记可通过相干发射机制加以解释，超越了传统光锥（light-cone）图像；所建立的半解析框架为连接源轨迹与直接波提供了可行途径。

title: The Standard Model with Non-Anticommuting $γ_5$ in the BMHV Scheme
summary: The Breitenlohner-Maison/'t Hooft-Veltman (BMHV) scheme provides a treatment of $γ_5$ in dimensional regularisation (DReg) that is guaranteed to be self-consistent at all orders, but it breaks gauge and BRST invariance at the regularised level, which must be restored by suitable counterterms. We present the complete 1-loop renormalisation of the full Standard Model in the BMHV scheme in general $R_ξ$-gauge, including all singular and all finite symmetry-restoring counterterms. We further analyse the impact of evanescent gauge interactions, which allow the photon and gluon currents to be treated either 4- or $D$-dimensionally. We show that QCD always contributes to the symmetry breaking, so that the Standard Model must be treated as a whole, and we recommend a purely 4-dimensional treatment of electroweak gauge interactions. Our results provide a necessary step towards multi-loop electroweak precision calculations with a fully consistent treatment of $γ_5$.

AI.tldr: 该文在BMHV方案下完成了标准模型（Standard Model）完整的单圈重整化，给出一般R_ξ规范下全部奇异性与有限的重建对称性抵消项，并分析evanescent规范相互作用的影响。
AI.motivation: BMHV方案虽能在所有阶数自洽地处理γ_5，但在正规化层面破坏规范对称性与BRST不变性，需通过抵消项恢复；而多圈电弱精确计算要求对γ_5有一致处理，因此需要完整的单圈重整化基础。
AI.method: 在BMHV方案下，对一般R_ξ规范中完整标准模型进行单圈重整化，系统计算所有奇异及有限的对称性重建抵消项（symmetry-restoring counterterms），并考察evanescent规范相互作用对光子与胶子流取4维或D维处理的影响。
AI.result: QCD总是对对称性破坏有贡献，故标准模型必须作为整体处理；建议对电弱规范相互作用采用纯4维处理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为具有完全一致γ_5处理的多圈电弱精确计算（multi-loop electroweak precision calculations）提供了必要步骤。

title: Informative Fisher Modes in Neural Networks as a Result of Explicit Symmetry Breaking
summary: Learning in a neural network takes place on a high dimensional, non-convex loss landscape, the Hessian curvature of which dictates the learning dynamics. Despite its high dimensionality, the large number of architectural symmetries explains some of the geometric of this landscape, in particular flat directions, i.e. near-zero modes of the Hessian. These architectural symmetries have therefore been suggested as an organizing principle of deep learning. It remains an open question, though, wether there are additional organizing principles in the remaining degrees of freedom in the learning dynamic. Here we identify task-dependent contingent symmetries as such an additional organizing principle. We show that non-flat learning directions emerge due to explicit breaking of these contingent symmetries. We isolate this symmetry in an analytically solvable minimal model. Furthermore, we show that, by tuning an L2 penalty, signatures of the symmetry breaking become measurable. As a consequence of the same mechanism, adding noise to the data drives the model through a sequence of broken symmetry recoveries in the form of Baik-Ben-Arous-Péché (BBP) transitions. We demonstrate analytically for linear and numerically for deep linear networks that the contingent symmetry group remains explicit, and that the symmetry-breaking mechanism identifies which Hessian modes carry task-specific information. These signatures are measurable without a symmetry-group description and, hence, offer a route to study symmetry breaking as a more general principle in nonlinear networks and other learning systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"任务相关的相依对称性（contingent symmetries）"作为深度学习损失景观（loss landscape）的额外组织原则，证明非平坦学习方向源于这类对称性的显式破缺，并在线性与深度线性网络中给出解析与数值证据。
AI.motivation: 尽管架构对称性可解释Hessian的平坦方向（近零模），但学习动态其余自由度是否存在其他组织原则仍是未解问题，论文旨在识别此类额外原则。
AI.method: 将相依对称性在可解析求解的极小模型中隔离出来；通过调节L2惩罚（L2 penalty）使对称性破缺特征可测量；结合线性网络的解析分析与深度线性网络（deep linear networks）的数值实验，并借助Baik-Ben-Arous-Péché（BBP）跃迁刻画加噪数据的对称性恢复序列。
AI.result: 非平坦学习方向由相依对称性的显式破缺产生；加噪数据驱动模型经历一系列BBP跃迁形式的破缺对称性恢复；该方法可识别哪些Hessian模携带任务特定信息，且这些特征无需对称群描述即可测量。
AI.conclusion: 相依对称性破缺机制为研究非线性网络及其他学习系统中的对称性破缺提供了一条更普适的路径。

title: On the properties of the potential and the spherical harmonic expansions for general planets
summary:
The convergence of spherical harmonic expansions (SHEs) of gravitational potentials below the Brillouin sphere has been a long-standing problem in potential theory and geodesy. In previous work, some of the present authors gave a necessary and sufficient condition for convergence along a fixed ray, formulated in terms of analyticity of a longitudinal average of the balayage density. In the present paper, we extend these results to arbitrary physical solid planets, assuming only that the planet is a compact subset of $\mathbb R^3$ and that its density belongs to $L^\infty$. We establish sharp regularity properties of the gravitational potential at the Brillouin sphere. The potential and its first derivative extend continuously to the sphere, the first derivative is locally Hölder continuous with exponent $1/2$, and the second derivative satisfies the optimal bound $V''(z)=O\bigl(\operatorname{dist}(z,\partial\mathbb D)^{-1/2}\bigr)$ under nontangential approach from the exterior.
  We also obtain sharp estimates for the spherical harmonic coefficients: $a_\ell=O(\ell^{-3/2}).$ If, for almost every latitude, the Brillouin sphere is a one-sided Lebesgue point from the interior of the longitudinally averaged density, then $a_\ell=o(\ell^{-3/2}).$ Both estimates are optimal. We explicitly recover the balayage density on the Brillouin sphere from the exterior gravitational potential, and its circular averages from the potential along a single radial line. Finally, we give a physical characterization of convergence of the SHE below the Brillouin sphere. If the SHE converges at such a point, then, after truncating the planet at any suitable intermediate radius, the gravitational potential of the removed outer part is completely determined by that of the remaining truncated planet. This provides a direct interpretation of the strong constraint imposed by convergence below the Brillouin sphere.

AI.tldr: 本文在仅假设行星为 $\mathbb R^3$ 的紧子集且密度属于 $L^\infty$ 的条件下，证明引力势及其导数在布里渊球（Brillouin sphere）上的尖锐正则性，并给出球谐系数（spherical harmonic coefficients）$a_\ell=O(\ell^{-3/2})$ 的最优估计及其改进条件。
AI.motivation: 球谐展开（spherical harmonic expansions, SHEs）在布里渊球以下的收敛性长期以来是位势论（potential theory）与大地测量学（geodesy）中的未解问题，此前结果仅对固定射线给出基于经向平均性质的充要条件，缺乏对一般物理行星的普适刻画。
AI.method: 将先前沿固定射线的收敛性判据推广至任意物理实心行星，仅假设行星为 $\mathbb R^3$ 的紧子集且密度属 $L^\infty$；通过分析布里渊球处的正则性、从外部引力势显式恢复平衡密度（balayage density）及其圆周平均，建立收敛性的物理解释。
AI.result: 势及其一阶导数连续延拓至球面，一阶导数局部 Hölder 连续（指数 $1/2$），二阶导数在非切向逼近下满足最优界 $V''(z)=O(\operatorname{dist}(z,\partial\mathbb D)^{-1/2})$；系数估计 $a_\ell=O(\ell^{-3/2})$，若几乎每个纬度上布里渊球为经向平均密度的一侧 Lebesgue 点，则强化为 $a_\ell=o(\ell^{-3/2})$，两者均最优。
AI.conclusion: 若 SHE 在布里渊球以下某点收敛，则在任意合适中间半径截断行星后，被移除外部部分的引力势完全由剩余截断行星的势决定，这为布里渊球以下收敛所施加的强约束提供了直接物理解释。

title: Interacting scalar-fermion two-component dark matter in a gauged $\boldsymbol{U(1)_{B-L}}$ model
summary: We propose an interacting two-component dark matter model based on a gauged $U(1)_{B-L}$ extension of the Standard Model, which also accommodates neutrino masses through the type-I seesaw mechanism. The dark sector consists of a Dirac fermion $χ$ and a complex scalar $S$, which can both be stable without imposing an additional discrete symmetry and are directly coupled by a gauge-invariant Yukawa interaction. The resulting conversion, semi-conversion, and semi-annihilation processes lead to a genuinely coupled freeze-out. After imposing collider and dark matter constraints, we identify viable solutions away from the $Z'$ resonance for both mass hierarchies, $m_S > m_χ$ and $m_S < m_χ$. Despite the strong direct-detection constraints, part of the surviving parameter space remains within the reach of next-generation experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于规范 \(U(1)_{B-L}\) 扩展的相互作用双组分暗物质模型，暗部门由狄拉克费米子与复标量构成，通过规范不变的汤川耦合实现真正耦合的冻结出（freeze-out）。
AI.motivation: 在标准模型中引入 \(U(1)_{B-L}\) 规范扩展，可同时解释中微子质量（经由 type-I 跷跷板机制，type-I seesaw mechanism）与暗物质问题，且无需额外离散对称性即可保证暗部门粒子稳定。
AI.method: 构建含狄拉克费米子 \(\chi\) 与复标量 \(S\) 的双组分暗部门，二者由规范不变汤川相互作用（Yukawa interaction）直接耦合，产生转化（conversion）、半转化（semi-conversion）与半湮灭（semi-annihilation）过程；随后施加对撞机与暗物质约束进行参数扫描。
AI.result: 在两种质量层级 \(m_S > m_\chi\) 与 \(m_S < m_\chi\) 下，均找到远离 \(Z'\) 共振（\(Z'\) resonance）的可行解；尽管直接探测（direct detection）约束很强，部分存活参数空间仍处于下一代实验的探测范围内。
AI.conclusion: 该模型可在不引入额外离散对称性的前提下实现稳定双组分暗物质与耦合冻结出，并给出可被下一代实验检验的剩余参数空间。

title: IRIS: an agentic eye on symmetry-derived paths and energy landscapes of structural phase transitions
summary: Structural phase transitions underpin ferroelectric and multiferroic functionality, but constructing interpretable energy landscapes remains dependent on specialist expertise. Predicting this behaviour rests on Landau free energies expanded in symmetry-adapted order parameters: their coefficients classify a transition, expose the couplings between distortions, set switching paths and barriers, and parametrize phase-field and effective-Hamiltonian models at larger scales. Obtaining these coefficients from first principles means sampling the Born--Oppenheimer energy surface along symmetry-derived structural paths, which requires crystallographic analysis, reliable structure generation and extensive computation, especially for coupled multidimensional order parameters. Here we introduce IRIS, an agentic workflow that converts plain-language requests and crystal structures into symmetry-adapted energy landscapes and fitted Landau energy models. Deterministic gates govern acceptance of structures, calculations and fits, while language models interpret requests and select constrained recovery actions. Applications across six compounds include a six-dimensional BiFeO$_3$ landscape that separates competition between polar and tilt amplitudes from directional locking and ranks homogeneous switching pathways. Controlled replays detected all 53 injected faults; disabling gates allowed 14 silent errors. Four prospective BaTiO$_3$ runs produced fitted landscapes from 96 density-functional calculations in 34 minutes total without intervening human decisions. IRIS makes physical model construction a reusable computational capability and provides a framework for scientific automation grounded in explicit verification.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 IRIS，一个将自然语言请求与晶体结构自动转化为对称适应能量景观（symmetry-adapted energy landscapes）并拟合 Landau 能量模型的智能体工作流（agentic workflow），在六种化合物上验证并证明其可复用性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 铁电与多铁功能依赖结构相变，而可解释的能量景观构建及 Landau 自由能系数获取高度依赖专家经验、晶体学分析与大量计算，尤其对耦合多维序参量困难显著，故需自动化且可验证的流程。
AI.method: 采用确定性门控（deterministic gates）控制结构、计算与拟合的接受准则，结合语言模型（language models）解析请求并选择受限的恢复动作；通过沿对称性导出的结构路径对第一性原理（first principles）Born–Oppenheimer 能量面采样，获得对称适应序参量展开的 Landau 系数。
AI.result: 在六种化合物中应用，包括构建六维 BiFeO₃ 能量景观以区分极性（polar）与倾转（tilt）振幅竞争及方向锁定并排序同质切换路径；受控重放检测出全部 53 个注入故障，禁用门控时出现 14 个静默错误；四次前瞻性 BaTiO₃ 运行在 34 分钟内由 96 次密度泛函（density-functional）计算完成拟合且无需人工干预。
AI.conclusion: IRIS 将物理模型构建转变为可复用的计算能力，并为以显式验证（explicit verification）为基础的科学自动化提供了框架。

title: Metastability of the Meissner state in the three-dimensional Ginzburg--Landau model with pinning
summary: We study the persistence of the Meissner state in the three-dimensional magnetic Ginzburg--Landau model with a spatially dependent pinning term. Factoring out the equilibrium profile associated with the pinning term reduces the problem to the analysis of a weighted Ginzburg--Landau functional. In the extreme type-II regime, we construct locally minimizing vortexless configurations for applied fields extending far beyond the first critical field. We obtain quantitative estimates showing that these configurations remain close, up to gauge transformations, to a Meissner-type state determined by a weighted London problem. We also prove the uniqueness, up to gauge transformations, of the locally minimizing Meissner-type branch within a quantitatively controlled class of local minimizers. A central difficulty is to derive elliptic estimates that remain uniform in the Ginzburg--Landau parameter in the presence of the resulting spatially dependent weight. Under a small-BMO assumption on this weight, we obtain the required regularity and extend to the three-dimensional pinned setting the metastability picture previously established for the homogeneous model.

AI.tldr: 该文研究带空间依赖钉扎项（pinning term）的三维磁 Ginzburg–Landau 模型中 Meissner 态（Meissner state）的持续性，在极端第二类超导（extreme type-II）区域构造出局域极小且无涡旋（vortexless）的构型，并证明其在对规范变换（gauge transformations）意义下保持唯一性，从而把均匀模型的亚稳态图像（metastability picture）推广到三维钉扎情形。
AI.motivation: 原始动机在于考察空间非均匀的钉扎项如何影响 Meissner 态的稳定性；此前亚稳态分析主要针对均匀模型，三维钉扎情形尚待刻画。
AI.method: 方法上先剥离（factor out）与钉扎项相关的平衡 профиль，将问题约化为带权 Ginzburg–Landau 泛函（weighted Ginzburg–Landau functional）；核心是在权重存在时推导关于 Ginzburg–Landau 参数一致的椭圆估计（elliptic estimates uniform in the GL parameter），并在权重满足小 BMO 假设（small-BMO assumption）下获得所需正则性。
AI.result: 结果表明可在外加磁场（applied field）远超第一临界场（first critical field）时构造局域极小无涡旋构型；定量估计显示这些构型在对规范变换意义下接近由加权 London 问题（weighted London problem）决定的 Meissner 型态，且该分支在定量受控的局域极小类中唯一。
AI.conclusion: 结论是三维钉扎模型在极端第二类区域延承了均匀模型的亚稳态图景；小 BMO 权重假设是保证一致椭圆正则性与上述结论的关键条件。

title: Detectability of an orbital-angular-momentum-based gravitational wave detector
summary: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) of light provides a new approach to probing gravitational waves (GWs) through transitions between OAM states. Here, we assess the detectability of an OAM-based GW detector by developing a readout scheme and evaluating its noise budget over the frequency range from $1~\mathrm{mHz}$ to $100~\mathrm{Hz}$, including laser-intensity noise, laser-phase noise, mode-impurity noise, and shot noise. For a symmetric superposition OAM state, the GW-induced transition amplitudes satisfy $α_+=-α_-^*$, whereas the noise-induced mode-crosstalk coefficients obey $n_+=n_-^*$. Hence, the GW-induced signal forms a differential-mode contribution, while laser-intensity and mode-impurity noises enter as common-mode contributions, enabling their suppression by the balanced detection. Under a fixed beam-waist constraint, a shorter arm permits a larger paraxial parameter, reducing the equivalent angular-noise strain sensitivity. We adopt an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $γ=0.1$, a laser power incident on the beam splitter of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, and a wavelength of $λ_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$. Using representative noise spectra, we find that, for GWs from an equal-mass binary black hole with source-frame component masses of $M_{\mathrm{src}}=10^{4}\,M_{\odot}$ at redshift $z=1$, balanced detection yields an SNR of $24.7$ for an imbalance parameter of $ε=10^{-3}$ and $239$ for $ε=10^{-5}$, with the sensitivity approaching the shot-noise limit in the latter case. These results highlight the importance of a compact optical configuration and strong common-mode rejection for realizing an OAM-based GW detector.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于轨道角动量（OAM）的光学引力波（GW）探测方案，构建了读出方案并核算 1 mHz–100 Hz 频段的噪声预算，证明平衡探测可将激光强度噪声与模式杂质噪声作为共模抑制，并在紧凑构型下获得接近散粒噪声极限的灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 光的轨道角动量（OAM）态间跃迁为引力波探测提供了新途径，但其可探测性缺乏系统的读出方案与噪声预算评估。
AI.method: 开发读出方案并评估 1 mHz–100 Hz 的噪声预算，涵盖激光强度噪声、激光相位噪声、模式杂质噪声与散粒噪声；利用对称叠加 OAM 态下信号满足 α₊=−α₋*、噪声耦合系数满足 n₊=n₋* 的对称性，采用平衡探测（balanced detection）实现共模抑制。
AI.result: 在臂长 L=4 m、往返次数 N=160、近轴参数 γ=0.1、分束器入射功率 P_BS=10 kW、波长 λ_opt=1064 nm 的设定下，对红移 z=1、源系质量 M_src=10⁴ M_⊙ 的等质量双黑洞，信噪比（SNR）在不平衡参数 ε=10⁻³ 时为 24.7、ε=10⁻⁵ 时为 239，后者接近散粒噪声极限。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑光学构型与强共模抑制是实现基于 OAM 的引力波探测器性能的关键条件。

title: Diffusion-Based Generative Screening of ABX$_3$ Perovskite Compositions for Bandgap-Targeted Materials Discovery
summary: Crystal-generation models can explore compositions and atomic arrangements beyond a fixed set of crystal prototypes, but their usefulness for a specific materials family depends on whether the generated structures retain the defining topology and whether their predicted properties remain reliable across the sampled chemistry. Here, a pretrained diffusion model is used to generate candidate ABX$_3$ perovskites and to examine their structural, chemical and electronic-property distributions. A connectivity-based filter distinguishes three-dimensional corner-sharing perovskites from structures that share the same nominal ABX$_3$ stoichiometry. The accepted set contains substantial B-site multiplicity, including ordered double-perovskite configurations that are inaccessible to the two-prototype substitution reference used here. The generated set is enriched in chloride-, bromide- and iodide-containing compositions relative to the Materials Project, while all generated B-site elements are already represented in that database. On the downstream MP-trained ALIGNN scale, the predicted bandgap distribution is shifted towards 1.4 eV, but the target-window fraction (8.2\%) is close to the MP reference fraction (7.3\%); the separate MatterGen and ALIGNN label sources prevent this comparison from establishing target-condition enrichment. An ALIGNN model performs well on a formula-grouped random test split but does not outperform a constant baseline on a deliberately severe B-site-disjoint test. First-principles calculations on six generated structures show that relaxation can alter structural classification and that predicted and calculated gaps can differ appreciably. These results identify both the chemical-space coverage offered by crystal diffusion and the structural and predictive checks needed before its outputs can be treated as materials candidates.

AI.tldr: 该研究用预训练扩散模型（diffusion model）生成 ABX₃ 钙钛矿候选结构，并通过连接性筛选、数据库比对与第一性原理（first-principles）计算，系统评估生成结构在拓扑定义、化学空间覆盖和电子性质预测上的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 晶体生成模型（crystal-generation models）可突破固定晶体原型（crystal prototypes）探索成分与原子排布，但其对特定材料体系的价值取决于生成结构是否保持定义性拓扑（topology），以及预测性质在所采样化学空间上是否可靠，这一可靠性此前缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 使用预训练扩散模型生成 ABX₃ 钙钛矿候选，并以基于连接性（connectivity-based）的过滤器区分三维共角钙钛矿与名义 ABX₃ 化学计量相同的其他结构；随后与 Materials Project 数据库比对，并借助 MP 训练的 ALIGNN 模型评估带隙（bandgap）分布，另用分组测试（formula-grouped、B-site-disjoint）考察泛化性，最后对六个生成结构做第一性原理计算验证。
AI.result: 筛选后集合含显著 B 位多重性（B-site multiplicity），包括两原型取代参考无法得到的有序双钙钛矿（double-perovskite）构型；相对 MP 富集氯、溴、碘化物成分，但 B 位元素均已在库中出现。预测带隙分布向 1.4 eV 偏移，目标窗口占比 8.2\% 接近 MP 参考的 7.3\%，但因分类来源不同无法据此确立目标条件富集。ALIGNN 在公式分组随机测试上表现良好，但在严苛的 B 位不相交测试上未优于常数基线（constant baseline）。六个结构的第一性原理计算显示弛豫（relaxation）可改变结构分类，且预测与计算带隙存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果既揭示了晶体扩散模型（crystal diffusion）提供的化学空间覆盖优势，也表明其输出在被视为材料候选之前，需要结构分类与性质预测层面的多重校验。

title: Universality of Large-Scale Geometry For Critical Random-Cluster Models
summary: The understanding of the behaviour of critical lattice models in two dimensions has made immense progress in the past couple of decades, with conformal invariance as its conjectured end goal. We consider here the critical random-cluster model (or FK-percolation) on a large class of graphs --- namely bi-periodic isoradial graphs --- with cluster-weight~$q \in [1,4]$. Following up on the establishment of rotational invariance at criticality in \cite{Rotation}, we prove that the large scale behaviour of these models is asymptotically the same on all such graphs. These include the critical homogeneous models on the square, triangular and hexagonal lattices.

AI.tldr: 该摘要报告了在双向周期等径向图（bi-periodic isoradial graphs）上证明临界随机簇模型（random-cluster model）的大尺度行为在簇权重（cluster-weight）q∈[1,4]时渐近一致。
