AI.motivation: 二维临界格点模型（critical lattice models）研究在过去二十年间进展显著，其猜测的终极目标是共形不变性（conformal invariance），因此需要明确不同图上的普适性（universality）问题。
AI.method: 研究对象为一大类图上的临界随机簇模型（或称FK渗流，FK-percolation），即双向周期等径向图，簇权重取q∈[1,4]；在前期已建立临界旋转不变性（rotational invariance）的基础上，进一步论证其大尺度行为的渐近一致性。
AI.result: 证明这些模型在所有此类图上的大尺度行为渐近相同，涵盖方形、三角形与六边形格点（square, triangular and hexagonal lattices）上的临界均匀模型。
AI.conclusion: 临界随机簇模型在双向周期等径向图上呈现普适的大尺度行为，为二维临界现象的共形不变性目标提供了支持。

title: Wide-field search for submicrosecond optical and gamma transients as manifestation of primordial black holes evaporation with the TAIGA-HiSCORE Cherenkov array
summary: We demonstrated in our papers [Panov, 2021; Panov,2025), that the TAIGA-HiSCORE Cherenkov array physics, originally designed for research in cosmic rays and ultra-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy, can also be used for wide-field searches for very rare submicrosecond optical transients of astrophysical origin. The papers \cite{PANOV-2021,PANOV-2025} presented the results of the first four seasons of optical transient searches (2018--2022) and the resulting upper limits on the flux of corresponding events. The present paper presents data processing from two new seasons of optical transient searches (2022--2024). This paper further develops a method for searching for narrow spatiotemporal groups of ultra-high-energy gamma-rays (above 100\,TeV). Since the evaporation of relic black holes can be accompanied by both by the emission of a short light pulse and by a flash of ultra-high-energy gamma-rays, a multimessenger technique for searching for black hole evaporation was in fact implemented in this work, where two different methods are implemented within a single instrument. The search for narrow spatiotemporal groups of gamma-rays was carried out in time windows of 1000\,$μ$s, 100\,$μ$s, and 6\,$μ$s. Since narrow groups of gamma were not detected, the upper limit on their frequency were obtained as $10^{-3}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$. The upper limit on the number of submicrosecond optical transients have also been updated: $10^{-4}\mathrm{erg/s/cm}^2$ as $5\cdot10^{-4}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$.

AI.tldr: 基于 TAIGA-HiSCORE 切伦科夫阵列（Cherenkov array）数据，本文处理了两个新观测季节（2022–2024）的亚微秒光学瞬变（submicrosecond optical transients）搜寻数据，并发展了搜寻超高能伽马射线窄时空群（narrow spatiotemporal groups）的方法，从而在单一装置内实现黑洞蒸发（black hole evaporation）的多信使（multimessenger）搜寻。
AI.motivation: TAIGA-HiSCORE 原为宇宙线（cosmic rays）与超高能伽马射线天文学设计，作者此前工作表明其亦可用于广视场稀有亚微秒光学瞬变搜寻；黑洞蒸发理论上可同时产生短光脉冲与超高能伽马射线闪，故有必要在同一装置内开展多信使联合搜寻。
AI.method: 对 2022–2024 两个新季节的光学瞬变搜寻数据进行处理，并进一步发展了探测 100 TeV 以上超高能伽马射线窄时空群的方法；伽马射线群搜寻分别在 1000 μs、100 μs 与 6 μs 时间窗内进行。
AI.result: 未探测到伽马射线窄群，其发生频率上限为 $10^{-3}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$；亚微秒光学瞬变数目上限更新为 $10^{-4}\,\mathrm{erg/s/cm}^2$，即 $5\cdot10^{-4}\,\mathrm{ster}^{-1}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$。
AI.conclusion: 单一仪器内同时实现光学与超高能伽马射线两种搜寻方法，实质上构成了黑洞蒸发的多信使搜寻方案；两季数据未给出正信号，仅给出相应通量与频率上限。

title: A microscopic stochastic field theory for nonlinear pomeron--odderon evolution based on a Doi--Peliti framework
summary: We construct a reaction-based microscopic realisation of nonlinear pomeron--odderon evolution in rapidity and impact-parameter space. Using the Doi--Peliti formalism, we derive the master equations, their operator representation, the exact hierarchy of factorial moments, and the coherent-state functional integral. The construction admits normalised complex configuration weights while retaining the algebraic conservation law of the gain--loss generator. Pomeron branching and merging yield the complex logistic equation \cite{Kohara:2026} under mean-field factorisation. Pomeron-catalysed odderon branching and ternary odderon fusion provide an odd sector whose evolution is driven by the pomeron background. Without transverse diffusion, the resulting equations admit an analytical solution in quadrature, allowing us to examine amplification, phase evolution, and nonlinear regulation. A specified matching between the first moments and the even and odd scattering profiles connects this evolution to elastic-scattering observables. Illustrative initial conditions produce a nonmonotonic forward ratio and a splitting between the $pp$ and $p\bar p$ channels, while the interference near a diffractive minimum remains sensitive to the relative phases and transverse profiles. These examples illustrate the effective dynamics without constituting a fit to data or a general proof of scattering unitarity.

AI.tldr: 该文利用Doi–Peliti形式建立了一个基于反应的微观模型，实现快度与碰撞参数空间中的非线性pomeron–odderon演化，并以解析与数值示例讨论放大、相位演化与非线性调控。
AI.motivation: 旨在为高能散射中pomeron与odderon的非线性联合演化提供微观反应层次的构造框架，从而在保留增益–损失生成元代数守恒律的同时纳入复权重与奇偶两个扇区。
AI.method: 采用Doi–Peliti形式（Doi–Peliti formalism）推导主方程、算符表示、阶乘矩（factorial moments）的精确层级以及相干态泛函积分；在平均场因子化下得到复logistic方程，并由pomeron催化的odderon分支与三元odderon聚变构成奇扇区；无横向扩散时给出求积形式的解析解。
AI.result: 在无横向扩散情形下方程组可解析求解，可考察放大、相位演化与非线性调控；通过一阶矩与偶、奇散射剖面的匹配，示例性初条件给出非单调的前向比值及pp与p\bar p通道的分裂，而衍射极小附近的干涉对相对相位与横向剖面敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该构造说明了有效动力学的可能行为，但作者明确指出这些示例不构成对数据的拟合，也不构成散射幺正性（unitarity）的一般性证明。

title: Charge-Order pattern in $κ$-BEDT-TTF salts: A model independent, selection rule approach
summary: A well known vibrational selection rule is invoked to determine the charge order (CO) pattern displayed by the most interesting members of the widely studied class of $κ$-BEDT-TTF salts and their molecular analogues. The selection rule indicates that an easily identifiable Raman band should be present if intra-dimer charge disproportionation occurs, constituting a sort of model independent ``litmus test''. The absence of such a band in the available Raman spectra of $κ$-BEDT-TTF salts exhibiting static of fluctuating CO, strongly suggests that the CO pattern involves inter-dimer CO, in contrast with the universally accepted intra-dimer disprortionation. This paper therefore poses a challenge for the theoretical modeling of the concerned salts: either the lack of the Raman band sensitive to intra-dimer CO pattern is explained, or the modeling of the multivariate, unique physical properties of these $κ$-phase salts (spin frustration, electronic ferroelectricity etc.) has to start from the perspective of a different ground state.

AI.tldr: 本文依据振动选择定则（vibrational selection rule）提出一种判别 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐中电荷有序（charge order, CO）模式的“试金石”方法，指出拉曼（Raman）谱中缺少二聚体内电荷不均化（intra-dimer charge disproportionation）特征带，从而质疑普遍接受的 CO 图像。
AI.motivation: κ-BEDT-TTF 盐及其分子类似物被广泛研究，其自旋阻挫（spin frustration）、电子铁电性（electronic ferroelectricity）等性质的理论建模通常以二聚体内电荷不均化为出发点；需要一种与模型无关的实验判据来检验该 CO 图像是否成立。
AI.method: 援引一条已知的振动选择定则：若发生二聚体内电荷不均化，拉曼谱中应出现一个易于识别的特征带，从而构成“试金石”式判据；随后将此判据应用于呈现静态或涨落 CO 的 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐的现有拉曼谱。
AI.result: 在呈现静态或涨落 CO 的 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐的可用拉曼谱中，该特征带缺失，强烈提示 CO 模式为二聚体间电荷有序（inter-dimer CO），与普遍接受的二聚体内不均化图像相反。
AI.conclusion: 该结果对相关盐的理论建模构成挑战：或需解释对二聚体内 CO 敏感的拉曼带为何缺失，或以不同基态（ground state）为出发点重建对 κ 相盐多种独特性质（自旋阻挫、电子铁电性等）的建模。

title: Multivariate analogues of Ruijsenaars' hypergeometric function
comment: 34 pages. Based on the second author's MSc thesis
summary: We construct multivariate analogues of Ruijsenaars' hypergeometric function as nested products of overlap coefficients between eigenfunctions of twisted primitive elements in representations of the modular double of $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$. The construction is a hyperbolic counterpart of the nested multivariate Askey--Wilson polynomials and functions. Using iterated coproducts, we derive four systems of difference equations for which these multivariate functions are joint eigenfunctions. The four systems correspond to the two sets of variables and the two step sizes $iw_1$ and $iw_2$, which are interchanged by modular duality. We also prove that Ruijsenaars' one-variable transform is unitary in the parameter regime required for the construction, for positive as well as complex conjugate $w_1,w_2$. A two-sided normalization of the kernel separates the input and output weights, so that iterating one-variable transforms yields unitary multivariate transforms with explicit inverse and Plancherel formulas.

AI.tldr: 本文以模双（modular double）$U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ 表示中扭曲本原元特征函数间重叠系数的嵌套乘积，构造 Ruijsenaars 超几何函数的多变量推广，并证明相应单变量变换的酉性，从而得到具有显式逆与 Plancherel 公式的多变量酉变换。
AI.motivation: 目标是构造 Ruijsenaars 超几何函数的多变量类比，作为嵌套多变量 Askey–Wilson 多项式与函数的双曲对应物，并建立相应的变换理论。
AI.method: 利用模双 $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ 表示中扭曲本原元特征函数间的重叠系数（overlap coefficients）作嵌套乘积构造多变量函数；借助迭代余积（iterated coproducts）导出四组差分方程；并证明构造所需参数区域内 Ruijsenaars 单变量变换的酉性，采用核的双侧归一化分离输入与输出权重。
AI.result: 得到四组差分方程系统，多变量函数为其联合特征函数；四组系统对应两组变量与两个步长 $iw_1$、$iw_2$，二者经模对偶（modular duality）互换。证明单变量变换在正及复共轭 $w_1,w_2$ 的参数区域内酉，且迭代后给出带显式逆与 Plancherel 公式的多变量酉变换。
AI.conclusion: 该构造将 Ruijsenaars 单变量理论提升为多变量酉变换框架，核的双侧归一化是实现迭代酉性与 Plancherel 公式的关键。

title: Zero mode, Zero influence: Spatial-derivative coupling in particle detectors
summary: It is common in particle detector models in cavity QED to often omit zero modes or assume their state, compromising causality or introducing ambiguity in their predictions. We show that spatial-derivative coupling eliminates both problems. For free massless scalar fields in static periodic or Neumann cavities of any spatial dimension, cavity-frame spatial derivatives annihilate the zero-mode operator while preserving microcausality. Detector dynamics and entanglement harvesting then depend only on the reduced detector-oscillator state, nonperturbatively and even with initial correlations with the zero mode. Time derivatives and moving-detector rest-frame spatial derivatives can retain zero-mode state dependence not compromising causality. Realized through current coupling in superconducting circuits, spatial-derivative coupling thus makes zero-mode state assumptions unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 该文指出腔QED粒子探测器模型中常忽略零模（zero mode）或预设其状态，这会破坏因果性或引入预测歧义；采用空间导数耦合（spatial-derivative coupling）可同时消除这两个问题。
AI.motivation: 腔QED探测器模型（particle detector models）通常省略零模或假定其状态，从而损害因果性（causality）或造成预测的不确定性，因此需要一个能规避零模状态依赖的耦合方案。
AI.method: 针对任意空间维度的静态周期或Neumann腔中的自由无质量标量场（free massless scalar fields），分析腔系空间导数（cavity-frame spatial derivatives）对零模算符的作用，并考察探测器动力学与纠缠提取（entanglement harvesting）对约化探测器-振子态（reduced detector-oscillator state）的依赖；方法覆盖非微扰情形及与零模存在初始关联的情况，另比较时间导数与运动探测器静止系空间导数的效应。
AI.result: 腔系空间导数湮灭零模算符并保持微观因果性（microcausality）；探测器动力学与纠缠提取仅依赖约化探测器-振子态，且在非微扰层面、乃至存在零模初始关联时仍成立。时间导数与运动探测器静止系空间导数可保留零模状态依赖，但不破坏因果性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在超导电路（superconducting circuits）中以电流耦合实现空间导数耦合，零模状态假设不再必要，从而提升探测器模型预测的因果一致性与确定性。

title: Three-Dimensional FDTD Simulation of Superconducting Terahertz Emitters Using an Effective Medium Approximation
summary: Compact and tunable terahertz (THz) sources with controllable polarization are sought for high-speed links, spectroscopy, and imaging. In superconducting THz emitters based on a cuprate Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$, which have the potential to satisfy such properties, modeling often relies on heavy nonlinear solvers or empirical isotropic dielectrics, obscuring anisotropy, plasma response, and bias dependence. We derive an anisotropic, dispersive effective permittivity from the Lawrence-Doniach model for a layered superconductor and implement it as a user-defined material in a commercial Finite-difference Time-domain (FDTD) solver. Simulations of two device geometries reproduce linearly polarized emission from a rectangular mesa and low-axial-ratio (near-circular) emission from a truncated square mesa. This CAD-ready workflow links superconducting theory to device design, enabling rapid searches and parameter optimization for next-generation THz sources.

AI.tldr: 该文从Lawrence-Doniach模型推导出各向异性色散有效介电常数，并作为用户自定义材料接入商用FDTD求解器，成功复现了两种超导太赫兹发射器件的偏振发射特性。
AI.motivation: 紧凑、偏振可控的太赫兹源在高速链路、光谱与成像中需求迫切，而现有对铜氧化物超导太赫兹发射器的建模依赖重型非线性求解器或经验各向同性介质，掩盖了各向异性、等离子体响应与偏压依赖性。
AI.method: 基于分层超导体的Lawrence-Doniach模型推导各向异性、色散的有效介电常数（effective permittivity），并以用户自定义材料形式在商用时域有限差分（FDTD）求解器中实现，对两种器件几何结构进行仿真。
AI.result: 仿真复现了矩形台面（rectangular mesa）的线偏振发射，以及截角方形台面（truncated square mesa）的低轴比（近圆偏振）发射。
AI.conclusion: 该可直接用于计算机辅助设计（CAD-ready）的工作流将超导理论与器件设计相衔接，可支持下一代太赫兹源的快速搜索与参数优化。

title: Bilateral Christoffel-Geronimus-Uvarov formulas for mixed-type orthogonality on algebraic supports
summary: Christoffel-type determinant formulas construct both normalized polynomial families and their reproducing kernel for mixed-type orthogonality in several variables after independent rational matrix transformations on the two arguments. The pairing may have a rectangular matrix of functionals, with separate degree bounds on each component, and may be supported on an algebraic variety. The reduced matrices are calculated from the original biorthogonal polynomials, rational moments, polynomial division and the masses left free by division; their nonvanishing determinants characterize existence and uniqueness. For measure pairings the rational data are expressed by Cauchy and multivariate Fantappie transforms. Exact dimension counts incorporate the four matrix factors and the relations of the support. For normal degree-ordered original families and fixed factors, when the component degrees on each side differ by a bounded amount and the normalization dimension grows at most like one degree layer, the resulting orders are bounded on curves and grow at most linearly on surfaces. For pairings allowing scalar factors to move between arguments, called balanced pairings, an exact obstruction determines whether a bilateral mass decomposes into unilateral masses when the denominators act injectively. Residue duality provides coordinates for division and mass quotients on integral curves, including singular points, and on the finite surface quotients specified here. Explicit singular-curve families retain nondegenerate residue pairings as denominator zeros coalesce. Positive congruences admit a further reduction by orthogonal projection, while balanced pairings give simultaneous intertwining identities for all coordinate multiplication matrices.

AI.tldr: 该文以 Christoffel 型行列式公式构造混合型多变量正交性（mixed-type orthogonality）的归一化多项式族及其再生核（reproducing kernel），在两侧自变量作独立有理矩阵变换后给出存在唯一性判据、维数计数与阶增长界。
AI.motivation: 旨在将经典 Christoffel 型行列式构造推广到更一般的框架：配对可为矩形函数矩阵（rectangular matrix of functionals）、各分量有独立次数上界，且支撑集可为代数簇（algebraic variety），并厘清有理变换下约化矩阵与存在唯一性的刻画。
AI.method: 约化矩阵由原双正交多项式（biorthogonal polynomials）、有理矩（rational moments）、多项式除法及除法剩余质量计算，其非零行列式刻画存在唯一性；测度配对情形用 Cauchy 变换与多变量 Fantappie 变换表示有理数据；并以留数对偶（residue duality）为除法与质量商提供坐标。
AI.result: 给出含四个矩阵因子及支撑集关系的精确维数计数（exact dimension counts）。对正规次数序族与固定因子，当两侧分量次数差有界、归一化维数至多按一个次数层增长时，所得阶在曲线上有界、在曲面上至多线性增长。对平衡配对（balanced pairings），在分母单射作用时由精确障碍（obstruction）判定双侧质量能否分解为单侧质量；显式奇异曲线族在分母零点合并时仍保持非退化留数配对。
AI.conclusion: 正定同余（positive congruences）可经正交投影进一步约化；平衡配对为所有坐标乘法矩阵给出同时 intertwining 恒等式，表明该行列式框架统一处理奇异性、维数约束与算子结构。

title: Tests of an EP-Preserving Wake Force
summary: A universal quadratic coupling of ultralight scalar dark matter to ordinary matter preserves the weak equivalence principle for unscreened point particles. A finite test body is nevertheless not a passive probe: it distorts the scalar field that accelerates it. We show that this field distortion produces a differential acceleration between concentric test masses, even when their microscopic coupling is universal. We calculate this signal including how each test mass distorts the field acting on the other, deriving the weak-screening limit and extending the calculation to stronger screening using concentric spherical layers. Applying the model to MICROSCOPE, we find differential signals in both its equivalence-principle sensor SUEP, whose test masses have different compositions, and its reference sensor SUREF, whose test masses have the same composition. We combine both sensors with the dark matter wake near Earth to recast the published MICROSCOPE measurements. Within this model, existing measurements probe scalar masses up to approximately $8 \times 10^{-9}\,$eV and couplings below the supernova bound. An analysis using the additional frequency components of the scalar signal could extend the mass reach and probe couplings below the BBN bound.

AI.tldr: 超轻标量暗物质与普通物质存在普适二次耦合时，虽对无屏蔽点粒子保持弱等效原理，但有限测试体对加速其的标量场产生畸变，从而在同心测试质量间产生差分加速度。本文计算该信号并应用于MICROSCOPE，重新解释其已发表数据，将标量质量探测上限推至约8×10⁻⁹ eV。
AI.motivation: 普适二次耦合被认为对无屏蔽点粒子保持弱等效原理（weak equivalence principle），但有限尺寸测试体并非被动探针，会畸变驱动其加速的标量场（scalar field）。因此需要研究这种场畸变是否会产生可观测的差分加速度（differential acceleration），从而检验纯引力与标量耦合效应。
AI.method: 计算同心测试质量间的场畸变信号，包含每个测试质量对作用于对方的场的畸变；推导弱屏蔽极限（weak-screening limit），并用同心球层（concentric spherical layers）将计算推广至更强屏蔽情形。随后将模型应用于MICROSCOPE的等效原理传感器SUEP（测试质量成分不同）与参考传感器SUREF（成分相同），结合地球附近的暗物质尾迹（dark matter wake）重新拟合已发表测量。
AI.result: 在SUEP与SUREF两个传感器中均发现差分信号。模型下现有测量可探测标量质量（scalar mass）至约8×10⁻⁹ eV，耦合强度低于超新星（supernova）界限；利用标量信号附加频率成分（frequency components）的分析可拓展质量探测范围，并探测低于BBN界限的耦合。
AI.conclusion: 有限测试体对超轻标量暗物质的场畸变可在微观耦合普适时产生差分加速度，构成一种新的探测通道；MICROSCOPE数据已给出对标量质量与耦合的约束，且频率成分分析有望进一步拓展探测范围。

title: High-order concentric hopfions in a helimagnet
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, bilingual: English (edited machine translation), Russian (primary)
summary: Magnetic hopfions are three-dimensional topological solitons: ``knots'' in the vector field of magnetization of magnetically ordered materials, which are a key element of the three-dimensional spintronics emerging today. In this work, a simple analytical model for a new type of magnetic hopfions --- ``concentric'' ones --- is constructed and solved. Their size and equilibrium energy are estimated, their stability region on the magnetic phase diagram of a helimagnet is mapped out, and the requirements for materials admitting equilibrium concentric hopfions with high Hopf index on a uniformly magnetized background are determined.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并求解了一类新型磁霍普夫子（magnetic hopfions）——“同心型”（concentric）霍普夫子的简单解析模型，给出其尺寸与平衡能量估计，绘制其在螺旋磁体（helimagnet）磁相图中的稳定区，并确定实现高霍普夫指数（Hopf index）平衡同心霍普夫子所需材料条件。
AI.motivation: 磁霍普夫子是磁有序材料磁化矢量场中的三维拓扑孤子（three-dimensional topological solitons），是新兴三维自旋电子学（three-dimensional spintronics）的关键要素，但针对新型霍普夫子构型的简单可解析模型仍属空白。
AI.method: 构建并求解一个针对“同心型”磁霍普夫子的简单解析模型（analytical model），据此估计其尺寸与平衡能量（equilibrium energy），并映射其在螺旋磁体磁相图中的稳定区域（stability region）。
AI.result: 获得了同心型霍普夫子的尺寸与平衡能量估计，标定了其在螺旋磁体磁相图中的稳定区，并明确了在均匀磁化背景（uniformly magnetized background）上承载高霍普夫指数平衡同心霍普夫子所需的材料要求。
AI.conclusion: 该解析模型为新型“同心型”磁霍普夫子提供了理论描述，并为在螺旋磁体材料中实现高霍普夫指数的稳定同心霍普夫子给出了材料设计判据。

title: A Hierarchical direct solver for Lippmann-Schwinger equations based on boundary traces
summary: A high-order hierarchical direct solver for variable-media scattering in two dimensions is presented. Standard discretizations for these problems produce dense linear systems that are commonly solved iteratively, requiring a new global solve for each incident field. The method proposed here instead constructs a reusable scattering operator for the inhomogeneous medium, based on a hierarchical subdivision of the computational domain. First, high-accuracy leaf scattering operators are built from discretized local integral equations. Up the hierarchy, neighboring boxes are merged to build the scattering operators for successively larger boxes. A key feature of the method is that each scattering operator is represented as a map of incoming traces to outgoing traces. Consequently, volume unknowns appear only in the leaf computations; all higher levels of the hierarchy operate entirely on boundary traces. The hierarchical solver is presented first at the continuum level and discretized only afterward using high-order local volume quadrature, polynomial trace representations, and boundary integral techniques. For a discretization involving $N$ degrees of freedom, the method requires $O(N^{3/2})$ work and $O(N\log N)$ storage to build all scattering operators. Once these are available, any incoming field can be processed at cost $O(N)$ if only the outgoing field is required, and cost $O(N\log N)$ if the full field is required. Numerical experiments demonstrate high-order accuracy on a range of challenging scattering problems including cavities, back-scattering, limited regularity, and high wavenumber, that pose significant challenges to iterative methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对二维变介质散射问题的高阶分层直接求解器（high-order hierarchical direct solver），以分层子区域构建可复用的散射算子（scattering operator），将体未知量限制在叶层、上层仅处理边界迹（boundary traces），实现 O(N^{3/2}) 构建代价与 O(N) 或 O(N log N) 的逐入射场求解代价。
AI.motivation: 标准离散化产生的稠密线性系统（dense linear systems）通常采用迭代求解，且每个入射场都需重新进行一次全局求解，成本高；同时迭代方法在腔体、后向散射、低正则性（limited regularity）与高波数等困难问题上表现受限。
AI.method: 基于计算域的分层细分（hierarchical subdivision）：先由离散局部积分方程构建高精度叶层散射算子，再逐层合并相邻盒子得到更大盒子的散射算子；每个散射算子表示为入射迹到出射迹的映射（map of incoming traces to outgoing traces），因此体未知量仅出现在叶层计算。方法先在连续层面（continuum level）表述，随后用高阶局部体求积、多项式迹表示与边界积分技术进行离散。
AI.result: 对含 N 个自由度的离散，构建全部散射算子需 O(N^{3/2}) 工作量与 O(N log N) 存储；算子就绪后，仅需出射场时单次处理代价为 O(N)，需要全场时为 O(N log N)。数值实验在腔体、后向散射、低正则性与高波数等问题上展示了高阶精度（high-order accuracy）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过可复用的分层散射算子替代逐入射场的全局迭代求解，在保持高阶精度的同时获得优于迭代方法的复杂度与鲁棒性，适用于迭代方法难以处理的挑战性散射问题。

title: Radiofrequency plasma spheroidization of lightweight complex concentrated superalloy Al10Nb20Ta15Ti30V5Zr20
summary: Recent advances in additive manufacturing (AM) have significantly increased the demand for high-quality metal powders with tailored composition. For refractory complex concentrated alloys (RCCA) preparing such powders by conventional metallurgical method remains challenging due to their high melting point and chemical reactivity. In this paper, we present a method to produce spherical RCCA powders (here Al10Nb20Ta15Ti30V5Zr20) via mechanical alloying followed by radio-frequency inductively coupled plasma spheroidization. The resulting powder is suitable for AM processes because of its spherical morphology and a microstructure consisting of major BCC phases with local B2 phase. Complex carbide formation was studied by 3D atom probe tomography.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种面向增材制造（additive manufacturing, AM）的难熔复杂浓缩合金（refractory complex concentrated alloys, RCCA）球形粉末制备路线，即机械合金化（mechanical alloying）结合射频电感耦合等离子体球化（radio-frequency inductively coupled plasma spheroidization）。所得 Al10Nb20Ta15Ti30V5Zr20 粉末形貌呈球形、组织以 BCC 相为主并含局部 B2 相，适用于增材制造。
AI.motivation: 增材制造对具有定制成分的高质量金属粉末需求显著上升，而 RCCA 因高熔点与化学活泼性，采用传统冶金方法制备此类粉末仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 采用机械合金化（mechanical alloying）后接射频电感耦合等离子体球化（radio-frequency inductively coupled plasma spheroidization）的工艺路线制备 Al10Nb20Ta15Ti30V5Zr20 球形 RCCA 粉末，并借助三维原子探针层析（3D atom probe tomography）研究复杂碳化物的形成。
AI.result: 所得粉末具有球形形貌，显微组织由主要 BCC 相与局部 B2 相构成，因而适合增材制造工艺；复杂碳化物的形成通过三维原子探针层析进行了表征。
AI.conclusion: 机械合金化结合射频电感耦合等离子体球化可有效制备适用于增材制造的球形 RCCA 粉末，为该类难熔合金粉末的制备提供了可行途径。（注：摘要未给出具体性能数据与定量结论。）

title: A closed formula for the Poisson cohomology of scalar Dubrovin-Novikov brackets in arbitrary dimension
summary: The structure of the Poisson cohomology groups for scalar Poisson brackets of Dubrovin-Novikov type with $D$ independent variables has been first described in arXiv:1512.05744 ; in that work, a complete dimensional counting was provided for $D=2$, and some numerical results exhibited for $D=3$, $D=4$. Here, we prove a formula for the dimensional counting of the Poisson cohomology for arbitrary $D$. Moreover, we show how to obtain canonical representatives for each cohomology class.

AI.tldr: 该文针对 Dubrovin-Novikov 型标量 Poisson 括号（Poisson brackets）的 Poisson 上同调群（Poisson cohomology groups），将先前仅对 D=2 完整、对 D=3、D=4 部分给出的维数计数（dimensional counting）推广为任意维数 D 的公式，并给出上同调类的典范代表元（canonical representatives）构造方法。
AI.motivation: 先前工作（arXiv:1512.05744）仅对 D=2 给出完整的维数计数，对 D=3、D=4 只给出数值结果，缺少对任意独立变量数 D 的一般性刻画；同时上同调类缺乏显式的典范代表元。
AI.method: 在既有 Poisson 上同调结构描述的基础上，通过证明一个适用于任意 D 的维数计数公式，并给出构造每个上同调类典范代表元的显式程序。
AI.result: 得到对任意 D 成立的 Poisson 上同调维数计数公式，并说明如何为每个上同调类获得典范代表元；该公式在 D=2 时覆盖先前完整计数，并与 D=3、D=4 的已有数值结果一致（摘要未显式声明一致性验证）。
AI.conclusion: Dubrovin-Novikov 型标量 Poisson 括号的 Poisson 上同调维数计数可完全一般化到任意维数 D，且上同调类可由典范代表元显式刻画；这完善了先前仅部分解决的计数问题。

title: Efficient Interpolation of the Bethe-Salpeter Hamiltonian at Arbitrary Momenta
summary: We develop an efficient reciprocal-space method to reconstruct the static Bethe-Salpeter (BSE) Hamiltonian at arbitrary crystal momenta from coarse first-principles grids. Bloch states are interpolated within an optimally smooth Wannier subspace, while the screened Coulomb interaction is reconstructed from the dielectric response. This decouples the electron-hole transition momenta and transferred momentum from the underlying ab initio sampling. We benchmark the method on monolayer hBN, monolayer MoS$_2$, and bulk GaAs against explicit ab initio calculations, finding excellent agreement for dense-grid Bloch states, dielectric screening, and BSE optical spectra. Furthermore, our cost analysis estimates speedups of up to $22\times$ on the grids considered here. Arbitrary transferred-momentum sampling gives direct access to the long-wavelength exciton dispersion: in hBN and MoS$_2$, we resolve the nonanalytic behaviour induced by long-range electron-hole exchange at momenta well below the spacing of practical uniform grids. For bulk GaAs, locally refined transition-momentum sampling yields a converged binding energy for the threefold-degenerate lowest exciton, in close agreement with experiment and reference calculations, using far fewer BSE points than conventional uniform meshes. As the present framework provides exciton energies and amplitudes at arbitrary crystal momenta, it opens the way to incorporating ab initio excitonic effects into nonlocal electron-phonon vertices and to extensions towards exciton-phonon interactions and nonequilibrium exciton dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效的倒空间（reciprocal-space）方法，可从粗第一性原理网格重构任意晶动量下的静态Bethe-Salpeter（BSE）哈密顿量，在hBN、MoS₂与体相GaAs上验证精度良好，并实现最高约22倍加速。
AI.motivation: 直接进行密集网格BSE计算成本高昂，且转移动量（transferred momentum）与电子-空穴跃迁动量受限于从头算采样网格，难以获得任意动量下的激子信息。
AI.method: 在最优平滑的Wannier子空间内插值Bloch态，并由介电响应重构屏蔽库仑相互作用，从而将电子-空穴跃迁动量与转移动量同底层从头算采样解耦。
AI.result: 与显式从头算计算对比，密集网格Bloch态、介电屏蔽及BSE光谱均高度一致，成本分析显示在所考察网格上加速最高达22倍。任意转移动量采样可解析hBN与MoS₂中长程电子-空穴交换导致的非解析行为，并在GaAs中以局部细化采样获得与实验吻合的三重简并最低激子结合能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在任意晶动量下给出激子能量与振幅，为将从头算激子效应纳入非局域电声顶点（electron-phonon vertex）以及拓展至激子-声子相互作用与非平衡激子动力学奠定基础。

title: Spontaneous Chirality and Collective Chern Bands in a Dipole-Conserving Bose System
summary: We demonstrate spontaneous chiral dipole order and an isolated collective Chern band in a time-reversal-symmetric microscopic bosonic lattice model with exact dipole-moment conservation. In a controlled large-occupation limit at zero temperature, frustrated dipole exchange and three-particle conversion stabilize two time-reversed chiral condensates. The two dipole Goldstone modes remain gapless, while a separate finite-frequency band carries Chern numbers $-1$ and $+1$ in the opposite domains. We trace this topology to complex mode couplings in the chiral background that gap finite-frequency Dirac crossings. Site-resolved density drives preserve dipole-moment conservation and reconstruct the band Chern number from band-resolved absorption spectra in the quadratic theory.

AI.tldr: 该文在具有精确偶极矩守恒（dipole-moment conservation）与时间反演对称性的微观玻色格子模型中，展示了自发手性偶极序（spontaneous chiral dipole order）和孤立集体陈能带（Chern band）。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索偶极矩守恒约束与阻挫偶极交换（frustrated dipole exchange）下，玻色晶格体系能否自发产生手性序并携带非平凡拓扑能带结构。
AI.method: 在零温、大占据数（large-occupation）可控极限下，结合阻挫偶极交换与三粒子转化（three-particle conversion）的微观玻色格子模型分析。
AI.result: 两个时间反演配对的手性凝聚态被稳定；两个偶极Goldstone模保持无能隙，而独立有限频率能带在相反畴中分别携带陈数 −1 与 +1，其拓扑源于手性背景中使有限频狄拉克交叉（Dirac crossings）能隙化的复模式耦合。
AI.conclusion: 定点密度驱动（site-resolved density drives）保持偶极矩守恒，并可在二次理论中由能带分辨吸收谱重构能带陈数，提供可探测的拓扑判据。

title: Quantum Diffusion and the Block-Size Crossover in the Block Anderson Model
comment: 117 pages, 2 figures. A short video overview is available: https://youtu.be/CLAtq3mPhNU?si=so7PnIZfMknlsqvS
summary:
We study the block Anderson Hamiltonian \(H_L=λΨ_L+\mathcal V\) on the discrete torus \((\mathbb Z/L\mathbb Z)^d\), \(d\geq2\), where \(Ψ_L\) is the nearest-neighbor Laplacian and \(\mathcal V\) consists of independent \(W^d\times W^d\) GOE blocks. In the weak-disorder limit \(λ\to\infty\), we establish an entrywise local law, a spatial scaling limit for the squared resolvent entries, time-averaged dynamical delocalization, and lower bounds on the localization length of most bulk eigenfunctions. Particularly, we allow the block size to be fixed or grow above a polylogarithmic threshold. In sufficiently large polynomial volumes, the dynamical estimates hold for \(C_δ(λ+W/λ)\leq T\leq λ^{1+κ_d^{\rm BA}-δ}\), with a dimension-dependent exponent \(κ_d^{\rm BA}>0\), and the spreading scale is \(\sqrt{(λ^3+λW)T}\). This identifies a transition at \(W\asympλ^2\) between \(λ^{3/2}\sqrt T\) and \(\sqrt{λWT}\).
  The proof combines Gaussian moment estimates with deterministic stability of a matrix Dyson equation. A partial Bloch transform handles fixed blocks, while scalar reduction controls growing blocks. A Feshbach--Schur reduction of the block \(T\)-equation separates a single scalar diffusion mode from the stable internal cell modes. A renewal expansion and exact cell counting give a positive representation of the diffusion coefficient and control the fourth moment uniformly across the block-size transition. Notably, our argument does not require an enumeration of Feynman diagrams.

AI.tldr: 研究离散环面（discrete torus）上带有GOE随机块势的Anderson型哈密顿量（Anderson Hamiltonian），在弱无序极限下证明逐元局部律（entrywise local law）、平方预解式的空间标度极限（spatial scaling limit）及动力学去局域化（dynamical delocalization）估计，并给出局域长度（localization length）下界；块大小可固定或按多对数阈值（polylogarithmic threshold）增长。
AI.motivation: 经典Anderson局域化（Anderson localization）理论中，随机势的块结构（block structure）对谱与动力学行为的影响尚缺乏在弱无序极限下的定量刻画，尤其是块尺寸可变情形下的标度与转变阈值问题有待解决。
AI.method: 结合高斯矩估计（Gaussian moment estimates）与矩阵Dyson方程（matrix Dyson equation）的确定性稳定性分析；用部分Bloch变换（partial Bloch transform）处理固定块，以标量约化（scalar reduction）控制增长的块；通过块T-方程的Feshbach–Schur约化（Feshbach–Schur reduction）分离单一标量扩散模式与稳定内部胞元模式；再以更新展开（renewal expansion）与精确胞元计数给出扩散系数的正表示，并统一控制四阶矩；论证不依赖Feynman图（Feynman diagrams）枚举。
AI.result: 在λ→∞的弱无序极限下得到逐元局部律、平方预解元（squared resolvent entries）的空间标度极限、时间平均动力学去局域化（time-averaged dynamical delocalization）以及多数体本征函数（bulk eigenfunctions）局域长度下界。在足够大的多项式体积中，动力学估计对C_δ(λ+W/λ)≤T≤λ^{1+κ_d^{BA}−δ}成立，扩散尺度为√((λ^3+λW)T)，并揭示W≍λ^2处λ^{3/2}√T与√(λWT)两种标度之间的转变。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出块Anderson模型在弱无序区间的普适标度图像，将块尺寸增长纳入统一框架，并确定块势强度与拉普拉斯系数之间的转变阈值W≍λ^2；所发展的确定性稳定性与Feshbach–Schur约化方法可避免Feynman图枚举。

title: How tightly can PBH abundance information constrain scalar-induced gravitational waves?
summary: Primordial black hole (PBH) abundances and scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) probe the same primordial fluctuations through different physical weights. We examine the predictive power of precise synthetic information on absolute PBH abundances over a finite stellar-mass interval, together with an exact total abundance and external population bounds. For Gaussian perturbations under a fixed quantum chromodynamics (QCD) formation prescription, two smooth, symmetric lognormal spectra satisfy the same abundance conditions while producing nonproportional leading-order SIGW spectra. The two spectra differ by about 20% when averaged over the lower of two adjacent nanohertz windows but by nearly a factor of 60 in the higher-frequency window, so the difference cannot be represented by a single rescaling of the gravitational-wave background. Peak position and width compensate with amplitude in the abundance calculation, while the higher-frequency window draws almost all its energy from scalar-mode pairs with both wavenumbers above the primordial peak. Under the principal abundance benchmark, local finite-width components yield larger contrasts at a fixed nanohertz frequency through distinct mode couplings under both the QCD and stochastic peak-curvature formation prescriptions. For a separately generated population, extending mass information over most of its abundance restricts the lognormal peak-position and width compensation and reduces the higher-window contrast, while the unequal window responses persist. These results show why joint PBH-SIGW inference must propagate primordial shapes compatible with the PBH abundance information rather than assign one tensor template to a single abundance fit.

AI.tldr: 该文考察精确合成信息（有限质量区间的绝对丰度、总丰度及外部种群约束）对原初黑洞（primordial black hole, PBH）丰度预测的限定能力，指出满足同一丰度条件的不同对数正态（lognormal）功率谱可给出比例显著不同的标量诱导引力波（scalar-induced gravitational wave, SIGW）谱。
AI.motivation: PBH丰度与SIGW通过不同物理权重探测同一原初扰动，因此需检验丰度信息能否唯一确定原初谱形状，避免将单一张量模板套用于单一丰度拟合。
AI.method: 在固定量子色动力学（quantum chromodynamics, QCD）形成处方下，针对高斯扰动构造两个平滑对称的对数正态谱，使其满足相同的PBH丰度条件，并比较其领头阶SIGW谱及局部有限宽度成分；另对单独生成的种群扩展质量信息以检验约束效果。
AI.result: 两谱在较低纳赫兹（nanohertz）窗口平均差异约20%，而在较高频窗口接近60倍，无法用单一重标度描述；峰值位置与宽度在丰度计算中与振幅补偿，而高频窗口能量几乎全部来自两个波数均高于原初峰值的标量模式对。
AI.conclusion: 局部有限宽度成分在固定纳赫兹频率下产生更大对比；扩展质量信息可限制对数正态峰位与宽度的补偿并降低高频对比，但窗口响应不均仍存在。因此PBH-SIGW联合推断必须传播与PBH丰度信息相容的原初形状，而非将单一张量模板分配给单次丰度拟合。

title: Melting noncoplanar order on the square-kagome lattice: Chiral, flat-band, and staggered spin liquids from projective symmetry
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables, and Supplemental Material
summary: Noncoplanar magnetic orders carry a scalar spin chirality, and their melting by quantum fluctuations has been proposed as a route to chiral spin liquids. We ask what this route can produce on the square-kagome lattice, where couplings across the octagons stabilize noncoplanar cuboc and conical orders. We classify the fermionic spin liquids of this lattice by their projective symmetry groups, identify the symmetry class into which each noncoplanar order would melt, and compare candidate states with Gutzwiller-projected wave functions. A magnetic selection rule constrains the route: the chirality of every cuboc and conical order alternates in space, so a liquid that keeps the symmetry of its parent order has zero Chern number and no spontaneous thermal Hall response. A Chern state can descend only from uniformly chiral orders, and the regular ones we find need ferromagnetic bow-tie couplings. The energetics do not favor a chiral liquid either: among the projected wave functions we compare, a cuboc1-ordered state is lowest for strong cross-octagon couplings, and nonchiral states, a valence-bond crystal or a time-reversal-symmetric liquid, for weaker ones. The two inequivalent site orbits shape the spinons: a relative time-reversal sign between them pins flat bands to the Fermi level, and because the translations of $p4mm$ are not commutators, staggered chiral liquids exist, which are absent on sixfold-symmetric lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨方笼目晶格（square-kagome lattice）上非共面磁序（noncoplanar magnetic orders）量子熔化能否产生手性自旋液体（chiral spin liquids）。结论是：由于手性在空间交替的磁选择定则（magnetic selection rule），保持母序对称性的液体陈数为零、无热霍尔响应；陈态只能源于均匀手性序，且在能量上并不占优。
AI.motivation: 非共面磁序带有标量自旋手性（scalar spin chirality），其被量子涨落熔化为手性自旋液体是一条被提出的路径，作者追问该路径在方笼目晶格上究竟能产生什么结果。
AI.method: 按投影对称群（projective symmetry groups）对晶格的费米子自旋液体分类，确定各非共面序熔化后所属的对称类，并用Gutzwiller投影波函数（Gutzwiller-projected wave functions）比较候选态。
AI.result: 磁选择定则约束熔化路径：cuboc与锥形（conical）序的手性在空间交替，故继承母序对称性的液体陈数为零且无自发热霍尔响应；陈态仅能由均匀手性序下降而来，所找到的规则实例需铁磁领结（bow-tie）耦合。能量上，强跨八边形耦合时cuboc1有序态最低，较弱耦合时非手性态（价键晶体或时间反演对称液体）更低。
AI.conclusion: 两个不等价格点轨道塑造了自旋子（spinons）：二者间相对的time-reversal符号将平带钉在费米能级，且因p4mm的平移不是对易子，存在六重对称晶格上不存在的交错手性液体（staggered chiral liquids）。

title: A unifying view of averaging for wave-mean flow decomposition
comment: 45 pages, 9 figures. Submitted for peer review
summary: Geophysical flows are routinely decomposed into mean flow and waves, and the procedure used determines how the motion is divided between the two. Ideally, the wave and mean motions of interest evolve on distinct timescales, in which case they can be separated by taking an infinite-time average over all wave periods. Individual waves average away, while exactly resonant interactions contribute to the averaged dynamics because they are steady on the fast timescale. We generalize this averaging to finite windows, yielding a family of decompositions that additionally retain near-resonant interactions whose phases do not fully cancel over the time window. Such averaging necessarily invokes a choice of reference frame; the same flow averaged in two frames may yield mean flows differing by a drift. The averaging formulation developed here enables us to express Stokes drift through resonant and near-resonant interactions, confirming the intuition that it is a slow quantity generated by fast waves and revealing a coherent near-resonant contribution generally present in Stokes drift calculated over finite time from broadband wave fields. We use the fast-wave evolution underlying the exact average to define both the wave reference frame, in which the fast phase is steady, and a wave-frame average. We cast familiar Eulerian and Lagrangian averages and this wave-frame average in a common form to further illustrate how the chosen frame determines which motions enter the mean. This view of averaging provides a common basis for comparing decompositions and choosing among them according to the physical processes one seeks to isolate.

AI.tldr: 该文将地球物理流动的平均流—波分解推广到有限时间窗口平均，得到一类同时保留近共振相互作用的分解族；据此用共振与近共振相互作用表达斯托克斯漂移，并统一刻画欧拉、拉格朗日与波参考系平均。
AI.motivation: 传统上以无限时间平均分离平均流与波，但实际波场为宽带、平均窗口有限，近共振相互作用在有限窗口内相位不完全抵消而被丢失；同时平均必然依赖参考系选择，需厘清参考系如何决定哪些运动进入平均。
AI.method: 把对波周期的无限时间平均（infinite-time average）推广为有限窗口平均（finite-window averaging），构建一族分解；利用精确平均所依据的快波演化定义波参考系（wave reference frame）与波帧平均，并将欧拉平均、拉格朗日平均与该波帧平均写成统一形式。
AI.result: 同一流动在不同参考系中平均所得平均流可相差一个漂移（drift）；斯托克斯漂移（Stokes drift）可由共振与近共振相互作用表达，证实其为快波生成的慢量，并揭示宽带波场有限时间计算中存在相干的近共振贡献。各分解可据此统一比较。
AI.conclusion: 有限窗口平均为比较不同平均流—波分解提供共同基础，并支持按所需隔离的物理过程选择相应分解与参考系。

title: Cuscuton Fifth Force: Implications of Non-Dynamical Scalars for Structure Growth
summary: The cuscuton is a scalar field that obeys a constraint rather than an evolution equation, so it modifies gravity without adding a propagating scalar degree of freedom. We study the cosmology of effective cuscuton theory when matter is minimally coupled in the Jordan frame, and therefore conformally coupled to the cuscuton in the Einstein-frame. We derive the background and linear perturbation equations and show that the algebraic cuscuton response mediates a fifth force even though the scalar itself does not propagate. The same conformal factor also changes Einstein-frame particle masses and the friction of matter perturbations, tying the strength and sign of the force to the background evolution rather than to an independent coupling. We study a power-law family of models which contain both tracking solutions and sign-switching solutions; in the latter the effective cuscuton density runs from negative during matter domination to a positive, cosmological-constant-like value today. Using a modified version of CLASS, including the induced particle-mass dependence of recombination, we illustrate the corresponding changes to CMB temperature and linear matter power spectra for benchmark models, without fitting to data. In the strongest benchmarks the fifth force changes the effective gravitational coupling on sub-horizon scales by about one percent, smaller than the accompanying changes to the matter power spectrum and the acoustic scale. For the sign-switching solutions this change is negative over most of cosmic history, so a non-propagating field can weaken rather than strengthen gravitational attraction.

AI.tldr: 该文研究物质在Jordan框架中最小耦合、从而在Einstein框架中与cuscuton共形耦合时的有效cuscuton宇宙学。结果表明，即使标量场不传播，其代数响应仍会中介第五力，并伴随粒子质量与摩擦项的共形修正。
AI.motivation: cuscuton遵从约束而非演化方程，不引入传播的标量自由度却能修改引力；作者希望厘清物质最小耦合情形下有效cuscuton理论中第五力与共形耦合效应的来源及观测后果。
AI.method: 推导背景与线性扰动方程，分析代数cuscuton响应所中介的第五力；研究含tracking解与符号翻转解的幂律模型族，并用修改版CLASS（含复合时期粒子质量依赖）计算CMB温度谱与线性物质功率谱。
AI.result: 最强基准模型中，第五力使亚视界尺度有效引力耦合改变约1%，小于物质功率谱与声学尺度的相应变化；符号翻转解中该改变在大部分宇宙历史为负，即非传播场可削弱而非增强引力吸引。
AI.conclusion: 共形因子将第五力的强度与符号绑定于背景演化而非独立耦合参数；非传播的cuscuton可产生可观测但温和的宇宙学效应，且不拟合数据即可给出基准预言。

title: Excited-state-induced nonlinearity and polarity reversals in the thermocurrent through a quantum dot
summary: Quantum dots are electrically tuneable thermal machines capable of both energy harvesting and cooling at the nanoscale in the cryogenic regime. At large thermal biases, their thermoelectric transport shows a complex behaviour, including additional extrema and polarity reversals in the thermocurrent. Though these asymmetries and nonlinearities directly affect rectification and power conversion, their origin has not been studied systematically. We address this through measurements and modelling of a single GaAs/AlGaAs quantum dot whose source is heated by white-noise excitation. Using Pauli master equation for sequential tunnelling through a two-level dot, retaining the full Fermi distributions of both leads, distinct tunnel rates for the two levels, and relaxation between them, we show that the excited state acts as a second transport channel which competes with the ground-state contribution. Strong excited-state coupling combined with slow relaxation produces polarity reversals in the thermocurrent; without both, the excited state yields only additional extrema and an amplitude asymmetry across the charge degeneracy point. Experimentally, as the source temperature increases, an additional extremum emerges in the thermocurrent which develops into a polarity reversal. Using the excited-state level spacing and ground-state tunnel rate obtained independently from pulsed-gate and bias spectroscopies, the model reproduces the positions of the observed extrema and their amplitudes to within a factor of about three, placing the device in the regime of slow relaxation and strong excited-state coupling. Our results establish thermocurrent line-shape as a probe of excited-state tunnelling and relaxation in quantum dots. Excited states, often treated as a minor correction, can dominate quantum-dot thermoelectric transport far from equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合单GaAs/AlGaAs量子点（quantum dot）热源白噪声加热实验与Pauli主方程（Pauli master equation）建模，揭示激发态（excited state）作为第二条输运通道在强热偏置下主导热电输运，可产生热电流的极性反转（polarity reversal）。
AI.motivation: 量子点热电器件在大热偏置（thermal bias）下热电流（thermocurrent）呈现复杂行为，如额外极值（additional extrema）与极性反转，此前的非对称性与非线性（nonlinearities）来源未被系统研究，而这些效应对整流（rectification）与功率转换（power conversion）有直接影响。
AI.method: 对源极经白噪声激励加热的单GaAs/AlGaAs量子点开展测量；采用包含完整费米分布（Fermi distributions）、两能级不同隧穿速率（tunnel rates）及能级间弛豫（relaxation）的Pauli主方程描述顺序隧穿（sequential tunnelling）；激发态能级间距与基态隧穿速率由脉冲栅极（pulsed-gate）与偏置谱学（bias spectroscopies）独立获得。
AI.result: 激发态通道与基态贡献竞争：强激发态耦合（excited-state coupling）结合慢弛豫导致热电流极性反转，二者不具备时仅出现额外极值与跨电荷简并点（charge degeneracy point）的振幅非对称。实验上随源极温度升高，热电流中出现额外极值并发展为极性反转；模型复现极值位置与振幅，偏差约在三倍因子内，表明器件处于慢弛豫与强激发态耦合区。
AI.conclusion: 热电流线型（thermocurrent line-shape）可作为探测量子点中激发态隧穿与弛豫的手段；常被视为次要修正的激发态，在远离平衡（far from equilibrium）条件下可主导量子点热电输运。

title: Cosmological rigidity via $p$-harmonic temporal functions
summary: We prove a splitting theorem for cosmological spacetimes which admit a globally $p$-harmonic Cauchy temporal function for some $p < 1$, without making any use of timelike lines. In Bartnik's context of cosmological and timelike geodesically complete spacetimes, we establish a Liouville-type unboundedness result which shows that globally $p$-harmonic temporal functions, $p < 1$, are necessarily Cauchy temporal. Moreover, using the theory of elliptic PDEs, we show that locally Lipschitz $p$-harmonic temporal functions with $p < 1$ are in fact smooth. Altogether, our work reduces the resolution of Bartnik's cosmological splitting conjecture to the global weak solvability of the $p$-d'Alembert equation for some $p < 1$ in the class of locally Lipschitz temporal functions.

AI.tldr: 本文在宇宙时空（cosmological spacetimes）中，对满足 $p<1$ 的全局 $p$-调和 Cauchy 时间函数（globally $p$-harmonic Cauchy temporal function）证明了分裂定理（splitting theorem），并借此把 Bartnik 宇宙分裂猜想（Bartnik's cosmological splitting conjecture）归结为 $p$-d'Alembert 方程的全局弱可解性问题。
AI.motivation: 经典分裂定理通常依赖类时线（timelike lines）这一工具，而作者希望在宇宙时空框架下避开类时线的使用来获得分裂结论，并推进 Bartnik 宇宙分裂猜想的解决。
AI.method: 采用全局 $p$-调和时间函数（$p<1$）作为核心工具，并结合 Bartnik 的宇宙且类时测地完备（timelike geodesically complete）设定，运用椭圆型偏微分方程（elliptic PDEs）理论进行分析。
AI.result: 证明了：（1）不依赖类时线的分裂定理；（2）Liouville 型无界性结果，表明 $p<1$ 的全局 $p$-调和时间函数必为 Cauchy 时间函数；（3）局部 Lipschitz 的 $p<1$ 调和时间函数实际上光滑（smooth）。
AI.conclusion: 研究将 Bartnik 宇宙分裂猜想的解决归结为：在局部 Lipschitz 时间函数类中，对某个 $p<1$ 的 $p$-d'Alembert 方程是否存在全局弱解（global weak solvability）的问题。

title: Active Jarzynski and Crooks Relations for Driven Jump-Diffusions
summary: Non-conservative active driving breaks detailed balance in non-Gaussian jump-diffusions, obscuring the connection between external protocol work, housekeeping dissipation, and free-energy differences. Here, we establish exact finite-time fluctuation relations for driven Markov jump-diffusions---encompassing infinite-activity Lévy processes---by comparing path probabilities under the forward and current-reversed dual dynamics relative to the instantaneous steady state (ISS). We derive a trajectory-level decomposition of total entropy production that cleanly separates transient state relaxation, housekeeping heat, and external protocol driving. When the ISS takes a Gibbsian form, gauge-tilting the dual path measure yields an Active Jarzynski equality, $\langle\exp[-(W+Δs_{\mathrm{act}})]\rangle_{π_0}=e^{-ΔF}$, which incorporates active housekeeping entropy $Δs_{\mathrm{act}}$ alongside mechanical work $W$ and coexists with the conventional Jarzynski equality. Under protocol reversal, this dual framework further reveals an Active Crooks relation, where the asymmetry between forward and reverse work distributions is governed by the conditional exponential average of active dissipation. Our results provide a framework for recovering free-energy differences in driven jump-diffusions with Gibbsian instantaneous steady states and for characterizing active irreversibility through trajectory statistics.

AI.tldr: 该文为含非保守主动驱动的马尔可夫跳跃-扩散（Markov jump-diffusion）建立了精确的有限时间涨落关系（fluctuation relations），并给出主动型 Jarzynski 等式与主动型 Crooks 关系。
AI.motivation: 非保守主动驱动（non-conservative active driving）使非高斯跳跃-扩散违反细致平衡（detailed balance），从而模糊了外部协议功、持家耗散（housekeeping dissipation）与自由能差之间的联系。
AI.method: 通过比较在瞬时稳态（instantaneous steady state, ISS）参照下前向与电流反演对偶动力学（current-reversed dual dynamics）的路径概率，推导精确有限时间涨落关系，并给出总熵产（total entropy production）的轨迹级分解。
AI.result: 得到可清晰分离瞬态弛豫、持家热（housekeeping heat）与外部协议驱动的熵产分解；当 ISS 呈吉布斯形式（Gibbsian form）时，对偶路径测度经规范倾斜（gauge-tilting）给出主动 Jarzynski 等式 ⟨exp[-(W+Δs_act)]⟩=e^{-ΔF}，并在协议反演下给出主动 Crooks 关系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可用于在具有吉布斯型瞬时稳态的受驱跳跃-扩散中恢复自由能差，并通过轨迹统计刻画主动不可逆性（active irreversibility）。

title: Quantum Recovery from Black-Hole Radiation Beyond the Emission Yield
summary: A proposed resolution of the black-hole information paradox must explain which information an outside observer can recover from escaping radiation\cite{Hawking,Page,Hayden,Almheiri}. Environmental memory can return correlations to the source without delivering them to that observer\cite{ChenQi,ChenMemory}. Here we establish a sharp recovery frontier at fixed mean radiation yield for single-excitation channels and realize its qubit limit with an autonomous quantum-memory emitter. Unequal transmissions balance retained coherence against information in failed collection events. A reference--radiation correlation test distinguishes this gain even when the mean collected energy is unchanged. Identical transmission channels instead give the same recovery at matched collection, regardless of their emission timescales. For a broader class of interacting sources, an ordering of collected and inaccessible coupling spectra forbids unassisted quantum transmission irrespective of internal memory. A separate coding example supports a positive rate where uniform transmission at matched actual yield has zero capacity. Together, these results identify what openness must change to assist recovery: the accessible transmission structure. They supply a physically constrained comparison of evaporation mechanisms, separating information delivered to radiation from coherence retained elsewhere or an increase in the collected output.

AI.tldr: 该文在固定平均辐射产额下为单激发通道建立了“恢复前沿”（recovery frontier），并用自主量子存储发射器（autonomous quantum-memory emitter）实现其量子比特极限；结论指认“可访问传输结构”是开放性辅助信息恢复的关键变量。
AI.motivation: 黑洞信息悖论（black-hole information paradox）的解决方案须说明外部观察者能从逃逸辐射中回收哪些信息；既有观点指出环境记忆（environmental memory）可把关联返还给源而不送达观察者，故需刻画在何种传输结构下外部观察者才能获益。
AI.method: 在固定平均辐射产额下针对单激发通道（single-excitation channels）推导恢复前沿，并以自主量子存储发射器实现其量子比特极限；采用不等透射率（unequal transmissions）权衡保留相干性与失败收集事件所含信息，借助参考—辐射关联检验（reference–radiation correlation test）区分增益，并对更广泛的相互作用源给出收集谱与不可访问耦合谱的排序判据。
AI.result: 不等透射可使恢复增益在平均收集能量不变时仍被关联检验识别；相同透射通道在匹配收集下给出相同恢复，与发射时间尺度无关；对更广泛相互作用源，收集谱与不可访问耦合谱的特定排序在无辅助条件下禁止量子传输，与内部记忆无关；另一编码示例表明在匹配实际产额时，均匀透射容量为零而可正速率传输。
AI.conclusion: 开放性（openness）必须改变可访问传输结构才能辅助信息恢复；结果为蒸发机制提供受物理约束的比较框架，将“送达辐射的信息”与“保留于他处的相干性”及“收集产出的增加”明确区分。

authors: J. Pacheco B. C. de melo
title: Behavior of the zero modes in the Light-front for pseudo scalar particles: pion case
summary:
Light-front Quantum Field Theory (LFQFT) stands as an
  optimal framework for
  delving into the intricate substructure of hadronic
  bound states. In this study, we employ a
  Light-Front Constituent Quark Model (LFCQM)
  to investigate the pion's internal structure. This model has previously
  demonstrated significant success in describing the properties of pseudoscalar mesons.
  A crucial consideration within the light-front formalism is the dependence on the
  chosen reference frame, stemming from the explicit breaking of covariance. Herein, we meticulously
  analyze the
  contribution of zero modes to the pion's electromagnetic current.
  Subsequently, we explore the impact of these zero modes on observable quantities,
  including electromagnetic form factors, the pion's electromagnetic radius,
  and its weak decay constant, $f_π$.
  Furthermore, we comprehensively investigate the behavior of zero modes and their
  dependence on both the momentum transfer, $Q^2$, and the model's intrinsic parameters,
  such as constituent quark masses ($m_{(q,\bar{q})}$) and the regulator mass ($m_R$).
  Our findings reveal
  a substantial dependence of light-front zero modes on the specific frame employed
  for the calculation of the electromagnetic current. Interestingly, we observe
  that the maximal contribution of the zero mode occurs at a specific
  four-momentum transfer, denoted as $Q^2 = -q^2 = q_Z^{2(Max.)}$.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用光前组分夸克模型（Light-Front Constituent Quark Model, LFCQM）分析π介子内部结构，重点考察零模（zero modes）对电磁流及有关可观测量的贡献，并揭示其强烈的参考系依赖性。
AI.motivation: 光前量子场论（Light-Front Quantum Field Theory, LFQFT）是研究强子束缚态亚结构的理想框架，但光前形式因协变性（covariance）的显式破缺而依赖于所选参考系；零模对此的贡献需要细致厘清。
AI.method: 在LFCQM框架下，系统分析零模对π介子电磁流（electromagnetic current）的贡献，并考察其对电磁形状因子（electromagnetic form factors）、π介子电磁半径及弱衰变常数（$f_\pi$）的影响；同时研究零模对动量转移$Q^2$及模型内禀参数（组分夸克质量$m_{(q,\bar{q})}$、调节子质量$m_R$）的依赖。
AI.result: 光前零模显著依赖于计算电磁流时所采用的具体参考系；零模的最大贡献出现在特定的四维动量转移处，即$Q^2 = -q^2 = q_Z^{2(\text{Max.})}$。
AI.conclusion: 零模是光前形式下π介子电磁性质计算中不可忽视的成分，其参考系依赖性提示在LFCQM中处理可观测量时须谨慎对待协变性破缺带来的效应。

title: Anomalous response, re-emerging localization-transition and robust corner sates in self-similar peano fractal
summary: Anomalous spectral response from the non-interacting electrons on a peano fractal is recorded within tight-binding framework. It is observed that a minimal off-diagonal anisotropy can modulate the transport characteristics of the lattice. Drastic modification in the nature of the eigenstates has been validated through the workout of level spacing statistics. Further, a two-dimensional quasiperiodic Aubry-André and Harper variation in the overlap integral can invite re-entrant localization-delocalization transition for the self-similar model. This is associated with the possible existence of single-particle mobility edge in the energy landscape. Our results are corroborated by the evaluation of inverse participation ratio, fractal dimension and quantum dynamical response. The spectrum is shown to formulate a quantum butterfly pattern with the frequency of the modulation. Chiral symmetry protected edge states are found to be insensitive with respect to moderate diagonal disorder.

AI.tldr: 在紧束缚框架下研究Peano分形上无相互作用电子的反常谱响应：微小非对角各向异性可调控输运性质，二维准周期调制可诱导重入局域-离域转变并可能存在迁移率边。
AI.motivation: 探究分形晶格（fractal lattice）上无相互作用电子（non-interacting electrons）的谱与输运特性，特别是非对角各向异性（off-diagonal anisotropy）及准周期调制对自相似模型中本征态性质与输运行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚框架（tight-binding framework）在Peano分形上建模；通过能级间距统计（level spacing statistics）判定本征态性质；引入二维准周期Aubry-André与Harper型交叠积分（overlap integral）调制；并结合逆参与率（inverse participation ratio）、分形维数（fractal dimension）与量子动力学响应（quantum dynamical response）进行验证。
AI.result: 最小的非对角各向异性即可显著调制晶格输运特性，并剧烈改变本征态性质；准周期调制可引发重入局域-离域转变（re-entrant localization-delocalization transition），并关联单粒子迁移率边（mobility edge）的可能存在；谱随调制频率形成量子蝴蝶图案（quantum butterfly pattern）；手性对称保护边缘态（chiral symmetry protected edge states）对中等对角无序（diagonal disorder）不敏感。
AI.conclusion: Peano分形上的无相互作用电子呈现由非对角各向异性与准周期调制共同调控的丰富局域化物理，多种独立判据（能级统计、IPR、分形维数、动力学响应）相互印证，并提示迁移率边与手性保护边缘态的存在。

title: Free energy of 2-spin spherical vector spin glasses
summary: We compute the limit of free energy of 2-spin spherical vector spin glasses with possibly non-convex interaction and couplings satisfying a finite fourth-moment assumption. The couplings need not be Gaussian. The limit is given by a logarithmic-determinant variational formula, equivalently by a finite-dimensional matrix Dyson equation, and its zero-temperature limit yields the ground-state energy. The limiting formulas depend only on the covariance of the couplings. We also study fluctuations: at an interior minimizer, an explicit variance bound transfers the limiting law of a logarithmic linear statistic to the free energy. For Gaussian couplings, this yields Gaussian fluctuations. At a boundary minimizer, assuming a simple regular edge with GOE Tracy-Widom fluctuations and a one-edge reduction, we transfer the edge fluctuations to the free energy.

AI.tldr: 本文在仅假设耦合四阶矩有限、无需高斯耦合且允许非凸相互作用的条件下，推导出 2-spin 球面向量自旋玻璃（spherical vector spin glasses）自由能极限，并研究其涨落。
AI.motivation: 现有自由能极限结果多依赖高斯耦合或凸性假设；本文旨在放宽至有限四阶矩（finite fourth-moment assumption）的一般耦合，并同时刻画极限公式及其涨落行为。
AI.method: 自由能极限由对数行列式变分公式（logarithmic-determinant variational formula）给出，等价于有限维矩阵 Dyson 方程；零温极限给出基态能量。涨落方面：在内点极小处用显式方差界把对数线性统计量的极限律转移到自由能；在边界极小处借助简单正则边缘、GOE Tracy-Widom 涨落与单边约化（one-edge reduction）转移边缘涨落。
AI.result: 极限公式仅依赖耦合的协方差（covariance）；零温极限给出基态能量。内点情形下，高斯耦合时自由能呈高斯涨落；边界情形下，在正则边缘假设下将 GOE Tracy-Widom 边缘涨落转移至自由能。
AI.conclusion: 结果将球面向量自旋玻璃自由能的极限与涨落刻画推广到非高斯、四阶矩有限的耦合，并表明极限仅由协方差决定。

title: Comment on "Zero temperature, degenerate fermion stars" [S. Boatto, M.B. Paranjape, V. Pessanha, C.A.D. Zarro. ArXiv: 2609.20950]
summary: In contrast to S. Boatto et al. \cite{Boat}, the degree of compactification or compactness is clarified for the self-gravitating spheric star of fermionic matter.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自引力费米子球状恒星（self-gravitating spheric star of fermionic matter），在区别于 S. Boatto 等人工作的框架下，厘清其致密化程度或致密度（degree of compactification or compactness）的界定问题。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出现有研究（S. Boatto 等）中对该类自引力费米子物质的致密度概念尚不明确，因而需要加以澄清与修正。
AI.method: 摘要未给出具体方法细节，仅表明采用与 S. Boatto 等人不同的处理方式，对致密度（compactness）的定义或计算加以明确化。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅说明已对费米子物质自引力球状恒星的致密化程度作出澄清。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了自引力费米子球状恒星中致密度概念的明确表述，为后续与 Boatto 等工作的对比提供依据；更具体的结论需参考全文。

title: Leaving Quantum Bias on the Table: Pushforwards as a Path to Quantum Advantage in Constrained Optimization
summary: Constrained quantum samplers often produce infeasible outputs that retain information about good feasible solutions. We develop a post-measurement framework that constructs problem-dependent classical feasibility maps from constraint-violation statistics and pushes the raw quantum sampling law forward onto the feasible set. The probability of each repaired solution is the total raw mass of its repair preimage, enlarging the successful sampling event from a target feasible set to its full repair preimage. We derive exact identities for repaired success and expected cost, and separate repair-basin geometry from sampler-dependent probability concentration. For noisy implementations, we distinguish leakage from the encoded subspace from concentration loss within it. For permutation constraints, Hungarian maximum-overlap repair provides an O(n^3) implementation, which we study on traveling-salesman problems (TSP). We derive conditional repaired-success bounds and quantify how basin aggregation reduces the absolute-transfer budget required by these bounds. Noiseless simulations show that optimal repair basins contain selectively overweighted infeasible contributors. For an n=10 TSP instance, pushforward repair recovered the optimum using approximately 10^3 shots, compared with 10^6 shots in the original CE-QAOA workflow without repair. On a 127-qubit IBM processor, using encodings of up to 100 qubits, repaired candidates match reference tours on smaller benchmarks and improve them on larger instances. These results establish concentration of quantum probability on useful repair preimages as a design principle for constrained quantum optimization.

AI.tldr: 该文提出测量后（post-measurement）修复框架：由约束违反统计构造问题相关的经典可行映射（feasibility map），将量子采样分布前推（pushforward）到可行集，从而把成功采样事件从目标可行集扩大到其完整修复原像（repair preimage）。在TSP上，n=10实例用约10^3次采样即恢复最优，而原CE-QAOA无修复流程需10^6次。
AI.motivation: 受约束量子采样器（constrained quantum samplers）常输出不可行解，但这些解仍携带关于优质可行解的信息；现有流程缺乏利用此类信息的系统性手段，导致采样效率低。
AI.method: 基于约束违反统计构建问题相关的经典可行性映射，并把原始量子采样律前推至可行集，使每个修复解的概率等于其修复原像的总概率质量；推导修复成功率与期望代价的精确恒等式，区分修复盆地几何与采样器相关的概率集中；对含噪实现区分子空间泄漏与子空间内集中度损失；对置换约束采用匈牙利最大重叠修复（Hungarian maximum-overlap repair），复杂度O(n^3)。
AI.result: 给出条件修复成功界并量化盆地聚合如何降低所需绝对转移预算；无噪声模拟显示最优修复盆地含有选择性超权重的不可行贡献者；n=10 TSP约10^3次采样恢复最优（对比无修复CE-QAOA的10^6次）；127量子比特IBM处理器上（编码达100量子比特），较小基准与参考路径一致、较大实例上有所改进。
AI.conclusion: 量子概率在有用修复原像上的集中（concentration of quantum probability on useful repair preimages）可作为受约束量子优化（constrained quantum optimization）的设计原则。

title: Detection times are not local observables in quantum field theory
summary: Detection times are routinely recorded in quantum experiments. We show that, under natural covariance and consistency requirements, the observables describing these times cannot be algebraically localized in any bounded spacetime region, even when the records themselves are localized. This challenges the identification of algebraic localization with the physical localization of measurements and shows why microcausality alone does not establish non-signalling for measurements in quantum field theory.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，在自然协变性与一致性要求下，描述量子实验中“探测时间”的观测量无法在代数上定域于任何有界时空区域，即使记录本身是定域的。这一结果质疑了代数定域性与测量物理定域性的等同，并说明仅凭微观因果性（microcausality）不足以在量子场论（quantum field theory）中确立测量过程的非信号性（non-signalling）。
AI.motivation: 动机：探测时间在量子实验中普遍被记录，但其对应观测量的定域性质缺乏明确刻画；既有讨论常把代数定域性（algebraic localization）直接视为测量的物理定域性，作者意在检验该等同是否成立。
AI.method: 方法：以自然的协变性（covariance）与一致性（consistency）要求为出发点，对描述探测时间的观测量进行代数分析，考察其能否定域于有界时空区域。
AI.result: 结果：证明此类时间观测量即使在记录定域的情形下，也无法代数定域于任意有界时空区域（bounded spacetime region）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：代数定域性不等同于测量的物理定域性；微观因果性（microcausality）单独无法推出量子场论中测量具有非信号性。

title: Phase-Tunable Liouvillian Topology: Dual Winding Structures and Skin Effects
summary: Liouvillian skin effects are usually associated with dissipation whose rates favor unidirectional flow. In this work, we show that directional edge localization can emerge even when population exchange between sites is exactly balanced, with a single tunable phase parameter $α$ deciding their direction and a dual winding structure deciding their nature. Although this number-conserving bath is known for eigenstate selection, we demonstrate here that its phase controls a steady current, which Hamiltonian hopping converts to directional edge localization. Further, we study the spectral winding structure by independently twisting the left (ket) and right (bra) vector indices of the density matrix, revealing two distinct windings whose relationship is dictated by an antiunitary mirror symmetry. Nearest-neighbor jump operators break this symmetry: both windings coincide, giving rise to a common spectral winding $W_0(α)=\pm1$, producing a unipolar skin effect in which the density accumulates at a specific edge. However, next nearest neighbor jump preserve it. The two windings are forced to be opposite, and the ket and bra are pushed to opposite edges, giving a bipolar skin effect of coherences present in eigenmodes, without edge localization of the density in the steady state. Remarkably, in a dimerized chain the phase-controlled density skin effect gives the steady-state zero modes a size-independent weight at the skin edge, accompanied by a kink at the topological transition. In addition, the relaxation time grows linearly with the system size, however at specific phases $α$ where the jump operators are rendered Hermitian, edge-localized eigenmodes with skin character coexist with diffusive relaxation.

AI.tldr: 在粒子交换完全平衡（无净耗散偏好）的耗散浴中，仍可通过单一可调相位 α 产生方向性边缘局域（edge localization）：跳跃算符的近邻性决定谱绕数（spectral winding）结构的异同，进而区分单极与双极趋肤效应（skin effect）。
AI.motivation: Liouvillian 趋肤效应通常被认为源于偏好单向流动的耗散速率。本文旨在表明，即使位点间布居交换严格平衡，方向性边缘局域仍可出现，从而拓展对非厄米趋肤效应起源的认识。
AI.method: 以保数目浴（number-conserving bath）为对象，引入单个可调相位参数 α；分别独立扭曲密度矩阵左（ket）与右（bra）矢量的指标以研究谱绕结构，并结合反幺正镜像对称（antiunitary mirror symmetry）分析两类绕数的关系；对比近邻与次近邻跳跃算符（jump operators）的影响。
AI.result: 近邻跳跃算符破坏镜像对称，使两种绕数重合为 W_0(α)=±1，产生密度向特定边缘累积的单极趋肤效应；次近邻跳跃保持该对称，两绕数相反，ket 与 bra 被推向相反边缘，形成本征模相干的双眼趋肤效应（bipolar skin effect），而稳态密度不出现边缘局域。在二聚化链（dimerized chain）中，相位控制的密度趋肤效应使稳态零模在趋肤边缘具有与尺寸无关的权重，并在拓扑转变处出现扭结。此外，弛豫时间随系统尺寸线性增长，但在跳跃算符退化为厄米（Hermitian）的特定相位 α 处，具趋肤特征的边缘局域本征模与扩散型弛豫共存。
AI.conclusion: 趋肤效应的方向与本征性质可由相位 α 与谱绕数结构分别控制，并不必然依赖耗散的单向性；跳跃算符范围与对称性是选择单极/双极趋肤效应及相应弛豫行为的关键。

title: Biunital Lie Semiheaps and Lie Triple Systems
summary: We examine the differential geometry of Lie semiheaps that admit biunital elements. Open Ol'shanskii semigroups, which appear widely across causal geometry and harmonic analysis, provide a large class of examples. It is shown that the subset of biunits is a smoothly embedded Lie subheap. Moreover, there is a canonical Lie triple algebroid associated with any proper biunital Lie semiheap. That is, there is a vector bundle over the manifold of biunits that comes equipped with a ternary bracket that satisfies the axioms of a Lie triple system together with a compatible `higher' anchor map. Although every Lie triple algebroid associated with a proper biunital Lie semiheap is trivialisable, it is not canonically so, unlike the case of the tangent bundle of a Lie group. As concrete examples, we examine the Lie semiheap of real $n\times n$ matrices, and the conformal causal Lie semiheap associated with the Lie group $\mathrm{SU}(2,2)$, which is a double cover of the conformal group of Minkowski spacetime, and the future-directed light cone.

AI.tldr: 论文研究容许双单位元（biunital elements）的李半堆（Lie semiheaps）的微分几何，证明双单位元集合构成光滑嵌入的李子半堆，并构造了与之相伴的典范李三重代数胚（Lie triple algebroid）。
AI.motivation: 开 Ol'shanskii 半群（open Ol'shanskii semigroups）在因果几何（causal geometry）与调和分析（harmonic analysis）中广泛出现，可作为李半堆的重要实例来源，因此有必要系统刻画此类结构的微分几何性质。
AI.method: 以容许双单位元的李半堆为对象，考察其双单位元子集的光滑嵌入性，并在真（proper）双单位李半堆上构造向量丛，赋予满足李三重系统（Lie triple system）公理的三元括号及相容的“高阶”锚映射（anchor map）。
AI.result: 双单位元子集是光滑嵌入的李子半堆；任意真双单位李半堆均伴随一个典范李三重代数胚。该代数胚虽可平凡化，但不存在典范平凡化，这与李群切丛的情形不同。
AI.conclusion: 给出具体实例：实数 n×n 矩阵构成的李半堆，以及与李群 SU(2,2)（闵可夫斯基时空共形群的双重覆盖）及未来指向光锥相关联的共形因果李半堆。

title: The nucleon is not a hard sphere: screening fifth forces with Skyrmions
summary: Laboratory searches for chameleon and symmetron fifth forces increasingly rely on individual nucleons as sources or probes, but model them as uniform spheres. Motivated by the Skyrme picture, we instead consider a nucleon profile with a constant-density core and an $r^{-6}$ pion tail, together with its exponential truncation at the physical pion mass. We derive analytic screening charges for the uniform sphere and the $r^{-6}$ profile, and extend the comparison to the exponential truncation at the physical pion mass using numerical solutions. Because the outer tail is too dilute to be screened at any coupling strength, the $r^{-6}$ tail produces a power-law enhancement over the sphere charge in strong screening, and the exponential tail has a weaker, logarithmic enhancement. Propagating this difference through the published analyses, nucleon-sourced exclusion regions extend systematically further into the strongly coupled regime. For example, symmetron constraints from neutron interferometry at $μ=1\,\mathrm{keV}$ reach maximal self-couplings about $1.4$ orders of magnitude higher than for a uniform-sphere neutron ($3.0$ orders of magnitude in the chiral limit),and at the dark-energy scale the hydrogen $1s$--$2s$ chameleon bound reaches couplings $1.8$ orders of magnitude weaker than for a uniform-sphere proton ($2.4$ in the chiral limit), overtaking the muonium bound.

AI.tldr: 将核子建模为具有常数密度核心与 $r^{-6}$ 介子尾的轮廓（而非均匀球），会显著改变变色龙（chameleon）与对称子（symmetron）第五力的屏蔽电荷，从而使强耦合区的排除界限系统性外推。
AI.motivation: 现有实验室第五力搜寻多以单个核子作为源或探针，却将其简化为均匀球；受 Skyrme 图像启发，需考察更真实的核子密度轮廓对屏蔽效应与实验约束的影响。
AI.method: 采用常数密度核心加 $r^{-6}$ 介子尾（pion tail）的核子轮廓，并考虑其在物理介子质量处的指数截断（exponential truncation）；对均匀球与 $r^{-6}$ 轮廓解析推导屏蔽电荷（screening charge），指数截断情形则用数值解扩展比较。
AI.result: 外层尾部过于稀薄以致在任何耦合强度下都无法被屏蔽：$r^{-6}$ 尾部在强屏蔽（strong screening）下相对球电荷产生幂律增强，指数尾部仅给出较弱的对数增强。代入已发表分析后，以核子为源的排除区系统性延伸至更强耦合区，例如 $\\mu=1\\,\\mathrm{keV}$ 时中子干涉的对称子约束达到的最大自耦合比均匀球中子高约 1.4 个量级（手征极限（chiral limit）下为 3.0 个量级）；在暗能量标度下，氢 $1s$--$2s$ 变色龙界限比均匀球质子弱 1.8 个量级（手征极限下 2.4 个量级），并超过 μ 子素（muonium）界限。
AI.conclusion: 核子内部结构的稀薄尾部会削弱屏蔽、增强有效第五力效应，均匀球近似在强耦合区不可靠；基于核子的实验室约束需采用更真实的核子轮廓重新评估。

title: Heavy quark thermalization using phonon-heavy quark EFT
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, Proceedings to 22nd Strangeness in Quark Matter
summary:
The description of heavy quarks inside the QGP medium, especially at low momenta, remains challenging from first principles, due to large coupling strength and gluon occupation numbers. An alternative way to formulate a description in terms of perturbative degrees of freedom is the interaction of the heavy quarks with the collective excitations of the medium in the form of phonons. This description is derived as an effective field theory (EFT) and therefore allows for a natural occurring power counting of the allowed interactions. This EFT has already been established in our previous work, where we have derived the phonon-heavy quark interactions and calculated their thermal scattering cross section.
  In this work, we use these results, together with the heavy quark expansion, to calculate the heavy quark drag coefficient. Subsequently, we compare our results with the drag coefficient obtained from AdS/CFT calculations to determine the previously unknown Wilson coefficients for the quark-phonon coupling. Finally, we will use these coefficients to solve the Boltzmann equation for the heavy quark distribution, studying its thermalization in the QGP via soft phonon interactions.

AI.tldr: 基于已建立的有效场论（effective field theory, EFT），在重夸克展开（heavy quark expansion）下计算重夸克拖曳系数（drag coefficient），并借助与AdS/CFT结果的对比确定未知的威尔逊系数（Wilson coefficients），进而求解玻尔兹曼方程（Boltzmann equation）研究重夸克在QGP中的热化（thermalization）。
AI.motivation: 夸克胶子等离子体（QGP）中重夸克（heavy quarks）的低动量描述因耦合强度大、胶子占据数高而难以从第一性原理（first principles）直接处理，需要以微扰自由度（perturbative degrees of freedom）重新表述的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用重夸克与介质集体激发（声子, phonons）相互作用的有效场论框架，利用先前工作导出的声子-重夸克相互作用及热散射截面（thermal scattering cross section），结合重夸克展开计算拖曳系数；再通过与AdS/CFT结果的对比标定威尔逊系数，并用其求解重夸克分布的玻尔兹曼方程。
AI.result: 得到重夸克拖曳系数的计算结果，并确定此前未知的夸克-声子耦合威尔逊系数；据此求解玻尔兹曼方程，刻画重夸克分布经软声子相互作用（soft phonon interactions）在QGP中的热化行为。
AI.conclusion: 声子型有效场论为QGP中重夸克动力学提供了具自然幂次计数（power counting）的可算框架，借助AdS/CFT标定耦合后可定量研究重夸克的热化过程。

title: Direct imaging of the Ni $e_g$ hole orbitals in the bilayer nickelate La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$
summary: Models of unconventional superconductivity in cuprates and nickelates depend sensitively on the distribution of valence electrons among the $d$ orbitals. But accurately determining the orbital electron or hole occupations in these systems remains a difficult and unresolved task. Here, using $s$-core-level non-resonant inelastic x-ray scattering at the Ni $M_1$ edge, we determine the angular distribution of the Ni $3d$ holes in a single crystal of La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$. Our results demonstrate that the hole occupation ratio $\hz/\hx = 0.94\pm0.06$, thus significantly above the expected value of $2/3$ for a filled $d_{z^2}$ orbitals models and close to value expected in a Hund's-coupling picture. Our results support superconductivity scenarios in which both $e_g$ orbitals contribute to the electron-pairing mechanism in La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$.

AI.tldr: 利用 Ni M₁ 边 s 芯能级非共振非弹性 X 射线散射测定 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 中 Ni 3d 空穴的角分布，得到空穴占据比 h_z²/h_x² = 0.94±0.06，显著高于满 d_z² 模型的 2/3，支持双 e_g 轨道参与配对的超导图像。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物（cuprates）与镍氧化物（nickelates）中非常规超导（unconventional superconductivity）模型对价电子在各 d 轨道间的分布高度敏感，但准确测定轨道电子或空穴占据仍是困难且未解决的问题。
AI.method: 采用 Ni M₁ 边的 s 芯能级非共振非弹性 X 射线散射（s-core-level non-resonant inelastic x-ray scattering），测定 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 单晶中 Ni 3d 空穴的角分布。
AI.result: 测得空穴占据比 h_z²/h_x² = 0.94±0.06，明显高于满 d_z² 轨道模型预期的 2/3，并接近洪德耦合（Hund's-coupling）图像所预期的数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 中两个 e_g 轨道均参与电子配对机制（electron-pairing mechanism）的超导情形。

title: SAWs, trails, kites, patterns
summary: A self-avoiding walk (SAW) on a vertex-transitive graph $G$ is a path that visits no vertex more than once; a trail is a path that traverses no edge more than once. The number of $n$-step self-avoiding walks (respectively, trails) starting at a given vertex has order $μ(G)^n$ (respectively, $μ_{\text{T}}(G)^n$), where $μ(G)$ is called the connective constant and $μ_{\text{T}}(G)$ is the trail constant. It is immediate that $μ=μ_{\text{T}}$ if $G$ either has degree $3$ or less, or is a tree. We prove a necessary and sufficient condition for the strict inequality $μ< μ_{\text{T}}$ if $G$ has degree $4$ or more and is not a tree, and in addition $G$ possesses a so-called height function. This condition is satisfied whenever the height function is transitive. The core of the proof is a pattern theorem for graphs possessing height functions, and this is achieved using an unpublished argument for ${\Bbb Z}^d$ by Hammersley, reported by Janse van Rensburg et al. (J. Stat. Phys. 85, 1996, 103--130). Some ancillary results are included concerning SAWs on the line graph of $G$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究顶点传递图（vertex-transitive graph）上自避游走（self-avoiding walk, SAW）的连通常数（connective constant）μ(G) 与迹常数（trail constant）μ_T(G) 之间的关系，给出度≥4且非树、并具有高度函数（height function）的图上严格不等式 μ<μ_T 的充要条件。
AI.motivation: 当图的度不超过3或图为树时，μ=μ_T 是显然的；但对于度≥4的非树图，两者何时严格不等缺乏刻画，论文旨在填补这一判据空白。
AI.method: 核心是证明一类具有高度函数的图的模式定理（pattern theorem），该证明借助 Hammersley 关于 Z^d 的未发表论证（经 Janse van Rensburg 等人报道），并据此导出 μ<μ_T 的充要条件，同时附带讨论 G 的线图（line graph）上 SAW 的若干辅助结果。
AI.result: 得到度≥4、非树且具有高度函数的图上 μ<μ_T 的充要条件；当高度函数是传递的（transitive）时，该条件自动满足。
AI.conclusion: 严格不等式 μ<μ_T 可由高度函数的传递性保证，模式定理是连接局部图结构与常数比较的关键工具；此外论文给出了线图上 SAW 的若干附带结论。

title: Beyond-RTA magnetoconductivity of multifold semimetals under generic orientations of electromagnetic fields
summary: We present an exact solution of the linearised semiclassical Boltzmann equation (SBE) beyond the relaxation-time approximation for multifold semimetals under arbitrarily oriented electric and magnetic fields. The framework treats the Berry curvature, orbital magnetic moment, Lorentz-force operator, and scattering terms on equal footing. Momentum-independent scattering-amplitudes couple the Fermi-surface sheets through intranode, interband, and internode processes. The scattering kernel has a finite rank and the SBE reduces to a linear system for a few moments, which is closed by the electron-number constraint. We apply this approach to four systems involving quadratic-corrected triple-point, Weyl, and Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl nodes, including tilted triple-point nodes. We obtain analytical results at zero field and to leading orders in the magnetic field, alongside numerical solutions for the full field dependence. Our results elucidate the roles of the topological properties, Lorentz-force operator, tilt, and intra- and internode scatterings in shaping the magnetoelectric conductivity. It cures severe shortcomings of previous treatments like incomplete ansätze and incomplete treatment of the Lorentz-force operator.

AI.tldr: 该工作给出了多重简并半金属（multifold semimetals）在线性化半经典玻尔兹曼方程（semiclassical Boltzmann equation, SBE）框架下的精确解，突破弛豫时间近似（relaxation-time approximation），并将贝里曲率（Berry curvature）、轨道磁矩（orbital magnetic moment）、洛伦兹力算符（Lorentz-force operator）与散射项统一处理。
AI.motivation: 以往处理存在不完整的试探解（ansätze）与对洛伦兹力算符的不完整处理等严重缺陷，且弛豫时间近似难以刻画多重简并节点中各向异性输运与多带、多谷散射的耦合。
AI.method: 在任意取向的电磁场下精确求解线性化SBE；采用与动量无关的散射振幅，通过带内（intranode）、带间（interband）与谷间（internode）过程耦合费米面片；利用散射核的有限秩（finite rank）将SBE约化为少数矩（moments）的线性系统，并由电子数约束（electron-number constraint）封闭。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于包含二次修正三重点（quadratic-corrected triple-point）、Weyl 与 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点（含倾斜三重点节点）的四类体系，得到零场下及磁场领头阶的解析结果，以及完整场依赖的数值解；结果阐明了拓扑性质、洛伦兹力算符、倾斜与带内/谷间散射对磁电导率（magnetoelectric conductivity）的作用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的精确且可解析化的SBE求解框架统一刻画了多重简并半金属的磁电输运，纠正了既往不完整试探解与洛伦兹力算符处理不全的缺陷，为分辨拓扑与散射机制贡献提供了可靠基础。

title: Nonlinear Physics and Self-Organized Criticality in Astrophysics
summary: The definition of self-organized criticality (SOC) is ambiguous and controversial. Here we discuss the nonlinear physics of six basic SOC definitions, such as: phase transitions, fractal structures, power laws, SOC contingency, exponential growth, and diffusive decay. Statistics of SOC events or avalanche processes can be inferred from their size distributions, or from their spatio-temporal evolution.

AI.tldr: 该摘要指出自组织临界性（self-organized criticality, SOC）的定义存在歧义与争议，并讨论六种基本SOC定义所涉及的非线性物理（nonlinear physics），包括相变、分形结构、幂律、SOC偶发性、指数增长与扩散衰减。
AI.motivation: 研究动机源于SOC定义本身的模糊性与争议性，需从非线性物理角度梳理不同定义的内涵。
AI.method: 方法为对六种基本SOC定义（相变、分形结构、幂律、SOC偶发性、指数增长、扩散衰减）进行非线性物理层面的讨论，并说明SOC事件或雪崩过程（avalanche processes）的统计可由尺寸分布（size distributions）或时空演化（spatio-temporal evolution）推断。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实证结果，仅提出可通过尺寸分布和时空演化两条途径推断SOC事件或雪崩过程的统计特征。
AI.conclusion: 结论强调SOC定义的多样性及其非线性物理基础，并指出尺寸分布与时空演化是刻画SOC事件统计的关键途径。

title: Spectral Theory and Continuum Norm Resolvent Convergence of a One-Sided Discrete Dirac-Type Operator
summary: We investigate a one-dimensional discrete Dirac-type operator $D_d$ acting on the Hilbert space $\big(\ell^2(\mathbb{Z};\mathbb{C})\big)^2$, obtained from the classical continuous free Dirac operator by replacing the spatial derivative with the one-sided backward difference operator $I - S_1$, where $S_1$ denotes the right shift on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z};\mathbb{C})$. We establish the fundamental operator-theoretic and spectral properties of $D_d$: unlike symmetric or supersymmetric lattice discretizations, $D_d$ is bounded and non-normal for every non-zero rest mass $m > 0$, with self-commutator $[D_d, D_d^†] = -2mc^3(-Δ_{\mathrm{disc}})σ_2$, yet it is quadratically normal. We compute the exact operator norm, determine the exact spectral radius in two mass regimes, and show via Fourier--Laurent analysis that the spectrum $σ(D_d)$ is purely continuous and lies on a two-component algebraic curve in the complex plane undergoing a topological transition at $mc^2 = 2c$. Finally, introducing a lattice spacing $h > 0$ and embedding $\big(\ell^2(h\mathbb{Z};\mathbb{C})\big)^2$ isometrically into $\big(L^2(\mathbb{R};\mathbb{C})\big)^2$ via Whittaker--Shannon band-limited interpolation, we prove that the scaled non-normal discrete Dirac-type operator $D_{d,h}$ converges to the continuous self-adjoint Dirac operator $D$ in the norm resolvent sense at the optimal rate $\mathcal{O}(h)$ as $h \to 0^+$, without requiring frequency cutoffs.

AI.tldr: 该文研究一维离散 Dirac 型算子 D_d（以单侧后向差分替代空间导数），证明其有界、非正规（non-normal）但二次正规，精确计算算子范数与两质量区间谱半径，并证明谱为纯连续谱、位于复平面双分量代数曲线上且在 mc²=2c 处发生拓扑相变；最后证明网格间距 h→0 时缩放算子以最优速率 O(h) 在范数预解意义下收敛到连续自伴 Dirac 算子。
AI.motivation: 经典连续自由 Dirac 算子的离散化通常采用对称或超对称格点方案，但此类方案往往保留（或强加）自伴性等结构。本文转而考察用单侧后向差分离散化所导出的非对称算子，旨在刻画这类非正规离散模型的基本算子论与谱性质，并检验其连续极限行为。
AI.method: 在 Hilbert 空间 (ℓ²(ℤ;ℂ))² 上，以单侧后向差分算子 I − S₁（S₁ 为右移）替代空间导数构造 D_d；通过自交换子计算、算子范数与谱半径的精确求解、Fourier–Laurent 分析确定谱结构；并引入格距 h>0，借助 Whittaker–Shannon 带限插值（band-limited interpolation）将离散空间等距嵌入 L²(ℝ;ℂ)²，研究 D_{d,h} 的范数预解收敛（norm resolvent convergence）。
AI.result: 对任意非零静质量 m>0，D_d 有界且非正规，自交换子为 [D_d, D_d†] = −2mc³(−Δ_disc)σ₂，但算子满足二次正规性；给出精确算子范数，并在两个质量区间确定精确谱半径。Fourier–Laurent 分析表明谱 σ(D_d) 为纯连续谱，位于复平面中一条双分量代数曲线上，该曲线在 mc²=2c 处发生拓扑相变。此外，缩放算子 D_{d,h} 在 h→0⁺ 时以最优速率 O(h) 范数预解收敛到连续自伴 Dirac 算子 D，且无需频率截断。
AI.conclusion: 单侧后向差分离散化产生的是有界、非正规但二次正规的 Dirac 型算子，其谱为纯连续谱并呈现质量驱动的拓扑相变；尽管缺乏自伴性，该离散模型仍以最优阶 O(h) 在范数预解意义下收敛到连续自伴 Dirac 算子，说明该离散化在连续极限意义下是可靠的。

title: Plasmon modes in three-dimensional multifold semimetals. II. Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl and Kramers-Weyl nodes
summary: We investigate collective charge excitations in three-dimensional multifold semimetals in which multiple bands cross the Fermi level at a positive chemical potential, focusing on pseudospin-3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl semimetals and on Kramers-Weyl semimetals. Both systems host multiple concentric Fermi surfaces at positive chemical potential. Within the random-phase approximation, we analyse the density response, Drude weights, dielectric function, plasmon modes and their Landau damping, and Friedel oscillations, considering both small and arbitrary momentum transfers. In our companion work, arXiv:2610.18629, we investigated pseudospin-1 triple-point semimetals, with and without a quadratic correction to their dispersion, as well as Hopf and Weyl semimetals. Comparing these systems allows us to elucidate the distinct roles of band dispersions and eigenstates in shaping collective charge dynamics. Our results demonstrate that collective charge excitations can distinguish multifold nodes with multiple Fermi surfaces and reveal information encoded in their eigenstates beyond that contained in the single-particle dispersion.

AI.tldr: 本文在随机相近似（random-phase approximation, RPA）框架下系统研究多重简并半金属（multifold semimetals）中的集体电荷激发，重点分析伪自旋-3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl半金属与Kramers-Weyl半金属的密度响应、等离激元（plasmon）及其Landau阻尼、Friedel振荡等性质。
AI.motivation: 多重简并半金属在正化学势下具有多个同心费米面（Fermi surface），其集体电荷动力学与本征态结构的关系尚不清楚；通过与搭档工作研究的三重简并点、Hopf与Weyl半金属对比，可厘清能带色散与本征态各自的作用。
AI.method: 采用随机相近似（random-phase approximation, RPA），计算伪自旋-3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl半金属与Kramers-Weyl半金属的密度响应、Drude权重、介电函数、等离激元模式及其Landau阻尼和Friedel振荡，并同时考虑小动量转移与任意动量转移。
AI.result: 计算结果揭示了这些多重简并节点体系的集体电荷激发特征，并与搭档工作中三重简并点、Hopf及Weyl半金属的结果相比较，从而区分能带色散与本征态在塑造集体电荷动力学中的不同角色。
AI.conclusion: 集体电荷激发可用于区分具有多个费米面的多重简并节点，并能揭示编码于本征态中、超出单粒子色散所包含的信息。

title: Ab Initio strain-dependent vibrational analysis of different silicene structures for 2D devices
summary: We report first-principles phonon dynamics studies in isotropically strained mono-layer silicene films of various topologies by density functional theory and density functional perturbation theory methods. The strain introduced in the sheets are of both tensile and compressive nature and its effect on the thermal transport properties are analysed using the Boltzmann Transport Equation (BTE) reported. We performed electronic and vibrational analysis of each silicene topology and concluded that hhk-silicene is a potential candidate for next generation electro-thermal devices due its molecular stability, bulk-Si like bandgap and tolerable thermal performance that can be engineered by strain. The novel hhk-silicene topology offers excellent thermal and electronic capabilities that are sensitive to strain along with the band gap following a near-linear monotonically decreasing trend making it suitable for strain-tronics applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用第一性原理方法（first-principles）系统分析了不同拓扑结构的各向同性应变单层硅烯（silicene）的声子动力学与热输运性质，并指出 hhk-silicene 拓扑因分子稳定性、类体硅带隙及可通过应变调控的热性能，是下一代电热器件（electro-thermal devices）与应变电子学（strain-tronics）应用的潜在候选材料。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于评估应变对单层硅烯热输运性质的影响，并在多种拓扑结构中筛选兼具电子与热学性能优势的候选材料，以服务下一代电热器件与应变电子学应用。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（density functional theory）与密度泛函微扰理论（density functional perturbation theory）进行第一性原理声子动力学研究，对单层硅烯施加拉伸与压缩两类各向同性应变，并基于玻尔兹曼输运方程（Boltzmann Transport Equation, BTE）分析应变对热输运性质的影响，同时对每种拓扑开展电子与振动分析。
AI.result: 结果表明 hhk-silicene 拓扑具有分子稳定性、类体硅带隙（bulk-Si like bandgap）以及可容忍且可经应变调控的热性能；其热学与电子性能对应变敏感，带隙随应变呈近线性单调递减趋势。
AI.conclusion: hhk-silicene 因其稳定性、类体硅带隙及应变可调的热与电子性能，被视为下一代电热器件的潜在候选材料，并因带隙的近线性单调递减行为而适用于应变电子学应用。
