title: Gravitational-Wave Signal from a Short GRB Relativistic MHD Jet
summary: We analyze the gravitational-wave (GW) signal produced by a relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulation of a short GRB jet with parameters corresponding to those of GRB 170817A. The signal that is generated in the hidden central engine of the GRBs is computed by direct integration of the retarded solution of the linearized Einstein equations of an MHD simulation. Separating the GW signal into its baryonic and electromagnetic contributions, we identify the physical origin of its dominant features. The waveform is of the memory type, with $h(f) \propto 1/f$ at low frequencies and a knee at $\sim 0.5-0.5$Hz set by the energy injection time, which corresponds to the GRB duration. A pronounced early peak reflects the opening of the magnetic field lines and the equatorial kick given to the ejecta at the onset of the jet, demonstrating that the GW signal can reveal processes deep in the GRB engine that cannot be observed otherwise. The signal is strongest for observers far from the jet axis. The total radiated GW energy is only $\sim 10^{42}$ erg, about $10^{-9}$ of the jet energy; it scales as ${\cal E}^2/τ$ with the shortest variability time $τ$, so this is a lower limit. Comparing the predicted spectrum with the sensitivity of current and future detectors, we find that events similar to GW170817 are marginally detectable by DECIGO from up to 10 Mpc and by the Einstein Telescope from 1 Mpc. The injected Poynting flux in this simulation was smooth. An engine variable on a millisecond timescale, as predicted in some GRB models, would substantially increase the GW energy and detectability.

AI.tldr: 该文基于GRB 170817A参数的相对论磁流体（MHD）模拟，直接积分线性化爱因斯坦方程的推迟解，计算短伽马暴喷流隐藏中心引擎产生的引力波信号，并分析其物理起源、波形特征、能量分配与可探测性。
AI.motivation: 伽马暴中心引擎深处过程无法被电磁观测直接探测，作者希望检验引力波（gravitational-wave, GW）能否作为探针揭示喷流启动等隐藏机制，并评估此类信号对当前与未来探测器的可探测性。
AI.method: 采用与GRB 170817A参数对应的短伽马暴喷流相对论磁流体动力学（magnetohydrodynamic, MHD）模拟，对线性化爱因斯坦方程（linearized Einstein equations）的推迟解（retarded solution）直接积分得到引力波信号，并将信号分解为重子（baryonic）与电磁（electromagnetic）贡献以定位主要特征的物理来源。
AI.result: 波形属记忆型（memory type），低频满足h(f)∝1/f，并在约0.5 Hz处出现由能量注入时标（对应伽马暴持续时间）决定的拐点；早期显著峰反映磁力线张开与喷流启动时对抛射物的赤道向冲击。信号在远离喷流轴的观测者方向上最强，总辐射引力波能量仅约10^42 erg（约为喷流能量的10^-9），并按E^2/τ随最短变时标τ标度，故为下限。与探测器灵敏度比较，类似GW170817的事件在10 Mpc内对DECIGO、1 Mpc内对爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope）仅为边缘可探测。
AI.conclusion: 引力波信号可揭示伽马暴引擎中其他手段无法观测的深部过程；本模拟注入的坡印廷通量（Poynting flux）较平滑，若引擎在毫秒时标上变化（如部分伽马暴模型所预言），引力波能量与可探测性将显著提升。

title: Rapid microscopic decorrelation precedes sustained collective ordering in quenched two-dimensional colloids
summary: Independent Brownian noise can rapidly separate trajectories launched from the same microscopic configuration, but configuration-space distance need not reveal their later assembly outcomes. We studied this distinction in 480 two-dimensional Brownian-dynamics trajectories generated as three independent-noise replicas of 40 parent configurations under four finite-duration quenches. Ninety-two of 160 replica sets sharing one parent and one protocol reached both ordered and non-ordered terminal outcomes. A relative-diffusion calculation relates the free-particle mean-squared replica separation to the time-integrated diffusivity. The measured mean-squared separation remained about one-sixth of the free-particle reference, while its scaling was indistinguishable for replica pairs with the same and different outcomes. In contrast, outcome-resolved global sixfold order, ordered-particle population and coherence, and reciprocal-space translational order separated progressively after quench completion. With quench durations weighted equally, global order, the state score combining global and population order, coherence, and translational order remained informative 0.50 reduced time units before terminal assessment. This result persisted after either changing the terminal window or reducing the integration timestep. Transient threshold crossings were common, and 94.5\% of non-ordered crossings subsequently lost the required ordered-particle population. An independent $N=128$ ensemble showed state-score discrimination at temperatures for which both terminal classes occurred. The assembly dynamics therefore separate generic microscopic decorrelation from the later emergence and finite-window persistence of collective order associated with terminal structure.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过480条二维布朗运动（Brownian dynamics）轨迹，区分了微观构型空间中的噪声去相关（decorrelation）与后续装配终态的涌现；结果表明微观分离度不能预测终态，而全局六重取向序（sixfold order）等集体序参量在淬火（quench）完成后可逐步区分终态。
AI.motivation: 独立布朗噪声（independent Brownian noise）可迅速分离源自同一微观构型的轨迹，但构型空间距离（configuration-space distance）未必能反映其后续装配结果，论文旨在厘清微观去相关与终态结构之间的关系。
AI.method: 在四种有限时长淬火（finite-duration quench）条件下，对40个母构型各生成三个独立噪声复本（replica），共得到480条二维布朗动力学轨迹；采用相对扩散（relative-diffusion）计算将自由粒子复本均方分离与时间积分扩散率（diffusivity）相联系，并追踪全局六重序、有序粒子占比与相干性（coherence）及倒空间平动序（reciprocal-space translational order）等序参量的时间演化。
AI.result: 160组同母构型、同协议的复本中有92组同时出现有序与非有序终态；实测均方分离约为自由粒子参考值（free-particle reference）的六分之一，且同终态与异终态复本对的标度行为（scaling）不可区分。相反，各序参量在淬火完成后逐步分离，且在终态评估前0.50个约化时间单位（reduced time unit）仍具区分力，改变终态窗口或减小积分时间步长后结论稳健；94.5%的非有序阈值跨越随后失去所要求的有序粒子占比。独立N=128系综（ensemble）在两类终态共存的温度下亦显示状态评分（state score）的判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 装配动力学将一般的微观去相关与集体序的后期涌现及其有限窗口持续性区分开来，后者才与终态结构相关联；因此构型空间分离度不宜作为终态预测指标。

title: A Clustered Equivalent-Source Method with Local Response Compression and Group-Symmetry Reduction for Antenna-Array Analysis
summary: Full-wave analysis of finite antenna arrays is computationally demanding because detailed element responses must be resolved and coupled across the entire array. To reduce this cost, this paper presents a clustered equivalent-source method that combines local response compression with group-symmetry reduction. Local responses are represented in compressed equivalent-surface bases or coordinates inherited from child clusters. Symmetry constraints associated with the cluster partition and excitation reduce the coupled system, while the corresponding group transformations recover the complete response in the retained coordinates. To assess overall efficiency, we evaluate the costs of local construction, propagation, global solution, and recovery. Numerical examples involving layered and finite annular patch arrays show close agreement between the computed and reference complex far fields and shorter complete-run times than those of the corresponding symmetry-reduced direct solvers. Among the three equivalent-source implementations for the layered array, the one with the smallest coupled system has the longest runtime because local construction and propagation dominate the cost. These findings highlight the need to consider local construction and coupling costs when assessing the benefit of reducing the global system dimension.

AI.tldr: 提出一种簇化等效源方法（clustered equivalent-source method），结合局部响应压缩与群对称性约减，以降低有限天线阵列全波分析的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 有限天线阵列的全波分析需分辨细致单元响应并在整个阵列上耦合，计算需求高，因此需要降低整体计算代价。
AI.method: 局部响应用压缩的等效表面基（equivalent-surface bases）或从子簇继承的坐标表示；利用簇划分与激励相关的对称性约束约减耦合系统，并通过相应群变换（group transformations）在保留坐标中恢复完整响应；同时评估局部构造、传播、全局求解与恢复各环节成本。
AI.result: 分层与有限环形贴片阵列算例中，计算与参考复远场（complex far fields）吻合良好，完整运行时间短于相应的对称性约减直接求解器；分层阵列的三种等效源实现中，耦合系统最小者运行时间最长，因局部构造与传播主导成本。
AI.conclusion: 评估降低全局系统维度的收益时，必须同时考虑局部构造与耦合成本。

title: A Clifford-index approach connecting boundary Dirac fermions to sigma-model topological terms in the periodic table of topological insulators and superconductors
summary: The periodic table of topological insulators and superconductors emerges from two distinct approaches: boundary Anderson localization and momentum-space K-theory. Connecting these approaches physically requires deriving the boundary sigma-model topological terms from the underlying fermion theories. We develop an index-theoretic framework for minimal massless boundary Dirac models in the eight real Altland--Zirnbauer classes. Its central ingredients are an elliptic cylinder operator interpolating between two sigma-field textures, a quotient index defined by the cylinder's graded Clifford symmetry algebra, and an index theorem identifying its protected zero-mode index with the relative homotopy class of the endpoint textures. To establish this correspondence, we deform the cylinder texture while preserving the kernel's index class and localize the obstruction to a Clifford defect. An exact oscillator-kernel calculation fixes the generator normalization. A field-independent congruence and a common regularization provide a real antisymmetric Pfaffian representative whose sign transport is related to the cylinder mod-two index by Witten's spectral-flow argument. This yields the nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2$ theta weight for one minimal physical module. Combining complex-parent anomalies with physical Clifford multiplicities and real-target periods also gives the real-class Wess--Zumino terms with unit spherical level. The framework thus provides an operator-level connection between boundary Dirac theories and the sigma-model topological terms associated with the periodic table.

AI.tldr: 本文建立一个指标论框架，从无质量边界狄拉克模型（massless boundary Dirac models）出发推导边界 sigma 模型（sigma-model）拓扑项，从而在边界安德森局域化（Anderson localization）与动量空间 K 理论（K-theory）两条路径之间建立算符层面的物理联系。
AI.motivation: 拓扑绝缘体与超导体的周期表源于边界安德森局域化与动量空间 K 理论两种不同进路，二者之间缺乏物理上的直接联系；要弥合这一缺口，需从底层费米子理论导出边界 sigma 模型的拓扑项。
AI.method: 针对八个实 Altland–Zirnbauer 类中的最简无质量边界狄拉克模型，构造插值于两个 sigma 场构型（texture）之间的椭圆柱算符（elliptic cylinder operator），并借助柱的渐变克利福德对称代数（graded Clifford symmetry algebra）定义商指标（quotient index）。通过保持核指标类不变的形变将阻碍局域化为克利福德缺陷（Clifford defect），结合精确谐振子核计算、场无关同余与共同正则化，用 Witten 谱流论证（spectral-flow argument）把 Pfaffian 符号输运与柱的模二指标相联系。
AI.result: 建立指标定理，将该保护的零模指标等同于端点构型的相对同伦类（relative homotopy class）；由此得到一个最简物理模块的非平凡 Z₂ theta 权重，并结合复父辈异常（complex-parent anomalies）、物理克利福德重数与实靶周期，给出单位球面能级的实类 Wess–Zumino 项。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在算符层面连接了边界狄拉克理论与周期表所对应的 sigma 模型拓扑项，为两种周期表推导进路提供了统一的物理桥梁。

title: Visualizing Anisotropic Charge Transport in CrSBr using Bias-Dependent Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
comment: 18 pages, 5 main figures, 11 supplementary figures, 1 toc figure
summary: Anisotropic semiconductors offer unique opportunities for next-generation electronics due to their direction-dependent transport. However, conventional electrical measurements provide only spatially averaged characteristics. Here, we employ bias-dependent Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) to directly visualize the response of CrSBr under different electrical bias configurations. Spatially resolved KPFM maps reveal highly distinct, crystallographic-direction-dependent potential profiles. To elucidate this behavior, we employ anisotropic transport simulations that capture the charge transport and electric-field distributions in CrSBr. The close agreement between experiment and simulation provides a unified picture of anisotropic charge transport and bias-induced potential redistribution. Our experiments further reveal a boundary-associated redistribution of the transport field when bias is applied along the $a$-axis, suggesting a possible role of crystal boundaries in charge transport along the low-conductivity direction. This work establishes bias-dependent KPFM as a powerful platform for uncovering localized transport phenomena in low-symmetry quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用偏压依赖的开尔文探针力显微镜（Kelvin probe force microscopy, KPFM）直接可视化各向异性半导体 CrSBr 在不同偏压构型下的电势响应，并结合各向异性输运模拟（anisotropic transport simulations）揭示电荷输运与电场的空间分布规律。
AI.motivation: 各向异性半导体（anisotropic semiconductors）因方向依赖的输运特性对下一代电子器件具有潜力，但传统电学测量仅能给出空间平均特征，难以获得局域输运信息，故需发展具备空间分辨能力的表征手段。
AI.method: 采用偏压依赖的 KPFM 对 CrSBr 在不同偏压构型下的响应进行空间分辨成像，并结合各向异性输运模拟再现电荷输运与电场分布，与实验结果相互对照。
AI.result: KPFM 图显示出高度依赖于晶向（crystallographic direction）的差异化电势分布；实验与模拟结果高度吻合，给出各向异性电荷输运与偏压诱导电势重分布（bias-induced potential redistribution）的统一图像；沿 $a$ 轴施加偏压时观察到与边界相关的输运场重分布。
AI.conclusion: 沿低电导方向的输运中晶界（crystal boundaries）可能发挥作用；偏压依赖 KPFM 可作为揭示低对称性量子材料（low-symmetry quantum materials）中局域输运现象的有效平台。

title: Binary Quantum Hypothesis Testing with a Rejection Option: The Exact Error-Exponent Trade-off
summary: We characterize the exact error-exponent trade-off in binary quantum hypothesis testing with a rejection option for faithful states on a finite-dimensional Hilbert space. The probabilities of rejection under the two hypotheses are required to vanish exponentially, with exponents at least $K$ and $L$. We show that a quadruple $(a,b,K,L)$ of positive error and rejection exponents is achievable if and only if it satisfies three single-letter conditions: two conditions involve Petz--Rényi quantities and coincide with the converse bound conjectured to be tight by Ji and Regula; the third involves the $α$--$z$ Rényi quantities on the triangle $\max\{α,1-α\}\le z\le1$. The proof combines a sector decomposition inside Schur--Weyl blocks, an explicit one-shot measurement construction, and an exact minimax argument.

AI.tldr: 该文刻画了有限维希尔伯特空间上带拒绝选项（rejection option）的二元量子假设检验（binary quantum hypothesis testing）中误差指数与拒绝指数的精确权衡关系，给出可达四元组（a,b,K,L）的充要条件为三个单字母（single-letter）不等式。
AI.motivation: 带拒绝选项的量子假设检验中，误差指数（error exponent）与拒绝指数（rejection exponent）之间存在权衡；此前 Ji 与 Regula  conjectured 的逆定理界（converse bound）是否紧尚未确定，本文旨在给出完整的精确刻画。
AI.method: 证明结合了三项技术：Schur--Weyl 块内部的扇区分解（sector decomposition）、显式的一次性测量构造（one-shot measurement construction），以及精确的极小极大论证（exact minimax argument）。
AI.result: 正误差指数与拒绝指数组成的四元组 (a,b,K,L) 可达，当且仅当满足三个单字母条件：其中两个涉及 Petz--Rényi 量（Petz--Rényi quantities），且与 Ji 和 Regula 猜想为紧的逆定理界一致；第三个涉及在三角形 max{α,1-α} ≤ z ≤ 1 上的 α--z Rényi 量（α--z Rényi quantities）。
AI.conclusion: 结果为带拒绝选项的二元量子假设检验提供了误差—拒绝指数权衡的精确、可判定的充要刻画，并确认了相关猜想界在单字母层面的紧性。

title: Adiabatic pulsed-field dynamics of a frustrated spin-lattice system
summary: Magnetocaloric measurements in pulsed magnetic fields probe competing phases through the coupled evolution of magnetization and temperature. We formulate an adiabatic classical spin-lattice simulation that treats bond and site optical coordinates explicitly while representing the remaining thermal degrees of freedom by a finite internal reservoir. Magnetic work and energy exchange determine its temperature along each trajectory, providing feedback to the Langevin dynamics without external heat flow. Applied to a pyrochlore exchange-striction model motivated by CdCr$_2$O$_4$, the method produces a half-magnetization plateau, cooling near its onset, a temperature dome, and a change in cooling slope near plateau exit. Their joint emergence without an imposed temperature profile captures the experimental sequence of magnetic and thermal features. An approximate magnetization crossing near the temperature maximum is consistent with the reversible thermodynamic interpretation of the dome. The phenomenological reservoir enables this qualitative comparison within a simple model.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种绝热经典自旋-晶格模拟（adiabatic classical spin-lattice simulation），用有限内部热库（internal reservoir）替代其余热自由度，并沿轨迹由磁功与能量交换决定温度，从而在无外部热流条件下复现脉冲磁场磁热（magnetocaloric）测量中的磁化与温度耦合演化。
AI.motivation: 脉冲强磁场下的磁热测量通过磁化强度（magnetization）与温度的共同演化探测竞争相（competing phases），但缺乏能同时描述自旋、晶格与热反馈的简单理论框架。
AI.method: 构建绝热经典自旋-晶格模拟，显式处理键与位点的光学坐标（bond and site optical coordinates），其余热自由度以有限内部热库表示；由磁功（magnetic work）与能量交换确定温度，并反馈至朗之万动力学（Langevin dynamics），无需外部热流。
AI.result: 应用于受CdCr$_2$O$_4$启发的烧绿石（pyrochlore）交换伸缩（exchange-striction）模型，得到半磁化平台（half-magnetization plateau）、平台起始附近的冷却、温度穹顶（temperature dome）及平台退出处冷却斜率的变化；温度极大值附近的近似磁化交叉与穹顶的可逆热力学解释一致。
AI.conclusion: 在未施加温度预设的条件下，模型自发呈现磁与热特征的实验序列，表明唯象热库（phenomenological reservoir）足以在简单模型中实现定性比较。

title: Locally Conformal Analysis of Non-Degenerate Odd Pairs
summary:
We study the locally conformal geometry of cosymplectic and coorientable contact manifolds within a common algebraic framework based on a non-degenerate odd pair: a one-form and a two-form whose appropriate wedge product defines a nowhere-vanishing top-degree form on an odd-dimensional manifold. We consider conformally compatible local geometric and Hamiltonian data and encode their gluing through a closed Lee form and the Lichnerowicz-de Rham differential.
  For locally conformal cosymplectic geometry, we introduce an equal-weight formulation in which the defining forms carry the same conformal weight. This formulation allows compatible local Hamiltonian vector fields to glue directly into a global Hamiltonian vector field without additional rescaling, thereby preserving the local dynamics. For contact geometry, we develop a twisted odd-pair formulation in which the Lee form records the conformal gluing of local Hamiltonian data, while the global one-form remains an ordinary contact form. We illustrate these constructions through time-dependent mass dynamics in the cosymplectic setting and dissipative particle dynamics in the contact setting.

AI.tldr: 本文在研究余辛（cosymplectic）与余定向接触（coorientable contact）流形的局部共形几何时，基于非退化奇对（one-form 与 two-form）建立统一代数框架，并用闭 Lee 形式（closed Lee form）和 Lichnerowicz-de Rham 微分刻画局部数据的粘合。
AI.motivation: 余辛几何与接触几何的局部共形结构通常分开处理，缺乏共同的代数语言；同时局部哈密顿数据（Hamiltonian data）在共形粘合时往往需要额外重标度，可能破坏局部动力学。
AI.method: 在奇数维流形上以非退化奇对（one-form 与 two-form，其楔积给出处处非零的顶形式）为共同框架，考察共形相容的局部几何与哈密顿数据，并通过闭 Lee 形式与 Lichnerowicz-de Rham 微分编码其粘合；对余辛情形提出等权（equal-weight）表述，对接触情形提出扭化奇对（twisted odd-pair）表述。
AI.result: 在余辛情形，等权表述使相容的局部哈密顿向量场无需额外重标度即可直接粘合为全局哈密顿向量场，从而保持局部动力学；在接触情形，扭化表述中 Lee 形式记录局部哈密顿数据的共形粘合，而全局 one-form 仍为普通接触形式。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架统一刻画了两类流形的局部共形粘合，并以余辛框架下的含时质量动力学（time-dependent mass dynamics）与接触框架下的耗散粒子动力学（dissipative particle dynamics）作为示例说明其适用性。

title: Mass and angular momentum assessement of the neutron star XTEJ 1807-294 using X-ray triplets
comment: 5 pages, Proceedings of the 49th international conference Applications of Mathematics in Engineering and Economics (AMEE 2023)
summary: The X-ray power-density spectrum of the accreting millisecond pulsar XTEJ 1807-294 contains several triplets of simultaneously observed quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs): a lower and a upper kHz QPOs and a low-frequency QPO. This fact allows us to assess the mass and the specific angular momentum of the central neutron star. We also apply an error propagation formula to obtain interval estimates of the parameters of the star. The calculations are repeated with several different models for the kHz QPOs. The degree of consistency of the bounds obtained with the different triplets may provide information for the viability of the used models.

AI.tldr: 利用吸积毫秒脉冲星 XTE J1807-294 同时观测到的 kHz 准周期振荡（QPO）三重态，估算中心中子星的质量与比角动量，并检验不同 kHz QPO 模型的可行性。
AI.motivation: 该源的 X 射线功率密度谱（power-density spectrum）包含多个同时观测的三重态：下 kHz QPO、上 kHz QPO 与低频 QPO，这一观测特征为测定中心中子星（neutron star）的基本参数提供了机会。
AI.method: 基于同时观测的 QPO 三重态反演中子星质量与比角动量（specific angular momentum）；采用误差传播公式（error propagation formula）给出参数的区间估计；并使用多种不同的 kHz QPO 模型重复计算。
AI.result: 得到中子星质量与比角动量的估计值及相应的区间估计；不同模型给出的结果一并给出，具体数值摘要中未列出。
AI.conclusion: 不同三重态所得约束的一致程度可反映所用 kHz QPO 模型的可行性（viability）。

title: Compliance-Shifting Elastogranular Shells
summary: Shells and grains separately exhibit complex nonlinear behavior when confined - shells buckle and snap, while grains transition from fluid-like to solid-like. When coupled, elastogranular structures have the ability to display a remarkable variety of mechanical behaviors. Gere we created an elastogranular shell where spherical grains are sandwiched between two thin, elastic shells. By evacuating the air enclosed by the two layers, we can tune the stiffness of the elastogranular shell and alter its critical buckling load. Introducing controlled vacancy defects in the arrangement of the grains allows us to more finely tune critical buckling parameters, as the shell must balance the combined effects of defect size and resultant granular packing density. Defects in the jammed granular layer have a counterintuitive effect on the shell's buckling load, as they can stiffen the shell away from the defect. With an empirically determined scaling model, we established how the shell and grains distribute load and create a compliance-shifting structure with a tunable buckling load.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建由两层薄弹性壳夹持球形颗粒的弹性颗粒壳（elastogranular shell）结构，通过抽真空调节刚度与临界屈曲载荷，并利用颗粒排布中的空位缺陷（vacancy defects）实现更精细的屈曲参数调控，最终以经验标度模型（scaling model）阐明壳与颗粒的载荷分配机制。
AI.motivation: 薄壳（shells）在受限时会发生屈曲与突跳（buckle and snap），颗粒（grains）则呈现类流体到类固体的转变（fluid-like to solid-like），二者耦合的弹性颗粒结构（elastogranular structures）具备多样的力学行为；但如何对这类结构的刚度与临界屈曲载荷（critical buckling load）进行可调控制尚待研究。
AI.method: 将球形颗粒夹于两层薄弹性壳之间构成弹性颗粒壳，通过抽除两层间封闭空气（evacuating the air）调节结构刚度；并在颗粒排布中引入受控的空位缺陷（vacancy defects），考察缺陷尺寸与由此产生的颗粒堆积密度（granular packing density）的耦合影响，同时建立经验标度模型（empirical scaling model）。
AI.result: 抽真空可调节弹性颗粒壳的刚度并改变其临界屈曲载荷；空位缺陷对屈曲载荷具有反直觉（counterintuitive）影响，可使远离缺陷处的壳发生硬化（stiffen the shell away from the defect）；壳需在缺陷尺寸与颗粒堆积密度的联合效应之间取得平衡，从而实现更精细的屈曲参数调控。
AI.conclusion: 经验标度模型揭示了壳与颗粒如何分担载荷，从而形成一种具备可调屈曲载荷的柔度可切换结构（compliance-shifting structure）；该结果为弹性颗粒壳的力学性能设计与调控提供了依据。

title: Hidden by Exponential Screening: The Invisibility of the Dymnikova Black Hole de Sitter Core to Accretion Observables
summary: The Dymnikova spacetime replaces the Schwarzschild singularity with a de Sitter core, and its lapse deviates from Schwarzschild by a factor decaying as $e^{-r^3/(2l_{\rm cr}^2M)}$. Whether this screening renders the core invisible to accretion has remained an open quantitative question. We address it with GRHD simulations of BHL accretion onto Dymnikova BH for six values of the critical length, $0.1M\le l_{\rm cr}\le 1.1M$, the last being 97% of the extremal value. All runs share identical gas parameters and resolution, so any difference in the flow must originate from the geometry. The dynamically relevant quantity is the gravitational acceleration, whose deviation reaches 12% at the inner boundary for the most strongly corrected model, yet the flow responds only locally: the post-shock density drops by 10% in the innermost zone and the quiet-phase accretion rate by 0.12%, with no effect beyond $r\simeq2.7M$. Because runs differing by as little as $\sim 10^{-10}$ in the metric decorrelate completely once the shock-cone instability saturates, we compare models statistically using ensembles of independent realizations. The time-averaged accretion rate is then independent of $l_{\rm cr}$ to within 0.8% $(2σ)$ at all radii; the variability amplitude, shock-cone opening angle $(1.077\pm0.003 rad)$, and stagnation radius $(26.8\pm0.3M)$ vary only within the realization scatter; the propagation lags $(75.5\pm1.0M$ and $31.6\pm0.4M)$ agree to within 1.6%; and no power spectrum carries a detectable core signature. Accretion onto a Dymnikova BH is therefore observationally indistinguishable from accretion onto a Schwarzschild black hole: timing observations test the shock-cone mechanism, not the regular core. More broadly, ensemble-based statistical comparisons are essential before differences between simulated accretion flows in different spacetimes can be interpreted as physical.

AI.tldr: 通过广义相对论流体动力学（GRHD）模拟与集合统计比较，证明Dymnikova黑洞（Dymnikova BH）的正则核心对BHL吸积流无观测可辨效应，其吸积与Schwarzschild黑洞吸积不可区分。
AI.motivation: Dymnikova时空以de Sitter核心替代Schwarzschild奇点，其lapse函数偏离Schwarzschild并按指数因子衰减；这种屏蔽是否使核心在吸积过程中不可见，此前缺乏定量回答。
AI.method: 对临界长度$0.1M\le l_{\rm cr}\le 1.1M$的六个取值（最大者为极端值的97%）开展BHL吸积的GRHD模拟，各运行的气体参数与分辨率完全相同；因冲击锥不稳定性（shock-cone instability）使微小度规差异导致结果完全去相关，故采用独立实现集合进行统计比较。
AI.result: 引力加速度偏差在内边界最大达12%，但流动仅局域响应：最内区冲击后密度降10%，静稳期吸积率降0.12%，且$r\simeq2.7M$之外无影响。时间平均吸积率在各半径处对$l_{\rm cr}$的依赖在0.8%（2σ）以内；变幅、冲击锥开角$(1.077\pm0.003\,{\rm rad})$、驻点半径$(26.8\pm0.3M)$仅在实现散布内变化；传播滞后$(75.5\pm1.0M$、$31.6\pm0.4M)$一致到1.6%以内；功率谱无可探测的核心特征。
AI.conclusion: Dymnikova黑洞吸积在观测上与Schwarzschild黑洞吸积无法区分，计时观测检验的是冲击锥机制而非正则核心；更广泛地，在将不同时空模拟吸积流的差异解释为物理效应之前，基于集合的统计比较是必要的。

title: From First Bond to Stable Adhesion: Multivalent Bond Stabilization in Receptor-Mediated Endocytosis
summary: After a particle forms its first receptor--ligand bond near a cell membrane, stable attachment often requires a threshold number of additional bonds. This paper develops a biophysical kinetic theory of this post-capture stage. The bond-number dynamics are modeled as a finite birth--death chain on $n=0,1,\dots,m$, where $0$ is loss of the initial bond and $m$ is the stabilization threshold. The mesoscopic rates $λ_n$ and $μ_n$ encode the local energy landscape, accessible receptor--ligand pairs, steric and orientational constraints, and cooperative interactions within the growing cluster. The probability of reaching the threshold before losing the first bond is derived in closed form for general rates and, in the constant-ratio case, reduces to a geometric series controlled by the free-energy bias $ρ_n=μ_n/λ_n$. The mean time to failure or stabilization follows from a tridiagonal backward equation. Conditioning on successful attachment is treated as a trajectory-selection effect: the conditioned chain is a Doob $h$-transform whose dissociation rate at $n=1$ vanishes, because successful trajectories cannot lose the first bond early. A minimal interface between the spatial first-capture probability and the bond-number chain is formulated, together with the conditions under which the stable capture probability factorizes into their product. The analysis shows that hitting probabilities constrain only the rate ratios, whereas the absolute rate scale requires time-resolved or dwell-time data. The threshold $m$ is a model-defined stabilization criterion, not a directly measured ligand count. The rates and threshold are effective parameters specified independently or inferred from kinetic data. The theory provides a quantitative framework for interpreting attachment probabilities, lifetimes, and the transition from first bond formation to stable multivalent adhesion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种描述“首次成键后到稳定黏附”这一阶段（post-capture stage）的生物物理动理学理论（biophysical kinetic theory），将键数演化建模为有限生灭链（finite birth–death chain），并给出达到稳定阈值概率的闭式解、平均时间及轨迹选择效应。
AI.motivation: 细胞膜附近粒子形成首个受体–配体键（receptor–ligand bond）后，稳定附着通常需要达到阈值数量的额外键；现有研究对这一“捕获后阶段”缺乏定量理论描述，本文旨在填补该空白。
AI.method: 以 n=0,1,…,m 上的有限生灭链（finite birth–death chain）描述键数动力学，其中 0 表示首个键丢失、m 为稳定化阈值；介观速率（mesoscopic rates）λ_n 与 μ_n 编码局部能量景观、可及受体–配体对、位阻与取向约束及簇内协同相互作用。推导任意速率下到达阈值的闭式概率，并用三对角后向方程（tridiagonal backward equation）求平均失败/稳定化时间；将条件于成功附着处理为 Doob h-变换（Doob h-transform）的轨迹选择效应。
AI.result: 一般速率下到达阈值前丢失首键的概率有闭式解；常比值情形下化为由自由能偏置（free-energy bias）ρ_n=μ_n/λ_n 控制的几何级数。条件化后的链在 n=1 处解离速率消失，因成功轨迹不能在早期丢失首键。给出了空间首次捕获概率与键数链之间的最小接口，并给出稳定捕获概率可因式分解为二者乘积的条件。命中概率仅约束速率比，绝对速率尺度需时间分辨或驻留时间（dwell-time）数据确定。
AI.conclusion: 阈值 m 是模型定义的稳定化判据，而非直接测量的配体计数；速率与阈值均为有效参数（effective parameters），可独立指定或由动力学数据推断。该理论为解释附着概率、寿命及从首键形成到稳定多价黏附（multivalent adhesion）的转变提供了定量框架。

title: On the Finite-Time Singularities of Point-Vortex Systems I: The Half-Plane
summary: In this paper, the first in a series devoted to finite-time singularities of point-vortex systems in domains with boundaries, we establish the existence of finite-time interior collapse for three vortices in the upper half-plane $\mathbb{H}^+$. Our approach treats the boundary-induced interactions as a perturbation of the classical self-similar Gröbli collapse in the full plane. Under suitable conditions on the vortex circulations and collapse profile, we prove the existence of a one-dimensional local strong stable manifold of the augmented rescaled system, which generates exact solutions in which three distinct vortices collapse simultaneously at any prescribed interior point $z^*\in\mathbb{H}^+$. Moreover, these solutions are asymptotically self-similar, with the characteristic square-root collapse rate $O(\sqrt{T-t})$.

AI.tldr: 该论文（系列首篇）证明上半平面 $\mathbb{H}^+$ 中三个点涡（point vortices）存在有限时间内部坍缩（finite-time interior collapse），坍缩以方根速率 $O(\sqrt{T-t})$ 渐近自相似地发生。
AI.motivation: 研究有界区域中点涡系统的有限时间奇性（finite-time singularities），此前经典的 Gröbli 坍缩结论建立在全平面，边界如何影响坍缩行为尚待刻画。
AI.method: 将边界诱导相互作用（boundary-induced interactions）视为全平面经典自相似 Gröbli 坍缩的扰动（perturbation），在增广重标度系统（augmented rescaled system）上证明存在一维局部强稳定流形（one-dimensional local strong stable manifold）。
AI.result: 在涡旋环量（circulations）与坍缩剖面（collapse profile）的适当条件下，稳定流形生成精确解，使三个不同涡旋同时坍缩于任意指定内点 $z^*\in\mathbb{H}^+$，且解为渐近自相似，具特征方根坍缩速率 $O(\sqrt{T-t})$。
AI.conclusion: 上半平面边界的存在不破坏经典自相似坍缩结构，而是通过扰动机制保留其强稳定流形；该结果为后续系列工作研究有界区域点涡有限时间奇性奠定框架。

title: Before the First Bond: Depletion-Assisted Stochastic Capture at the Onset of Endocytosis
summary: In a crowded extracellular environment, viruses and nanoparticles must reach the cell membrane within a few nanometers before the first ligand-receptor bond can form. Crowders generate an entropic depletion attraction, yet continuum models usually assume contact is already established or treat the approach deterministically. We formulate a thermodynamically consistent stochastic theory for this pre-contact stage. The sphere-plane depletion geometry uses the exact Asakur-Oosawa spherical-cap overlap, rather than a fitted cap, with either ideal van 't Hoff or pressure-only Carnahan-Starling osmotic pressure. A spatially varying near-wall mobility introduces a noise-induced drift that is essential for thermodynamic consistency and is often omitted. The first specific reaction is modeled by a Robin radiation boundary; the outer boundary is reflecting or absorbing. Three first-passage problems are solved analytically by quadrature: the mean reaction time, the reaction-before-escape probability, and the conditional success time, the last encoded by a Doob transform that exposes the selection bias of conditioning on capture. The theory separates thermodynamic inputs from conditional parameters and reveals a reaction-limited to diffusion-limited crossover controlled by the local Damköhler number. For typical virus and nanoparticle parameters, the depletion well reaches $2$-$6\,k_{\rm B}T$, capture times are $0.1$-$1\,{\rm ms}$, and the conditional success time is measurably shorter than the unconditional mean. Finite-volume and Chebyshev schemes reproduce the analytic results within their discretization errors and satisfy the radiation-boundary mass balance. This provides a quantitative theoretical framework for crowding-assisted capture prior to membrane wrapping and a reference for comparing crowding, near-wall mobility, and surface reactivity in endocytosis.

AI.tldr: 该文建立一个热力学自洽的随机理论，描述病毒/纳米颗粒在拥挤的胞外环境中结合膜面前、首个配体-受体键形成之前的“接触前阶段”，并解析求解三个首次通过问题。
AI.motivation: 拥挤剂（crowders）产生的熵性耗尽力（entropic depletion attraction）使颗粒在数纳米内接近膜面，但连续介质模型通常假定接触已建立或对趋近过程作确定性处理，缺少对接触前阶段随机动力学的定量描述。
AI.method: 采用球-平面耗尽几何并基于精确的Asakura-Oosawa球冠重叠（而非拟合球冠），渗透压取理想van 't Hoff或仅压力项的Carnahan-Starling形式；引入空间变化的近壁迁移率（near-wall mobility）及其噪声诱导漂移（noise-induced drift）以保证热力学一致性；首个特异性反应用Robin辐射边界（radiation boundary）刻画，外边界为反射或吸收。
AI.result: 以求积（quadrature）解析求解三个首次通过量：平均反应时间、逃逸前反应概率和条件成功时间（后者由Doob变换（Doob transform）编码，揭示条件化带来的选择偏差）。理论分离热力学输入与条件参数，并给出由局部Damköhler数控制的反应受限到扩散受限的转变；对典型病毒与纳米颗粒参数，耗尽势阱达2–6 k_BT，捕获时间0.1–1 ms，条件成功时间显著短于无条件平均。有限体积与Chebyshev数值方案在离散误差内复现解析结果并满足辐射边界质量平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为膜包裹（membrane wrapping）之前的拥挤辅助捕获提供了定量理论框架，并为内吞（endocytosis）中比较拥挤效应、近壁迁移率与表面反应活性提供参照。

title: Far-field Layers of Steady State for Viscous and Heat-conductive Gas
summary: We study the vanishing heat conductivity limit of radially symmetric stationary solutions to the non-isentropic compressible Navier--Stokes equations in the exterior of a ball under an inflow boundary condition. A distinctive feature of this singular limit is the formation of a far-field layer whose transition region moves toward spatial infinity as the heat conductivity tends to zero. We establish the existence and uniqueness of stationary solutions with the uniform estimates with respect to the heat conductivity and analyze the corresponding limiting problem. The limiting solution generally fails to attain the prescribed far-field density and temperature separately, although its pressure at infinity agrees with the prescribed far-field pressure. We show that this discrepancy gives rise to a far-field layer, derive its explicit representation, and identify its characteristic spatial scale. Finally, we prove that the stationary solution is uniformly approximated over the entire exterior domain by the superposition of the limiting solution and the far-field layer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究球外区域非等熵可压缩 Navier–Stokes 方程在流入边界条件下径向对称驻定解的热传导系数（heat conductivity）消失极限，核心是远场层（far-field layer）随热传导系数趋零而向空间无穷远处移动的奇异极限现象。
AI.motivation: 热传导系数趋于零的奇异极限（singular limit）会导致极限解无法分别达到给定的远场密度与温度，仅压力在无穷远处与给定值一致；该偏差如何产生并如何在全区域上描述解的行为，是本文的出发点。
AI.method: 作者建立驻定解的存在唯一性及关于热传导系数的一致估计（uniform estimates），分析相应极限问题（limiting problem），并对远场层给出显式表达及其特征空间尺度（characteristic spatial scale）。
AI.result: 极限解一般不能分别匹配给定的远场密度与温度，但在无穷远处的压力与给定远场压力相符；这一差异导致远场层的出现，且其过渡区域随热传导系数趋零而向空间无穷远移动。
AI.conclusion: 证明在整个外部区域上，驻定解可由极限解与远场层的叠加（superposition）一致逼近（uniformly approximated）。

title: DBI Softens Stiff-Phase Gravitational-Wave Spectra
summary: We investigate the effect of non-canonical kinetic terms on the present-day density spectrum of primordial gravitational waves (GWs), by considering the dynamics of a scalar field governed by the Dirac--Born--Infeld (DBI) action and a runaway potential. The field, responsible for a period of inflation, subsequently enters a kinetically dominated regime, where the DBI structure reduces the equation-of-state parameter relative to the canonical kination result $w=1$, thereby softening the blue tilt of the GW spectrum. Simultaneously, the energy density of the field redshifts at a slower rate, delaying radiation domination and prolonging the stiff phase. The interplay between these two effects can lead to a potentially observable GW signal that would otherwise remain beyond the reach of future experiments in the canonical case. We test our predictions by numerically solving the background and perturbations, from inflation until radiation domination, and find viable parameter space compatible with cosmic microwave background and Big Bang Nucleosynthesis constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非正则动能项（non-canonical kinetic terms）对原初引力波（primordial gravitational waves, GWs）当今密度谱的影响。以 Dirac–Born–Infeld（DBI）作用量配合 runaway 势描述标量场动力学，发现 DBI 结构可软化 GW 谱的蓝倾（blue tilt）并延长 stiff 阶段，二者协同可能产生可观测信号，且数值计算得到的参数空间与 CMB 及 BBN 约束相容。
AI.motivation: 正则情形下 kination 阶段给出状态方程参数 w=1，使原初引力波谱呈现较强蓝倾，信号往往超出未来实验探测范围，因此有必要考察非正则动能项能否改变这一局面。
AI.method: 采用由 DBI 作用量与 runaway 势支配的标量场动力学，该场先驱动暴胀（inflation），随后进入动能主导（kinetically dominated）阶段；从暴胀到辐射主导（radiation domination）对背景演化与扰动进行数值求解。
AI.result: DBI 结构使状态方程参数（equation-of-state parameter）低于正则 kination 的 w=1，从而软化 GW 谱的蓝倾；同时场能量密度红移变慢，推迟辐射主导并延长 stiff 阶段。两种效应叠加可产生原本在正则情形下无法探测的潜在可观测 GW 信号，数值结果给出与宇宙微波背景（cosmic microwave background, CMB）和太初核合成（Big Bang Nucleosynthesis, BBN）约束相容的可行参数空间。
AI.conclusion: 非正则 DBI 动能项通过降低状态方程参数并延缓辐射主导，可显著增强原初引力波的可观测性，为非正则场模型下的引力波探测提供了与现有宇宙学约束相容的理论可能。

title: Artificial spin ice on the CaVO lattice: a tricritical bridge from square to kagome
summary: Artificial spin ices (ASIs) are arrays of interacting nanomagnets in which phase transitions can be imaged and controlled. Studies of the thermodynamic have focused mainly on the square and kagome lattices, and on their variants. Here we study artificial spin ice on the CaVO lattice, formed of squares and octagons. At fixed lattice constant, the ratio $r$ of the square and octagon link lengths tunes the interactions strongly while changing the geometry only slightly. Magnetic force microscopy and Monte Carlo simulations show a continuous bridge from square-ice-like to kagome-like behavior. At small $r$ the system has a single ordering transition, whereas at large $r$ it passes from a correlated paramagnet to charge order and then long-range order. The two regimes meet in a multicritical region, accurately modeled by a Blume-Capel model of the octagon toroidal moments. From this picture, we design a comparative magnetometry protocol that unambiguously separates interaction effects from single-nanomagnet effects in thermally active samples. Finally, the charge-ordered region maps onto a tunable dimer model, with a Coulomb phase and pinch points along the line between two ordered dimer phases. The CaVO ASI thus provides access to a rich phase diagram only through geometric tuning, without requiring extreme experimental conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文在CaVO晶格（正方形与八边形组成）上构建人工自旋冰（artificial spin ice, ASI），通过仅调节正方形与八边形链长比r实现几何微调下的强相互作用调控。结合磁力显微镜（magnetic force microscopy）与蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulation），揭示了从类正方冰到类笼目（kagome）行为的连续过渡及多临界区域，并提出分离相互作用效应与单纳米磁体效应的磁测量协议。
AI.motivation: 既有ASI热力学研究主要集中于正方（square）与笼目（kagome）晶格及其变体，缺乏通过几何参数小幅变化来强烈调控相互作用并探索丰富相图的途径。论文旨在利用CaVO晶格实现无需极端实验条件、仅靠几何调节即可获得的相图。
AI.method: 采用CaVO晶格人工自旋冰，在固定晶格常数下以正方形与八边形链长比r作为调控参量，结合磁力显微镜（magnetic force microscopy）观测与蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulation），并用Blume-Capel模型描述八边形环向磁矩（toroidal moments），另设计对比磁测量（comparative magnetometry）协议。
AI.result: 小r时系统呈现单一有序化转变；大r时依次经历关联顺磁体（correlated paramagnet）、电荷有序（charge order）到长程有序（long-range order）。两种区域在多临界区域（multicritical region）交汇，且电荷有序区可映射为可调二聚体模型（dimer model），在两种有序二聚体相之间出现库仑相（Coulomb phase）与尖点（pinch points）。
AI.conclusion: CaVO人工自旋冰仅通过几何调节即可获得丰富相图，无需极端实验条件；所提磁测量协议可在热激活样品中区分相互作用效应与单纳米磁体效应，为ASI热力学与拓扑相研究提供新平台。

title: Alternative Tikhonov-Type Regularization for the Calderón Inverse Conductivity Problem
summary: This paper investigates the application of two regularization methods, classical Tikhonov and Alternative Tikhonov regularization, to the Calderón inverse conductivity problem. We develop an iterative reconstruction scheme based on linearizing the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map and approximating conductivity updates using Gaussian basis functions. The resulting linear systems are solved using both regularization methods, with particular attention given to the derivation and numerical implementation of Alternative Tikhonov regularization. We compare the performance of these methods through numerical experiments on a synthetic conductivity containing two localized regions of differing conductivity. A total of 666 reconstruction tests are performed across varying regularization parameters, damping factors, and iteration counts. The lowest relative reconstruction errors obtained are 0.064730 for Alternative Tikhonov and 0.065173 for classical Tikhonov regularization. Although both methods produce comparable reconstructions, Alternative Tikhonov achieves the lowest observed error. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of both approaches within the proposed reconstruction scheme and motivate further investigation into parameter selection, numerical stability, and reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文比较经典 Tikhonov 与 Alternative Tikhonov 两种正则化方法在 Calderón 逆电导问题中的迭代重建表现，在 666 组数值实验中两者重建误差接近，Alternative Tikhonov 取得最低相对误差 0.064730。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估两种正则化方法（regularization methods）在 Calderón 逆电导问题（Calderón inverse conductivity problem）迭代重建框架中的适用性与性能差异，并重点关注 Alternative Tikhonov 正则化的推导与数值实现。
AI.method: 基于 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 映射（Dirichlet-to-Neumann map）的线性化构建迭代重建方案，并用高斯基函数（Gaussian basis functions）近似电导率更新；所得线性系统分别采用经典 Tikhonov 与 Alternative Tikhonov 正则化求解，并进行数值实现。
AI.result: 在含两个不同电导率局部区域的合成电导率（synthetic conductivity）上共进行 666 次重建测试，遍历不同正则化参数、阻尼因子（damping factors）与迭代次数；最低相对重建误差为 Alternative Tikhonov 的 0.064730 与经典 Tikhonov 的 0.065173。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法均能给出可比的重建结果，Alternative Tikhonov 的观测误差最低，表明两者在所提重建方案中均有效；后续需进一步研究参数选择（parameter selection）、数值稳定性（numerical stability）与重建精度。

title: Calogero-Moser Polynomial Approximations and Dwork Congruences for Complete Flags
summary: We construct $p$-adic polynomial approximations to the zero-framing cohomological quasimap vertex of cotangent bundles to complete flag varieties from the trigonometric Calogero--Moser system. Negative integer couplings give regular staircase Jack polynomials with nonnegative integer coefficients. We compare them with complete-flag master polynomials extending the construction of Smirnov--Varchenko. Both families converge coefficientwise to the vertex and satisfy the full commuting equations modulo $p^s$. For $n\geq3$, we prove sharp degree-dependent congruences and compute leading residues at every $p$-power scale. Their discrepancy has coefficient norm $p^{-1}$ and an exact weighted Gauss norm giving uniform decay on smaller closed polydiscs. For the master family, multivariable Dwork congruences reconstruct the vertex by an infinite product. The results hold in every rank for $0<r/d\leq1/2$ and odd prime $p$.

AI.tldr: 本文从三角 Calogero–Moser 系统（trigonometric Calogero–Moser system）出发，构造了完全旗簇（complete flag varieties）余切丛的零标架上同调拟映射顶点（zero-framing cohomological quasimap vertex）的 p 进多项式逼近，并证明两类逼近族逐系数收敛且模 $p^s$ 满足完整对易方程。
AI.motivation: 研究目标是为完全旗簇余切丛的拟映射顶点提供 p 进（p-adic）多项式逼近，并将负整数耦合对应的阶梯 Jack 多项式（staircase Jack polynomials）与 Smirnov–Varchenko 型完全旗主多项式（complete-flag master polynomials）加以比较。
AI.method: 借助三角 Calogero–Moser 系统构造 p 进多项式逼近；负整数耦合给出系数为非负整数的正则阶梯 Jack 多项式；进而与完全旗主多项式族对比，并分析其在模 $p^s$ 下的对易方程、同余关系与残数。
AI.result: 两族均逐系数收敛到该顶点，且在模 $p^s$ 下满足完整对易方程；对 $n\geq3$ 证明了尖锐的依赖于次数的同余式（degree-dependent congruences），并在每个 p 幂尺度计算首项残数。两族差异的系数范数为 $p^{-1}$，并具有精确加权 Gauss 范数（weighted Gauss norm），在较小闭多圆盘上给出均匀衰减；主族通过多变量 Dwork 同余以无穷乘积重构顶点。
AI.conclusion: 结果对所有秩在 $0<r/d\leq1/2$ 范围及奇素数 $p$ 下成立，表明两族多项式逼近在 p 进意义下有效刻画该顶点，并给出其差异的定量衰减与同余结构。

title: Nonlinear kink modes for nonisentropic supersonic vortex sheets
summary: In this paper, planar nonisentropic vortex sheets of the two-dimensional Euler equations under the stability condition are studied via nonlinear geometric optics, focusing on the interaction induced by a small-amplitude, high-frequency incident wave impinging on a planar vortex sheet. It is found that there exist three asymmetric critical incident angles at which resonance occurs, leading to a significant amplification of the reflected and refracted oscillatory waves. Moreover, by refining the asymptotic expansion, we deduce that the leading profiles of the highly oscillatory waves are described by initial-boundary value problems for Burgers transport equations, while the leading profile of the contact discontinuity front satisfies an initial value problem for a Hamilton--Jacobi-type equation, which reduces to a forced linear transport equation on one resonant branch. These results extend the resonant amplification mechanism from the isentropic setting to the nonisentropic Euler flow and reveal the asymmetric influence of entropy variations on the nonlinear evolution of compressible vortex sheets.

AI.tldr: 该文借助非线性几何光学（nonlinear geometric optics）研究二维欧拉方程（2D Euler equations）非等熵平面涡片（nonisentropic vortex sheets）在稳定条件下的波-涡片相互作用，揭示三个非对称临界入射角（critical incident angles）引发的共振放大，并给出振荡波与接触间断前沿的极限方程（Burgers输运方程、Hamilton–Jacobi型方程）。
AI.motivation: 目的是将等熵情形下已知的共振放大机制推广到非等熵欧拉流，并考察熵变化对可压缩涡片非线性演化的影响。研究对象为小振幅、高频入射波撞击平面涡片所诱导的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用非线性几何光学（nonlinear geometric optics）方法，在稳定性条件下分析高频振荡波与平面涡片的相互作用；并通过细化渐近展开（asymptotic expansion）推导主导轮廓（leading profiles）所满足的极限方程。
AI.result: 发现存在三个非对称的临界入射角（critical incident angles），在其上发生共振，导致反射波与折射振荡波显著放大。进一步得到：高频振荡波的主导轮廓由Burgers输运方程（Burgers transport equations）的初边值问题描述；接触间断前沿（contact discontinuity front）的主导轮廓满足Hamilton–Jacobi型方程（Hamilton–Jacobi-type equation）的初值问题，该方程在某一共振分支上退化为受迫线性输运方程。
AI.conclusion: 结果将共振放大机制从等熵情形推广至非等熵欧拉流，并揭示了熵变化对可压缩涡片非线性演化的非对称影响。

title: Spacetime Emergence in the Memory of a Learning Agent
summary: We show that the causal structure of spacetime can emerge within the memory of a learning agent performing a quantum information task. We train a model-based reinforcement-learning agent to maximize the quantum mutual information between localized quantum probes interacting with a quantum field in Minkowski spacetime, without directly providing it with information regarding the spacetime metric or causal structure. In learning to accomplish this task, the reinforcement-learning agent constructs an internal predictive model whose planner develops the characteristic null structure of spacetime, allowing us to reconstruct the causal structure of the Minkowski metric with high accuracy. Within this task, spacetime geometry is obtained from an agent's successful predictions and actions, providing a first step toward showing that spacetime concepts emerge from operational quantum experience.

AI.tldr: 该研究训练一个基于模型的强化学习智能体（model-based reinforcement-learning agent），使其在闵可夫斯基时空（Minkowski spacetime）中通过量子探测与量子场相互作用来最大化局部量子互信息（quantum mutual information），在未获得度规或因果结构信息的前提下，其内部预测模型自发重建出高精度的时空零结构（null structure）与因果结构。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在探讨时空几何与因果结构能否从智能体的操作性量子经验（operational quantum experience）中涌现，而非作为先验输入被给定，从而为“时空概念源于经验”提供初步证据。
AI.method: 采用基于模型的强化学习（model-based reinforcement learning），令智能体在闵可夫斯基时空中与量子场相互作用的局域量子探测进行任务训练，目标是最大化量子互信息；训练中不向其提供任何时空度规（spacetime metric）或因果结构信息，仅考察其内部预测模型与规划器（planner）所构建的结构。
AI.result: 智能体学成任务后，其内部预测模型的规划器发展出时空特征的零结构（null structure），据此可高精度地重建闵可夫斯基度规的因果结构（causal structure）。
AI.conclusion: 时空几何可由智能体成功的预测与动作中获得，这表明时空概念有望从操作性量子经验中涌现，构成迈向该目标的第一步。

title: 2+1 flavor light hadron spectrum with PACS10 configurations
summary: We present the results for the hadron spectrum, the pseudoscalar meson decay constants, and the quark mass ratio in the continuum limit using the ``PACS10'' gauge configurations generated with the $O(a)$-improved Wilson quark action and the Iwasaki gauge action. Numerical simulations are carried out at three lattice spacings keeping the space-time volumes over (10 fm$)^4$ in 2+1 flavor QCD at the physical point. We calculate physical quantities with two choices of conventions to define pseudoexperimental values expected in the isosymmetric QCD. In order to investigate the finite size effects on the physical quantities we have additionally generated the (5.4 fm$)^4$ lattice at the coarsest lattice spacing of $a=0.08487(14)$~fm, which is a hypercube with half the length in each direction compared to the PACS10 configurations. While the finite size effect is hardly observed in comparison of the hadron effective masses on the (10.9 fm$)^4$ and (5.4 fm$)^4$ lattices, the results for the pseudoscalar meson decay constants show discrepancies beyond the error bars. The (5.4 fm$)^4$ lattice also serves for determining the expansion parameters of the pseudoscalar meson masses and decay constants, and the octet baryon masses in terms of the quark masses around the physical point with the aid of the mass reweighting technique. The expansion parameters are used for the fine-tuning of the physical point employing the pseudoexperimental masses of the $π$ meson, $K$ meson, and the $Ξ$ baryon as physical inputs in each convention. We compare the results for the octet baryon masses and the pseudoscalar decay constants in the continuum limit with the corresponding pseudoexperimental values in both conventions. We also discuss the deviation between two results with different conventions. As for the quark mass ratio the result is compared with the recent FLAG summary.

AI.tldr: 基于 PACS10 组态（(10 fm)⁴ 大体积、三种格距、2+1 味物理点 QCD），在连续极限下给出强子谱、赝标介子衰变常数与夸克质量比，并借助 (5.4 fm)⁴ 小体积格点评估有限体积效应及确定质量展开参数。
AI.motivation: 需在连续极限下以受控的有限体积效应检验格点 QCD 计算结果，并厘清不同"伪实验值"约定对强子谱、衰变常数和夸克质量比提取的影响。
AI.method: 采用 O(a) 改进 Wilson 夸克作用量与 Iwasaki 规范作用量生成的 PACS10 组态，在三种格距（体积均超过 (10 fm)⁴）上模拟 2+1 味物理点 QCD；另在 a=0.08487(14) fm 处生成 (5.4 fm)⁴ 格点，配合质量重加权（mass reweighting）技术确定介子质量/衰变常数与八重态重子质量关于夸克质量的展开参数，用于物理点精细调节。
AI.result: (10.9 fm)⁴ 与 (5.4 fm)⁴ 格点上的强子有效质量（effective mass）几乎无有限体积效应，但赝标介子衰变常数的差异超出误差棒；在两种约定下比较了连续极限的八重态重子质量与赝标衰变常数，并讨论了两种约定结果间的偏离；夸克质量比与近期 FLAG 总结进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 大体积 PACS10 组态支持连续极限外推的可靠结果；有限体积效应对衰变常数不可忽略而对照射强子质量不显著，且约定选择会带来系统性差异，需在结果解释中加以区分。

title: Local and global conservation laws of partial differential equations on moving domains in three dimensions
summary: For PDE systems in three spatial dimensions, firstly, a review of the various types of global conservation laws --- volumetric, surface-flux, circulatory --- is given using vector calculus, and their corresponding local forms --- divergence, curl, gradient --- are explained. Secondly, an extension of each type of conservation law to moving domains is presented, where the domain --- volume, surface, curve --- is transported by a prescribed velocity field. This provides a generalization of Reynolds' transport theorem known for material domains in which the velocity field is the fluid velocity. The main results are illustrated by numerous physical examples taken from gas dynamics, fluid flow, nonlinear acoustics, chemotaxis, plasma dynamics, and also Maxwell's equations, which do not involve any physically specified velocity field. As an additional main result, an extension of the multiplier method for finding local conservation laws of divergence-type is presented for local curl-type and gradient-type conservation laws on both static and moving domains.

AI.tldr: 该文以向量微积分系统梳理三维偏微分方程（PDE）系统中的体积型、通量型与环流型全局守恒律及其散度、旋度、梯度局部形式，并将各类守恒律推广至由给定速度场输运的移动区域，同时把乘子法（multiplier method）扩展到旋度型与梯度型局部守恒律。
AI.motivation: 现有文献对守恒律的讨论多集中于散度型（divergence-type）形式，且经典雷诺输运定理（Reynolds' transport theorem）仅适用于速度场为流体速度的材料区域，缺乏对旋度型、梯度型守恒律及任意给定速度场下移动区域的统一处理框架。
AI.method: 采用向量微积分（vector calculus）对体积、曲面通量与环流三类全局守恒律及其局部对应形式进行综述与统一表述；将区域（体、面、曲线）以给定速度场输运，构造适用于非材料移动区域的守恒律推广；并将乘子法扩展用于求解静态与移动区域上的局部旋度型和梯度型守恒律。
AI.result: 建立了三类守恒律在移动区域上的统一推广形式，作为雷诺输运定理的推广；通过气体动力学（gas dynamics）、流体流动、非线性声学、趋化性（chemotaxis）、等离子体动力学及麦克斯韦方程组（Maxwell's equations）等实例加以说明，其中麦克斯韦方程组不涉及物理指定的速度场；并给出旋度型与梯度型局部守恒律的乘子法扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为三维PDE系统中多类型守恒律提供了统一的向量微积分表述与移动区域推广，并将乘子法从散度型拓展至旋度型和梯度型，适用于含或不含物理速度场的广泛模型。

title: Mercury (Hg): a relativistic $N$-body simulation for Horndeski gravity
summary: We present Mercury, a relativistic $N$-body code for cosmological simulations in the $α$-basis formulation of Horndeski gravity. Mercury extends a particle-mesh scheme by incorporating the dynamics of the additional scalar degree of freedom and the corresponding modified Einstein equations, expressed in terms of the time-dependent functions $α_{\rm K}, α_{\rm B}, α_{\rm M}, α_{\rm T}$ and the effective Planck mass $M_*^2$. This generalises our previous implementation of Horndeski subclass models, namely $k$-essence and kinetic gravity braiding (KGB), to the general linear Horndeski $α$-basis. The code evolves the additional scalar degree of freedom and its effective stress--energy tensor alongside the nonlinear matter and metric fields, so that nonlinear structure formation sources the scalar-field evolution and feeds back on the gravitational potentials. Through its interface with hi_class, Mercury supports both phenomenological $α$-function parametrisations and covariant Horndeski theories; we demonstrate the latter using nKGB, the Cubic Galileon, and Brans--Dicke models. We validate the implementation against hi_class in the linear regime and recover the expected nonlinear $k$-essence and KGB limits. For the luminal Horndeski models considered here, we show how a running effective Planck mass generates gravitational slip through the scalar anisotropic stress and modifies the friction terms governing the vector and tensor metric perturbations. The evolution of $M_*^2$ also modifies the normalisation and scale dependence of the effective dark-energy density contrast, leaving a corresponding imprint on its power spectrum. The present framework provides an intermediate step towards nonlinear Horndeski simulations, in which nonlinear scalar self-interactions and screening effects can be incorporated consistently within the same relativistic framework.

AI.tldr: Mercury 是首个将 Horndeski 引力（Horndeski gravity）的广义 α-基（α-basis）完整实现于宇宙学非线性 N 体模拟的相对论性代码，可自洽演化额外标量自由度与非线性物质/度规场的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 已有的 Horndeski 模拟实现仅局限于子类模型（k-essence 与 kinetic gravity braiding, KGB），缺乏对一般线性 Horndeski α-基的支持，难以系统研究有效普朗克质量（effective Planck mass）演化等一般修正引力效应对非线性结构形成的影响。
AI.method: 在粒子网格（particle-mesh）方案基础上，Mercury 引入由时间依赖函数 α_K、α_B、α_M、α_T 及有效普朗克质量 M_*^2 描述的额外标量自由度动力学与修正爱因斯坦方程（modified Einstein equations），同步演化标量场、有效应力-能量张量（effective stress–energy tensor）以及非线性物质与度规场；并通过与 hi_class 的接口支持现象学 α-函数参数化与协变 Horndeski 理论（如 nKGB、Cubic Galileon、Brans–Dicke）。
AI.result: 代码在线性区与 hi_class 结果一致，并正确复现非线性 k-essence 与 KGB 极限；对光速（luminal）Horndeski 模型，发现跑动有效普朗克质量通过标量各向异性应力（scalar anisotropic stress）产生引力滑移（gravitational slip），并修正矢量与张量度规扰动的摩擦项，同时改变有效暗能量密度扰动（dark-energy density contrast）的归一化与尺度依赖，在功率谱（power spectrum）上留下印记。
AI.conclusion: 该框架构成通向完整非线性 Horndeski 模拟的中间步骤，为在同一相对论框架内一致纳入非线性标量自相互作用与屏蔽效应（screening effects）奠定基础。

title: Learning materials spectra across modalities and scales with structure-conditioned neural fields
summary: Spectroscopic observables encode rich information about material behavior across diverse, often high-dimensional domains of energy, momentum, and other experimental coordinates, providing critical insights into the physical properties underlying material functionalities and applications. However, learning these responses directly from atomic structures remains challenging due to the complexity of both structural configurations and spectroscopic observation spaces. Here, we develop a structure-conditioned neural-field framework that learns continuous spectroscopic response functions by coupling an equivariant structural encoder with a coordinate-conditioned network. The framework accurately predicts spectroscopic observables across diverse observation domains, ranging from one-dimensional densities of states to multidimensional scattering functions. We show that fine-tuning with limited spectral supervision captures strain- and composition-dependent spectral changes, with validated transfer to alloy configurations containing hundreds of atoms and computational scalability demonstrated for configurations exceeding $10^4$ atoms. Our work establishes a versatile and computationally scalable approach to learning structure-spectroscopy relationships, providing a foundation for spectroscopic analysis and future materials characterization, inverse problems, and experimental design.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以结构为条件（structure-conditioned）的神经场（neural-field）框架，将等变结构编码器（equivariant structural encoder）与坐标条件网络（coordinate-conditioned network）耦合，学习连续的光谱响应函数，可从原子结构直接预测跨观测域的光谱可观测物，并具备大规模计算可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 光谱可观测物（spectroscopic observables）编码了材料在能量、动量等高维观测空间中的丰富信息，对理解材料物理性质至关重要；但受结构构型与光谱观测空间双重复杂性的限制，直接从原子结构学习这些响应仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 构建结构条件化的神经场框架，将等变结构编码器与坐标条件网络耦合以学习连续的光谱响应函数；并通过有限光谱监督下的微调（fine-tuning）适配特定体系。
AI.result: 框架可准确预测从一维态密度（density of states）到多维散射函数（scattering functions）等多种观测域的光谱可观测物；有限光谱监督微调可捕捉应变与组分相关的谱变化，并验证了向含数百原子合金构型的迁移，且在超过10^4原子构型上展示了计算可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了学习结构—光谱关系（structure-spectroscopy relationships）的通用且计算可扩展方法，为光谱分析及未来材料表征、反问题（inverse problems）与实验设计奠定基础。

title: A Game of Scales
summary:
These notes cover the material of two courses given at SISSA, Trieste, in the academic years 2023-2024 and 2025-2026, together with some material from courses taught in other recent years. The original idea behind these courses emerged from conversations with Andrea Causin and Margherita Solci about the somewhat elusive notion of `multiscale behaviour', which arises in the study of variational problems involving one or more small parameters. Two main mechanisms govern their asymptotic behaviour: concentration and oscillations. Their description is often associated with the emergence of a characteristic `scale', quantifying either the speed of concentration or the period of an optimal oscillation. These mechanisms may originate from different variational principles and may occur separately, coexist, compete, or interact, thus providing a natural interpretation of the term `multiscale'. This perspective inspired the informal title of the courses, which also became the title of these notes.
  The natural framework for these analyses is $Γ$-convergence. However, these notes are not intended as a general introduction to this now well-established theory. We provide only a brief account of the techniques relevant to our purposes, referring the reader to the author's book chapter {\em A Handbook of $Γ$-convergence}. For a broader introduction to $Γ$-convergence, and in particular to its topological properties, the standard reference is Dal Maso's monograph {\em An Introduction to $Γ$-convergence}.

AI.tldr: 该讲义围绕变分问题中含一个或多个小参数情形下难以界定的“多尺度行为（multiscale behaviour）”概念组织内容，指出其渐近行为主要由集中（concentration）与振荡（oscillation）两种机制主导，并以Γ-收敛（Γ-convergence）为基本分析框架。
AI.motivation: 写作动机源于作者与Andrea Causin、Margherita Solci的讨论，旨在为研究含小参数的变分问题时出现的“多尺度行为”这一略显模糊的概念提供清晰刻画。
AI.method: 以Γ-收敛（Γ-convergence）作为自然分析框架，但对这一已成熟的理论仅作简要技术性介绍，并指向作者所著《A Handbook of Γ-convergence》章节及Dal Maso专著作为参考。
AI.result: 指出渐近行为由集中与振荡两种主要机制支配，二者均伴随特征“尺度（scale）”的出现——用于量化集中速度或最优振荡周期；这些机制可能源自不同的变分原理，并可能单独出现、共存、竞争或相互作用，从而构成“多尺度”的自然含义。
AI.conclusion: 讲义内容取自SISSA于2023-2024与2025-2026学年的两门课程及近年其他课程材料，其非正式课程名称即为“多尺度行为”，该名称亦成为讲义标题；讲义定位为专题技术性论述而非Γ-收敛的一般性导论。

title: Polarization instability of unpolarized excited states in trapped two-component Bose--Einstein condensates
summary: A binary Bose--Einstein condensate in an elongated trap supports unpolarized excited states, in which both components share the same spatial profile. Within mean-field theory we show that the interspecies repulsion at which these states demix rises with the excitation level. Since each component keeps its atom number, the components separate by moving in opposite directions in the trap, and demixing sets in when the interaction energy released by the separation balances its cost in kinetic and trap energy. We show that the threshold also marks the onset of an exponential, non-oscillating growth of the separation, which divides the cloud into domains of opposite polarization, with walls at the density nodes and further walls interlaced with them. In the Thomas--Fermi regime of a quasi-one-dimensional condensate the rise of the threshold follows power laws in the ratio of the trap oscillator energy to the chemical potential. The trap raises the ground-state threshold, in units of the intraspecies repulsion, by 1.82 times the square of this ratio. Each density node of an excited state near the trap center raises the threshold further by 1.24 times the cube of this ratio. Because the steps between successive levels scale as the cube of this ratio, they fall as the inverse square of the atom number, and the dependence on the excitation level is a mesoscopic effect, appreciable only when the chemical potential is no more than a few times the oscillator energy. In a hyperfine mixture of $^{87}$Rb a Feshbach resonance tunes the interspecies repulsion across the thresholds of the lowest states.

AI.tldr: 本文在平均场理论框架下研究细长阱中二元玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体的无极化激发态的相分离（demixing），证明种间排斥的失稳阈值随激发能级升高，且阈值同时标志分离呈指数非振荡增长，可用$^{87}$Rb超精细混合物的Feshbach共振检验。
AI.motivation: 细长阱中的二元玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体支持两分量共享同一空间分布的无极化激发态，但其在种间排斥下的稳定性与失稳机制尚缺乏系统刻画，尤其阈值如何依赖激发能级与阱几何有待澄清。
AI.method: 采用平均场理论（mean-field theory），以分离释放的相互作用能与动能、阱能代价的平衡确定失稳条件；并在准一维凝聚体的Thomas–Fermi区间推导阈值随阱振子能量与化学势之比的幂律（power laws）标度。
AI.result: 失稳阈值随激发能级升高；阈值处分离呈指数、非振荡增长，将云团分为极化相反的畴，畴壁位于密度节点（density nodes）并与之交错。Thomas–Fermi区间内，阱使基态阈值（以种内排斥为单位）升高该比值的平方的1.82倍，近阱心每个密度节点再升高其立方的1.24倍；相邻能级间距按该比值立方标度，故随原子数按平方反比下降。该能级依赖属介观效应（mesoscopic effect），仅在化学势不超过振子能量数倍时显著。
AI.conclusion: 无极化激发态的失稳阈值可由阱能与化学势之比定量预测，激发依赖性属介观尺度效应；在$^{87}$Rb超精细混合物中，Feshbach共振可调节种间排斥以跨越最低态的阈值，提供实验检验途径。

title: Nonlinear Dynamics in Periodically Distributed Fibre Amplification Systems
comment: To be published in Physics Letters A
summary: We investigate effects of longitudinally varying nonlinearity on periodically distributed amplification systems in optical fibres. Emphasis is made on configurations in which the nonlinear coefficient exponentially grows or decays along the propagation distance, while the group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) coefficient is held constant. Such systems are of practical relevance to the design of highly efficient nonlinear devices, including broadband light sources and advanced amplification schemes, where precise management of the interplay between the GVD, nonlinearity, and gain is essential. Adopting the known generic integrability condition, we derive exact analytical expressions for the evolution of the optical field in the presence of the tailored nonlinearity profiles and periodically distributed gain. The resulting periodic wavetrain solutions and their long-wave limit in the form of bright and dark solitons provide insight into the controlled enhancement or suppression of nonlinear effects under realistic amplification conditions. The robustness of these solutions is examined by introducing finite perturbations and directly evaluating their effects on the corresponding intensity profiles. The structural stability of solutions against deviations from the integrability condition is demonstrated too. Outcomes of this study contribute to a deeper understanding of the nonlinear pulse dynamics in engineered gain-managed fibres and offer guidance for the development of novel optical systems, where the spatial distribution of the nonlinearity is exploited to optimise the performance.

AI.tldr: 研究纵向变化非线性对光纤周期分布放大系统的影响，在群速度色散（GVD）系数恒定、非线性系数沿传播距离指数增长或衰减的条件下，借助已知的普适可积条件（integrability condition）推导光场演化的精确解析解，并分析其稳定性。
AI.motivation: 此类系统与高效非线性器件（如宽带光源和先进放大方案）的设计密切相关，其中GVD、非线性与增益之间相互作用的精确管理至关重要，因此需要理解定制非线性剖面下光场的演化规律。
AI.method: 以非线性系数指数增长或衰减、GVD恒定的周期分布放大系统为对象，采用已知的普适可积条件，推导含定制非线性剖面与周期分布增益时光场的精确解析表达式，并通过引入有限扰动及偏离可积条件的偏差来检验解的结构稳定性（structural stability）。
AI.result: 获得周期波列（periodic wavetrain）解及其长波极限下的亮孤子（bright soliton）与暗孤子（dark soliton）形式的精确解，据此揭示在实际放大条件下非线性效应的受控增强或抑制；有限扰动对强度剖面的直接影响及解对可积条件偏离的结构稳定性均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果加深了对工程化增益管理光纤中非线性脉冲动力学（nonlinear pulse dynamics）的理解，并为利用非线性空间分布优化性能的新型光学系统开发提供指导。

title: Universal Curve Counting in Calabi-Yau 4-folds
summary: Recently, Pardon introduced a universal curve counting framework, which allows him to show that curve counting on 3-folds is "generated" by local curves (in a precise sense). We implement this universal curve counting program for Calabi-Yau 4-folds, where a significant technical difficulty comes from the dependence of the virtual dimension on the genus, which leads to more complicated generators than just local curves. Our main techniques are combinations of deformation-theoretic and homotopy-theoretic methods with an adaptation of Pardon's generic transversality results, which allow us to establish a full set of (computable) generators for CY4 curve counting. As a result, we prove (a slight correction of) the Gromov-Witten/Pandharipande-Thomas correspondence with primary descendents for CY4-folds, formulated by Cao, Maulik, and Toda. From this, we additionally obtain integrality of Gopakumar-Vafa style invariants for CY4-folds, as conjectured by Klemm-Pandharipande.

AI.tldr: 该论文为 Calabi-Yau 4-folds（CY4）建立普适曲线计数框架，构造可计算的生成元，并据此证明带基本后代类的 GW/PT 对应及 GV 型不变量的整性。
AI.motivation: Pardon 的普适曲线计数框架已表明 3-folds 上的曲线计数由局部曲线（local curves）生成；本文旨在将该纲领推广到 Calabi-Yau 4-folds，其中虚拟维数（virtual dimension）依赖亏格，使生成元比局部曲线更复杂。
AI.method: 结合形变理论（deformation theory）与同伦理论（homotopy theory）方法，并改造 Pardon 的一般横截性（generic transversality）结果，构造 CY4 曲线计数的完整可计算生成元集合。
AI.result: 建立了 CY4 曲线计数的一整套可计算生成元，并证明了 Cao–Maulik–Toda 提出的带基本后代类（primary descendents）的 Gromov-Witten/Pandharipande-Thomas 对应（略作修正）。
AI.conclusion: 由上述结果进一步得到 CY4 的 Gopakumar-Vafa 型不变量（Gopakumar-Vafa style invariants）的整性（integrality），验证了 Klemm–Pandharipande 的猜想。

title: Theoretical Prediction of Superconducting 2D Hydrogenated Janus V2CSH and Nb2CSH MXenes
summary: Two dimensional hydrogenated Janus MXenes represent a new frontier in superconducting materials, where asymmetric surface terminations enable tunable electronic and vibrational properties. In this work, we present the first comparative study of hydrogen or sulfur terminated V2CSH and Nb2CSH monolayers using density functional theory and density functional perturbation theory. Both compounds are structurally and thermally stable, exhibiting isotropic in plane elasticity and nonmagnetic multiband metallic states dominated by transition metal d orbitals. The asymmetric S or H terminations generate nonequivalent surface potentials and intrinsic out of plane dipoles. Electron phonon coupling constants of 0.39 (V2CSH) and 0.53 (Nb2CSH) yield superconducting transition temperatures of 2.36 K and 5.27 K, respectively, within the Allen Dynes framework. Low energy lattice vibrations, primarily involving metal and sulfur atoms, account for 77% of the coupling in both MXenes. These findings establish metal substitution as a design principle for tuning superconductivity in Janus MXenes and highlight Nb2CSH as a promising candidate for low temperature superconducting applications.

AI.tldr: 该文首次对比研究氢/硫终止的Janus MXene单层V2CSH与Nb2CSH，二者结构热稳定、非磁多带金属性，电子-声子耦合常数分别为0.39和0.53，对应超导转变温度2.36 K与5.27 K，表明金属替代是调控Janus MXene超导性的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 二维氢化Janus MXene（Janus MXene）因非对称表面终止可调控电子与振动性质，被视为超导材料（superconducting materials）的新前沿；但对其终止方式与金属替代如何影响超导性缺乏系统的对比认识。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（density functional theory）与密度泛函微扰理论（density functional perturbation theory），首次对氢或硫终止的V2CSH与Nb2CSH单层进行对比计算，评估其结构/热稳定性、弹性、电子结构与电子-声子耦合（electron phonon coupling）。
AI.result: 两种化合物结构与热稳定，呈各向同性面内弹性（isotropic in plane elasticity）及由过渡金属d轨道主导的非磁多带金属态（nonmagnetic multiband metallic states）；非对称S/H终止产生不等价表面势与本征面外偶极。电子-声子耦合常数为0.39（V2CSH）与0.53（Nb2CSH），在Allen-Dynes框架下给出超导转变温度2.36 K与5.27 K；低能晶格振动（主要涉及金属与硫原子）贡献了77%的耦合。
AI.conclusion: 金属替代可作为调控Janus MXene超导性的设计原则，Nb2CSH是低温超导应用（low temperature superconducting applications）的有前景候选材料。

title: Enriched Surface Thermodynamics for Sharp-Interface Fluid Models
summary:
A sharp interface can retain material and structural information about an unresolved fluid transition zone. We formulate a local thermodynamic framework for isotropic surfaces carrying constituent surface mass densities and a thickness descriptor. The distinction between densities of additive contents and internal descriptors determines the area conjugate, reversible surface stress, and Gibbs-Duhem relation. A volume-per-area thickness has a pressure-like conjugate, a mechanical work contribution, and a separate evolution equation. Independent, constrained, and rapidly equilibrating thicknesses require different kinematics and reductions. Material storage can be retained without retaining surface inertia.
  The balances and entropy production specify admissible exchange and structural relaxation. For a moving surface patch, an available-free-energy identity accounts for mechanical power and for the contributions of material and structural fluxes across its boundary. Equilibrium reduction retains the production and transport needed to follow the reduced state. An explicit mass-thickness free energy has a positive-definite material Hessian and gives coupled adsorption, expansion, compression, and dissipative relaxation. Pressure response yields conditional restrictions on reduced states and demonstrates that distinct independent and constrained states can share an entire pressure-tension curve. Geometric thickness realizations and finite-rate transfer are treated with their associated mechanical and balance requirements. The framework separates state selection, constitutive closure, reduction, and identification from observations.

AI.tldr: 本文为各向同性（isotropic）尖锐界面建立了局部热力学（local thermodynamic framework）框架，界面携带组分表面质量密度（constituent surface mass densities）与厚度描述符（thickness descriptor）。框架区分加和性内容密度与内部描述符，导出面积共轭量（area conjugate）、可逆表面应力与Gibbs-Duhem关系，并给出厚度演化的独立方程。
AI.motivation: 尖锐界面（sharp interface）可能保留未解析流体过渡区的材料与结构信息，但需要一个能够同时刻画材料储存与结构（厚度）变量的严格热力学表述，以区分独立、受约束与快速平衡等不同厚度运动学（kinematics）。
AI.method: 建立局部热力学表述：将密度分为加和性内容与内部描述符，推导面积共轭量、可逆表面应力与Gibbs-Duhem关系；以单位面积体积（volume-per-area thickness）作为厚度度量，赋予类压力共轭量、机械功贡献及独立演化方程；通过平衡与熵产（entropy production）约束交换与结构松弛，并构建运动表面片上的可用自由能（available-free-energy）恒等式。
AI.result: 显式质量-厚度自由能（mass-thickness free energy）具有正定材料Hessian（positive-definite material Hessian），给出耦合的吸附（adsorption）、膨胀、压缩与耗散松弛；压力响应给出对约化状态（reduced states）的条件性限制，并证明不同的独立态与约束态可共享整条压力-张力曲线（pressure-tension curve）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在无需保留表面惯性（surface inertia）的条件下保留材料储存，并将状态选择、本构闭合（constitutive closure）、约化（reduction）与基于观测的辨识彼此分离；几何厚度实现与有限速率传递（finite-rate transfer）可连同其力学与平衡要求一并处理。

title: Superinsulation, electric confinement in condensed matter
summary: Superinsulation is the confining phase of condensed matter systems. It is a genuine quantum state of matter, dual to superconductivity, just as confinement in particle physics is dual to the Higgs phase. In contrast to hadron physics, the gauge field that becomes confining is not colour SU(3) but the conventional U(1) electromagnetic field. Superinsulation arises in superconductors with an emergent granular condensate when core-less XY vortices between condensate grains become tensionless, unobservable Dirac strings and magnetic monopoles are liberated and condense. This magnetic condensate confines electric fields into flux tubes, strings that generate a linear potential between Cooper pairs. These dual Abrikosov flux tubes give rise to infinite electrical resistance, persisting up to a finite deconfinement temperature. We shall review the theoretical framework of superinsulation together with its experimental validation, including the direct observation of the linear confining potential and we shall stress how phase-only approaches and disorder-based ideas for the phases around the superconductor-to-insulator transition are hard to reconcile with recent experimental observations.

AI.tldr: 该综述将“超绝缘（superinsulation）”界定为凝聚态体系的禁闭相，是超导（superconductivity）的量子对偶态，其禁闭规范场为常规U(1)电磁场而非粒子物理中的颜色SU(3)。文中系统梳理了超绝缘的理论框架与实验验证，并指出仅相位（phase-only）方案与无序（disorder）图像难以与近期实验相符。
AI.motivation: 既有关于超导—绝缘转变（superconductor-to-insulator transition）附近物相的解释多依赖仅相位方法或无序机制，摘要指出这些思路与最新实验观察难以调和，因而需要以对偶禁闭（confinement）视角重新审视该相图。
AI.method: 采用理论综述与实验对照相结合的方式：建立超绝缘的对偶规范理论框架，并汇总其包括线性禁闭势（linear confining potential）直接观测在内的实验验证。
AI.result: 在具有涌现颗粒凝聚体（emergent granular condensate）的超导体中，凝聚颗粒间的无芯XY涡旋（core-less XY vortices）变为无张力的不可观测Dirac弦，磁单极子（magnetic monopoles）被释放并凝聚；该磁凝聚将电场限制为通量管（flux tube），在库珀对（Cooper pairs）间产生线性势，形成对偶Abrikosov通量管，导致直至有限退禁闭温度（deconfinement temperature）仍持续的无穷大电阻。
AI.conclusion: 超绝缘作为电磁场的禁闭相，其理论框架已获实验支持，尤其体现为线性禁闭势的直接观测；相比之下，仅相位方法与基于无序的解释难以与近期实验结果相协调。

title: Covariance-dependent participation scaling of Comtet disorder on open hyperbolic lattices
summary: Negative curvature makes the electrostatic Green function decay exponentially, producing a finite disorder-variance budget even as radial volume grows exponentially. We investigate whether this near-field concentration also determines wave-function participation on open hyperbolic lattices. A Gaussian control preserves the full one-site distribution of Comtet disorder at every vertex while removing its off-diagonal covariance. Complete-window participation ratios on $\{7,3\}$ graphs with $N=847,2240,5887$ yield an effective-exponent difference of $-0.028$ at $W/t=0.5$ and $+0.116$ at $W/t=3$; both signs persist upon extending to $N=15435$. Size-resolved squared-kernel radii lie near $2.45\ell$ on the larger graphs of this sequence, below the cutoff-matched continuum value $3.12\ell$. Distance-shell weights resolve the finite discrete measure associated with this shift, while higher participation moments and spacing ratios characterize the accompanying wave-function and spectral structure. A marginal-matched exponential-kernel family gives positive exponent contrasts at all five sampled kernel lengths at $W/t=0.5,3$, separating the Comtet response from a description based on the decay length alone. These results distinguish a concentrated variance budget from the covariance-dependent participation response of finite open hyperbolic systems.

AI.tldr: 该文考察负曲率双曲晶格上无序（disorder）近场集中是否也支配波函数参与比（participation ratio）。通过高斯对照保留 Comtet 无序的完整单点分布而去除其非对角协方差，在 {7,3} 图上得到不同无序强度下符号相反的有效指数差，表明集中方差预算与协方差依赖的参与响应可相区分。
AI.motivation: 负曲率使静电格林函数（electrostatic Green function）指数衰减，即便径向体积指数增长仍产生有限的方差预算；作者欲检验这种近场集中是否同样决定开放双曲晶格上的波函数参与行为。
AI.method: 采用高斯对照（Gaussian control）构造：在每个格点保留 Comtet 无序的完整单点分布、去除其非对角协方差（off-diagonal covariance）。在 N=847、2240、5887（并扩展至 15435）的 {7,3} 图上计算全窗口参与比、尺寸分辨的平方核半径、距离壳层权重、高阶参与矩与能级间距比（spacing ratios），并构造边缘匹配的指数核族作对照。
AI.result: 有效指数差在 W/t=0.5 时为 -0.028，在 W/t=3 时为 +0.116，两种符号在扩展至 N=15435 后均保持；较大图上的平方核半径接近 2.45ℓ，低于截止匹配的连续极限值 3.12ℓ。边缘匹配指数核族在全部五个采样核长度上于 W/t=0.5 与 3 均给出正的指数对比。
AI.conclusion: 结果将有限开放双曲系统中的“集中方差预算”与“协方差依赖的参与响应”区分开来，说明仅凭衰减长度不足以描述 Comtet 无序的响应。

title: Two-scale estimates for limit-periodic Schrödinger operators
summary: We prove strong ballistic transport for one-dimensional continuum Schrödinger operators by comparing the spectral geometry at two consecutive periods. Enlarging a period decomposes each fiber into the eigenspaces of translation by the smaller cell. Away from the larger-period symmetry momenta, a simple ordered band remains in one translation sector and agrees with one translated smaller-period band. This permits us to combine large-period ordering and non-overlap with a smaller-period derivative bound. We obtain lower bounds for folded band widths and confine all near-collisions to a common neighborhood of the symmetry momenta, with the exponential cost at the smaller period. For nested periods $p_n$ with $p_{n+1}/p_n\in\mathbb{N}$ and $p_{n+1}\ge2p_n$, approximation errors $o(p_{n+1}^{-2}e^{-ηp_n})$, where $η>7\sqrt{2R}$ and $\|V\|_\infty\le R$, give a nonzero strong asymptotic velocity on a weighted $H^2$ class containing the Schwartz space. Every position moment of order $0<r\le4$ has two-sided ballistic growth. A period-uniform form estimate, ordered-gap summation, and a linear dynamical comparison complete the argument. No upper bound on successive period ratios is assumed, and the sufficient approximation exponents are not claimed to be optimal.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了一维连续薛定谔算子（continuum Schrödinger operators）在加权 H² 类上的强弹道输运（strong ballistic transport）。方法是通过比较两个相邻周期的谱几何，结合大周期排序与非重叠性和小周期导数界，得到折叠带宽下界与近碰撞的局域化控制。
AI.motivation: 研究一维连续薛定谔算子的弹道输运现象，需在不假设相邻周期比上界的前提下，建立位置矩的两侧弹道增长，并刻画由周期逼近误差与势函数上界控制的条件。
AI.method: 将较大周期分解到较小周期平移的本征空间（eigenspaces of translation），在远离较大周期对称动量（symmetry momenta）处识别出与较小周期能带对应的有序单能带；再结合大周期排序与非重叠、小周期导数界、周期一致形式估计（period-uniform form estimate）、有序能隙求和（ordered-gap summation）与线性动力学比较（linear dynamical comparison）完成论证。
AI.result: 对嵌套周期 p_n（p_{n+1}/p_n∈ℕ 且 p_{n+1}≥2p_n），在逼近误差 o(p_{n+1}^{-2}e^{-ηp_n})（η>7√(2R)，‖V‖_∞≤R）条件下，于含 Schwartz 空间（Schwartz space）的加权 H² 类上得到非零强渐近速度（strong asymptotic velocity）；阶数 0<r≤4 的每个位置矩均具有两侧弹道增长（ballistic growth）。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明周期比较方法可有效证明一维连续模型的强弹道输运，且无需假设相邻周期比的上界；作者明确未声称所给充分逼近指数（approximation exponents）为最优。

title: Superradiance fingerprints of moiré exciton-biexciton condensates: path-entangled biphoton vs. supercurrent-enabled one-photon channel
summary: Hybrid moiré excitons form a dense array of electrically tunable single-photon emitters, entailing cooperative optical responses with intriguing consequences. With the strong dipole-dipole interaction, they also realize Bose-Hubbard quantum simulators of emergent correlated matter such as Bose-Einstein condensates (BEC). Here we reveal the characteristic cooperative radiation from condensates of hybrid moiré excitons in twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayers. In each individual moiré trap, the layer hybridization selection rule dictates that the ground-state exciton is a quantum emitter of orbital-angular-momentum photons, with an exceptionally long radiative lifetime. Ground-state emission becomes pronounced only upon forming condensates, where inter-sublattice dipole attraction and intra-sublattice repulsion together lead to the coexistence of exciton and biexciton BEC with comparable weights. The biexciton (molecular-type) BEC decays through superradiance of path-entangled biphotons, whereas the exciton (atomic-type) BEC is dark at rest and becomes superradiant when it carries a supercurrent. Our findings not only uncover a novel source of entangled light but also establish unique fingerprints for exploring the cold chemistry of atomic-molecular condensates with moiré excitons.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示扭转MoTe₂双层中杂化莫尔激子（hybrid moiré excitons）凝聚体的协同辐射特性，指出激子型与双激子型BEC共存并分别以超辐射方式产生路径纠缠双光子。
AI.motivation: 杂化莫尔激子兼具可电调单光子发射与强偶极-偶极相互作用，可构建Bose-Hubbard量子模拟器研究BEC等关联物质，但其凝聚态下的协同辐射行为尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示其特征辐射机制。
AI.method: 以扭转MoTe₂双层为平台，基于层杂化选择定则分析单个莫尔势阱中基态激子的轨道角动量光子发射与超长辐射寿命，并结合子晶格间偶极吸引与子晶格内排斥讨论凝聚形成条件与辐射行为。
AI.result: 单个莫尔势阱中基态激子辐射极弱，仅在形成凝聚后显著增强；子晶格间吸引与子晶格内排斥导致激子BEC与双激子BEC以相当权重共存。双激子（分子型）BEC通过路径纠缠双光子的超辐射衰减，激子（原子型）BEC静止时为暗态、携带超电流时转为超辐射。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一类新型纠缠光源，并为利用莫尔激子探索原子-分子凝聚体的冷化学（cold chemistry）提供了独特指纹。

title: Maximum purity of absolutely separable and absolutely PPT states in qutrit--qudit systems
summary: A bipartite state is absolutely positive partial transpose (APPT) if it remains PPT under every global unitary transformation, and absolutely separable if it remains separable. For every qutrit--qudit system $\mathbb{C}^3\otimes\mathbb{C}^n$, $n\ge3$, we prove that the maximum purity is the same for absolutely separable and APPT states and equals $\max\{(3n+8)/(3n+2)^2,\,3/(8n)\}$. The maximizing ordered spectrum is unique and contains exactly two distinct eigenvalues: the larger one has multiplicity one for $3\le n\le8$ and multiplicity $n$ for $n\ge9$. We also derive, in terms of the purity, an upper bound on the minimum partial-transpose eigenvalue achievable by global unitary transformations, and characterize all states for which the bound is attained. These results confirm the inscribed-polytope purity conjecture of Ahiable, Kothakonda, and Winter for all qutrit--qudit systems. They also give a lower bound, sharp over explicit purity ranges, on the global depolarizing noise needed for absolute separability or APPT.

AI.tldr: 该论文确定了所有 qutrit–qudit 系统（qutrit–qudit system，即 ℂ³⊗ℂⁿ）中绝对可分态（absolutely separable state）与绝对正部分转置态（absolutely positive partial transpose, APPT）的最大纯度（purity），并给出其唯一最优有序谱（ordered spectrum）结构。
AI.motivation: 绝对可分性与 APPT 性是比标准可分性更强的性质，其可达纯度的上界此前仅有猜想（inscribed-polytope purity conjecture），缺乏对 qutrit–qudit 系统的完整证明。
AI.method: 通过对 ℂ³⊗ℂⁿ（n≥3）系统的谱优化分析，比较绝对可分态与 APPT 态的最大纯度，并推导纯度与全局酉变换（global unitary transformation）下最小部分转置特征值之间的定量关系。
AI.result: 两类态的最大纯度相同，等于 max{(3n+8)/(3n+2)², 3/(8n)}；最优有序谱唯一且仅含两个不同特征值，较大者重数在 3≤n≤8 时为 1、在 n≥9 时为 n。此外得到最小部分转置特征值的纯度上界及取等条件。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实了 Ahiable、Kothakonda 与 Winter 提出的 inscribed-polytope purity 猜想，并给出实现绝对可分或 APPT 所需全局去极化噪声（global depolarizing noise）的紧下界。

title: Second-order evolution of spin shear tensor for massive spin-1/2 particles
summary: We present the second-order evolution equation for the spin shear component of the spin tensor in spin-polarized fluids, using a classical description of the spin degrees of freedom. Employing a semi-classical kinetic theory for the massive spin-1/2 particles within the relaxation time approximation we obtain a relaxation-type equation describing the evolution of spin shear driven by various thermodynamic forces and high-order gradient corrections. This equation yields a new set of transport coefficients that govern the dynamics of the dissipative spin-shear tensor.

AI.tldr: 本文在经典自旋自由度框架下，推导了自旋极化流体（spin-polarized fluids）中自旋张量（spin tensor）自旋剪切分量（spin shear component）的二阶演化方程，并由此得到一组控制耗散自旋剪切张量（dissipative spin-shear tensor）动力学的新输运系数（transport coefficients）。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是建立自旋极化流体中自旋剪切分量的二阶演化描述，以刻画耗散性自旋输运的动力学行为，弥补该方面演化方程与输运系数的缺失。
AI.method: 采用自旋自由度的经典描述（classical description），基于大质量自旋-1/2 粒子（massive spin-1/2 particles）的半经典动理学理论（semi-classical kinetic theory），并在弛豫时间近似（relaxation time approximation）下进行推导。
AI.result: 得到描述自旋剪切演化的弛豫型方程（relaxation-type equation），其演化由多种热力学力（thermodynamic forces）与高阶梯度修正（high-order gradient corrections）共同驱动，并给出一组新的输运系数。
AI.conclusion: 自旋剪切分量的二阶演化可由弛豫型方程描述，其中热力学力与高阶梯度修正起驱动作用；相应的新输运系数决定了耗散自旋剪切张量的动力学。该结论限于半经典、弛豫时间近似框架。

title: Fredholm approximations to the Bethe-Salpeter equation with spherical-Bessel kernels for Wannier-Mott excitons
summary: We develop a deterministic radial approximation to the static Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE), designed for rapid preliminary screening of Wannier-Mott exciton binding across direct-gap bulk materials. The approximation replaces the electron-hole transition problem by small radial eigenvalue problems that require no stochastic sampling. Starting from the four-point BSE and its matrix representation in a Bloch electron-hole basis, we retain one valence and one conduction band in the effective-mass limit within the Tamm-Dancoff approximation. We introduce a central projection of the screened direct interaction and omit bare electron-hole exchange.
