AI.result: 埋入界面存在与刚性堆垛几何莫尔（geometric moiré）不同的周期性结构重构，并呈现类头对头（head-to-head-like）极性畸变、莫尔调制的Ti电子结构，以及在本征顺电绝缘SrTiO3中增强的微波导纳（microwave admittance）。
AI.conclusion: 在终止明确的前提下，莫尔重构（moiré reconstruction）可作为在扭角钙钛矿氧化物（twisted perovskite oxides）中诱导新兴电学行为的一条途径。

title: Observation of Superconductivity in a Cu-Rich High-Entropy Alloy
summary: A Cu-rich multielement alloy containing Zn, Sn, Ag, and Au was synthesized and studied to explore its structural and physical properties. The alloy was prepared by vacuum-sealed melting of high-purity elements followed by rapid quenching in cold water. Powder X-ray diffraction confirms that the alloy crystallizes in a face-centered cubic (fcc) Cu-type structure. Field-emission scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping show uniform distribution of all constituent elements. Magnetic measurements indicate the appearance of a superconducting transition at low temperature, while electrical resistivity remains metallic without reaching zero resistance. This difference between magnetic and transport behaviour suggests that the superconducting state may be limited to local or partial regions within the sample. These findings indicate that the Cu-rich multielement alloy exhibits unusual low-temperature properties and may represent a new class of compositionally complex Cu-based materials with superconducting characteristics.

AI.tldr: 该研究合成了一种含Zn、Sn、Ag和Au的富铜多组元合金（multielement alloy），确认其具有面心立方（fcc）Cu型结构且元素分布均匀，低温下出现超导转变但电阻率未归零，暗示超导态可能局限于局部区域。
AI.motivation: 探索富铜多组元合金的结构与物理性质，并考察其是否可作为一类新的成分复杂铜基超导材料（compositionally complex Cu-based materials）。
AI.method: 采用高纯元素真空密封熔炼（vacuum-sealed melting）后于冷水中快速淬火（rapid quenching）制备样品；通过粉末X射线衍射（powder X-ray diffraction）、场发射扫描电子显微镜（field-emission scanning electron microscopy）及能谱（EDS）面分布分析结构与成分均匀性，并进行磁性与电阻率测量。
AI.result: XRD确认合金为面心立方（fcc）Cu型结构，EDS映射显示各组成元素分布均匀；磁性测量显示低温出现超导转变（superconducting transition），而电阻率保持金属性（metallic）且未达到零电阻。
AI.conclusion: 磁性与输运行为的差异表明超导态可能仅限于样品的局部或部分区域；该富铜多组元合金表现出异常的低温柔性（unusual low-temperature properties），有望成为具有超导特征的新型成分复杂铜基材料。

title: Electrically tunable moiré hybridization in scalable twist-with-a-spacer structures
summary: Moiré superlattices emerge from the interplay between interlayer hybridization and long-wavelength periodicity, both set by the twist angle between layers in direct contact. Here we show that moiré minibands and pronounced Brown-Zak oscillations persist even when twisted graphene layers are separated by an atomically thin spacer, such as a misaligned graphene monolayer. This twist-with-a-spacer architecture reduces interlayer coupling, such that moiré hybridization can be tuned with a modest displacement field without changing moiré periodicity, allowing us to disentangle the roles of those parameters in miniband formation. Importantly, the spacer suppresses atomic relaxation, enabling highly uniform, rigid superlattices at twist angles down to ~0.1 degree. This robustness allows twist-with-a-spacer structures to be grown directly by scalable chemical vapour deposition (CVD): devices fabricated from CVD-grown structures exhibit the same moiré physics phenomena as those assembled manually. Our work provides insights into the physics of moiré bandstructure formation and opens a route towards scalable moiré systems.

AI.tldr: 通过在扭转石墨烯层间插入原子级厚度间隔层（spacer，如取向失配的石墨烯单层），仍可观察到莫尔微带（moiré minibands）与显著的Brown-Zak振荡；该结构降低层间耦合、抑制原子弛豫，并支持用CVD可规模化制备。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为莫尔超晶格（moiré superlattices）由直接接触层间杂化与扭转角决定的长波长周期性共同产生，层间耦合与周期难以独立调控，且小扭转角下原子弛豫导致超晶格不均匀，限制规模化制备。
AI.method: 提出"扭转加间隔层"（twist-with-a-spacer）架构：在扭转石墨烯层之间插入原子级薄间隔层（如取向失配的石墨烯单层），以降低层间耦合，并用适度的位移场（displacement field）调控莫尔杂化而不改变莫尔周期；同时采用可规模化的化学气相沉积（chemical vapour deposition, CVD）直接生长该结构并制备器件。
AI.result: 在含间隔层的结构中仍观测到莫尔微带与明显的Brown-Zak振荡；间隔层抑制原子弛豫，使扭转角低至约0.1度时仍保持高度均匀的刚性超晶格；CVD生长结构所制器件表现出与手工堆叠器件相同的莫尔物理现象。
AI.conclusion: 该工作区分了层间杂化与莫尔周期性在微带形成中的各自作用，深化了对莫尔能带结构（moiré bandstructure）形成的理解，并为可规模化莫尔体系提供了一条路径。

title: Galilean electrodynamics fluctuation in a superfluid: from general coordinate invariance to Tkachenko mode
summary: We explore coupling the Galilean electrodynamics (GED) to an s-wave superfluid. Governed by the general coordinate invariance, the proposed effective Lagrangian hosts an unconventional superfluid whose mass is shifted by the GED gauge multiplet. We compute its electromagnetic and gravitational responses in the linear regime. In the long-wavelength limit, we discover a vanishing pressure response, and remarkably the collective mode assumes a quadratic dispersion relation reminiscent of the Tkachenko mode in an oscillating vortex lattice in (2+1) dimensions. We further demonstrate that the soft sector of the vortex lattice model is a GED in disguise, and illustrate the relation between the gauge multiplet and the Lifshitz scalar in the lowest-Landau-level regime of the vortex lattice.

AI.tldr: 将伽利略电动力学（Galilean electrodynamics, GED）与s波超流体耦合，构造受广义坐标不变性支配的有效拉格朗日量，发现质量被GED规范多重态移动的非传统超流体，其长波集体模呈二次色散，类似(2+1)维振荡涡旋晶格中的Tkachenko模。
AI.motivation: 探究伽利略电动力学（GED）与s波超流体的耦合，并借助广义坐标不变性构造有效理论，以刻画非传统超流体的电磁与引力响应及其集体激发行为。
AI.method: 在广义坐标不变性（general coordinate invariance）约束下提出有效拉格朗日量（effective Lagrangian），在线性响应区域计算电磁响应与引力响应（gravitational responses），并在长波极限下分析集体模色散；进一步对照涡旋晶格模型的软模部分。
AI.result: 所得超流体的质量被GED规范多重态（gauge multiplet）移动；长波极限下压强响应（pressure response）消失，集体模呈二次色散关系（quadratic dispersion relation），类似(2+1)维振荡涡旋晶格中的Tkachenko模。
AI.conclusion: 涡旋晶格模型的软模部分（soft sector）实质上是伪装的GED，并阐明在涡旋晶格的最低朗道能级（lowest-Landau-level）区域，规范多重态与Lifshitz标量场之间的关系。

title: For any static interaction the self-energy and vertex corrections to the electron-gas polarizability combine exactly into one integrand free of the Coulomb singularity
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, plus 1 page of supplementary material
summary: The first-order corrections to the polarizability of the uniform electron gas are a self-energy insertion and a vertex correction. For the Coulomb interaction the coefficient of q^2 in each diverges logarithmically at small wave vector, and the two divergences have opposite signs and cancel in their sum. This Note shows that for any interaction that depends only on the momentum it transfers, the two integrands combine exactly into one before any integration is done. At zero temperature the combined integrand has no Coulomb singularity and no chemical-potential counterterm. For screened interactions, which must be integrated numerically, it should be computed in place of the two diagrams. The Note gives the derivation and its physical reason, the one term added at finite temperature, and checks for bare, Yukawa and screened interactions. With a frequency-dependent interaction the combination is no longer exact.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，均匀电子气（uniform electron gas）极化率的一阶修正——自能插入（self-energy insertion）与顶点修正（vertex correction）——对于仅依赖动量转移的任意相互作用，可在积分前精确合并为单一被积函数，从而避免库仑情形下对数发散的两项相互抵消的处理困难。
AI.motivation: 库仑相互作用下，两项一阶修正中 q^2 项系数在小波矢处各自对数发散，虽符号相反可相加抵消，但分开计算时需处理发散与抵消问题，作者希望从被积函数层面直接消除该困难。
AI.method: 证明对任何仅依赖于所传递动量的相互作用，两个图（自能插入与顶点修正）的被积函数可在任何积分之前精确合并为一个表达式；给出推导及其物理原因，并针对裸库仑、Yukawa 与屏蔽（screened）相互作用进行检验，另讨论有限温度下需补充的一项。
AI.result: 合并后的被积函数在零温下不含库仑奇异性，也无需化学势抵消项（chemical-potential counterterm）；对必须数值积分的屏蔽相互作用，应以该合并表达式替代计算两个独立图。频率依赖的相互作用下该合并不再严格成立。
AI.conclusion: 该合并为极化率一阶修正的计算提供了更简洁、数值上更稳健的方案，其适用边界是相互作用仅依赖于动量转移且不依赖频率。

title: Topological origin of the Gutenberg-Richter law: Dynamic decoupling of fault cascades and energy dissipation
summary: The Gutenberg-Richter (G-R) law is seismology's most robust empirical regularity, yet a first-principles derivation of its slope-the b-value-has remained elusive. Here, we present an analytical theory based on a finite hierarchical fault network composed of velocity-weakening asperities separated by velocity-strengthening creeping zones. By coupling network topology with fracture mechanics, we derive a generalized closed-form expression of b-value,$\(b=\frac{3}{3+2γ}\frac{\log_{10}k}{\log_{10}q}\)$, where k is the threshold branching ratio and q is the area amplification factor. Crucially, we reveal a dynamic decoupling between k and q governed by energy dissipation. The empirical universality of b=1 naturally emerges as the fault network self-organizes into a critical attractor (k=q) that maximizes two-dimensional spatial filling. Furthermore, grounded in Rate-and-State Friction rheology, we demonstrate that foreshock acceleration (inverse-Omori) and aftershock decay (Omori-Utsu) are dual manifestations of the similar hierarchical cascade. In the mean-field limit, these temporal exponents are decoupled from static fracture energy, revealing a profound orthogonality between time-dependent friction and static energy release. By unifying the G-R law, Bath's law, and the foreshock-aftershock asymmetry, this framework might provide a physics-based pathway for operational earthquake forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于有限层级断层网络（hierarchical fault network）的解析理论，从网络拓扑与断裂力学耦合出发，导出地震 G-R 律 b 值的闭式表达式，并揭示其普适性 b=1 源于断层网络自组织临界吸引子。
AI.motivation: G-R 律是地震学最稳健的经验规律，但其斜率（b 值）缺乏第一性原理推导，这一空白长期未解，构成本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 构建由速度弱化凹凸体（velocity-weakening asperities）与速度强化蠕滑区交替构成的有限层级断层网络，将网络拓扑与断裂力学（fracture mechanics）耦合，并结合速率-状态摩擦（Rate-and-State Friction）流变学，进行解析推导。
AI.result: 得到广义闭式 b 值表达 b=(3/(3+2γ))·(log₁₀k/log₁₀q)，其中 k 为阈值分支比、q 为面积放大因子；发现二者受能量耗散控制而动态解耦，b=1 的普适性对应网络自组织至 k=q 的临界吸引子；并证明前震加速（inverse-Omori）与余震衰减（Omori-Utsu）为同一层级级联的对偶表现。
AI.conclusion: 在平均场极限下时间指数与静态断裂能解耦，体现时变摩擦与静态能量释放的正交性；该框架统一了 G-R 律、Bath 律及前震-余震不对称性，或可为业务化地震预报提供基于物理的路径。

title: Magnetically and electrically tunable nonlinear Hall effect in Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets
summary: Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets can exhibit multiferroicity with coexisting ferroelectricity and magnetic order, and thus host multiple order-parameter configurations. However, how to electrically read out these configurations is an issue meriting further investigation. Here, by combining tight-binding and first-principles calculations, we propose electrically and magnetically tunable nonlinear Hall transport in ferroelectric Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets. Model calculations show that ferroelectric switching can reverse the sign of the Berry curvature dipole (BCD), whereas the Neel vector rotation modulates its magnitude, allowing both ferroelectric and magnetic order to be reflected in the nonlinear Hall signal. First-principles calculations of the VOCl2 monolayer confirm these behaviors and predict a sizable BCD that gives rise to a potentially detectable Hall voltage. Our findings open up opportunities to integrate electrical and magnetic modulations of the nonlinear Hall effect within a single material, with potential applications in multi-state information encoding and readout in antiferromagnetic spintronics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在铁电性 Tt 对称反铁磁体（Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets）中，利用非线性霍尔输运（nonlinear Hall transport）可将铁电序与磁序同时读出：铁电极化翻转反转 Berry 曲率偶极（Berry curvature dipole, BCD）符号，奈尔矢量（Neel vector）旋转调制其大小，VOCl2 单层的第一性原理计算支持该结论。
AI.motivation: Tt 对称反铁磁体可表现出铁电性与磁序共存的多铁性（multiferroicity），并具有多种序参量构型，但如何以电学方式读出这些构型仍是有待研究的问题。
AI.method: 结合紧束缚模型（tight-binding）与第一性原理（first-principles）计算，研究铁电 Tt 对称反铁磁体中的非线性霍尔输运，并以 VOCl2 单层为具体材料进行验证。
AI.result: 模型计算显示铁电翻转可反转 BCD 符号，奈尔矢量旋转则调制 BCD 大小，使铁电序与磁序均可反映于非线性霍尔信号；VOCl2 单层的计算确认了这些行为，并预测出可观的 BCD 及潜在可探测的霍尔电压（Hall voltage）。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了在单一材料中整合非线性霍尔效应的电学与磁学调控途径，有望用于反铁磁自旋电子学（antiferromagnetic spintronics）中的多态信息编码与读出。

title: Data-driven candidate structure ensemble generation beyond the convex hull with crystALL approach
summary: Real materials consist of multiple stable or metastable states under real-world conditions, existing as statistical ergodic ensembles of configurations rather than ideal crystals. Yet, data-driven computational materials discovery increasingly biases itself toward finding "new stable structures" from ground-state DFT calculations alone. This limits our long-term ability to discover materials whose properties emerge from metastable phases, to explain experimental observations, or to model thermodynamic behavior comprehensively. Predicting ergodic sets of atomic configurations of known and hypothetical solids is a fundamental challenge in theoretical crystallography, approached via many complementary methods. We discuss this conceptually and introduce crystALL, a pragmatic and powerful data-driven approach to discovering ensembles beyond the convex hull, embracing structural diversity over stability alone, enabling robust experiment matching in cases evading traditional methods. crystALL leverages 5 million relaxed structures from OPTIMADE and MPDD to rapidly generate a comprehensive candidate set by: (1) species substitutions; (2) ML feature-space analysis with pySIPFENN; (3) representative structure selection via clustering and energy-minimization or property matching; and (4) construction of the final candidate ensemble for experimental or ab initio validation. We also uniquely address the common challenge of experimental composition uncertainties spanning many integer stoichiometries by new efficient searches across anonymized compositional ranges rather than fixed formulas. Overall, crystALL's ensemble-focused philosophy provides critical advantages over the prevailing convex-hull-searching paradigm, which often fails to account for key experimental observations and increases AI/ML discovery bias over time - akin to model collapse in LLMs retrained on iteratively generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 crysALL 这一数据驱动方法，用于发现超越凸包（convex hull）的原子构型系综（ensemble），以弥补当前材料发现过度聚焦于基态稳定结构的偏倚。该方法利用 OPTIMADE 与 MPDD 中约 500 万个弛豫结构，通过元素替换、ML 特征空间分析、代表性结构选择及最终系综构建四个步骤快速生成候选集。其核心论点是强调结构多样性（structural diversity）而非单纯稳定性，从而更好地匹配实验观测并避免类似大语言模型（LLM）模型崩溃（model collapse）的发现偏倚累积。
AI.motivation: 真实材料在现实条件下呈现多稳态或亚稳态（metastable phases）构成的统计遍历系综（statistical ergodic ensembles），而当前数据驱动的材料计算发现日益偏向仅依赖基态 DFT（density functional theory）计算寻找"新的稳定结构"。这种偏倚限制了发现亚稳态性质材料、解释实验观测及全面建模热力学行为的能力，因此需要预测已知与假想固体的遍历构型集。
AI.method: crystALL 利用来自 OPTIMADE 和 MPDD 的 500 万个弛豫结构，通过四个步骤快速生成综合候选集：（1）元素种类替换（species substitutions）；（2）基于 pySIPFENN 的机器学习特征空间分析；（3）通过聚类与能量极小化或性质匹配进行代表性结构选择；（4）构建用于实验或从头算（ab initio）验证的最终候选系综。此外，针对跨越多个整数化学计量比的实验成分不确定性，采用匿名化成分区间（anonymized compositional ranges）的高效搜索而非固定化学式。
AI.result: crystALL 能够在超越凸包的情形下发现构型系综，实现结构多样性优先于单一稳定性，并在传统方法失效的案例中实现稳健的实验匹配（experiment matching）。该方法将 AI/ML 发现偏倚的累积类比为迭代生成内容再训练所导致的大型语言模型崩溃（model collapse），指出系综导向策略相对主流凸包搜索范式（convex-hull-searching paradigm）具有关键优势。
AI.conclusion: 系综导向（ensemble-focused）的研究哲学优于占主导地位的凸包搜索范式，后者往往无法解释关键实验观测，并随时间加剧 AI/ML 发现偏倚。crystALL 为理论晶体学（theoretical crystallography）中预测遍历构型集提供了务实且强大的数据驱动途径。

title: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics simulation with external field
summary: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics simulations with classical path approximation (CPA-NAMD) cannot simulate the carrier dynamics under an external field. We develop CPA-NAMD-extF, a first-principles density-matrix framework for calculating field-driven electronic responses along precomputed finite-temperature ionic trajectories. The method combines explicit external-field coupling with self-consistent updates of electronic density while retaining the computational efficiency of the classical-path approximation. Benchmarks against regular TDDFT methods show close agreement for time-dependent dipoles, finite-field currents, and linear optical responses. Applications to the linear absorption spectrum of crystalline and amorphous SiO$_2$ demonstrate its capability to large and structurally complex systems. This method is also applied to the 2D hybrid perovskite $(\mathrm{BA})_2\mathrm{CsPb}_2\mathrm{Br}_7$. Finite-temperature calculations show that the second-order opto-current response is strongly affected by structural fluctuations. Real-space DC current density further reveals pronounced Br-centered vortex currents, and its microscopic origin is investigated.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 CPA-NAMD-extF，一种基于第一性原理密度矩阵（density matrix）的框架，可在预计算的有限温度离子轨迹上模拟外场驱动的电子响应，弥补传统 CPA-NAMD 无法处理外场的不足。
AI.motivation: 经典路径近似下的非绝热分子动力学（CPA-NAMD）无法模拟外场作用下的载流子动力学，因而缺乏兼顾效率与外场响应的第一性原理方法。
AI.method: 将显式外场耦合与电子密度自洽更新相结合，在预计算的有限温度离子轨迹上求解密度矩阵演化，同时保留经典路径近似（classical path approximation）的计算效率。
AI.result: 与常规 TDDFT 方法在时变偶极、有限场电流和线性光学响应上吻合良好；成功应用于晶态与非晶 SiO₂ 的线性吸收谱及二维杂化钙钛矿 (BA)₂CsPb₂Br₇。
AI.conclusion: 有限温度计算表明二阶光电流响应受结构涨落强烈影响；实空间直流电流密度揭示显著的以 Br 为中心的涡旋电流（vortex currents），并对其微观起源进行了探讨。

title: Collective dipole effects amplify field-driven ion transport in amorphous Li$_3$PO$_4$
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, and 13 pages of Supplemental Material
summary: Amorphous solid electrolytes often outperform their crystalline counterparts, but how disorder shapes ionic transport under strong electric fields is poorly understood. We use molecular dynamics with a machine-learned interatomic potential and a machine-learned Born-effective-charge model to measure Li mobility in amorphous Li$_3$PO$_4$ and in a crystal with Li vacancies, from the linear to the strongly nonlinear regime. The amorphous phase shows a much stronger field enhancement, and we trace this to a collective dipole effect. The migrating ion carries the same charge in both phases. Alone it would not make the amorphous phase respond more strongly. What makes the difference is the environment. In the amorphous network the surrounding atoms move with the hop. Their motion makes the work the field performs vary widely between hops. Since hopping rates grow exponentially with the work, the most strongly assisted hops can dominate the drift. Disorder thus enhances field-driven transport through the environment rather than the carrier itself, a mechanism that may operate in disordered ion conductors in general.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过机器学习原子间势与机器学习玻恩有效电荷模型驱动的分子动力学模拟，比较非晶Li₃PO₄与含锂空位晶体中锂离子迁移，发现非晶相在强电场下迁移增强显著更强，机制源于环境原子的集体偶极响应而非载流子本身。
AI.motivation: 非晶固体电解质常优于晶态材料，但无序结构在强电场下如何影响离子输运尚不清楚，尤其缺乏从线性到强非线性区间的定量认识。
AI.method: 采用机器学习原子间势（machine-learned interatomic potential）与机器学习玻恩有效电荷模型（machine-learned Born-effective-charge model）结合的分子动力学模拟，测量非晶Li₃PO₄及含锂空位晶体中的Li迁移率，覆盖线性至强非线性电场区间，并比较迁移离子的有效电荷与跃迁功分布。
AI.result: 非晶相呈现更强的电场增强效应；两种相中迁移离子的有效电荷相同，单凭载流子自身无法解释差异；差异源于非晶网络中周围原子随跃迁协同运动，使电场做功在跃迁间分布很宽，而跃迁速率随做功指数增长，导致强助跃迁主导漂移。
AI.conclusion: 无序通过环境（集体偶极效应）而非载流子本身增强电场驱动的离子输运，该机制可能普遍适用于无序离子导体。

title: Phonon Angular Momentum Multipoles and Nonlinear Thermal Responses
summary: Chiral phonons carry angular momentum and couple lattice dynamics to magnetic and transport phenomena. In magnets, however, a systematic classification of momentum-space phonon angular momentum (PAM) textures and experimental signatures of the resulting thermal responses remain elusive. Here we classify the PAM textures for all 122 magnetic point groups (MPGs) using two equivalent approaches: directly solving the linear symmetry constraints on the multipole expansion coefficients and constructing the allowed textures from group-representation basis functions. Both methods yield the same fivefold classification according to the leading nonzero order: $s$-wave (monopole), $p$-wave (dipole), $d$-wave (quadrupole), $f$-wave (octupole), and $g$-wave (hexadecapole). We further show that a temperature gradient generates a nonequilibrium PAM density whose $n$th-order term in $\nabla T$ contains an energy-weighted PAM $2^n$-pole tensor and a kinematic remainder, thereby linking the response order and partial-wave channel through exact selection rules. Because the Berry curvature obeys the same symmetry constraints, this taxonomy is in one-to-one correspondence with Berry-curvature multipoles and their nonlinear Hall responses. We propose a cantilever torque measurement whose allowed angular harmonics are fixed by the MPG, with period $2π/n$ for a pure $n$th harmonic, providing a direct probe of the partial-wave content of PAM in both nonmagnetic and magnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 该文对所有122个磁性点群（magnetic point groups, MPGs）的动量空间声子角动量（phonon angular momentum, PAM）纹理进行系统分类，并按领先非零阶统一为s、p、d、f、g五类；进而给出温度梯度下PAM响应的精确选择定则，并提出悬臂扭矩测量作为直接探测手段。
AI.motivation: 手性声子（chiral phonons）携带角动量并耦合晶格动力学与磁、输运现象，但在磁体中，动量空间PAM纹理的系统分类及相应热响应的实验表征仍缺乏，这构成本文的研究动机。
AI.method: 采用两种等价途径：直接求解多极展开（multipole expansion）系数的线性对称约束，以及由群表示（group representation）基函数构造允许的纹理；并分析温度梯度下PAM密度的∇T各阶项结构。
AI.result: 两种方法给出一致的五重分类：s波（单极）、p波（偶极）、d波（四极）、f波（八极）、g波（十六极）。温度梯度产生的非平衡PAM密度第n阶项包含能量加权PAM 2^n极张量与一个运动学余项，由此将响应阶数与分波通道通过精确选择定则相联系；且贝里曲率（Berry curvature）服从相同对称约束，该分类与贝里曲率多极及其非线性霍尔响应（nonlinear Hall responses）一一对应。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种悬臂扭矩（cantilever torque）测量方案，其允许的角谐波由MPG确定，纯第n次谐波周期为2π/n，可作为非磁与磁性材料中PAM分波成分的直接探针。

title: Strain-tunable electronic transport in disordered borophene nanoribbons with line defects
summary: Resonant tunneling intrinsically exists in disordered borophene nanoribbons (BNRs) with randomly distributed line defects (LDs), providing a versatile platform for transport modulation. Here, we theoretically investigate the effects of in-plane mechanical strain on the electronic transport properties of disordered BNRs coupled to metallic electrodes. Our results demonstrate that the resonant peaks in disordered BNRs of different widths remain robust against variations in electrode parameters and can be efficiently modulated via mechanical strain. Specifically, uniaxial strain significantly modulates the energies, widths, and amplitudes of these resonant peaks, and can even suppress the peaks selectively and induce new ones. In particular, the response of the resonant energies to the applied strain exhibits remarkable anisotropy, where strains along the longitudinal and transverse directions induce opposite energy shifts. Moreover, identical resonant peaks recurring in different nanoribbon widths respond uniformly to applied strain. Biaxial strain enables highly efficient conductance switching across multiple distinct levels, with the modulation frequency increasing for wider nanoribbons. Our findings establish a promising defect-strain-engineering strategy for manipulating electronic transport in borophene and other gapless materials.

AI.tldr: 该论文理论上研究了面内机械应变（mechanical strain）对含随机线缺陷（line defects, LDs）的无序硼烯纳米带（borophene nanoribbons, BNRs）电子输运性质的影响，表明共振隧穿峰对应变高度敏感且可通过单轴与双轴应变实现多级电导开关调控。
AI.motivation: 无序硼烯纳米带中随机分布的线缺陷（line defects）天然存在共振隧穿（resonant tunneling），是有潜力的输运调制平台；本文旨在探究面内机械应变能否作为有效手段调控这类体系的电子输运性质。
AI.method: 采用理论计算方法，研究耦合到金属电极的无序硼烯纳米带在不同面内机械应变（单轴应变与双轴应变）下的电子输运特性，并考察不同纳米带宽度及电极参数的影响。
AI.result: 不同宽度无序BNRs中的共振峰（resonant peaks）对电极参数变化保持稳健，但可被应变有效调制：单轴应变显著改变共振峰的能量、宽度与振幅，甚至可选择性抑制原有峰并诱导新峰；共振能量对应变的响应呈现显著各向异性（anisotropy），纵向与横向应变引起相反的能量移动；不同宽度下重复出现的相同共振峰对应变响应一致；双轴应变可实现多级电导开关（conductance switching），且纳米带越宽调制频率越高。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果确立了一种“缺陷—应变工程（defect-strain-engineering）”策略，可用于调控硼烯及其他无能隙材料（gapless materials）中的电子输运。

title: Competing interaction driven broad magnetic entropy distribution in triangular net compounds \text{Ba$_3$RE(BO$_3$)$_3$}, RE= Dy and Ho
summary: Triangular magnetic lattices have attracted significant attention as a model platform for exploring frustrated magnetism and quantum spin liquids, particularly in rare-earth-based systems. These materials also hold considerable promise for cryogenic magnetic refrigeration. In this work, we investigate the magnetic and magnetocaloric properties of the rare-earth (RE) based compounds $\text{Ba}_3\text{RE}(\text{BO}_3)_3$ ($\text{RE} = \text{Dy}$ and $\text{Ho}$). Polycrystalline samples synthesized via a solid-state reaction method crystallize in a hexagonal structure with the space group $P6_3mc$, featuring triangular nets separated by approximately $8.8~\textÅ$ along the $c$-axis. Detailed magnetic investigation reveals a deviation from pure paramagnetic behavior at low temperatures ($T < 20\text{ K}$). This is further corroborated by isothermal magnetization measurements, which exhibit non-overlapping $M$ vs. $H/T$ plots and reduced magnetization moments, suggesting significant crystal electric field (CEF) splitting of localized $f$-states. For an applied magnetic field change of $70\text{ kOe}$, the maximum entropy change (Relative Cooling Power) reaches $4.2\text{ J kg}^{-1}\text{ K}^{-1}$ ($204\text{ J kg}^{-1}$) and $7.3\text{ J kg}^{-1}\text{ K}^{-1}$ ($230\text{ J kg}^{-1}$) for the Dy- and Ho-based compounds, respectively. Overall, the positive slopes of Arrott plots, the universal scaling behaviour of $ΔS_{\text{m}}/ΔS_{\text{m}}^{\text{max}}$ versus reduced temperature ($t$), and the field exponent $c$ of the RCP versus $H$ curves indicate a second-order nature of entropy distribution, making them promising candidates for magnetocalorics in the millikelvin range.

AI.tldr: 该文研究了三角晶格稀土化合物Ba3RE(BO3)3（RE=Dy、Ho）的磁性与磁热效应，发现低温下偏离纯顺磁行为源于晶体电场劈裂，并在70 kOe磁场变化下获得4.2与7.3 J kg⁻¹K⁻¹的最大磁熵变，显示其为二级相变并有望用于毫开尔文温区磁制冷。
AI.motivation: 三角磁晶格是研究阻挫磁性（frustrated magnetism）与量子自旋液体（quantum spin liquids）的重要模型平台，稀土基体系兼具低温磁制冷（magnetic refrigeration）应用潜力，因此需系统表征此类材料的磁与磁热性质。
AI.method: 采用固相反应法（solid-state reaction）合成Ba3RE(BO3)3（RE=Dy、Ho）多晶样品，通过结构表征确认其六方结构（空间群P6₃mc）及沿c轴约8.8 Å间隔的三角网格；结合低温磁化与等温磁化测量（M vs. H/T、Arrott图）、磁熵变（ΔS_m）普适标度分析及RCP随场强的场指数c分析来判定相变性质。
AI.result: 低温（T<20 K）下磁行为偏离纯顺磁，M–H/T曲线不重合及磁矩减小表明局域f态存在显著晶体电场（CEF）劈裂；在70 kOe磁场变化下，Dy基与Ho基化合物的最大磁熵变分别为4.2与7.3 J kg⁻¹K⁻¹，相对制冷能力（RCP）分别为204与230 J kg⁻¹。
AI.conclusion: Arrott图正斜率、ΔS_m/ΔS_m^max对约化温度（reduced temperature）的普适标度行为以及RCP–H曲线的场指数c共同表明熵分布对应二级相变（second-order transition），该体系是毫开尔文（millikelvin）温区磁制冷的候选材料。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. VI. Surface diffusion on a nonmetal-terminated surface
summary: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate surface diffusion of adsorbates on the nonmetal-terminated surface of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. These surfaces are wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e. GaN(000-1) surface, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e. GaP(-1-1-1) gallium arsenide, GaAs (-1-1-1) and gallium antimonide GaSb (-1-1-1) surfaces. The mixed coverage consists of Ga adatoms in the first layer with a nonmetal atom attached above them forming a triangular-based pyramid. The pyramidal structures are stable during surface jumps involving rotations around one of the basal Ga adatoms. Thus, the diffusion proceeds via rotation (pivot) of the pair of the other basal Ga adatoms around an immobile Ga adatom moving them into new, originally empty sites. Using an energy-path determination procedure, the diffusion barriers were obtained as the difference between the initial site energy and the activated complex state energy. The detachment energy of the NM adatom was obtained assuming a final state in atomic and molecular form. The energy barrier for detachment to the atomic state is high for all atoms, on the order of 5 eV. For the molecular state these barriers are different: smaller for nitrogen, on the order of 1 eV, which is related to the high dissociation energy of the N2 molecule. For P and As the barrier is above 2 eV. For Sb it was not determined. Accordingly, the surface diffusion length is macroscopically large, indicating that all NM adatoms arrive at the steps.

AI.tldr: 采用从头算（ab initio）方法模拟 GaN、GaP、GaAs、GaSb 非金属终止表面的吸附物表面扩散，揭示三角锥状结构以旋转（pivot）方式迁移，并给出脱附能垒。
AI.motivation: 研究四面体半导体非金属终止表面上混合覆盖吸附物的表面扩散机制，以及非金属（NM）吸附原子的脱附行为。
AI.method: 对 wurtzite GaN(000-1) 及 zinc blende GaP(-1-1-1)、GaAs(-1-1-1)、GaSb(-1-1-1) 表面进行从头算（ab initio）计算；混合覆盖由第一层 Ga 吸附原子及其上方非金属原子构成的三角锥结构组成，并用能量路径确定程序（energy-path determination procedure）求扩散与脱附能垒。
AI.result: 扩散经由两个基座 Ga 吸附原子围绕不动 Ga 吸附原子的旋转（pivot）完成，锥状结构在跳跃中保持稳定；脱附至原子态能垒均约 5 eV，脱附至分子态时 N 约 1 eV、P 与 As 高于 2 eV，Sb 未确定。
AI.conclusion: 表面扩散长度在宏观尺度上很大，表明所有非金属吸附原子均能到达台阶（steps）。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. VII. Step kinetics
summary: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the kinetics of attachment of new segments of the crystalline lattice (pyramids) at steps on the nonmetal-terminated surface of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. These surfaces are wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e. GaN(000-1) surface, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e. GaP(-1-1-1) gallium arsenide, GaAs(-1-1-1) and gallium antimonide GaSb(-1-1-1) surfaces. Diffusion species are gallium adatoms at high coverage or gallium adatoms connected with nonmetal atom creating stable pyramids. These pyramids arrive at the steps, and cannot be attached be directly because the Ga adatom at the pyramid base cannot be attached directly. Therefore they are incorporated into the step by additional nonmetal atoms glue atoms arriving from the vapor or detached from other segments of the surface terraces.

AI.tldr: 采用从头算（ab initio）方法模拟了GaN、GaP、GaAs、GaSb非金属终结表面上晶格新片段（金字塔，pyramids）在台阶处的附着动力学，指出金字塔需借助额外的非金属"胶原子（glue atoms）"才能并入台阶。
AI.motivation: 研究四面体半导体（tetrahedral semiconductors）非金属终结表面台阶处晶格生长片段的附着动力学机制，以理解此类材料的外延生长过程。
AI.method: 使用从头算（ab initio）计算模拟GaN(000-1)（纤锌矿，wurtzite）、GaP(-1-1-1)、GaAs(-1-1-1)与GaSb(-1-1-1)（闪锌矿，zinc blende）表面台阶处金字塔片段附着的动力学，考虑高覆盖度下的镓吸附原子（gallium adatoms）及与非金属原子结合形成的稳定金字塔。
AI.result: 金字塔片段到达台阶后无法直接附着，因为金字塔底部的Ga吸附原子不能直接并入台阶；需由来自气相或从其他表面台地片段脱离的额外非金属胶原子（glue atoms）介导其并入。
AI.conclusion: 四面体半导体非金属终结表面的台阶生长并非片段直接附着，而是依赖非金属胶原子完成的间接并入机制。

title: Quantized pumping of boundary Hilbert space in chiral Floquet phases
summary: Chiral Floquet phases support quantized chiral flow along their boundaries even when the bulk is fully localized. In this Letter, we establish a complementary phenomenon, which we call Hilbert-space pumping: under a boundary condition twisted by time translation, a part of the boundary Hilbert space, of quantized dimension, is transferred between the opposite boundaries. The twist is the temporal analogue of Laughlin's flux insertion in the quantum Hall effect. For noninteracting fermions, the number of transferred boundary modes is determined by the winding number, as we show analytically for the boundary dynamics and numerically for the anomalous Floquet Anderson insulator. For interacting systems whose boundary dynamics is a quantum cellular automaton, the transferred dimension is set by the Gross-Nesme-Vogts-Werner (GNVW) index: the twisted boundary Floquet operator is the Floquet operator on a tilted time slice, whose Hilbert-space dimension is multiplied by the index for each period of twist. We derive this relation for matrix product unitaries and test it numerically in random unitary circuits. Applied to the matrix product operators of non-invertible symmetries, the same twisted rank returns the quantum dimension of the symmetry operator in addition to its flow index.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“Hilbert 空间泵浦（Hilbert-space pumping）”现象：在时间平移扭曲的边界条件下，量子化维数的边界希尔伯特空间在两侧边界间转移，其转移量由缠绕数（winding number）或 GNVW 指数（GNVW index）决定。
AI.motivation: 手性 Floquet 相（chiral Floquet phases）在体态完全局域化时仍支持边界上的量子化手性流；本文旨在建立一种与之互补的边界输运现象，即时间维度上的“Laughlin 通量插入”类比。
AI.method: 引入由时间平移扭曲的边界条件，将扭曲后的边界 Floquet 算符（Floquet operator）视为倾斜时间切片上的 Floquet 算符；对非相互作用费米子用边界动力学的解析缠绕数论证，对相互作用情形（边界动力学为量子元胞自动机（quantum cellular automaton））以 GNVW 指数刻画，并在矩阵乘积酉算符（matrix product unitaries）上推导该关系。
AI.result: 非相互作用情形下，转移的边界模数由缠绕数决定，解析结果与反常 Floquet Anderson 绝缘体（anomalous Floquet Anderson insulator）的数值结果一致；相互作用情形下，每经过一个扭曲周期，转移维数按 GNVW 指数倍增，并在随机酉电路（random unitary circuits）中获数值验证。
AI.conclusion: 扭曲边界 Floquet 算符的希尔伯特空间维数转移与缠绕数／GNVW 指数直接对应；将该扭曲秩（twisted rank）应用于非可逆对称性（non-invertible symmetries）的矩阵乘积算符时，可同时返回对称算符的量子维数（quantum dimension）与其流指数（flow index）。

title: High-Entropy A-Site Disorder Enhances Oxygen Evolution Reaction Activity and Stability in Nickelate Thin Films
summary: Rare-earth nickelates are among the most active oxide electrocatalysts for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER), owing to their tunable Ni-O covalency, near-unity eg occupancy, and sensitivity to A-site chemistry, oxygen stoichiometry, and epitaxial strain. Here, we use epitaxial A-site high-entropy (La0.2Pr0.2Nd0.2Sm0.2Eu0.2)NiO3 thin films to reveal how epitaxial strain influences defect formation, Ni valence, electronic structure, and OER activity in a chemically disordered rare-earth (RE) sublattice. Tensile strain promotes Ruddlesden-Popper fault formation, interrupts the corner-sharing NiO6 network, and lowers the average Ni oxidation state. Although the occupied density of states near the Fermi level remains largely unchanged, O K-edge X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveals increased low-energy unoccupied states under tensile strain. First-principles calculations suggest that tensile strain shifts RE 4f-derived states toward the Fermi level, enhancing RE 4f-O 2p-Ni 3d hybridization. These coupled structural and electronic changes lead to earlier OER onset, stronger pre-catalytic Ni redox features, and higher activity than compressively strained films and representative single-A-site nickelates. The high-entropy nickelate also shows enhanced resistance to OER-induced structural degradation compared with LaNiO3. These results suggest that A-site configurational disorder and epitaxial strain can jointly tune defect formation and rare-earth-derived electronic states, providing a route for improving perovskite oxide electrocatalysts.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用外延A位高熵（high-entropy）稀土镍酸盐薄膜，揭示拉伸应变通过促进RP层错形成与增强RE 4f–O 2p–Ni 3d杂化来调控缺陷、Ni价态与析氧反应（OER）活性，从而获得优于压应变薄膜的催化性能与结构稳定性。
AI.motivation: 稀土镍酸盐（rare-earth nickelates）是活跃的析氧反应（oxygen evolution reaction, OER）氧化物电催化剂，其性能对A位化学、氧化学计量与外延应变敏感；但在化学无序的稀土（RE）亚晶格中，外延应变如何影响缺陷形成、Ni价态、电子结构与OER活性尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用外延A位高熵(La0.2Pr0.2Nd0.2Sm0.2Eu0.2)NiO3薄膜作为模型体系，结合O K边X射线吸收谱（X-ray absorption spectroscopy）与第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），对比拉伸与压缩应变下的缺陷、Ni氧化态与电子结构。
AI.result: 拉伸应变促进Ruddlesden-Popper层错（Ruddlesden-Popper fault）形成，打断共角NiO6网络并降低平均Ni氧化态；费米能级附近占据态密度基本不变，但低能未占据态增加，计算表明拉伸应变使RE 4f派生态向费米能级移动并增强RE 4f–O 2p–Ni 3d杂化（hybridization）。由此导致更早的OER起始电位、更强的预催化Ni氧化还原特征和更高活性，且抗OER诱导结构降解能力优于LaNiO3。
AI.conclusion: A位构型无序（configurational disorder）与外延应变可协同调控缺陷形成与稀土派生电子态，为提升钙钛矿氧化物（perovskite oxide）电催化剂性能提供了一条途径。

title: Coulomb Blockade in a One-Dimensional Array of Strong Josephson Junctions
summary: We measure current across a voltage-biased, long array of Josephson junctions. Current-voltage characteristics do not reveal any critical current and instead display the presence of threshold voltage and finite activation energy, consistent with the Coulomb blockade. However, the respective energy scale is well below the value prescribed by a single-island geometric capacitances. We explain it by strong quantum fluctuations of charge associated with a large value of Josephson energy, $E_J\gg E_C$, where $E_C$ is the charging energy associated with the inter-island capacitance. Comparison between the data and theory points to an exponential (in parameter $E_J/E_C$) suppression of the threshold. We achieve a quantitative agreement with theory by accounting for charge-$e$ solitons associated with the quasiparticles entering the array from its leads. This scenario however underestimates the current below threshold in comparison with the experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文测量了电压偏置长约瑟夫森结阵列的电流，观察到无临界电流但存在阈值电压与有限激活能，符合库仑阻塞（Coulomb blockade）特征，但其能量尺度远低于单岛几何电容预言值。
AI.motivation: 单岛几何电容给出的能量尺度无法解释实验观测到的阈值电压与激活能，需澄清强量子涨落（quantum fluctuations）在 E_J≫E_C 条件下对阈值行为的作用机制。
AI.method: 对电压偏置的长约瑟夫森结阵列（Josephson junction array）测量电流-电压特性（current-voltage characteristics），并将数据与考虑电荷-e 孤子（charge-e solitons）——即由引线进入阵列的准粒子（quasiparticles）所伴随的孤子——的理论进行对比。
AI.result: 数据与理论对比表明阈值随参数 E_J/E_C 呈指数抑制（exponential suppression）；计入电荷-e 孤子后可实现定量一致，但该图像在阈值以下低估了实验电流。
AI.conclusion: 强量子涨落与电荷-e 孤子机制可定量解释阈值电压的指数抑制，但阈值以下电流的偏差表明该理论图像尚不完整。

title: Cluster Condensation and Symmetry-Protected Thermal Rigidity of Bose gases on the Haldane Sphere
summary: We show that a spinless Bose gas on a Haldane sphere with a small monopole charge \(q\) realizes, in the lowest Landau level (LLL), an exactly solvable SU(2)-protected cluster condensate: a Hafnian condensate of two-boson singlets for \(q=1\), analogous to resonating-valence-bond singlet coverings, and a four-boson singlet condensate for \(q=3/2\). Unlike topologically protected quantum Hall states, the exactness of these states relies only on SU(2) symmetry and repulsiveness, with no pseudopotential fine-tuning. Their SU(2)-protected degeneracy renders the single-particle correlations exactly temperature-independent even as the clusters dissociate, a thermal rigidity absent in conventional Bose--Einstein condensates (BECs). Increasing the interaction drives a transition to a vortex BEC with spontaneously broken rotational symmetry.

AI.tldr: 该论文表明，在具有小单极荷（monopole charge）\(q\) 的 Haldane 球面上，无自旋玻色气体（spinless Bose gas）在最低朗道能级（lowest Landau level, LLL）中可实现精确可解的、受 SU(2) 对称性保护的团簇凝聚态（cluster condensate）。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索与拓扑保护的量子霍尔态（quantum Hall states）不同的、仅依赖 SU(2) 对称性与排斥相互作用即可精确求解的多体玻色态，并考察其热力学特性与常规玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose–Einstein condensate, BEC）的差异。
AI.method: 采用 Haldane 球面几何并引入小单极荷 \(q\)，在最低朗道能级（LLL）框架下构造精确可解的 SU(2)-保护团簇凝聚态：\(q=1\) 时为双玻色子单态（two-boson singlet）的 Hafnian 凝聚，类比共振价键（resonating-valence-bond）单态覆盖；\(q=3/2\) 时为四玻色子单态凝聚。该精确性仅依赖 SU(2) 对称性与排斥性，无需赝势（pseudopotential）精细调节。
AI.result: 这些态具有 SU(2)-保护简并（SU(2)-protected degeneracy），使单粒子关联（single-particle correlations）在团簇解离过程中仍精确地与温度无关，表现出常规 BEC 所缺乏的热刚性（thermal rigidity）。增大相互作用强度则驱动系统转变为自发破缺旋转对称性的涡旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（vortex BEC）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了一类无需拓扑保护或赝势调节、仅由 SU(2) 对称性与排斥性保证精确可解的玻色团簇凝聚态，并展示了其独特的温度无关关联特性及向涡旋 BEC 的相互作用驱动相变。

title: Observing oscillations using the non-magnetic and magnetic spin Hall effect in a non-collinear antiferromagnet
summary: In this study, it was observed that, in non-collinear IrMn3, both the non-magnetic spin Hall effect (NMSHE) and the magnetic spin Hall effect (MSHE) exhibit oscillations as the triangularly ordered magnetic moments of IrMn3 evolve with temperature. These oscillations are strongly influenced by the magnetic properties at the interface between IrMn3 and the adjacent material. Permalloy (Py), a ferromagnet, and platinum (Pt), a paramagnet, were employed as adjacent layers. Such experimental analyses demonstrate the pioneering nature of this phenomenon, which is validated through magnetoresistance measurements performed under different experimental conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现非共线反铁磁体（non-collinear antiferromagnet）IrMn3中非磁自旋霍尔效应（NMSHE）与磁自旋霍尔效应（MSHE）随温度变化呈振荡行为，且受界面磁性显著调制。
AI.motivation: 探讨IrMn3中三角磁有序随温度演化时，NMSHE与MSHE的行为及其与相邻材料界面磁性的关联。
AI.method: 以铁磁体坡莫合金（Permalloy, Py）与顺磁体铂（Pt）作为相邻层构建IrMn3界面体系，并在不同实验条件下进行磁电阻（magnetoresistance）测量。
AI.result: NMSHE与MSHE均随温度驱动的三角磁矩演化而振荡，振荡强烈受IrMn3与相邻材料界面磁性影响；磁电阻测量验证了该现象。
AI.conclusion: 该现象具有开创性，表明界面磁性是调控非共线反铁磁体中自旋霍尔效应振荡的关键因素。

title: Magnetic order in Co[Cr(CN)$_6$]$_{2/3}\cdot z$H$_2$O and its interplay with correlated vacancy order
summary: Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) are versatile hybrid framework materials that often exhibit local and long-range departures from their cubic parent structure, influencing their functionality. Long-range magnetic order is common in PBAs, owing to magnetic interactions between transition metal ions via bridging cyanide ligands in the structure. Here we report the magnetic structure of cobalt (II) hexacyanochromate, Co[Cr(CN)$_6$]$_{2/3}\cdot z$H$_2$O, determined using neutron powder diffraction. No evidence for magnetostriction at the magnetic ordering temperature is observed in contrast to the reported behaviour of a related PBA. Following experimental characterisation of the magnetic order of this PBA, we employ a simple Monte Carlo model to gain a better understanding of the relationship between hexacyanometallate vacancy distributions and magnetic ordering behaviour in these materials. This model shows that magnetic ordering is robust to the extent and nature of vacancy correlations, with only minor effects noticeable in the critical region, suggesting that PBAs with the same composition but different vacancy correlations might be expected to show similar magnetic behaviour.

AI.tldr: 采用中子粉末衍射（neutron powder diffraction）测定钴六氰基铬酸盐 Co[Cr(CN)₆]₂/₃·zH₂O 的磁结构，未观察到磁致伸缩（magnetostriction），并以蒙特卡罗（Monte Carlo）模型探讨空位分布与磁有序的关系。
AI.motivation: 普鲁士蓝类似物（Prussian blue analogues, PBAs）常偏离立方母结构并具有磁有序，但其磁结构与空位分布（vacancy distribution）对磁有序的影响尚需厘清。
AI.method: 利用中子粉末衍射确定 Co[Cr(CN)₆]₂/₃·zH₂O 的磁结构，并构建简单蒙特卡罗模型模拟六氰基金属酸盐空位分布（hexacyanometallate vacancy distributions）与磁有序行为的关系。
AI.result: 在磁有序温度下未观察到磁致伸缩，与相关 PBA 的报道行为相反；模型显示磁有序对空位的程度与关联性质具有鲁棒性（robust），仅在临界区（critical region）有轻微影响。
AI.conclusion: 相同组成但空位关联不同的 PBAs 预期表现出相似的磁行为，表明空位关联并非磁有序的主要控制因素。

title: Zero-field plasmon splitter: Controlled interaction between quantum anomalous Hall edge states
summary: The quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect provides chiral edge states without the need for an external magnetic field, but unlike in conventional quantum Hall systems, their trajectories cannot be readily controlled electrostatically. Here, we engineer Coulomb interactions between two spatially separated, counter-propagating QAH edge channels using a floating metallic island. Microwave measurements reveal frequency-dependent redistribution of injected edge plasmons between two output channels, demonstrating interaction-induced hybridization of the collective modes. A long-range interaction model quantitatively reproduces the response and reveals a very low plasmon velocity in the coupling region, strongly reduced by electrostatic screening. Our results establish engineered Coulomb coupling as a route to control collective excitations in QAH edge states and provide a building block for chiral plasmonic circuits and electron quantum optics in magnetic topological insulators.

AI.tldr: 利用悬浮金属岛工程化两个空间分离、反向传播的量子反常霍尔（QAH）边缘通道间的库仑相互作用，微波测量显示注入边缘等离激元的频率依赖再分配，证实集体模式的相互作用诱导杂化。
AI.motivation: QAH效应可提供无外磁场的手性边缘态，但与传统量子霍尔系统不同，其边缘轨迹难以通过静电方式调控，缺乏对边缘集体激发的可控手段。
AI.method: 采用悬浮金属岛耦合两个空间分离、反向传播的QAH边缘通道以引入库仑相互作用，并通过微波测量观测边缘等离激元在两个输出通道间的频率依赖再分配；同时构建长程相互作用模型进行定量拟合。
AI.result: 微波测量显示注入边缘等离激元在两输出通道间发生频率依赖的再分配，表明存在相互作用诱导的集体模式杂化；长程相互作用模型定量重现了响应，并揭示耦合区域中因静电屏蔽而显著降低的极低等离激元速度。
AI.conclusion: 工程化库仑耦合可作为调控QAH边缘态集体激发的途径，并为磁性拓扑绝缘体中的手性等离激元电路与电子量子光学提供基础构件。

title: Intrinsic Zak Phase of Solitons: A Geometric Correspondence with the Center-of-Mass Position
summary: The center-of-mass position of a nonlinear soliton in a lattice is commonly attributed to the interplay between nonlinearity and lattice confinement. Here, we reveal its geometric origin by establishing an exact relation between the soliton position and an intrinsic Zak phase. Unlike the Zak phase of a linear Bloch band, this intrinsic Zak phase arises from the nonlinear self-consistent band of the lattice reconstructed by the soliton density. We construct a composite periodic function to define this phase and demonstrate that its topological winding during nonlinear Thouless pumping dictates the quantized soliton displacement. Our results establish band geometry as a fundamental descriptor of nonlinear soliton position in a lattice and provide a geometric framework for their topological transport.

AI.tldr: 该文指出晶格中非线性孤子（soliton）质心位置的几何起源，建立了孤子位置与内禀 Zak 相位（intrinsic Zak phase）之间的精确关系。该内禀 Zak 相位源自孤子密度重构的非线性自洽能带（nonlinear self-consistent band），而非线性 Bloch 能带的常规 Zak 相位；其在非线性 Thouless 泵浦（nonlinear Thouless pumping）过程中的拓扑绕数（topological winding）决定了孤子位移的量子化。
AI.motivation: 既有认识通常将非线性孤子的质心位置归因于非线性与晶格束缚（lattice confinement）之间的相互作用，缺乏几何层面的统一解释。作者旨在揭示该位置的几何起源，并给出可描述其拓扑输运的几何框架。
AI.method: 通过建立孤子位置与内禀 Zak 相位的精确关系，并构造一个复合周期函数（composite periodic function）来定义该相位；该相位由孤子密度重构的晶格非线性自洽能带确定。
AI.result: 该内禀 Zak 相位在非线性 Thouless 泵浦过程中的拓扑绕数决定了孤子位移的量子化行为，从而以能带几何解释了孤子位置。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立能带几何（band geometry）作为晶格中非线性孤子位置的基本描述量，并为非线性孤子的拓扑输运提供了几何框架。

title: Molecular Curvature Enables Tubular π-Stacked Pathways in Three-Dimensional Conductive Metal-Organic Frameworks
summary: Conductive metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are commonly constructed from planar aromatic ligands, whose geometries favor conventional π-stacking arrangements. However, intrinsically twisted ligands offer an alternative geometric approach to directing aromatic packing and constructing unconventional framework architectures. Here, we employ intrinsically twisted, butterfly-shaped dibenzo[g,p]chrysene-2,3,6,7,10,11,14,15-octaol (DBC) ligands to construct a series of lanthanide MOFs. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals an interpenetrated three-dimensional framework in which π-π interactions between the aromatic fragments generate axially extended tubular π-stacked pathways, alongside one-dimensional channels rich in hydrogen-bonding sites. Lanthanide substitution preserves the overall tubular framework topology while modulating aromatic stacking distances and local pore environments. PrDBC single crystals exhibit mixed electron-proton transport, with electron and proton conductivities reaching 1.62 x 10-3 and 4.37 x 10-4 S cm-1, respectively, at 338 K and 30% relative humidity. This work highlights molecular curvature as a structural design strategy for constructing three-dimensional conductive MOFs that integrate tubular aromatic stacks with tunable pore environments for mixed electron-proton transport.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用本征扭曲的蝴蝶形DBC配体构建一系列镧系金属有机框架（lanthanide MOFs），得到具有管状π堆叠通道的互穿三维结构，其中PrDBC单晶表现出电子-质子混合导电，338 K、30%相对湿度下电子与质子电导率分别为1.62×10⁻³和4.37×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹。
AI.motivation: 导电金属有机框架（conductive MOFs）多由平面芳香配体构建，其几何构型倾向形成常规π堆叠（π-stacking）排列；本征扭曲配体则提供了引导芳香堆积、构筑非常规框架结构的替代几何路径。
AI.method: 采用本征扭曲、蝴蝶形的dibenzo[g,p]chrysene-2,3,6,7,10,11,14,15-octaol（DBC）配体合成一系列镧系MOF，并通过单晶X射线衍射（single-crystal X-ray diffraction）解析结构；同时考察镧系取代对堆积距离与孔道环境的影响，并测试PrDBC单晶的导电性能。
AI.result: 结构解析显示为互穿三维框架：芳香片段间的π-π相互作用形成轴向延伸的管状π堆叠通道，并伴有一维富氢键位点孔道。镧系取代保持整体管状框架拓扑，同时调节芳香堆积距离与局部孔环境。PrDBC单晶呈电子-质子混合传输，338 K、30%相对湿度下电子与质子电导率分别为1.62×10⁻³和4.37×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹。
AI.conclusion: 分子曲率（molecular curvature）可作为构筑三维导电MOF的结构设计策略，实现管状芳香堆叠与可调孔环境的整合，用于电子-质子混合传输（mixed electron-proton transport）。

title: Frequency-domain spin-wave logic gate based on three-magnon confluence
summary: Spin-wave-based information processing provides a promising platform for low-power nanoscale computing by exploiting coherent magnon dynamics and intrinsic nonlinear interactions. A key advantage of wave-based processing for efficient miniaturization is the ability to perform operations in the frequency domain without requiring separate propagation paths for the input and output signals. Here, we demonstrate a frequency-domain spin-wave logic gate based on resonant, non-degenerate three-magnon confluence in an yttrium iron garnet nanowaveguide. Under resonant conditions, two input spin waves at different frequencies efficiently generate an output spin wave at the sum frequency, which occurs only when both input signals are present, thereby directly implementing an AND logic operation. We further show that the output intensity scales linearly with each input intensity and is therefore proportional to their product, enabling analog multiplication of two signals. These results demonstrate nonlinear magnon confluence as a versatile mechanism for frequency-domain spin-wave logic and analog signal processing.

AI.tldr: 该工作基于钇铁石榴石（yttrium iron garnet）纳米波导中共振的非简并三磁振子合流（three-magnon confluence），在频域实现自旋波（spin-wave）AND逻辑门与模拟乘法功能。
AI.motivation: 自旋波信息处理（spin-wave-based information processing）可借助相干磁振子（magnon）动力学与本征非线性实现低功耗纳米计算；频域操作无需为输入输出信号设置独立传播路径，是高效小型化的关键优势。
AI.method: 在钇铁石榴石纳米波导中利用共振、非简并的三磁振子合流：两个不同频率的输入自旋波在共振条件下产生和频输出自旋波，仅在两个输入同时存在时才有输出。
AI.result: 该机制直接实现AND逻辑操作；输出强度随每个输入强度线性变化，因而正比于二者乘积，可用于两信号的模拟乘法（analog multiplication）。
AI.conclusion: 非线性磁振子合流（nonlinear magnon confluence）是频域自旋波逻辑与模拟信号处理（analog signal processing）的通用机制。

title: Generative diffusion in long-range correlated landscapes: Speciation cascade and the foam structure of the score
summary: While state of the art for image and video generation, the fundamental reasons for the effectiveness of generative diffusion remain unclear. In particular, the observed advantage of following an entire reverse process with respect to single-shot or autoregressive methods, and for what type of data it may hold, is not well understood. In this work, we aim to better understand the role of the reverse process by considering a complex yet analytically tractable data model, the Gibbs measure of a high-dimensional Gaussian random potential with long-range correlations. Focusing on the exact score, we show that the speciation threshold, in which a trajectory commits to one class of the data, becomes a speciation window, in which the reverse process progressively resolves the Parisi tree of pure states of the full replica-symmetry breaking measure, committing to ever finer branches down to a single pure state. Importantly, these commitments take place at noise levels where the noisy sample distinguishes the pure states only through an energy of order one, beyond the reach of standard replica saddle points. Constructing a Larkin argument suited to such $O(1)$ energy gaps, we describe the score as a foam, with slab-like cells separated by shock-like boundaries. In the variance-exploding process we consider, this window is followed by a shrinkage of the samples towards the data support, and finally by reconstruction within the selected pure state. The denoising error of the exact score follows these stages, dropping during the speciation window with a profile set by the Parisi function alone, and then within the selected state. We believe that the generative foam we describe, and in particular the boundaries between cells, could play an important role in determining where the errors of trained diffusion models redistribute the mass of the generated samples when the data are long-range correlated.

AI.tldr: 该论文以具有长程关联（long-range correlations）的高维高斯随机势（Gaussian random potential）的吉布斯测度（Gibbs measure）为可解析数据模型，研究扩散模型（diffusion models）逆向过程（reverse process）的作用机制，提出"物种形成窗口（speciation window）"与"生成泡沫（generative foam）"图像。
AI.motivation: 图像与视频生成已达到最先进水平，但生成扩散（generative diffusion）有效性的根本原因仍不清楚；尤其是完整逆向过程相对单步（single-shot）或自回归（autoregressive）方法的优势及其适用数据类型缺乏理解。
AI.method: 考虑一类复杂但可解析处理（analytically tractable）的数据模型，即具有长程关联的高维高斯随机势的吉布斯测度；聚焦精确得分函数（exact score），并构造适用于 $O(1)$ 能隙的 Larkin 论证，将得分描述为"泡沫（foam）"结构——由激波状边界（shock-like boundaries）分隔的板状单元（slab-like cells）。
AI.result: 发现物种形成阈值（speciation threshold）扩展为物种形成窗口：逆向过程逐步解析全复本对称破缺测度（full replica-symmetry breaking measure）的纯态（pure states）Parisi 树，逐级承诺至更细分支直至单一纯态；这些承诺发生在噪声水平下、纯态仅通过 $O(1)$ 量级能量可区分之处，超出标准复本鞍点（replica saddle points）的适用范围。在方差爆炸（variance-exploding）过程中，该窗口之后是样本向数据支撑（data support）收缩，最后在选定纯态内重建。
AI.conclusion: 精确得分的去噪误差（denoising error）遵循上述阶段：在物种形成窗口内按仅由 Parisi 函数决定的轮廓下降，随后在选定纯态内继续下降。所描述的生成泡沫，特别是单元间边界，可能在数据具长程关联时决定训练扩散模型误差如何重新分配生成样本质量方面起重要作用。

title: Anion Engineering Enables Concurrent Optimization of Phonon and Carrier Transport in AMg$_2$X$_2$ Zintl Thermoelectrics
summary: The simultaneous suppression of lattice heat transport and enhancement of carrier transport is central to the development of high-performance thermoelectric materials. Here, we investigate the microscopic mechanisms governing phonon and carrier transport in CaAl$_2$Si$_2$-type AMg$_2$X$_2$ (A = Ca, Sr, Ba; X = P, As, Sb, Bi) Zintl compounds using first-principles calculations, machine-learning interatomic potentials, and Boltzmann transport theory. As X changes from P to Bi, the widening phonon band gap restricts three-phonon scattering channels and increases the relative importance of four-phonon processes. In CaMg$_2$Bi$_2$ and BaMg$_2$Bi$_2$, four-phonon scattering dominates the relaxation of low-frequency heat-carrying modes at 900 K. The Bi-based series also exhibits an anomalous increase in lattice thermal conductivity from Ca to Ba despite the increasing cation mass. Mode-resolved analysis links the lower thermal conductivity of CaMg$_2$Bi$_2$ to reduced low-frequency group velocities and stronger anharmonic scattering, with Ca-related mid-frequency vibrations providing additional four-phonon scattering channels. Including both particle-like and coherent contributions, its lattice thermal conductivity reaches 0.23 W$\cdot$m$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ at 900 K. Meanwhile, the increasing covalent character of the vertical Mg-X bonds is accompanied by enhanced band-edge dispersion and reduced carrier effective masses. These electronic changes, together with conduction-band convergence, favor n-type transport and yield a predicted peak $ZT$ of 3.68 at 900 K in CaMg$_2$Bi$_2$. These results elucidate the interplay of phonon spectral structure and higher-order anharmonicity in thermal transport, alongside the distinct electronic response to anion substitution.

AI.tldr: 该文结合第一性原理计算、机器学习原子间势与玻尔兹曼输运理论，揭示CaAl2Si2型AMg2X2 Zintl化合物中声子谱结构与高阶非谐性对热输运的调控，并阐明阴离子取代对电输运的差异化影响，预测CaMg2Bi2在900 K下n型ZT峰值达3.68。
AI.motivation: 高性能热电材料（thermoelectric materials）需同时抑制晶格热输运与提升载流子输运，但声子与载流子输运的微观机制及其协同调控尚不清晰，尤其高阶非谐性（higher-order anharmonicity）的作用有待厘清。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potentials）与玻尔兹曼输运理论（Boltzmann transport theory），对AMg2X2（A = Ca, Sr, Ba; X = P, As, Sb, Bi）体系进行声子与电子的模式分辨分析。
AI.result: 随X由P变为Bi，声子带隙（phonon band gap）展宽压缩三声子散射通道并提升四声子过程（four-phonon processes）的相对重要性；CaMg2Bi2与BaMg2Bi2中四声子散射主导900 K下低频载热模弛豫。Bi基系列晶格热导率（lattice thermal conductivity）由Ca至Ba反常升高，CaMg2Bi2在900 K达0.23 W·m⁻¹K⁻¹。Mg–X键共价性增强伴随带边色散增强与载流子有效质量（carrier effective mass）降低，利于n型输运。
AI.conclusion: 研究阐明了声子谱结构与高阶非谐性在热输运中的相互作用，以及阴离子取代引发的差异化电子响应，为Zintl热电材料的声子与载流子协同优化提供依据。

title: Hidden variable $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological order in a bilayer kagomé antiferromagnet
summary: Topological orders in realistic systems are quite rare, raising one fundamental question of whether they might be harbored with hidden degrees of freedom rather than directly exposed in conventional spins or electrons. We here propose a set of hidden variables and their effective interactions in a bilayer kagomé antiferromagnet. By properly organizing four local states of the spin dimer into two pseudospin-$1/2$ variables ($\boldsymbolτ$ and $\boldsymbolμ$), we identify a regime where an effective Balents-Fisher-Girvin model emerges, realizing a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological order in the hidden $\boldsymbolτ$ sector while the auxiliary $\boldsymbolμ$ sector remains a trivial paramagnet. This hidden nature drastically alters the experimental manifestations. Physical spins map to composite objects, typically convolving fractionalized anyon continua with non-topological magnon excitations. Nevertheless, specific symmetry-selected channels, such as the longitudinal intralayer response, exclusively reveal the bare two-vison continuum without collective-mode dressing. Our findings demonstrate that the topological order could be buried in certain hidden and emergent degrees of freedom, pointing to a promising pathway for seeking elusive topological states disguised within hidden internal degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在双层笼目反铁磁体（bilayer kagomé antiferromagnet）中，将自旋二聚体的四个局域态重组为两个赝自旋-1/2变量，从而在隐藏自由度中实现Z2拓扑序。
AI.motivation: 真实体系中的拓扑序（topological order）较为罕见，因此引出核心问题：拓扑序是否可能隐藏于内部自由度中，而非直接暴露在常规自旋或电子上。
AI.method: 引入一组隐藏变量及其有效相互作用，把自旋二聚体的四个局域态重新组织为两个赝自旋-1/2变量（τ与μ），并指出在此情形下可涌现出有效的Balents-Fisher-Girvin模型。
AI.result: 在隐藏的τ扇区实现Z2拓扑序，而辅助的μ扇区保持为平庸顺磁体（trivial paramagnet）；物理自旋映射为复合对象，通常表现为分数化任意子连续谱（fractionalized anyon continua）与非拓扑磁振子（magnon）激发的卷积，但纵向层内响应等特定对称选择通道可纯净呈现裸的双维松（two-vison）连续谱。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑序可能埋藏于某些隐藏且涌现的自由度中，这为寻找伪装在隐藏内部自由度里的难寻拓扑态提供了有前景的途径。

title: The normal approximation to macroscopic dynamical fluctuations
summary: Under local detailed balance, the Lagrangian of macroscopic dynamical fluctuations has a canonical structure: its time-antisymmetric part is the entropy flux, and its time-symmetric part is a Legendre pair of kinetic and dissipation functions. We show what survives of that structure for normal (Gaussian) fluctuations around a nonequilibrium steady state. The quadratic Lagrangian keeps the canonical form, with the Hessian of the dissipation function as noise matrix. However, the force on the fluctuations differs from the linearized thermodynamic force by a term proportional to the driving and to the state dependence of the dynamical activity, so that local detailed balance is violated at the Gaussian level. Nevertheless, the Gaussian dynamics is gradient flow for the quadratic part of the nonequilibrium entropy, around an emergent nondissipative current. Finally, we show which parts of the Lagrangian can be reconstructed from measured Gaussian fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 该文研究非平衡稳态附近高斯涨落（Gaussian fluctuations）的拉格朗日结构，表明二次型拉格朗日量保留正则形式，但高斯层面上局域细致平衡（local detailed balance）被破坏，涨落动力学可视为非平衡熵二次部分在涌现无耗散流周围的梯度流。
AI.motivation: 在局域细致平衡下，宏观动力学涨落的拉格朗日量具有正则结构（时间反对称部分为熵流，时间对称部分为动能与耗散函数的勒让德对）。作者旨在探究这一结构在非平衡稳态附近的正态（高斯）涨落中还保留哪些部分。
AI.method: 围绕非平衡稳态对涨落拉格朗日量作二次展开，考察其正则结构，并将涨落所受的力与线性化热力学力进行比较；同时分析高斯动力学与非平衡熵二次部分的关系。
AI.result: 二次型拉格朗日量保持正则形式，噪声矩阵为耗散函数的黑塞矩阵（Hessian）；但涨落所受的力与线性化热力学力相差一项，该项正比于驱动力与动力学活度（dynamical activity）的态依赖性，故局域细致平衡在高斯层面被破坏。此外，高斯动力学是非平衡熵二次部分围绕涌现的无耗散流（nondissipative current）的梯度流（gradient flow）。
AI.conclusion: 非平衡稳态的高斯涨落仅部分继承宏观涨落的正则拉格朗日结构：正则形式与耗散黑塞噪声矩阵保留，但局域细致平衡失效。作者进一步指出可从实测高斯涨落中重构拉格朗日量的哪些部分。

title: Ultrafast Polar Topology Reversal via THz-Driven Inertial Switching
summary: Topological polar structures in ferroelectric heterostructures offer functional states beyond ordinary domains. As polarization reversal underpins ferroelectric devices, switching between degenerate topological variants, which we refer to as topology reversal, would greatly expand the ways to control polar textures. However, polar topology reversal is challenging because it requires coordinated flipping of oppositely oriented local polarizations, a process not naturally driven by a uniform electric field. Using a multiscale modeling approach, we show that polar topology can be stabilized and reversed in a simple Pt/PbTiO$_3$/Pt nanocapacitor. Electrode-controlled boundary conditions drive tetragonal PbTiO$_3$ into competing orthorhombic- and rhombohedral-like polarization states, which form building blocks for diverse topological structures, including vortex arrays, skyrmion lattices, dipole spirals, and dipole waves. We further show that the same out-of-plane THz pulse can reversibly switch a double-$\mathbf q$ dipole wave between degenerate topological variants within a few picoseconds, while preserving its spatial modulation. This process is enabled by damping-assisted inertial switching, in which the THz pulse injects energy to drive large-angle polarization rotation across shallow barriers, while dissipation removes excess energy and traps the system in the reversed state. These results establish ferroelectric nanocapacitors as a simple platform for programmable polar topology and low-power, THz-speed control through dissipative dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文通过多尺度建模（multiscale modeling）证明，在简单 Pt/PbTiO₃/Pt 纳米电容器（nanocapacitor）中可实现极性拓扑（polar topology）的稳定与翻转；同一太赫兹脉冲（THz pulse）可在数皮秒内可逆切换简并拓扑变体，机制为阻尼辅助的惯性翻转（damping-assisted inertial switching）。
AI.motivation: 铁电异质结构中的拓扑极性结构（topological polar structures）提供了超越普通畴（domain）的功能态，而拓扑翻转（topology reversal）有望大幅拓展极性织构（polar textures）的调控方式；但其难点在于需要相反取向局域极化的协同翻转，均匀电场无法自然驱动该过程。
AI.method: 采用多尺度建模方法，研究 Pt/PbTiO₃/Pt 纳米电容器中由电极控制的边界条件（electrode-controlled boundary conditions）所诱导的四方相（tetragonal）向类正交相（orthorhombic-like）与类菱方相（rhombohedral-like）极化态的转变，并模拟面外 THz 脉冲对拓扑态的作用。
AI.result: 类正交与类菱方极化态构成多种拓扑结构的构筑单元，包括涡旋阵列（vortex arrays）、斯格明子晶格（skyrmion lattices）、偶极螺旋（dipole spirals）与偶极波（dipole waves）；同一面外 THz 脉冲可在数皮秒内使双 q 偶极波（double-q dipole wave）在简并拓扑变体间可逆切换，且保持其空间调制。
AI.conclusion: 翻转过程由阻尼辅助的惯性翻转实现：THz 脉冲注入能量驱动大角度极化旋转跨越浅势垒，耗散移除多余能量并将系统锁定于翻转态；由此确立铁电纳米电容器为可编程极性拓扑及低功耗、THz 速度耗散动力学调控的简单平台。

title: Synchronization and Spatiotemporal Phases in Driven Precessing Domain Walls
summary: The dynamics of extended magnetic domain walls driven by constant and alternating magnetic fields are studied using a collective coordinate $u$-$φ$ model. While purely constant-field driven systems exhibit deterministic spatiotemporal chaos and roughening, the alternating component can lock the precessional frequency via Shapiro-like steps. Using linear stability analysis and Floquet theory, the phase boundaries of stable, synchronized flat wall states are mapped. By studying the nonlinear dynamics of the extended system, a rich phase diagram is identified, composed of five dynamical regimes characterized by the combination of domain wall spatial order (flat, rough, or periodic) and domain wall precession temporal order (pinned, synchronized, or unsynchronized). Notably, the macroscopic temporal order of the synchronized phases can lead to a flat domain wall or to a periodic structure dominated by a narrow band of linearly unstable modes, both with coherent precession of the domain wall magnetization, while unsynchronized phases can be flat, with coherent precession, or rough with spatiotemporal chaos and incoherent precession.

AI.tldr: 该文基于集体坐标（collective coordinate）$u$-$\phi$ 模型，研究恒定场与交变场驱动的扩展磁畴壁（magnetic domain wall）动力学，揭示由空间序（平坦/粗糙/周期）与时间序（钉扎/同步/非同步）组合构成的五类动力学相。
AI.motivation: 扩展磁畴壁在恒定场驱动下呈现确定性时空混沌（spatiotemporal chaos）与粗糙化（roughening），而交变场分量可能通过类 Shapiro 台阶（Shapiro-like steps）锁定进动频率，其稳定同步态与非线性相图尚需系统刻画。
AI.method: 采用集体坐标 $u$-$\phi$ 模型描述畴壁动力学，并结合线性稳定性分析（linear stability analysis）与 Floquet 理论确定稳定同步平坦壁态的相边界，进一步通过扩展系统的非线性动力学数值分析构建相图。
AI.result: 识别出五个动力学区域，由畴壁空间序（平坦、粗糙、周期）与进动时间序（钉扎、同步、非同步）组合而成；同步相既可对应平坦畴壁，也可对应由窄带线性不稳定模主导的周期结构，二者均伴随畴壁磁化的一致进动（coherent precession）；非同步相可为平坦且一致进动，也可为粗糙且具时空混沌与非相干进动。
AI.conclusion: 宏观时间序（同步）并不唯一决定空间结构，同步与非同步相均可呈现平坦畴壁；时空混沌与粗糙化仅出现在非同步相中，表明类 Shapiro 锁定是抑制畴壁粗糙化的关键机制。

title: Many-Body Correlations in Phase-Space Microscopes
summary: The recently proposed "phase-space microscope" (PSM) extends quantum gas microscopes by allowing joint, single-shot measurements of position and momentum. We show that the $n$-body correlation functions constructed from such phase-space snapshots determine, in principle, all $n$-body observables of a many-body quantum state. This establishes phase-space imaging as a complete probe of strongly correlated matter, beyond what snapshots of position and momentum can provide---a limitation that goes back to a famous question posed by Pauli. Even without the full reconstruction of the density matrices, the PSM provides valuable insight into the quantum states. We demonstrate this power through several applications: witnessing entanglement hidden from both position and momentum, including between spatially separated collective degrees of freedom; resolving pairing structure across the BEC-BCS crossover, including the phase of the pair wavefunction and the reconstruction of its two-body Wigner function; probing inhomogeneous systems and preformed pairs without long-range order, relevant to the pseudogap phase; extracting the interaction energy in a magnetic field; and measurements of the local Chern marker. Furthermore, we discuss phase imprinting in the matter-wave Fourier plane as an alternative method for probing time-reversal-symmetry-broken phases such as chiral $p$-wave superconductors. Together, these results establish the PSM as a versatile new tool for exploring fundamental features of quantum many-body phases in strongly correlated quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 相空间显微镜（phase-space microscope, PSM）通过单次联合测量位置与动量，其相空间快照构建的 $n$-体关联函数原则上可确定多体量子态的全部 $n$-体可观测量，从而成为强关联物质的完备探针，并在纠缠见证、配对结构、赝能隙及陈数标记等方向展示应用价值。
AI.motivation: 传统量子气体显微镜只能快照位置或动量，二者单独均无法完整刻画量子态，这一局限可追溯至 Pauli 提出的著名问题；因此需要一种能联合测量位置与动量的探针手段。
AI.method: 利用新近提出的相空间显微镜在单次测量中同时获得位置与动量信息，并由相空间快照构建 $n$-体关联函数（$n$-body correlation functions）；此外讨论了在物质波傅里叶平面（matter-wave Fourier plane）进行相位印记（phase imprinting）的替代方案。
AI.result: 即使不完整重构密度矩阵，PSM 也能：见证位置与动量均无法显现的纠缠（包括空间分离的集体自由度之间的纠缠）；解析 BEC-BCS 交叉（BEC-BCS crossover）中的配对结构，包括配对波函数相位与两体 Wigner 函数（Wigner function）重构；探测无长程序的非均匀系统与预配对，关联赝能隙（pseudogap）相；提取磁场中的相互作用能；测量局域陈数标记（local Chern marker）。
AI.conclusion: 相空间成像被确立为强关联物质的一种完备探针，PSM 可作为探索强关联量子物质中量子多体相基本特征的多用途新工具。

title: Exact fermionic matrix elements from the Bethe-ansatz solution of the Richardson-Gaudin model
summary: We introduce an effective Hamiltonian description of mesoscopic superconducting systems based on the Bethe-ansatz solution of the Richardson--Gaudin model. Our central result is a compact determinant formula for the matrix elements of fermionic creation and annihilation operators, expressed entirely in terms of eigenvalue-based variables. This formula allows single-electron tunneling terms to be represented directly in the eigenbasis of the Richardson--Gaudin model, extending the eigenvalue-based framework beyond overlaps and previously known form factors. As a benchmark, we apply the method to a superconducting Anderson impurity model comprising a quantum dot coupled to an ultrasmall superconducting grain. The resulting low-energy description, formulated naturally in the canonical ensemble, captures even-odd effects, subgap excitations, and quantum-dot physics. The same framework gives access to observables not previously computed for such grain-dot systems in the canonical ensemble, such as the fixed-particle-number optical conductivity and flux-tunable spectra.

AI.tldr: 该文基于Richardson–Gaudin模型（Richardson–Gaudin model）的Bethe-ansatz解，构造介观超导系统的有效哈密顿量（effective Hamiltonian）描述，并给出单粒子算符矩阵元的行列式公式，从而将单电子隧穿项直接表示在模型本征基中。
AI.motivation: 既有基于本征值变量的框架主要限于交叠积分（overlaps）与已知形状因子（form factors），缺乏对费米子产生湮灭算符矩阵元的紧凑表达，限制了对单电子隧穿等项的处理。
AI.method: 提出以本征值变量完全表达的费米子产生与湮灭算符矩阵元的紧凑行列式公式（determinant formula），使单电子隧穿项可在Richardson–Gaudin模型本征基（eigenbasis）中直接表示；并以量子点耦合超小超导颗粒的超导Anderson杂质模型（superconducting Anderson impurity model）为基准进行应用。
AI.result: 所得低能描述自然地在正则系综（canonical ensemble）中表述，能够刻画奇偶效应（even-odd effects）、亚能隙激发（subgap excitations）与量子点物理；并可计算此前未在该类颗粒-量子点系统中于正则系综下得到的可观测量，如固定粒子数光导率（optical conductivity）与磁通可调谱（flux-tunable spectra）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将基于本征值的框架扩展至单电子算符矩阵元，为介观超导系统提供紧凑且可计算的有效哈密顿量方法，并拓展了正则系综上可获得的物理量范围。

title: Characterisation of surface layers formed on plasma-facing components in controlled fusion devices: Role of heavy ion elastic recoil detection
summary: Wall components retrieved from the TEXTOR tokamak after tracer experiments with nitrogen-15 and molybdenum hexafluoride (MoF6) injection were studied to determine deposition patterns and, by this, to conclude on material migration. Toroidal limiter tiles made of carbon fibre composites and fine grain graphite were examined using time-of-flight heavy ion elastic recoil detection analysis. Molybdenum deposition patterns indicated migration based on erosion and prompt re-deposition. Nitrogen-15 was trapped together with the deposited molybdenum. Some information on the depth distribution of species in the top 400 nm layer of the limiters was obtained; however surface roughness of the samples strongly limited resolution. In the case of molybdenum, the largest concentration was found in the 100 nm outermost layer, whereas fluorine and nitrogen-15 displayed more irregular profiles. Other species, besides deuterium fuel and carbon-12, were also identified: boron-10 and boron-11 originating from boronisations, carbon-13 from earlier tracer experiments, nitrogen-14 from plasma edge cooling and metals eroded from the Inconel wall.

AI.tldr: 对TEXTOR托卡马克示踪实验后取回的石墨/碳纤维复合材料限制器瓦片进行飞行时间重离子弹性反冲探测分析（ToF heavy ion ERDA），以推断钼与氮-15的沉积模式及材料迁移行为。
AI.motivation: 通过氮-15与六氟化钼（MoF6）示踪注入实验后壁组件的沉积图案，推断托卡马克中的材料迁移（material migration）过程。
AI.method: 对环形限制器瓦片（碳纤维复合材料与细晶石墨）采用飞行时间重离子弹性反冲探测分析（time-of-flight heavy ion elastic recoil detection analysis），获取表层约400 nm内的元素种类与深度分布信息。
AI.result: 钼沉积图案表明其迁移由侵蚀与即时再沉积（prompt re-deposition）主导；氮-15与沉积钼共滞留。钼在100 nm最外层浓度最高，氟与氮-15的深度剖面较不规则；样品表面粗糙度严重限制深度分辨率。另检出硼-10/11（硼化处理）、碳-13（早期示踪实验）、氮-14（等离子体边缘冷却）及Inconel壁侵蚀金属。
AI.conclusion: 示踪元素的沉积与深度分布可用于推断材料迁移机制，但表面粗糙度是限制近表层深度分辨的主要因素；多种来源杂质元素的共存反映了壁处理与历史实验的累积影响。

title: A Topology-Based Approach to Representative Volume Element Assessment in Solid Oxide Cell Anodes Using Large Volume Tomography and Persistent Homology
summary: Determining the representative volume element is essential for establishing statistically meaningful microstructure-property relationships. Conventional approaches rely on the convergence of selected geometric descriptors, which may yield different estimates of the representative volume. Here, we propose a topology-based framework for assessing the representative scale of a nickel-yttria-stabilized zirconia solid oxide cell anode reconstructed using plasma focused ion beam-scanning electron microscopy (121.8 um x 83.97 um x 45.99 um). Persistent homology was used to characterize the pore network, and normalized persistence images of subvolumes were compared with those of the largest available reference volume using the L1 distance. This provides a continuous measure of topological similarity across observation scales, rather than defining representativeness through a single convergence threshold. The topological distance decreases with increasing volume and is described by empirical exponential models over the investigated range (R2 in [0.972, 0.983]). Comparison with porosity and specific surface area highlights differences in the scale-dependent behavior of geometric and topological descriptors. The framework was also tested on three independent synthetic realizations, demonstrating its potential for quantitative assessment of topological similarity in porous microstructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于拓扑的表征框架，利用持续同调（persistent homology）与归一化持续图像（persistence images）的L1距离，定量评估多孔微结构的代表性体积尺度，替代依赖单一几何描述子收敛阈值的传统做法。
AI.motivation: 确定代表性体积元（representative volume element）是建立具有统计意义的微结构—性能关系的前提，但传统方法依赖选定几何描述子的收敛，可能给出不同的代表性体积估计。
AI.method: 以等离子聚焦离子束—扫描电子显微镜（plasma focused ion beam-scanning electron microscopy）重建的镍—氧化钇稳定氧化锆固体氧化物电池阳极（121.8 μm × 83.97 μm × 45.99 μm）为对象，用持续同调刻画孔隙网络，计算子体积与最大参考体积归一化持续图像间的L1距离，并以经验指数模型拟合该距离随体积的变化，同时在三个独立合成实现上检验框架。
AI.result: 拓扑距离随体积增大而下降，在研究范围内可由经验指数模型描述（R² 处于 [0.972, 0.983]）；与孔隙率（porosity）和比表面积（specific surface area）的对比显示几何描述子与拓扑描述子的尺度依赖行为存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供跨观测尺度的连续拓扑相似性度量，而非以单一收敛阈值界定代表性；在合成样本上的测试表明其可用于多孔微结构拓扑相似性的定量评估。

title: Pressure-correlation phase diagram unraveling quantum phase transitions in altermagnetic $ε$-FeOOH and realization of piezo-anomalous Hall effect
summary: We establish a pressure-correlation phase diagram that yields multiple pressure-tunable quantum phase transitions in iron oxyhydroxide ($ε$-FeOOH) across three critical pressures, $P_{c1}>P_{c2}>P_{c3}$. The transitions arise from the competition among electron-correlation, crystal-field, and Hund's coupling. First-principles calculations reveal that the earlier reported high-spin (HS) to low-spin (LS) crossover at correlation-sensitive $P_{c1}$ is accompanied by a transition from charge-transfer to Mott insulating (CTI-MI) phase, and a change in the spin-quantization axis (SQA) from $\hat{y}$ to $\hat{x}$. The HS-LS crossover and CTI-MI transition is driven by the simultaneous increase in crystal-field splitting and decrease in Hund's coupling. The critical pressure $P_{c2}$ governing the structural transition from centrosymmetric $Pnnm$ phase to noncentrosymmetric $P2_1nm$ phase is found to be independent of electron-correlation. When correlation is strong, a third critical pressure ($P_{c3}$) emerges in the lower-pressure regime of the phase diagram. Validating the recent experimental observation, $P_{c3}$ is responsible for changing the SQA from $\hat{z}$ to $\hat{y}$. By exhibiting altermagnetism in both $P2_1nm$ and $Pnnm$ phases and possessing finite anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) only for SQA along $\hat{x}$ and $\hat{y}$, $ε$-FeOOH enables a unique piezo-anomalous Hall effect where one can switch on the AHC at a lower pressure and change its direction at a higher pressure.

AI.tldr: 该工作构建了压力–关联相图，揭示羟基氧化铁（ε-FeOOH）在三个临界压力下出现多个可压调控的量子相变（quantum phase transition），并预言其可通过自旋量子化轴（SQA）调控各向异性霍尔电导，实现压电–反常霍尔效应（piezo-anomalous Hall effect）。
AI.motivation: 电子关联（electron correlation）、晶体场（crystal field）与洪德耦合（Hund's coupling）的竞争如何在不同压力下驱动多种量子相变及自旋态转变，尚缺乏统一的相图描述，尤其是各临界压力的物理起源与关联依赖性问题。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）构建压力–关联相图，分析HS-LS跨越、电荷转移–莫特绝缘体（charge-transfer to Mott insulating, CTI-MI）相变、结构相变以及自旋量子化轴（spin-quantization axis）取向变化，并计算反常霍尔电导（anomalous Hall conductivity, AHC）。
AI.result: 发现P_c1处HS-LS跨越伴随CTI-MI相变及SQA由ŷ转向x̂，由晶体场劈裂增大与洪德耦合减弱共同驱动；P_c2对应的中心对称Pnnm到非中心对称P2₁nm结构相变不依赖电子关联；强关联时在低压区出现P_c3，使SQA由ẑ转向ŷ，验证了近期实验观测。两相均展现交错磁（altermagnetism），且仅在SQA沿x̂、ŷ时具有有限AHC。
AI.conclusion: ε-FeOOH可实现独特的压电–反常霍尔效应：较低压力下开启AHC，较高压力下改变其方向，显示出压力调控自旋态与拓扑输运耦合的潜力。

title: Mechano-chemical control of enzymatic activity in crowded environments
summary: Macromolecular crowding has long been known to alter biochemical equilibria and enzyme kinetics, with reported catalytic activities that may increase, decrease, or vary non-monotonically with crowder concentration. Classical Michaelis--Menten kinetics does not by itself identify which of these responses should occur for a conformationally active enzyme. Here, we develop a minimal non-equilibrium mechano-chemical theory for a fueled enzyme embedded in a bath of passive crowders and uncover a fluctuation-induced effective force dipole acting on the enzyme subunits, akin to a generalized form of dispersion or depletion interaction. Since the preferred conformation of the model enzyme varies through the catalytic cycle, the fluctuation-induced mechanical load affects the relevant kinetic activation barriers and is sufficient to produce both monotonic inhibition and non-monotonic modification of turnover. The framework provides a thermodynamically consistent route for linking crowded environments to catalytic currents, suggesting how mechanical design principles could be leveraged to control enzymatic pathways.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个极简的非平衡力学-化学（mechano-chemical）理论，描述驱动型酶（fueled enzyme）在被动拥挤剂（passive crowders）浴中的行为，揭示由涨落诱导的有效力偶极（effective force dipole），可统一解释对大分子拥挤（macromolecular crowding）下酶转换数（turnover）的单调抑制与非单调调控。
AI.motivation: 大分子拥挤已知会改变生化平衡与酶动力学（enzyme kinetics），实验报道的催化活性可随拥挤剂浓度升高而增加、降低或非单调变化；而经典米氏动力学（Michaelis–Menten kinetics）本身无法预测构象活跃酶（conformationally active enzyme）会出现哪种响应，缺乏统一的理论解释。
AI.method: 构建一个极简的非平衡力学-化学理论，将驱动型酶置于被动拥挤剂浴中，推导出作用于酶亚基（enzyme subunits）的涨落诱导有效力偶极，其形式类似推广的色散/耗竭相互作用（dispersion or depletion interaction）；由于模型酶的优势构象（preferred conformation）随催化循环（catalytic cycle）变化，该力学负载会调制相关动力学活化能垒（kinetic activation barriers）。
AI.result: 涨落诱导的力学负载足以同时产生对转换数的单调抑制（monotonic inhibition）与非单调修饰（non-monotonic modification），从而覆盖实验中观察到的多种响应类型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了将拥挤环境与催化电流（catalytic currents）联系起来的、热力学自洽（thermodynamically consistent）的路径，并提示可借助力学设计原理（mechanical design principles）调控酶促通路（enzymatic pathways）。

title: Establishing Néel order in the square-lattice antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model: a bootstrap proof
summary: Rigorously establishing spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) in the thermodynamic limit is generally challenging. This is exemplified by the two-dimensional (2D) $S = 1/2$ antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model where the existence of Néel order is not rigorously established despite overwhelming evidence from a variety of methods. We show that a bootstrap approach can be used to rigorously establish SSB and use it to prove the existence of Néel order in the 2D $S = 1/2$ XXZ model by deriving a strictly positive lower bound on the Néel order parameter for a set of discrete values of the anisotropy parameter $Δ$ in the range $[0,2]$ including the isotropic (Heisenberg) point $Δ= 1$. Our approach employs a generalization of the Kennedy--Lieb--Shastry inequalities, which use an infrared bound to reduce the existence of long-range order to bounds on certain finite-distance correlators. We compute these bounds for all sufficiently large systems with periodic boundary conditions using the bootstrap. An important ingredient in our proof is a novel method for obtaining exactly certified variational upper bounds on the energy density in the thermodynamic limit from matrix product states. Our approach can be readily generalized to other local lattice models for which infrared susceptibility bounds can be obtained.

AI.tldr: 论文利用自举方法（bootstrap）与推广的 Kennedy–Lieb–Shastry 不等式，对二维 $S=1/2$ XXZ 模型在热力学极限下严格证明了包括各向同性海森堡点 $\\Delta=1$ 在内的奈尔序（Néel order）存在，给出了序参量的严格正下界。
AI.motivation: 在热力学极限（thermodynamic limit）下严格证明自发对称破缺（spontaneous symmetry breaking, SSB）通常十分困难；二维 $S=1/2$ 反铁磁海森堡模型（antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model）虽已有大量证据支持奈尔序存在，却缺乏严格证明。
AI.method: 采用自举方法（bootstrap）严格确立 SSB：借助推广的 Kennedy–Lieb–Shastry 不等式，用红外界（infrared bound）将长程有序归结为有限距离关联函数（finite-distance correlators）的界，并对充分大的周期边界系统计算该界；同时提出由矩阵乘积态（matrix product states）得到热力学极限能量密度严格认证变分上界的新方法。
AI.result: 对 $[0,2]$ 区间内一组离散的各向异性参数 $\\Delta$（含海森堡点 $\\Delta=1$），导出奈尔序参量（Néel order parameter）的严格正下界，从而在这些取值上严格证明奈尔序存在。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可推广到其他能获得红外磁化率界（infrared susceptibility bounds）的局域晶格模型（local lattice models）。

title: Magnetic field as a tuning knob for edge mode interaction in integer quantum Hall interferometers
summary: The quantum Hall interferometer has been shown to be a powerful tool for probing both the nature of the chiral modes present at the edges of these systems and the interactions between them. Strong inter-edge mode interactions can lead the system into a regime where the period of the interferometer signal corresponds to an insertion of a half-quantum flux h/2e, rather than the standard flux quantum h/e. Using a highly tunable bilayer graphene device, we are able to measure the prevalence of both the h/e-period and the doubled-frequency regimes as a function of magnetic field, providing insight into the microscopic nature of the doubling mechanism. Furthermore, we are able to push our device to a regime where double-frequency oscillations coexist with a superimposed period-h/e pattern associated with the inner chiral modes farther from the edge. We argue that this regime has a natural interpretation in a picture of the frequency doubling being caused by strong capacitive couplings between the edge modes.

AI.tldr: 利用高度可调的双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene）量子霍尔干涉仪（quantum Hall interferometer），测量了 h/e 周期与倍频（doubled-frequency，对应 h/2e）区间随磁场的分布，并观察到倍频振荡与内层手性模（inner chiral modes）引起的 h/e 周期图案共存，支持倍频源于边缘模间强电容耦合（capacitive coupling）的解释。
AI.motivation: 量子霍尔干涉仪可探测边缘手性模（chiral modes）的性质及其相互作用；强边缘模间相互作用可使干涉信号周期由标准磁通量子 h/e 变为半磁通量子 h/2e，但其微观机制尚需澄清。
AI.method: 采用高度可调的双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene）器件构建干涉仪，在不同磁场下测量 h/e 周期与倍频（doubled-frequency）两种区间的出现情况，并将器件推至倍频振荡与 h/e 周期图案共存的参数区间。
AI.result: 测得 h/e 周期与倍频区间随磁场的分布规律，为倍频机制提供微观线索；并观察到倍频振荡与源自远离边缘的内层手性模（inner chiral modes）的 h/e 周期图案叠加共存。
AI.conclusion: 该共存区间可由边缘模之间强电容耦合（capacitive coupling）导致频率加倍（frequency doubling）的图像自然解释。

title: Membrane particle wrapping across methods and shapes
summary: Understanding the passive wrapping of adhesive particles by lipid membranes is a crucial step in untangling more complex endocytotic processes. However, despite the variety of computational approaches used to study passive endocytosis, a direct comparison of results across different modeling methods has never been performed. In this work, we present a comparative analysis of three distinct frameworks: numerical solutions of the axisymmetric membrane shape equation, a particle-based molecular dynamics model (MesoMem), and an energy-based triangulated surface model (FreeDTS). First, we validated our numerical solver for spherical particles against established literature and extended the implementation to include closed vesicle membranes and non-spherical particles. Next, we studied the same system with our two simulation methods, and found that the phase plots obtained from our numerical solution agree with those from our simulations. We then extended our study to anisotropic particles. By tracking engulfment pathways in MesoMem and FreeDTS, we observed a dynamic rotational transition where non-spherical particles initially bind in a horizontal ('submarine') orientation and subsequently rotate to a vertical ('rocket') orientation to complete wrapping - a behavior impossible to capture with standard axisymmetric models. Lastly, we considered the wrapping of soft vesicles with FreeDTS. Our simulations of a deformable, fixed-connectivity particle show that stronger adhesion promotes wrapping, whereas increasing membrane tension suppresses it. Complete engulfment is accompanied by a substantial reduction in particle volume, suggesting that particle compressibility provides an additional pathway for wrapping.

AI.tldr: 该文首次对三种研究被动胞吞（passive endocytosis）中膜包裹黏附颗粒的建模框架进行直接对比：轴对称膜形状方程数值解、基于粒子的分子动力学模型（MesoMem）与基于能量的三角网格表面模型（FreeDTS）。三种方法在相图（phase plot）上结果一致，并揭示非球形颗粒的动态旋转包裹路径与软颗粒可压缩性促进包裹的机制。
